verses.text: Bismil laahir-rahmaanir-raheem
Al hamdu lil laahi rabbil'aal ameen
Ar-rahmaanir-raheem
Maal iki yawmid-deen
'iyyaaka na'budu waiyyaaka nasta'een
Ahdinaas-siraatal mustaqeem
Siraatal lazeena 'an'amta 'al ayhim ghayril maghdoobi 'al ayhim wal aad-daal leen
Alif-Laaam-Meeem
Zaal ikal kitaabu laa rayba feehi huda llil muttaqeen
Al lazeena yu'minoona bil ghaybi wayuqeemoonas-sal aata wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
Wal lazeena yu'minoona bimaa 'unzil a 'il ayka wamaa 'unzil a min qablika wabil aakhirati hum yooqinoon
'ul aa'ika 'al aa huda mmir rrabbihim waul aa'ika humul muflihoon
'innal lazeena kafaru sawaa'un 'al ayhim 'aanzartahum 'am lam tunzirhum laa yu'minoon
Khatamal laahu 'al aa qul oobihim wa'al aa sam'ihim wa'al aa 'absaarihim ghishaawat wal ahum 'azaabun 'azeem
Waminan-naasi many yaqoolu 'aamannaa bil laahi wabil yawmil aakhiri wamaa hum bimu'mineen
Yukhaadi'oonal laaha wal lazeena 'aamanu wamaa yakhda'oona 'il laa 'anfusahum wamaa yash'uroon
Fee qul oobihim mmarad fazaadahumul laahu marada wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eemu bimaa kaanu yakziboon
Waizaa qeela lahum laa tufsidu fee al ardi qaal ooaa 'innamaa nahnu muslihoon
'al aa 'innahum humul mufsidoona wal aakil llaa yash'uroon
Waizaa qeela lahum 'aaminu kamaa 'aamanan-naasu qaal ooaa 'anu'minu kamaa 'aamanas-sufahaa'u 'al aa 'innahum humus-sufahaa'u wal aakil llaa ya'lamoon
Waizaa laqul lazeena 'aamanu qaal ooaa 'aamannaa waizaa khal awa 'il aa shayaateenihim qaal ooaa 'innaa ma'akum 'innamaa nahnu mustahzi'oon
Al laahu yastahzi'u bihim wayamudduhum fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon
'ul aa'ikal lazeenashtarawuad-dal aal ata bil hudaa famaa rabihat ttijaaratuhum wamaa kaanu muhtadeen
Mathal uhum kamathal il lazee astawqada naara fal ammaa 'adaa'at maa hawlahu zahabal laahu binoorihim watarakahum fee zul umaat llaa yubsiroon
Summu bukmun 'umy fahum laa yarji'oon
'aw kasayyib mminas-samaa'i feehi zul umaat wara'd wabarq yaj'al oona 'asaabi'ahum feeaa 'aazaanihim mminas-sawaa'iqi hazaral mawti wal laahu muheetu bil kaafireen
Yakaadul barqu yakhtafu 'absaarahum kul lamaa 'adaa'a lahum mmashawa feehi waizaa 'azlama 'al ayhim qaamu wal aw shaa'al laahu lazahaba bisam'ihim waabsaarihim 'innal laaha 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
Yayyuhaan-naasu'budu rabbakumul lazee khal aqakum wal lazeena min qablikum la'al lakum tattaqoon
Al lazee ja'al a lakumul arda firaasha was-samaa'a binaa' waanzal a minas-samaa'i maa' faakhraja bihi minath-thamaraati rizqa llakum fal aa taj'al u lil laahi 'andaada waantum ta'lamoon
Wain kuntum fee rayb mmimmaa nazzal naa 'al aa 'abdinaa fatu bisoorat mmim mmithlihi wad'u shuhadaa'akum mmin doonil laahi 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Fail llam taf'al u wal an taf'al u fattaqun-naaral latee waqooduhaan-naasu wal hijaaratu 'u'iddat lil kaafireen

Wabashshiril lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati 'anna lahum jannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru kul lamaa ruziqu minhaa min thamarat rrizqa qaal u haazaal lazee ruziqnaa min qablu wautu bihi mutashaabiha wal ahum feehaa 'azwaaj mmutahharat wahum feehaa khaal idoon

'innal laaha laa yastahyiaa 'any yadriba mathal a mmaa ba'oodat famaa fawqahaa faammaal lazeena 'aamanu faya'lamoona 'annahul haqqu mir rrabbihim waammaal lazeena kafaru fayaqooloona maazaa 'araadal laahu bihaazaa mathal a yudil lu bihi katheera wayahdee bihi katheera wamaa yudil lu bihiaa 'il laal faasiqeen
Al lazeena yanqudoona 'ahdal laahi mim ba'di meethaaqihi wayaqta'oona maa 'amaral laahu bihiaa 'any yoosal a wayufsidoona fee al ardi 'ul aa'ika humul khaasiroon
Kayfa takfuroona bil laahi wakuntum 'amwaata faahyaakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum thumma 'il ayhi turja'oon
Hooal lazee khal aqa lakum mmaa fee al ardi jamee'a thummastawaa 'il aas-samaa'i fasawwaahunna sab'a samaawaat wahooa bikul li shay'in 'al eem

Waiz qaal a rabbuka lil mal aa'ikati 'innee jaa'il fee al ardi khal eefat qaal ooaa 'ataj'al u feehaa many yufsidu feehaa wayasfikud-dimaa'a wanahnu nusabbihu bihamdika wanuqaddisu laka qaal a 'inneeaa 'a'lamu maa laa ta'lamoon
Wa'al lama 'aadamal asmaa'a kul laahaa thumma 'aradahum 'al aal mal aa'ikati faqaal a 'anbioonee biasmaa'i haa'ul aa'i 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Qaal u subhaanaka laa 'il ma lanaa 'il laa maa 'al lamtanaa 'innaka 'antal'al eemul hakeem
Qaal a yaadamu 'anbi'hum biasmaa'ihim fal ammaa 'anbaahum biasmaa'ihim qaal a 'al am 'aqul-lakum 'inneeaa 'a'lamu ghaybas-samaawaati wal ardi waa'lamu maa tubdoona wamaa kuntum taktumoon
Waiz qul naa lil mal aa'ikatisjudu liaadama fasajadooaa 'il laa 'ibleesa 'abaa wastakbara wakaana minal kaafireen
Waqul naa yaadamuskun 'anta wazawjukal jannata wakul aa minhaa raghadana haythu shi'tumaa wal aa taqrabaa haazihish-shajarata fatakoonaa minaz-zaal imeen
Faazal laahumaash-shaytaanu 'anhaa faakhrajahumaa mimmaa kaanaa feehi waqul naahbitu ba'dukum liba'din 'adoow wal akum fee al ardi mustaqarr wamataa'un 'il aa heen
Fatal aqqaa 'aadamu mir rrabbihi kal imaat fataaba 'al ayhi 'innahu hooat-tawwaabur-raheem
Qul naahbitu minhaa jamee'a faimmaa yateeannakum mminnee huda faman tabi'a hudaya fal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
Wal lazeena kafaru wakazzabu biayaatinaa 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabun-naari hum feehaa khaal idoon
Yaabaneeaa 'israa'eelazkuru ni'mateeal lateeaa 'an'amtu 'al aykum waawfu bi'ahdeeaa 'oofi bi'ahdikum waiyyaya farhaboon
Wa'aaminu bimaa 'anzal tu musaddiqa llimaa ma'akum wal aa takoonooaa 'awwal a kaafiri bihi wal aa tashtaru biayaatee thamana qal eela waiyyaya fattaqoon
Wal aa tal bisul haqqa bil baatil i wataktumul haqqa waantum ta'lamoon
Waaqeemus-sal aata wa'aatuz-zakaata warka'u ma'ar-raaki'een
'atamuroonan-naasa bil birri watansawna 'anfusakum waantum tatloonal kitaaba 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Wasta'eenu bis-sabri was-sal aati wainnahaa lakabeeratun 'il laa 'al aal khaashi'een
Al lazeena yazunnoona 'annahum mmul aaqu rabbihim waannahum 'il ayhi raaji'oon
Yaabaneeaa 'israa'eelazkuru ni'mateeal lateeaa 'an'amtu 'al aykum waannee faddal tukum 'al aal'aal ameen
Wattaqu yawma llaa tajzee nafsun 'an nnafs shaya wal aa yuqbal u minhaa shafaa'at wal aa yu'khazu minhaa 'adl wal aa hum yunsaroon
Waiz najjaynaakum mmin 'aal i fir'awna yasoomoonakum sooaa'al'azaabi yuzabbihoona 'abnaa'akum wayastahyoona nisaa'akum wafee zaal ikum bal aa' mmir rrabbikum 'azeem
Waiz faraqnaa bikumul bahra faanjaynaakum waaghraqnaa 'aal a fir'awna waantum tanzuroon
Waiz waa'adnaa moosaa 'arba'eena laylat thummattakhaztumul'ijla mim ba'dihi waantum zaal imoon
Thumma 'afawnaa 'ankum mmim ba'di zaal ika la'al lakum tashkuroon
Waiz 'aataynaa moosaal kitaaba wal furqaana la'al lakum tahtadoon

Waiz qaal a moosaa liqawmihi yaaqawmi 'innakum zal amtum 'anfusakum bittikhaazikumul'ijla fatoobooaa 'il aa baari'ikum faqtul ooaa 'anfusakum zaal ikum khayr llakum 'inda baari'ikum fataaba 'al aykum 'innahu hooat-tawwaabur-raheem
Waiz qul tum yaamoosaa lan nnu'mina laka hattaa naraal laaha jahrat faakhazatkumus-saa'iqatu waantum tanzuroon
Thumma ba'athnaakum mmim ba'di mawtikum la'al lakum tashkuroon
Wazal lal naa 'al aykumul ghamaama waanzal naa 'al aykumul manna was-sal waa kul u min tayyibaati maa razaqnaakum wamaa zal amoonaa wal aakin kaanooaa 'anfusahum yazlimoon
Waiz qul naadkhul u haazihil qaryata fakul u minhaa haythu shi'tum raghada wadkhul ul baaba sujjada waqoolu hittat nnaghfir lakum khatayaakum wasanazeedul muhsineen
Fabaddal al lazeena zal amu qawlana ghayral lazee qeela lahum faanzal naa 'al aal lazeena zal amu rijza mminas-samaa'i bimaa kaanu yafsuqoon

Waizistasqaa moosaa liqawmihi faqul naadrib bbi'asaakal hajara fanfajarat minhuthnataa 'ashrata 'ayna qad 'al ima kul lu 'unaas mmashrabahum kul u washrabu mir rrizqil laahi wal aa ta'thawa fee al ardi mufsideen

Waiz qul tum yaamoosaa lan nnasbira 'al aa ta'aam waahid fad'u lanaa rabbaka yukhrij lanaa mimmaa tunbitul ardu mim baqlihaa waqiththaa'ihaa wafoomihaa wa'adasihaa wabasal ihaa qaal a 'atastabdil oonal lazee hooa 'adnaa bil lazee hooa khayrun ahbitu misra fainna lakum mmaa saal tum waduribat 'al ayhimuz-zil latu wal maskanatu wabaa'oo bighadab mminal laahi zaal ika biannahum kaanu yakfuroona biayaatil laahi wayaqtul oonan-nabeeyina bighayril haqqi zaal ika bimaa 'asa wwakaanu ya'tadoon

'innal lazeena 'aamanu wal lazeena haadu wan-nasaaraa was-saabieena man 'aamana bil laahi wal yawmil aakhiri wa'amil a saal iha fal ahum 'ajruhum 'inda rabbihim wal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
Waiz 'akhaznaa meethaaqakum warafa'naa fawqakumut-toora khuzu maa 'aataynaakum biqoowat wazkuru maa feehi la'al lakum tattaqoon
Thumma tawal laytum mmim ba'di zaal ika fal awlaa fadlul laahi 'al aykum warahmatuhu lakuntum mminal khaasireen
Wal aqad 'al imtumul lazeena'tadawa minkum fee as-sabti faqul naa lahum koonu qiradatan khaasieen
Faja'al naahaa nakaal a llimaa bayna yadayhaa wamaa khal fahaa wamaw'izat llil muttaqeen
Waiz qaal a moosaa liqawmihiaa 'innal laaha yamurukum 'an tazbahu baqarat qaal ooaa 'atattakhizunaa huzooa qaal a 'a'oozu bil laahi 'an 'akoona minal jaahil een
Qaal ud'u lanaa rabbaka yubayyil llanaa maa heea qaal a 'innahu yaqoolu 'innahaa baqarat llaa faarid wal aa bikrun 'awaanu bayna zaal ika faf'al u maa tu'maroon
Qaal ud'u lanaa rabbaka yubayyil llanaa maa lawnuhaa qaal a 'innahu yaqoolu 'innahaa baqarat safraa'u faaqi' llawnuhaa tasurrun-naazireen
Qaal ud'u lanaa rabbaka yubayyil llanaa maa heea 'innal baqara tashaabaha 'al aynaa wainnaa 'in shaa'al laahu lamuhtadoon
Qaal a 'innahu yaqoolu 'innahaa baqarat llaa zal ool tutheerul arda wal aa tasqee al hartha musal lamat llaa sheeata feehaa qaal ul aana ji'ta bil haqqi fazabahoohaa wamaa kaadu yaf'al oon
Waiz qatal tum nafsa faddaaraa'tum feehaa wal laahu mukhrij mmaa kuntum taktumoon
Faqul naadriboohu biba'dihaa kazaal ika yuhyil laahul mawtaa wayureekum 'ayaatihi la'al lakum ta'qil oon

Thumma qasat qul oobukum mmim ba'di zaal ika faheea kal hijaarati 'aw 'ashaddu qaswat wainna minal hijaarati lamaa yatafajjaru minhul anhaaru wainna minhaa lamaa yashshaqqaqu fayakhruju minhul maa'u wainna minhaa lamaa yahbitu min khashyatil laahi wamaal laahu bighaafil in 'ammaa ta'mal oon
'afatatma'oona 'any yu'minu lakum waqad kaana fareeq mminhum yasma'oona kal aamal laahi thumma yuharrifoonahu mim ba'di maa 'aqal oohu wahum ya'lamoon
Waizaa laqul lazeena 'aamanu qaal ooaa 'aamannaa waizaa khal aa ba'duhum 'il aa ba'd qaal ooaa 'atuhaddithoonahum bimaa fatahal laahu 'al aykum leeuhaajjookum bihi 'inda rabbikum 'afal aa ta'qil oon
'awal aa ya'lamoona 'annal laaha ya'lamu maa yusirroona wamaa yu'linoon
Waminhum 'ummeeyoona laa ya'lamoonal kitaaba 'il laa 'amaaniyya wain hum 'il laa yazunnoon
Fawayl llil lazeena yaktuboonal kitaaba biaydeehim thumma yaqooloona haazaa min 'indil laahi leeashtaru bihi thamana qal eela fawayl llaahum mmimmaa katabat 'aydeehim wawayl llaahum mmimmaa yaksiboon
Waqaal u lan tamassanaan-naaru 'il laa 'ayyaama mma'doodat qul 'attakhaztum 'indal laahi 'ahda fal any yukhlifal laahu 'ahdahuaa 'am taqooloona 'al aal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Bal aa man kasaba sayyi'at waahaatat bihi khateeaatuhu faul aa'ika 'ashaabun-naari hum feehaa khaal idoon
Wal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabul jannati hum feehaa khaal idoon

Waiz 'akhaznaa meethaaqa baneeaa 'israa'eela laa ta'budoona 'il laal laaha wabil waal idayni 'ihsaana wazee al qurbaa wal yataamaa wal masaakeeni waqoolu lin-naasi husna waaqeemus-sal aata wa'aatuz-zakaata thumma tawal laytum 'il laa qal eela mminkum waantum mmu'ridoon
Waiz 'akhaznaa meethaaqakum laa tasfikoona dimaa'akum wal aa tukhrijoona 'anfusakum mmin deeaarikum thumma 'aqrartum waantum tashhadoon

Thumma 'antum haa'ul aa'i taqtul oona 'anfusakum watukhrijoona fareeqa mminkum mmin deeaarihim tazaaharoona 'al ayhim bil ithmi wal'udwaani wainy yatookum 'usaaraa tufaadoohum wahooa muharramun 'al aykum 'ikhraajuhum 'afatu'minoona biba'dil kitaabi watakfuroona biba'd famaa jazaa'u many yaf'al u zaal ika minkum 'il laa khizy fee al hayawaatid-dunyaa wayawmal qeeaamati yuraddoona 'il aa 'ashaddil'azaabi wamaal laahu bighaafil in 'ammaa ta'mal oon
'ul aa'ikal lazeenashtarawual hayawaatad-dunyaa bil aakhirati fal aa yukhaffafu 'anhumul'azaabu wal aa hum yunsaroon

Wal aqad 'aataynaa moosaal kitaaba waqaffaynaa mim ba'dihi bir-rusul i wa'aataynaa 'eesaabna maryamal bayyinaati wayyadnaahu biroohil qudusi 'afakul lamaa jaa'akum rasoolu bimaa laa tahwaa 'anfusukumustakbartum fafareeqa kazzabtum wafareeqa taqtul oon
Waqaal u qul oobunaa ghul fu bal-la'anahumul laahu bikufrihim faqal eela mmaa yu'minoon

Wal ammaa jaa'ahum kitaab mmin 'indil laahi musaddiq llimaa ma'ahum wakaanu min qablu yastaftihoona 'al aal lazeena kafaru fal ammaa jaa'ahum mmaa 'arafu kafaru bihi fal a'natul laahi 'al aal kaafireen

Bi'samaashtarawa bihiaa 'anfusahum 'any yakfuru bimaa 'anzal al laahu baghyana 'any yunazzil al laahu min fadlihi 'al aa many yashaa'u min 'ibaadihi fabaa'oo bighadabin 'al aa ghadab wal il kaafireena 'azaab mmuheen

Waizaa qeela lahum 'aaminu bimaa 'anzal al laahu qaal u nu'minu bimaa 'unzil a 'al aynaa wayakfuroona bimaa waraa'ahu wahooal haqqu musaddiqa llimaa ma'ahum qul fal ima taqtul oona 'anbeeaa'al laahi min qablu 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
Wal aqad jaa'akum mmoosaa bil bayyinaati thummattakhaztumul'ijla mim ba'dihi waantum zaal imoon

Waiz 'akhaznaa meethaaqakum warafa'naa fawqakumut-toora khuzu maa 'aataynaakum biqoowat wasma'u qaal u sami'naa wa'asaynaa waushribu fee qul oobihimul'ijla bikufrihim qul bi'samaa yamurukum bihiaa 'eemaanukum 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
Qul 'in kaanat lakumud-daarul aakhiratu 'indal laahi khaal isat mmin doonin-naasi fatamannawual mawta 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Wal any yatamannawhu 'abadaa bimaa qaddamat 'aydeehim wal laahu 'al eemu biz-zaal imeen

Wal atajidannahum 'ahrasan-naasi 'al aa hayawaat waminal lazeena 'ashraku yawaddu 'ahaduhum law yu'ammaru 'al fa sanat wamaa hooa bimuzahzihihi minal'azaabi 'any yu'ammara wal laahu baseeru bimaa ya'mal oon
Qul man kaana 'adoowa llijibreela fainnahu nazzal ahu 'al aa qal bika biiznil laahi musaddiqa llimaa bayna yadayhi wahuda wabushraa lil mu'mineen
Man kaana 'adoowa llil laahi wamal aa'ikatihi warusul ihi wajibreela wameekaal a fainnal laaha 'adoow llil kaafireen
Wal aqad 'anzal naa 'il ayka 'ayaati bayyinaat wamaa yakfuru bihaa 'il laal faasiqoon
'awakul lamaa 'aahadu 'ahda nnabazahu fareeq mminhum bal 'aktharuhum laa yu'minoon
Wal ammaa jaa'ahum rasool mmin 'indil laahi musaddiq llimaa ma'ahum nabaza fareeq mminal lazeena 'ootul kitaaba kitaabal laahi waraa'a zuhoorihim kaannahum laa ya'lamoon

Wattaba'u maa tatlush-shayaateenu 'al aa mul ki sul aymaana wamaa kafara sul aymaanu wal aakinnash-shayaateena kafaru yu'al limoonan-naasas-sihra wamaa 'unzil a 'al aal mal akayni bibaabil a haaroota wamaaroota wamaa yu'al limaani min 'ahadin hattaa yaqoolaa 'innamaa nahnu fitnat fal aa takfur fayata'al lamoona minhumaa maa yufarriqoona bihi baynal mar'i wazawjihi wamaa hum bidaarreena bihi min 'ahadin 'il laa biiznil laahi wayata'al lamoona maa yadurruhum wal aa yanfa'uhum wal aqad 'al imu lamanishtaraahu maa lahu fee al aakhirati min khal aaq wal abi'sa maa sharawa bihiaa 'anfusahum law kaanu ya'lamoon
Wal aw 'annahum 'aamanu wattaqawa lamathoobat mmin 'indil laahi khayr llaw kaanu ya'lamoon
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa taqoolu raa'inaa waqoolunzurnaa wasma'u wal il kaafireena 'azaabun 'al eem
Mmaa yawaddul lazeena kafaru min 'ahlil kitaabi wal aal mushrikeena 'any yunazzal a 'al aykum mmin khayr mmir rrabbikum wal laahu yakhtassu birahmatihi many yashaa'u wal laahu zoo al fadlil'azeem
Maa nansakh min 'ayatin 'aw nunsihaa nati bikhayr mminhaa 'aw mithlihaa 'al am ta'lam 'annal laaha 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
'al am ta'lam 'annal laaha lahu mul kus-samaawaati wal ardi wamaa lakum mmin doonil laahi minw wal eey wal aa naseer
'am tureedoona 'an tasal u rasoolakum kamaa su'il a moosaa min qablu wamany yatabaddal il kufra bil eemaani faqad dal la sawaa'as-sabeel

Wadda katheer mmin 'ahlil kitaabi law yaruddoonakum mmim ba'di 'eemaanikum kuffaarana hasada mmin 'indi 'anfusihim mmim ba'di maa tabayyana lahumul haqqu fa'fu wasfahu hattaa yateeal laahu biamrihiaa 'innal laaha 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
Waaqeemus-sal aata wa'aatuz-zakaata wamaa tuqaddimu lianfusikum mmin khayr tajidoohu 'indal laahi 'innal laaha bimaa ta'mal oona baseer
Waqaal u lany yadkhul al jannata 'il laa man kaana hoodana 'aw nasaaraa til ka 'amaaneeyuhum qul haatu burhaanakum 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Bal aa man 'aslama wajhahu lil laahi wahooa muhsin fal ahuaa 'ajruhu 'inda rabbihi wal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon

Waqaal atil yahoodu laysatin-nasaaraa 'al aa shay' waqaal atin-nasaaraa laysatil yahoodu 'al aa shay' wahum yatloonal kitaaba kazaal ika qaal al lazeena laa ya'lamoona mithla qawlihim fal laahu yahkumu baynahum yawmal qeeaamati feemaa kaanu feehi yakhtal ifoon

Waman 'azlamu mimmam mmana'a masaajidal laahi 'any yuzkara feehaasmuhu wasa'aa fee kharaabihaa 'ul aa'ika maa kaana lahum 'any yadkhul oohaa 'il laa khaa'ifeena lahum fee ad-dunyaa khizy wal ahum fee al aakhirati 'azaabun 'azeem
Wal il laahil mashriqu wal maghribu faynamaa tooal lu fathamma wajhul laahi 'innal laaha waasi'un 'al eem
Waqaal uttakhazal laahu wal ada subhaanahu bal-laahu maa fee as-samaawaati wal ardi kul l llaahu qaanitoon
Badee'us-samaawaati wal ardi waizaa qadaa 'amra fainnamaa yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoon
Waqaal al lazeena laa ya'lamoona lawlaa yukal limunaal laahu 'aw tateenaa 'ayat kazaal ika qaal al lazeena min qablihim mmithla qawlihim tashaabahat qul oobuhum qad bayyannaal ayaati liqawm yooqinoon
'innaa 'arsal naaka bil haqqi basheera wanazeera wal aa tusal u 'an 'ashaabil jaheem

Wal an tardaa 'ankal yahoodu wal aan-nasaaraa hattaa tattabi'a mil latahum qul 'inna hudaal laahi hooal hudaa wal a'inittaba'ta 'ahwaa'ahum ba'dal lazee jaa'aka minal'il mi maa laka minal laahi minw wal eey wal aa naseer
Al lazeena 'aataynaahumul kitaaba yatloonahu haqqa til aawatihiaa 'ul aa'ika yu'minoona bihi wamany yakfur bihi faul aa'ika humul khaasiroon
Yaabaneeaa 'israa'eelazkuru ni'mateeal lateeaa 'an'amtu 'al aykum waannee faddal tukum 'al aal'aal ameen
Wattaqu yawma llaa tajzee nafsun 'an nnafs shaya wal aa yuqbal u minhaa 'adl wal aa tanfa'uhaa shafaa'at wal aa hum yunsaroon
Waizibtal aa 'ibraahima rabbuhu bikal imaat faatammahunna qaal a 'innee jaa'il uka lin-naasi 'imaama qaal a wamin zurriyyatee qaal a laa yanaal u 'ahdee az-zaal imeen

Waiz ja'al naal bayta mathaabat llin-naasi waamna wattakhizu mim mmaqaami 'ibraahima musal la wa'ahidnaa 'il aa 'ibraahima waismaa'eela 'an tahhiraa bayteea lit-taa'ifeena wal'aakifeena war-rukka'is-sujood

Waiz qaal a 'ibraahimu rabbij'al haazaa bal adana 'aamina warzuq 'ahlahu minath-thamaraati man 'aamana minhum bil laahi wal yawmil aakhiri qaal a waman kafara faumatti'uhu qal eela thumma 'adtarruhuaa 'il aa 'azaabin-naari wabi'sal maseer
Waiz yarfa'u 'ibraahimul qawaa'ida minal bayti waismaa'eelu rabbanaa taqabbal minnaa 'innaka 'antas-samee'ul'al eem
Rabbanaa waj'al naa muslimayni laka wamin zurriyyatinaa 'ummat mmuslimat llaka waarinaa manaasikanaa watub 'al aynaa 'innaka 'antat-tawwaabur-raheem
Rabbanaa wab'ath feehim rasoola mminhum yatlu 'al ayhim 'ayaatika wayu'al limuhumul kitaaba wal hikmata wayuzakkeehim 'innaka 'antal'azeezul hakeem
Wamany yarghabu 'am mmil lati 'ibraahima 'il laa man safiha nafsahu wal aqadistafaynaahu fee ad-dunyaa wainnahu fee al aakhirati laminas-saal iheen
'iz qaal a lahu rabbuhuaa 'aslim qaal a 'aslamtu lirabbil'aal ameen
Wawassaa bihaa 'ibraahimu baneehi waya'qoobu yaabaniyya 'innal laahastafaa lakumud-deena fal aa tamootunna 'il laa waantum mmuslimoon

'am kuntum shuhadaa'a 'iz hadara ya'qoobal mawtu 'iz qaal a libaneehi maa ta'budoona mim ba'dee qaal u na'budu 'il aahaka wail aaha 'aabaa'ika 'ibraahima waismaa'eela waishaaqa 'il aaha waahida wanahnu lahu muslimoon
Til ka 'ummat qad khal at lahaa maa kasabat wal akum mmaa kasabtum wal aa tusal oona 'ammaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Waqaal u koonu hoodana 'aw nasaaraa tahtadu qul bal mil lata 'ibraahima haneefa wamaa kaana minal mushrikeen

Qoolooaa 'aamannaa bil laahi wamaa 'unzil a 'il aynaa wamaa 'unzil a 'il aa 'ibraahima waismaa'eela waishaaqa waya'qooba wal asbaati wamaa 'ooteea moosaa wa'eesaa wamaa 'ooteean-nabeeyoona mir rrabbihim laa nufarriqu bayna 'ahad mminhum wanahnu lahu muslimoon
Fain 'aamanu bimithli maa 'aamantum bihi faqadihtada wwain tawal lawa fainnamaa hum fee shiqaaq fasayakfeekahumul laahu wahooas-samee'ul'al eem
Sibghatal laahi waman 'ahsanu minal laahi sibghat wanahnu lahu 'aabidoon
Qul 'atuhaajjoonanaa fee al laahi wahooa rabbunaa warabbukum wal anaa 'a'maal unaa wal akum 'a'maal ukum wanahnu lahu mukhlisoon

'am taqooloona 'inna 'ibraahima waismaa'eela waishaaqa waya'qooba wal asbaata kaanu hoodana 'aw nasaaraa qul 'aantum 'a'lamu 'amil laahu waman 'azlamu mimman katama shahaadatan 'indahu minal laahi wamaal laahu bighaafil in 'ammaa ta'mal oon
Til ka 'ummat qad khal at lahaa maa kasabat wal akum mmaa kasabtum wal aa tusal oona 'ammaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Sayaqoolus-sufahaa'u minan-naasi maa wal laahum 'an qiblatihimul latee kaanu 'al ayhaa qul-lil laahil mashriqu wal maghribu yahdee many yashaa'u 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem

Wakazaal ika ja'al naakum 'ummat wasata llitakoonu shuhadaa'a 'al aan-naasi wayakoonar-rasoolu 'al aykum shaheeda wamaa ja'al naal qiblatal latee kunta 'al ayhaa 'il laa lina'lama many yattabi'ur-rasoola mimmany yanqal ibu 'al aa 'aqibayhi wain kaanat lakabeeratan 'il laa 'al aal lazeena hadaal laahu wamaa kaanal laahu leeudee'a 'eemaanakum 'innal laaha bin-naasi lara'oof rraheem

Qad naraa taqal luba wajhika fee as-samaa'i fal anooal leeannaka qiblat tardaahaa fawal li wajhaka shatral masjidil haraami wahaythu maa kuntum fawal lu wujoohakum shatrahu wainnal lazeena 'ootul kitaaba laya'lamoona 'annahul haqqu mir rrabbihim wamaal laahu bighaafil in 'ammaa ya'mal oon

Wal a'in 'ataytal lazeena 'ootul kitaaba bikul li 'ayat mmaa tabi'u qiblataka wamaa 'anta bitaabi' qiblatahum wamaa ba'duhum bitaabi' qiblata ba'd wal a'inittaba'ta 'ahwaa'ahum mmim ba'di maa jaa'aka minal'il mi 'innaka 'iza llaminaz-zaal imeen
Al lazeena 'aataynaahumul kitaaba ya'rifoonahu kamaa ya'rifoona 'abnaa'ahum wainna fareeqa mminhum layaktumoonal haqqa wahum ya'lamoon
Al haqqu mir rrabbika fal aa takoonanna minal mumtareen
Wal ikul l wijhatun hooa mooal leehaa fastabiqul khayraati 'ayna maa takoonu yati bikumul laahu jamee'ana 'innal laaha 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
Wamin haythu kharajta fawal li wajhaka shatral masjidil haraami wainnahu lal haqqu mir rrabbika wamaal laahu bighaafil in 'ammaa ta'mal oon

Wamin haythu kharajta fawal li wajhaka shatral masjidil haraami wahaythu maa kuntum fawal lu wujoohakum shatrahu li'al laa yakoona lin-naasi 'al aykum hujjatun 'il laal lazeena zal amu minhum fal aa takhshawhum wakhshawnee wal iutimma ni'matee 'al aykum wal a'al lakum tahtadoon
Kamaa 'arsal naa feekum rasoola mminkum yatlu 'al aykum 'ayaatinaa wayuzakkeekum wayu'al limukumul kitaaba wal hikmata wayu'al limukum mmaa lam takoonu ta'lamoon
Fazkurooneeaa 'azkurkum washkuru lee wal aa takfuroon
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanusta'eenu bis-sabri was-sal aati 'innal laaha ma'as-saabireen
Wal aa taqoolu limany yuqtal u fee sabeelil laahi 'amwaatu bal 'ahyaa' wal aakil llaa tash'uroon
Wal anablooannakum bishay' mminal khawfi wal joo'i wanaqs mminal amwaal i wal anfusi wath-thamaraati wabashshiris-saabireen
Al lazeena 'izaa 'asaabathum mmuseebat qaal ooaa 'innaa lil laahi wainnaa 'il ayhi raaji'oon
'ul aa'ika 'al ayhim sal awaat mmir rrabbihim warahmat waul aa'ika humul muhtadoon
'innas-safaa wal marwata min sha'aa'iril laahi faman hajjal bayta 'awi'tamara fal aa junaaha 'al ayhi 'any yattawwafa bihimaa waman tatawwa'a khayra fainnal laaha shaakirun 'al eem
'innal lazeena yaktumoona maa 'anzal naa minal bayyinaati wal hudaa mim ba'di maa bayyannaahu lin-naasi fee al kitaabi 'ul aa'ika yal'anuhumul laahu wayal'anuhumul laa'inoon
'il laal lazeena taabu waaslahu wabayyanu faul aa'ika 'atoobu 'al ayhim waanaat-tawwaabur-raheem
'innal lazeena kafaru wamaatu wahum kuffaarun 'ul aa'ika 'al ayhim la'natul laahi wal mal aa'ikati wan-naasi 'ajma'een
Khaal ideena feehaa laa yukhaffafu 'anhumul'azaabu wal aa hum yunzaroon
Wail aahukum 'il aah waahid llaa 'il aaha 'il laa hooar-rahmaanur-raheem

'inna fee khal qis-samaawaati wal ardi wakhtil aafil layli wan-nahaari wal ful kil latee tajree fee al bahri bimaa yanfa'un-naasa wamaa 'anzal al laahu minas-samaa'i mim mmaa' faahyaa bihil arda ba'da mawtihaa wabaththa feehaa min kul li daabbat watasreefir-reeaahi was-sahaabil musakhkhari baynas-samaa'i wal ardi layaat lliqawm ya'qil oon

Waminan-naasi many yattakhizu min doonil laahi 'andaada yuhibboonahum kahubbil laahi wal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'ashaddu hubba llil laahi wal aw yaraal lazeena zal amooaa 'iz yarawnal'azaaba 'annal qoowata lil laahi jamee'a waannal laaha shadeedul'azaab
'iz tabarraal lazeenattubi'u minal lazeenattaba'u waraawual'azaaba wataqatta'at bihimul asbaab
Waqaal al lazeenattaba'u law 'anna lanaa karrat fanatabarraa minhum kamaa tabarra'u minnaa kazaal ika yureehimul laahu 'a'maal ahum hasaraatin 'al ayhim wamaa hum bikhaarijeena minan-naar
Yayyuhaan-naasu kul u mimmaa fee al ardi hal aal a tayyiba wal aa tattabi'u khutooaatish-shaytaani 'innahu lakum 'adoow mmubeen
'innamaa yamurukum bis-sooaa'i wal fahshaa'i waan taqoolu 'al aal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Waizaa qeela lahumuttabi'u maa 'anzal al laahu qaal u bal nattabi'u maa 'al faynaa 'al ayhi 'aabaa'anaa 'awal aw kaana 'aabaa'uhum laa ya'qil oona shaya wal aa yahtadoon
Wamathal ul lazeena kafaru kamathal il lazee yan'iqu bimaa laa yasma'u 'il laa du'aa' wanidaa' summu bukmun 'umy fahum laa ya'qil oon
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu kul u min tayyibaati maa razaqnaakum washkuru lil laahi 'in kuntum 'iyyaahu ta'budoon
'innamaa harrama 'al aykumul maytata wad-dama wal ahmal khinzeeri wamaa 'uhil la bihi lighayril laahi famanidturra ghayra baagh wal aa 'aad fal aa 'ithma 'al ayhi 'innal laaha ghafoor rraheem

'innal lazeena yaktumoona maa 'anzal al laahu minal kitaabi wayashtaroona bihi thamana qal eelana 'ul aa'ika maa yakul oona fee butoonihim 'il laan-naara wal aa yukal limuhumul laahu yawmal qeeaamati wal aa yuzakkeehim wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eem
'ul aa'ikal lazeenashtarawuad-dal aal ata bil hudaa wal'azaaba bil maghfirati famaa 'asbarahum 'al aan-naar
Zaal ika biannal laaha nazzal al kitaaba bil haqqi wainnal lazeenakhtal afu fee al kitaabi lafee shiqaaqi ba'eed

Llaysal birra 'an tooal lu wujoohakum qibal al mashriqi wal maghribi wal aakinnal birra man 'aamana bil laahi wal yawmil aakhiri wal mal aa'ikati wal kitaabi wan-nabeeyina wa'aataal maal a 'al aa hubbihi zawee al qurbaa wal yataamaa wal masaakeena wabnas-sabeeli was-saa'il eena wafee ar-riqaabi waaqaamas-sal aata wa'aataaz-zakaata wal moofoona bi'ahdihim 'izaa 'aahadu was-saabireena fee al basaa'i wad-darraa'i waheenal basi 'ul aa'ikal lazeena sadaqu waul aa'ika humul muttaqoon

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu kutiba 'al aykumul qisaasu fee al qatlaal hurru bil hurri wal'abdu bil'abdi wal unthaa bil unthaa faman 'ufeea lahu min 'akheehi shay' fattibaa'u bil ma'roofi waadaa'un 'il ayhi biihsaan zaal ika takhfeef mmir rrabbikum warahmat famani'tadaa ba'da zaal ika fal ahu 'azaabun 'al eem
Wal akum fee al qisaasi hayawaat yaaoolee al al baabi la'al lakum tattaqoon
Kutiba 'al aykum 'izaa hadara 'ahadakumul mawtu 'in taraka khayranal wasiyyatu lil waal idayni wal aqrabeena bil ma'roofi haqqana 'al aal muttaqeen
Famam baddal ahu ba'da maa sami'ahu fainnamaa 'ithmuhu 'al aal lazeena yubaddil oonahuaa 'innal laaha samee'un 'al eem
Faman khaafa mim mmoos janafana 'aw 'ithma faaslaha baynahum fal aa 'ithma 'al ayhi 'innal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu kutiba 'al aykumus-seeaamu kamaa kutiba 'al aal lazeena min qablikum la'al lakum tattaqoon

'ayyaama mma'doodaat faman kaana minkum mmareedana 'aw 'al aa safar fa'iddat mmin 'ayyaamin 'ukhara wa'al aal lazeena yuteeqoonahu fidyat ta'aamu miskeen faman tatawwa'a khayra fahooa khayr llaahu waan tasoomu khayr llakum 'in kuntum ta'lamoon

Shahru ramadaanal lazeeaa 'unzil a feehil qur'aanu huda llin-naasi wabayyinaat mminal hudaa wal furqaani faman shahida minkumush-shahra fal yasumhu waman kaana mareedana 'aw 'al aa safar fa'iddat mmin 'ayyaamin 'ukhara yureedul laahu bikumul yusra wal aa yureedu bikumul'usra wal itukmil ul'iddata wal itukabbirul laaha 'al aa maa hadaakum wal a'al lakum tashkuroon
Waizaa saal aka 'ibaadee 'annee fainnee qareebun 'ujeebu da'watad-daa'i 'izaa da'aani fal yastajeebu lee wal yu'minu bee la'al laahum yarshudoon

'uhil la lakum laylatas-seeaamir-rafathu 'il aa nisaa'ikum hunna libaas llakum waantum libaas llaahunna 'al imal laahu 'annakum kuntum takhtaanoona 'anfusakum fataaba 'al aykum wa'afaa 'ankum fal aana baashiroohunna wabtaghu maa katabal laahu lakum wakul u washrabu hattaa yatabayyana lakumul khaytul abyadu minal khaytil aswadi minal fajri thumma 'atimmus-seeaama 'il aal layli wal aa tubaashiroohunna waantum 'aakifoona fee al masaajidi til ka hudoodul laahi fal aa taqraboohaa kazaal ika yubayyinul laahu 'ayaatihi lin-naasi la'al laahum yattaqoon
Wal aa takul ooaa 'amwaal akum baynakum bil baatil i watudlu bihaa 'il aal hukkaami litakul u fareeqa mmin 'amwaal in-naasi bil ithmi waantum ta'lamoon

Yasal oonaka 'anil ahil lati qul heea mawaaqeetu lin-naasi wal hajji wal aysal birru bian tatul buyoota min zuhoorihaa wal aakinnal birra manittaqaa watul buyoota min 'abwaabihaa wattaqul laaha la'al lakum tuflihoon
Waqaatil u fee sabeelil laahil lazeena yuqaatil oonakum wal aa ta'tadooaa 'innal laaha laa yuhibbul mu'tadeen

Waqtul oohum haythu thaqiftumoohum waakhrijoohum mmin haythu 'akhrajookum wal fitnatu 'ashaddu minal qatli wal aa tuqaatil oohum 'indal masjidil haraami hattaa yuqaatil ookum feehi fain qaatal ookum faqtul oohum kazaal ika jazaa'ul kaafireen
Fainintahawa fainnal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Waqaatil oohum hattaa laa takoona fitnat wayakoonad-deenu lil laahi fainintahawa fal aa 'udwaana 'il laa 'al aaz-zaal imeen
Ash-shahrul haraamu bish-shahril haraami wal hurumaatu qisaas famani'tadaa 'al aykum fa'tadu 'al ayhi bimithli maa'tadaa 'al aykum wattaqul laaha wa'lamooaa 'annal laaha ma'al muttaqeen
Waanfiqu fee sabeelil laahi wal aa tul qu biaydeekum 'il aat-tahlukati waahsinooaa 'innal laaha yuhibbul muhsineen

Waatimmul hajja wal'umrata lil laahi fain 'uhsirtum famaastaysara minal hadyi wal aa tahliqu ru'oosakum hattaa yablughal hadyu mahil laahu faman kaana minkum mmareedana 'aw bihiaa 'aza mmir rrasihi fafidyat mmin seeaamin 'aw sadaqatin 'aw nusuk faizaa 'amintum faman tamatta'a bil'umrati 'il aal hajji famaastaysara minal hadyi famal llam yajid faseeaamu thal aathati 'ayyaam fee al hajji wasab'atin 'izaa raja'tum til ka 'asharat kaamil at zaal ika limal llam yakun 'ahluhu haadiree al masjidil haraami wattaqul laaha wa'lamooaa 'annal laaha shadeedul'iqaab

Al hajju 'ashhur mma'loomaat faman farada feehinnal hajja fal aa rafatha wal aa fusooqa wal aa jidaal a fee al hajji wamaa taf'al u min khayr ya'lamhul laahu watazawwadu fainna khayraz-zaadit-taqwaa wattaqooni yaaoolee al al baab
Laysa 'al aykum junaahun 'an tabtaghu fadla mmir rrabbikum faizaa 'afadtum mmin 'arafaat fazkurul laaha 'indal mash'aril haraami wazkuroohu kamaa hadaakum wain kuntum mmin qablihi laminad-daal leen
Thumma 'afeedu min haythu 'afaadan-naasu wastaghfirul laaha 'innal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Faizaa qadaytum mmanaasikakum fazkurul laaha kazikrikum 'aabaa'akum 'aw 'ashadda zikra faminan-naasi many yaqoolu rabbanaa 'aatinaa fee ad-dunyaa wamaa lahu fee al aakhirati min khal aaq
Waminhum mmany yaqoolu rabbanaa 'aatinaa fee ad-dunyaa hasanat wafee al aakhirati hasanat waqinaa 'azaaban-naar
'ul aa'ika lahum naseeb mmimmaa kasabu wal laahu saree'ul hisaab

Wazkurul laaha feeaa 'ayyaam mma'doodaat faman ta'ajjal a fee yawmayni fal aa 'ithma 'al ayhi waman taakhkhara fal aa 'ithma 'al ayhi limanittaqaa wattaqul laaha wa'lamooaa 'annakum 'il ayhi tuhsharoon
Waminan-naasi many yu'jibuka qawluhu fee al hayawaatid-dunyaa wayushhidul laaha 'al aa maa fee qal bihi wahooa 'al addul khisaam
Waizaa tawal laa sa'aa fee al ardi leeufsida feehaa wayuhlikal hartha wan-nasla wal laahu laa yuhibbul fasaad
Waizaa qeela lahuttaqil laaha 'akhazathul'izzatu bil ithmi fahasbuhu jahannamu wal abi'sal mihaad
Waminan-naasi many yashree nafsahubtighaa'a mardaatil laahi wal laahu ra'oofu bil'ibaad
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanudkhul u fee as-sil mi kaaffat wal aa tattabi'u khutooaatish-shaytaani 'innahu lakum 'adoow mmubeen
Fain zal al tum mmim ba'di maa jaa'atkumul bayyinaatu fa'lamooaa 'annal laaha 'azeezun hakeem
Hal yanzuroona 'il laa 'any yateeahumul laahu fee zul al mminal ghamaami wal mal aa'ikatu waqudeeal amru wail aal laahi turja'ul umoor
Sal baneeaa 'israa'eela kam 'aataynaahum mmin 'ayati bayyinat wamany yubaddil ni'matal laahi mim ba'di maa jaa'athu fainnal laaha shadeedul'iqaab
Zuyyina lil lazeena kafarul hayawaatud-dunyaa wayaskharoona minal lazeena 'aamanu wal lazeenattaqawa fawqahum yawmal qeeaamati wal laahu yarzuqu many yashaa'u bighayri hisaab

Kaanan-naasu 'ummat waahidat faba'athal laahun-nabeeyina mubashshireena wamunzireena waanzal a ma'ahumul kitaaba bil haqqi leeahkuma baynan-naasi feemaakhtal afu feehi wamaakhtal afa feehi 'il laal lazeena 'ootoohu mim ba'di maa jaa'athumul bayyinaatu baghyaa baynahum fahadaal laahul lazeena 'aamanu limaakhtal afu feehi minal haqqi biiznihi wal laahu yahdee many yashaa'u 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem

'am hasibtum 'an tadkhul ul jannata wal ammaa yatikum mmathal ul lazeena khal awa min qablikum mmassathumul basaa'u wad-darraa'u wazul zil u hattaa yaqoolar-rasoolu wal lazeena 'aamanu ma'ahu mataa nasrul laahi 'al aa 'inna nasral laahi qareeb
Yasal oonaka maazaa yunfiqoona qul maa 'anfaqtum mmin khayr fal il waal idayni wal aqrabeena wal yataamaa wal masaakeeni wabnis-sabeeli wamaa taf'al u min khayr fainnal laaha bihi 'al eem
Kutiba 'al aykumul qitaal u wahooa kurh llakum wa'asaa 'an takrahu shaya wahooa khayr llakum wa'asaa 'an tuhibbu shaya wahooa sharr llakum wal laahu ya'lamu waantum laa ta'lamoon

Yasal oonaka 'anish-shahril haraami qitaal feehi qul qitaal feehi kabeer wasaddun 'an sabeelil laahi wakufru bihi wal masjidil haraami waikhraaju 'ahlihi minhu 'akbaru 'indal laahi wal fitnatu 'akbaru minal qatli wal aa yazaal oona yuqaatil oonakum hattaa yaruddookum 'an deenikum 'inistataa'u wamany yartadid minkum 'an deenihi fayamut wahooa kaafir faul aa'ika habitat 'a'maal uhum fee ad-dunyaa wal aakhirati waul aa'ika 'ashaabun-naari hum feehaa khaal idoon
'innal lazeena 'aamanu wal lazeena haajaru wajaahadu fee sabeelil laahi 'ul aa'ika yarjoona rahmatal laahi wal laahu ghafoor rraheem

Yasal oonaka 'anil khamri wal maysiri qul feehimaa 'ithm kabeer wamanaafi'u lin-naasi waithmuhumaa 'akbaru min nnaf'ihimaa wayasal oonaka maazaa yunfiqoona qul il'afwa kazaal ika yubayyinul laahu lakumul ayaati la'al lakum tatafakkaroon

Fee ad-dunyaa wal aakhirati wayasal oonaka 'anil yataamaa qul 'islaah llaahum khayr wain tukhaal itoohum faikhwaanukum wal laahu ya'lamul mufsida minal muslihi wal aw shaa'al laahu laa'natakum 'innal laaha 'azeezun hakeem

Wal aa tankihul mushrikaati hattaa yu'minna wal aamat mmu'minatun khayr mmim mmushrikat wal aw 'a'jabatkum wal aa tunkihul mushrikeena hattaa yu'minu wal a'abd mmu'minun khayr mmim mmushrik wal aw 'a'jabakum 'ul aa'ika yad'oona 'il aan-naari wal laahu yad'ooaa 'il aal jannati wal maghfirati biiznihi wayubayyinu 'ayaatihi lin-naasi la'al laahum yatazakkaroon

Wayasal oonaka 'anil maheedi qul hooa 'aza fa'tazil un-nisaa'a fee al maheedi wal aa taqraboohunna hattaa yathurna faizaa tatahharna fatoohunna min haythu 'amarakumul laahu 'innal laaha yuhibbut-tawwaabeena wayuhibbul mutatahhireen
Nisaa'ukum harth llakum fatu harthakum 'annaa shi'tum waqaddimu lianfusikum wattaqul laaha wa'lamooaa 'annakum mmul aaqoohu wabashshiril mu'mineen
Wal aa taj'al ul laaha 'urdat lliaymaanikum 'an tabarru watattaqu watuslihu baynan-naasi wal laahu samee'un 'al eem
Llaa yu'aakhizukumul laahu bil laghwi feeaa 'aymaanikum wal aakiny yu'aakhizukum bimaa kasabat qul oobukum wal laahu ghafoorun hal eem
Llil lazeena yu'loona min nnisaa'ihim tarabbusu 'arba'ati 'ashhur fain faa'oo fainnal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Wain 'azamut-tal aaqa fainnal laaha samee'un 'al eem

Wal mutal laqaatu yatarabbasna bianfusihinna thal aathata qurooaa' wal aa yahil lu lahunna 'any yaktumna maa khal aqal laahu feeaa 'arhaamihinna 'in kunna yu'minna bil laahi wal yawmil aakhiri wabu'oolatuhunna 'ahaqqu biraddihinna fee zaal ika 'in 'araadooaa 'islaaha wal ahunna mithlul lazee 'al ayhinna bil ma'roofi wal ir-rijaal i 'al ayhinna darajat wal laahu 'azeezun hakeem

At-tal aaqu marrataani faimsaaku bima'roofin 'aw tasreehu biihsaanw wal aa yahil lu lakum 'an takhuzu mimmaa 'aataytumoohunna shayana 'il laa 'any yakhaafaa 'al laa yuqeemaa hudoodal laahi fain khiftum 'al laa yuqeemaa hudoodal laahi fal aa junaaha 'al ayhimaa feemaaftadat bihi til ka hudoodul laahi fal aa ta'tadoohaa wamany yata'adda hudoodal laahi faul aa'ika humuz-zaal imoon

Fain tal laqahaa fal aa tahil lu lahu mim ba'du hattaa tankiha zawjana ghayrahu fain tal laqahaa fal aa junaaha 'al ayhimaa 'any yataraaja'aa 'in zannaa 'any yuqeemaa hudoodal laahi watil ka hudoodul laahi yubayyinuhaa liqawm ya'lamoon

Waizaa tal laqtumun-nisaa'a fabal aghna 'ajal ahunna faamsikoohunna bima'roofin 'aw sarrihoohunna bima'roof wal aa tumsikoohunna diraara llita'tadu wamany yaf'al zaal ika faqad zal ama nafsahu wal aa tattakhizooaa 'ayaatil laahi huzooa wazkuru ni'matal laahi 'al aykum wamaa 'anzal a 'al aykum mminal kitaabi wal hikmati ya'izukum bihi wattaqul laaha wa'lamooaa 'annal laaha bikul li shay'in 'al eem

Waizaa tal laqtumun-nisaa'a fabal aghna 'ajal ahunna fal aa ta'dul oohunna 'any yankihna 'azwaajahunna 'izaa taraadawa baynahum bil ma'roofi zaal ika yoo'azu bihi man kaana minkum yu'minu bil laahi wal yawmil aakhiri zaal ikum 'azkaa lakum waatharu wal laahu ya'lamu waantum laa ta'lamoon

Wal waal idaatu yurdi'na 'awlaadahunna hawlayni kaamil ayni liman 'araada 'any yutimmar-radaa'ata wa'al aal mawloodi lahu rizquhunna wakiswatuhunna bil ma'roofi laa tukal lafu nafsun 'il laa wus'ahaa laa tudaarra waal idatu biwal adihaa wal aa mawlood llaahu biwal adihi wa'al aal waarithi mithlu zaal ika fain 'araadaa fisaal ana 'an taraad mminhumaa watashaawur fal aa junaaha 'al ayhimaa wain 'aradttum 'an tastardi'ooaa 'awlaadakum fal aa junaaha 'al aykum 'izaa sal lamtum mmaa 'aataytum bil ma'roofi wattaqul laaha wa'lamooaa 'annal laaha bimaa ta'mal oona baseer

Wal lazeena yutawaffawna minkum wayazaroona 'azwaaja yatarabbasna bianfusihinna 'arba'ata 'ashhur wa'ashra faizaa bal aghna 'ajal ahunna fal aa junaaha 'al aykum feemaa fa'al na feeaa 'anfusihinna bil ma'roofi wal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer

Wal aa junaaha 'al aykum feemaa 'arradtum bihi min khitbatin-nisaa'i 'aw 'aknantum feeaa 'anfusikum 'al imal laahu 'annakum satazkuroonahunna wal aakil llaa tooaa'idoohunna sirrana 'il laa 'an taqoolu qawla mma'roofa wal aa ta'zimu 'uqdatan-nikaahi hattaa yablughal kitaabu 'ajal ahu wa'lamooaa 'annal laaha ya'lamu maa feeaa 'anfusikum fahzaroohu wa'lamooaa 'annal laaha ghafoorun hal eem

Llaa junaaha 'al aykum 'in tal laqtumun-nisaa'a maa lam tamassoohunna 'aw tafridu lahunna fareedat wamatti'oohunna 'al aal moosi'i qadaruhu wa'al aal muqtiri qadaruhu mataa'aa bil ma'roofi haqqana 'al aal muhsineen

Wain tal laqtumoohunna min qabli 'an tamassoohunna waqad faradtum lahunna fareedat fanisfu maa faradtum 'il laa 'any ya'foona 'aw ya'fooaal lazee beeadihi 'uqdatun-nikaahi waan ta'fooaa 'aqrabu lit-taqwaa wal aa tansawual fadla baynakum 'innal laaha bimaa ta'mal oona baseer
Haafizu 'al aas-sal awaati was-sal aatil wustaa waqoomu lil laahi qaaniteen
Fain khiftum farijaal ana 'aw rukbaana faizaa 'amintum fazkurul laaha kamaa 'al lamakum mmaa lam takoonu ta'lamoon

Wal lazeena yutawaffawna minkum wayazaroona 'azwaaja wasiyyat lliazwaajihim mmataa'ana 'il aal hawli ghayra 'ikhraaj fain kharajna fal aa junaaha 'al aykum fee maa fa'al na feeaa 'anfusihinna mim mma'roof wal laahu 'azeezun hakeem
Wal il mutal laqaati mataa'u bil ma'roofi haqqana 'al aal muttaqeen
Kazaal ika yubayyinul laahu lakum 'ayaatihi la'al lakum ta'qil oon

'al am tara 'il aal lazeena kharaju min deeaarihim wahum 'ul oofun hazaral mawti faqaal a lahumul laahu mootu thumma 'ahyaahum 'innal laaha lazoo fadlin 'al aan-naasi wal aakinna 'aktharan-naasi laa yashkuroon
Waqaatil u fee sabeelil laahi wa'lamooaa 'annal laaha samee'un 'al eem
Mman zaal lazee yuqridul laaha qardana hasana fayudaa'ifahu lahuaa 'ad'aafa katheerat wal laahu yaqbidu wayabsutu wail ayhi turja'oon

'al am tara 'il aal mal ai mim baneeaa 'israa'eela mim ba'di moosaa 'iz qaal u linabeey llaahumub'ath lanaa mal ika nnuqaatil fee sabeelil laahi qaal a hal 'asaytum 'in kutiba 'al aykumul qitaal u 'al laa tuqaatil u qaal u wamaa lanaa 'al laa nuqaatil a fee sabeelil laahi waqad 'ukhrijnaa min deeaarinaa waabnaa'inaa fal ammaa kutiba 'al ayhimul qitaal u tawal lawa 'il laa qal eela mminhum wal laahu 'al eemu biz-zaal imeen

Waqaal a lahum nabeeyuhum 'innal laaha qad ba'atha lakum taal oota mal ika qaal ooaa 'annaa yakoonu lahul mul ku 'al aynaa wanahnu 'ahaqqu bil mul ki minhu wal am yu'ta sa'at mminal maal i qaal a 'innal laahastafaahu 'al aykum wazaadahu bastat fee al'il mi wal jismi wal laahu yu'tee mul kahu many yashaa'u wal laahu waasi'un 'al eem

Waqaal a lahum nabeeyuhum 'inna 'ayata mul kihiaa 'any yateeakumut-taabootu feehi sakeenat mmir rrabbikum wabaqiyyat mmimmaa taraka 'aal u moosaa wa'aal u haaroona tahmil uhul mal aa'ikatu 'inna fee zaal ika layat llakum 'in kuntum mmu'mineen

Fal ammaa fasal a taal ootu bil junoodi qaal a 'innal laaha mubtal eekum binahar faman shariba minhu fal aysa minnee wamal llam yat'amhu fainnahu minneeaa 'il laa manightarafa ghurfata beeadihi fasharibu minhu 'il laa qal eela mminhum fal ammaa jaawazahu hooa wal lazeena 'aamanu ma'ahu qaal u laa taaqata lanaal yawma bijaal oota wajunoodihi qaal al lazeena yazunnoona 'annahum mmul aaqul laahi kam mmin fi'at qal eelatin ghal abat fi'at katheerata biiznil laahi wal laahu ma'as-saabireen
Wal ammaa barazu lijaal oota wajunoodihi qaal u rabbanaa 'afrigh 'al aynaa sabra wathabbit 'aqdaamanaa wansurnaa 'al aal qawmil kaafireen

Fahazamoohum biiznil laahi waqatal a daawudu jaal oota wa'aataahul laahul mul ka wal hikmata wa'al lamahu mimmaa yashaa'u wal awlaa daf'ul laahin-naasa ba'dahum biba'd llafasadatil ardu wal aakinnal laaha zoo fadlin 'al aal'aal ameen
Til ka 'ayaatul laahi natloohaa 'al ayka bil haqqi wainnaka laminal mursal een

Til kar-rusul u faddal naa ba'dahum 'al aa ba'd mminhum mman kal lamal laahu warafa'a ba'dahum darajaat wa'aataynaa 'eesaabna maryamal bayyinaati wayyadnaahu biroohil qudusi wal aw shaa'al laahu maaqtatal al lazeena mim ba'dihim mmim ba'di maa jaa'athumul bayyinaatu wal aakinikhtal afu faminhum mman 'aamana waminhum mman kafara wal aw shaa'al laahu maaqtatal u wal aakinnal laaha yaf'al u maa yureed
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'anfiqu mimmaa razaqnaakum mmin qabli 'any yateea yawm llaa bay' feehi wal aa khul lat wal aa shafaa'at wal kaafiroona humuz-zaal imoon

Al laahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooal hayyul qayyoomu laa takhuzuhu sinat wal aa nawm llaahu maa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardi man zaal lazee yashfa'u 'indahuaa 'il laa biiznihi ya'lamu maa bayna 'aydeehim wamaa khal fahum wal aa yuheetoona bishay' mmin 'il mihiaa 'il laa bimaa shaa'a wasi'a kurseeyuhus-samaawaati wal arda wal aa yaooduhu hifzuhumaa wahooal'al eeyul'azeem
Laa 'ikraaha fee ad-deeni qad ttabayyanar-rushdu minal ghayyi famany yakfur bit-taaghooti wayu'mim bil laahi faqadistamsaka bil'urwatil wuthqaa laanfisaama lahaa wal laahu samee'un 'al eem

Al laahu wal eeyul lazeena 'aamanu yukhrijuhum mminaz-zul umaati 'il aan-noori wal lazeena kafarooaa 'awleeaa'uhumut-taaghootu yukhrijoonahum mminan-noori 'il aaz-zul umaati 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabun-naari hum feehaa khaal idoon

'al am tara 'il aal lazee haajja 'ibraahima fee rabbihiaa 'an 'aataahul laahul mul ka 'iz qaal a 'ibraahimu rabbeeal lazee yuhyi wayumeetu qaal a 'anaa 'uhyi waumeetu qaal a 'ibraahimu fainnal laaha yatee bish-shamsi minal mashriqi fati bihaa minal maghribi fabuhital lazee kafara wal laahu laa yahdee al qawmaz-zaal imeen

'aw kal lazee marra 'al aa qaryat waheea khaaweeatun 'al aa 'urooshihaa qaal a 'annaa yuhyi haazihil laahu ba'da mawtihaa faamaatahul laahu mi'ata 'aam thumma ba'athahu qaal a kam labithta qaal a labithtu yawmana 'aw ba'da yawm qaal a bal-labithta mi'ata 'aam fanzur 'il aa ta'aamika washaraabika lam yatasannah wanzur 'il aa himaarika wal inaj'al aka 'ayat llin-naasi wanzur 'il aal'izaami kayfa nunshizuhaa thumma naksoohaa lahma fal ammaa tabayyana lahu qaal a 'a'lamu 'annal laaha 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer

Waiz qaal a 'ibraahimu rabbi 'arinee kayfa tuhyil mawtaa qaal a 'awal am tu'min qaal a bal aa wal aakil lleeatma'inna qal bee qaal a fakhuz 'arba'at mminat-tayri fasurhunna 'il ayka thummaj'al 'al aa kul li jabal mminhunna juz'a thummad'uhunna yateenaka sa'ya wa'lam 'annal laaha 'azeezun hakeem

Mmathal ul lazeena yunfiqoona 'amwaal ahum fee sabeelil laahi kamathal i habbatin 'anbatat sab'a sanaabil a fee kul li sunbul at mmia'atu habbat wal laahu yudaa'ifu limany yashaa'u wal laahu waasi'un 'al eem
Al lazeena yunfiqoona 'amwaal ahum fee sabeelil laahi thumma laa yutbi'oona maa 'anfaqu manna wal aa 'aza llaahum 'ajruhum 'inda rabbihim wal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
Qawl mma'roof wamaghfiratun khayr mmin sadaqat yatba'uhaa 'aza wal laahu ghaneeyun hal eem

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa tubtil u sadaqaatikum bil manni wal azaa kal lazee yunfiqu maal ahu ri'aa'an-naasi wal aa yu'minu bil laahi wal yawmil aakhiri famathal uhu kamathal i safwaanin 'al ayhi turaab faasaabahu waabil fatarakahu sal da llaa yaqdiroona 'al aa shay' mmimmaa kasabu wal laahu laa yahdee al qawmal kaafireen

Wamathal ul lazeena yunfiqoona 'amwaal ahumubtighaa'a mardaatil laahi watathbeeta mmin 'anfusihim kamathal i jannati birabwatin 'asaabahaa waabil faatat 'ukul ahaa di'fayni fail llam yusibhaa waabil fatal l wal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona baseer

'ayawaddu 'ahadukum 'an takoona lahu jannat mmin nnakheel waa'naab tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru lahu feehaa min kul lith-thamaraati waasaabahul kibaru wal ahu zurriyyat du'afaa'u faasaabahaa 'i'saar feehi naar fahtaraqat kazaal ika yubayyinul laahu lakumul ayaati la'al lakum tatafakkaroon

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'anfiqu min tayyibaati maa kasabtum wamimmaa 'akhrajnaa lakum mminal ardi wal aa tayammamul khabeetha minhu tunfiqoona wal astum biaakhizeehi 'il laa 'an tughmidu feehi wa'lamooaa 'annal laaha ghaneeyun hameed
Ash-shaytaanu ya'idukumul faqra wayamurukum bil fahshaa'i wal laahu ya'idukum mmaghfirat mminhu wafadla wal laahu waasi'un 'al eem
Yu'tee al hikmata many yashaa'u wamany yu'tal hikmata faqad 'ooteea khayra katheera wamaa yazzakkaru 'il laa 'oolul al baab
Wamaa 'anfaqtum mmin nnafaqatin 'aw nazartum mmin nnazr fainnal laaha ya'lamuhu wamaa liz-zaal imeena min 'ansaar
'in tubdus-sadaqaati fani'immaa heea wain tukhfoohaa watu'toohaal fuqaraa'a fahooa khayr llakum wayukaffiru 'ankum mmin sayyiaatikum wal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer

Llaysa 'al ayka hudaahum wal aakinnal laaha yahdee many yashaa'u wamaa tunfiqu min khayr fal ianfusikum wamaa tunfiqoona 'il laabtighaa'a wajhil laahi wamaa tunfiqu min khayr yooaffa 'il aykum waantum laa tuzlamoon

Lil fuqaraa'il lazeena 'uhsiru fee sabeelil laahi laa yastatee'oona darba fee al ardi yahsabuhumul jaahil u 'aghneeaa'a minat-ta'affufi ta'rifuhum biseemaahum laa yasal oonan-naasa 'il haafa wamaa tunfiqu min khayr fainnal laaha bihi 'al eem
Al lazeena yunfiqoona 'amwaal ahum bil layli wan-nahaari sirra wa'al aaneeat fal ahum 'ajruhum 'inda rabbihim wal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon

Al lazeena yakul oonar-ribawaa laa yaqoomoona 'il laa kamaa yaqoomul lazee yatakhabbatuhush-shaytaanu minal massi zaal ika biannahum qaal ooaa 'innamaal bay'u mithlur-ribawaa waahal lal laahul bay'a waharramar-ribawaa faman jaa'ahu maw'izat mmir rrabbihi fantahaa fal ahu maa sal afa waamruhuaa 'il aal laahi waman 'aada faul aa'ika 'ashaabun-naari hum feehaa khaal idoon
Yamhaqul laahur-ribawaa wayurbee as-sadaqaati wal laahu laa yuhibbu kul la kaffaarin 'atheem
'innal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati waaqaamus-sal aata wa'aatawuaz-zakaata lahum 'ajruhum 'inda rabbihim wal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanuttaqul laaha wazaru maa baqeea minar-ribawaa 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
Fail llam taf'al u fazanu biharb mminal laahi warasoolihi wain tubtum fal akum ru'oosu 'amwaal ikum laa tazlimoona wal aa tuzlamoon
Wain kaana zoo 'usrat fanaziratun 'il aa maysarat waan tasaddaqu khayr llakum 'in kuntum ta'lamoon
Wattaqu yawma turja'oona feehi 'il aal laahi thumma tooaffaa kul lu nafs mmaa kasabat wahum laa yuzlamoon

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'izaa tadayantum bidaynin 'il aa 'ajal mmusamma faktuboohu wal yaktub bbaynakum kaatibu bil'adli wal aa yaba kaatibun 'any yaktuba kamaa 'al lamahul laahu fal yaktub wal yumlil il lazee 'al ayhil haqqu wal yattaqil laaha rabbahu wal aa yabkhas minhu shaya fain kaanal lazee 'al ayhil haqqu safeehana 'aw da'eefana 'aw laa yastatee'u 'any yumil la hooa fal yumlil wal eeyuhu bil'adli wastashhidu shaheedayni mir rrijaal ikum fail llam yakoonaa rajul ayni farajul wamraataani mimman tardawna minash-shuhadaa'i 'an tadil la 'ihdaahumaa fatuzakkira 'ihdaahumaal ukhraa wal aa yabash-shuhadaa'u 'izaa maa du'u wal aa tasamooaa 'an taktuboohu sagheerana 'aw kabeerana 'il aa 'ajal ihi zaal ikum 'aqsatu 'indal laahi waaqwamu lish-shahaadati waadnaa 'al laa tartaabooaa 'il laa 'an takoona tijaaratan haadirat tudeeroonahaa baynakum fal aysa 'al aykum junaahun 'al laa taktuboohaa waashhidooaa 'izaa tabaya'tum wal aa yudaarra kaatib wal aa shaheed wain taf'al u fainnahu fusooqu bikum wattaqul laaha wayu'al limukumul laahu wal laahu bikul li shay'in 'al eem

Wain kuntum 'al aa safar wal am tajidu kaatiba farihaam mmaqboodat fain 'amina ba'dukum ba'da fal yu'addil lazee a'tumina 'amaanatahu wal yattaqil laaha rabbahu wal aa taktumush-shahaadata wamany yaktumhaa fainnahuaa 'aathim qal buhu wal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona 'al eem

Llil laahi maa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardi wain tubdu maa feeaa 'anfusikum 'aw tukhfoohu yuhaasibkum bihil laahu fayaghfiru limany yashaa'u wayu'azzibu many yashaa'u wal laahu 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer

'aamanar-rasoolu bimaa 'unzil a 'il ayhi mir rrabbihi wal mu'minoona kul lun 'aamana bil laahi wamal aa'ikatihi wakutubihi warusul ihi laa nufarriqu bayna 'ahad mmir rrusul ihi waqaal u sami'naa waata'naa ghufraanaka rabbanaa wail aykal maseer

Laa yukal liful laahu nafsana 'il laa wus'ahaa lahaa maa kasabat wa'al ayhaa maaktasabat rabbanaa laa tu'aakhiznaa 'in nnaseenaa 'aw 'akhtanaa rabbanaa wal aa tahmil 'al aynaa 'isra kamaa hamal tahu 'al aal lazeena min qablinaa rabbanaa wal aa tuhammil naa maa laa taaqata lanaa bihi wa'fu 'annaa waghfir lanaa warhamnaa 'anta mawlaanaa fansurnaa 'al aal qawmil kaafireen
Alif-Laaam-Meeem
Al laahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooal hayyul qayyoom
Nazzal a 'al aykal kitaaba bil haqqi musaddiqa llimaa bayna yadayhi waanzal at-tawraata wal injeel
Min qablu huda llin-naasi waanzal al furqaana 'innal lazeena kafaru biayaatil laahi lahum 'azaab shadeed wal laahu 'azeez zoo antiqaam
'innal laaha laa yakhfaa 'al ayhi shay' fee al ardi wal aa fee as-samaa'
Hooal lazee yusawwirukum fee al arhaami kayfa yashaa'u laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooal'azeezul hakeem

Hooal lazeeaa 'anzal a 'al aykal kitaaba minhu 'ayaat mmuhkamaatun hunna 'ummul kitaabi waukharu mutashaabihaat faammaal lazeena fee qul oobihim zaygh fayattabi'oona maa tashaabaha minhubtighaa'al fitnati wabtighaa'a taweelihi wamaa ya'lamu taweelahuaa 'il laal laahu war-raasikhoona fee al'il mi yaqooloona 'aamannaa bihi kul l mmin 'indi rabbinaa wamaa yazzakkaru 'il laa 'oolul al baab
Rabbanaa laa tuzigh qul oobanaa ba'da 'iz hadaytanaa wahab lanaa mil lladunka rahmatan 'innaka 'antal wahhaab
Rabbanaa 'innaka jaami'un-naasi leeawm llaa rayba feehi 'innal laaha laa yukhliful mee'aad
'innal lazeena kafaru lan tughneea 'anhum 'amwaal uhum wal aa 'awlaaduhum mminal laahi shaya waul aa'ika hum waqoodun-naar
Kadabi 'aal i fir'awna wal lazeena min qablihim kazzabu biayaatinaa faakhazahumul laahu bizunoobihim wal laahu shadeedul'iqaab
Qul-lil lazeena kafaru satughlaboona watuhsharoona 'il aa jahannama wabi'sal mihaad

Qad kaana lakum 'ayat fee fi'ataynil taqataa fi'at tuqaatil u fee sabeelil laahi waukhraa kaafirat yarawnahum mmithlayhim rayal'ayni wal laahu yu'ayyidu binasrihi many yashaa'u 'inna fee zaal ika la'ibrat llioolee al absaar

Zuyyina lin-naasi hubbush-shahawaati minan-nisaa'i wal baneena wal qanaateeril muqantarati minaz-zahabi wal fiddati wal khaylil musawwamati wal an'aami wal harthi zaal ika mataa'ul hayawaatid-dunyaa wal laahu 'indahu husnul maab

Qul 'a'unabbi'ukum bikhayr mmin zaal ikum lil lazeenattaqawa 'inda rabbihim jannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa waazwaaj mmutahharat waridwaam mminal laahi wal laahu baseeru bil'ibaad
Al lazeena yaqooloona rabbanaa 'innanaa 'aamannaa faghfir lanaa zunoobanaa waqinaa 'azaaban-naar
As-saabireena was-saadiqeena wal qaaniteena wal munfiqeena wal mustaghfireena bil ashaar
Shahidal laahu 'annahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa wal mal aa'ikatu waoolul'il mi qaa'imaa bil qisti laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooal'azeezul hakeem
'innad-deena 'indal laahil islaamu wamaakhtal afal lazeena 'ootul kitaaba 'il laa mim ba'di maa jaa'ahumul'il mu baghyaa baynahum wamany yakfur biayaatil laahi fainnal laaha saree'ul hisaab

Fain haajjooka faqul 'aslamtu wajheea lil laahi wamanittaba'ani waqul-lil lazeena 'ootul kitaaba wal ummeeyina 'aaslamtum fain 'aslamu faqadihtada wwain tawal lawa fainnamaa 'al aykal bal aaghu wal laahu baseeru bil'ibaad
'innal lazeena yakfuroona biayaatil laahi wayaqtul oonan-nabeeyina bighayri haqq wayaqtul oonal lazeena yamuroona bil qisti minan-naasi fabashshirhum bi'azaabin 'al eem
'ul aa'ikal lazeena habitat 'a'maal uhum fee ad-dunyaa wal aakhirati wamaa lahum mmin nnaasireen
'al am tara 'il aal lazeena 'ootu naseeba mminal kitaabi yud'awna 'il aa kitaabil laahi leeahkuma baynahum thumma yatawal laa fareeq mminhum wahum mmu'ridoon
Zaal ika biannahum qaal u lan tamassanaan-naaru 'il laa 'ayyaama mma'doodaat wagharrahum fee deenihim mmaa kaanu yaftaroon
Fakayfa 'izaa jama'naahum leeawm llaa rayba feehi wawuffeeat kul lu nafs mmaa kasabat wahum laa yuzlamoon
Qul il laahumma maal ikal mul ki tu'tee al mul ka man tashaa'u watanzi'ul mul ka mimman tashaa'u watu'izzu man tashaa'u watuzil lu man tashaa'u beeadikal khayru 'innaka 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
Toolijul layla fee an-nahaari watoolijun-nahaara fee al layli watukhrijul hayya minal mayyiti watukhrijul mayyita minal hayyi watarzuqu man tashaa'u bighayri hisaab

Llaa yattakhizil mu'minoonal kaafireena 'awleeaa'a min doonil mu'mineena wamany yaf'al zaal ika fal aysa minal laahi fee shay'in 'il laa 'an tattaqu minhum tuqaat wayuhazzirukumul laahu nafsahu wail aal laahil maseer
Qul 'in tukhfu maa fee sudoorikum 'aw tubdoohu ya'lamhul laahu waya'lamu maa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardi wal laahu 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
Yawma tajidu kul lu nafs mmaa 'amil at min khayr mmuhdara wamaa 'amil at min sooaa' tawaddu law 'anna baynahaa wabaynahuaa 'amadaa ba'eeda wayuhazzirukumul laahu nafsahu wal laahu ra'oofu bil'ibaad
Qul 'in kuntum tuhibboonal laaha fattabi'oonee yuhbibkumul laahu wayaghfir lakum zunoobakum wal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Qul 'atee'ul laaha war-rasoola fain tawal lawa fainnal laaha laa yuhibbul kaafireen
'innal laahastafaa 'aadama wanooha wa'aal a 'ibraaheema wa'aal a 'imraana 'al aal'aal ameen
Zurriyyata ba'duhaa mim ba'd wal laahu samee'un 'al eem
'iz qaal atimraatu 'imraana rabbi 'innee nazartu laka maa fee batnee muharrara fataqabbal minneeaa 'innaka 'antas-samee'ul'al eem

Fal ammaa wada'athaa qaal at rabbi 'innee wada'tuhaa 'unthaa wal laahu 'a'lamu bimaa wada'at wal aysaz-zakaru kal unthaa wainnee sammaytuhaa maryama wainneeaa 'u'eezuhaa bika wazurriyyatahaa minash-shaytaanir-rajeem

Fataqabbal ahaa rabbuhaa biqaboolin hasanw waanbatahaa nabaatana hasana wakaffal ahaa zakariyyaa kul lamaa dakhal a 'al ayhaa zakariyyaal mihraaba wajada 'indahaa rizqa qaal a yaamaryamu 'annaa laki haazaa qaal at hooa min 'indil laahi 'innal laaha yarzuqu many yashaa'u bighayri hisaab
Hunaal ika da'aa zakariyyaa rabbahu qaal a rabbi hab lee mil lladunka zurriyyat tayyibatan 'innaka samee'ud-du'aa'
Fanaadathul mal aa'ikatu wahooa qaa'im yusal lee fee al mihraabi 'annal laaha yubashshiruka beeahyaa musaddiqaa bikal imat mminal laahi wasayyida wahasoora wanabiyya mminas-saal iheen
Qaal a rabbi 'annaa yakoonu lee ghul aam waqad bal aghaneeal kibaru wamraatee 'aaqir qaal a kazaal ikal laahu yaf'al u maa yashaa'
Qaal a rabbij'al-leeaa 'ayat qaal a 'ayatuka 'al laa tukal liman-naasa thal aathata 'ayyaamin 'il laa ramza wazkur rrabbaka katheera wasabbih bil'asheeyi wal ibkaar
Waiz qaal atil mal aa'ikatu yaamaryamu 'innal laahastafaaki watahharaki wastafaaki 'al aa nisaa'il'aal ameen
Yaamaryamuqnutee lirabbiki wasjudee warka'ee ma'ar-raaki'een
Zaal ika min 'anbaa'il ghaybi nooheehi 'il ayka wamaa kunta ladayhim 'iz yul qoona 'aqlaamahum 'ayyuhum yakful u maryama wamaa kunta ladayhim 'iz yakhtasimoon
'iz qaal atil mal aa'ikatu yaamaryamu 'innal laaha yubashshiruki bikal imat mminhusmuhul maseehu 'eesaabnu maryama wajeeha fee ad-dunyaa wal aakhirati waminal muqarrabeen
Wayukal limun-naasa fee al mahdi wakahla waminas-saal iheen
Qaal at rabbi 'annaa yakoonu lee wal ad wal am yamsasnee bashar qaal a kazaal ikil laahu yakhluqu maa yashaa'u 'izaa qadaa 'amra fainnamaa yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoon
Wayu'al limuhul kitaaba wal hikmata wat-tawraata wal injeel

Warasoolana 'il aa baneeaa 'israa'eela 'annee qad ji'tukum biayat mmir rrabbikum 'anneeaa 'akhluqu lakum mminat-teeni kahayatit-tayri faanfukhu feehi fayakoonu tayraa biiznil laahi waubri'ul akmaha wal abrasa wauhyil mawtaa biiznil laahi waunabbi'ukum bimaa takul oona wamaa taddakhiroona fee buyootikum 'inna fee zaal ika layat llakum 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
Wamusaddiqa llimaa bayna yadayya minat-tawraati wal iuhil la lakum ba'dal lazee hurrima 'al aykum waji'tukum biayat mmir rrabbikum fattaqul laaha waatee'oon
'innal laaha rabbee warabbukum fa'budoohu haazaa siraat mmustaqeem
Fal ammaa 'ahassa 'eesaa minhumul kufra qaal a man 'ansaareeaa 'il aal laahi qaal al hawaareeyoona nahnu 'ansaarul laahi 'aamannaa bil laahi washhad biannaa muslimoon
Rabbanaa 'aamannaa bimaa 'anzal ta wattaba'naar-rasoola faktubnaa ma'ash-shaahideen
Wamakaru wamakaral laahu wal laahu khayrul maakireen

'iz qaal al laahu yaa'eesaa 'innee mutawaffeeka waraafi'uka 'il ayya wamutahhiruka minal lazeena kafaru wajaa'il ul lazeenattaba'ooka fawqal lazeena kafarooaa 'il aa yawmil qeeaamati thumma 'il ayya marji'ukum faahkumu baynakum feemaa kuntum feehi takhtal ifoon
Faammaal lazeena kafaru fau'azzibuhum 'azaaba shadeeda fee ad-dunyaa wal aakhirati wamaa lahum mmin nnaasireen
Waammaal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati fayooaffeehim 'ujoorahum wal laahu laa yuhibbuz-zaal imeen
Zaal ika natloohu 'al ayka minal ayaati waz-zikril hakeem
'inna mathal a 'eesaa 'indal laahi kamathal i 'aadama khal aqahu min turaab thumma qaal a lahu kun fayakoon
Al haqqu mir rrabbika fal aa takum mminal mumtareen

Faman haajjaka feehi mim ba'di maa jaa'aka minal'il mi faqul ta'aal awa nad'u 'abnaa'anaa waabnaa'akum wanisaa'anaa wanisaa'akum waanfusanaa waanfusakum thumma nabtahil fanaj'al-la'natal laahi 'al aal kaazibeen
'inna haazaa lahooal qasasul haqqu wamaa min 'il aahin 'il laal laahu wainnal laaha lahooal'azeezul hakeem
Fain tawal lawa fainnal laaha 'al eemu bil mufsideen

Qul yaahlal kitaabi ta'aal awa 'il aa kal imat sawaa'i baynanaa wabaynakum 'al laa na'buda 'il laal laaha wal aa nushrika bihi shaya wal aa yattakhiza ba'dunaa ba'dana 'arbaaba mmin doonil laahi fain tawal lawa faqoolushhadu biannaa muslimoon
Yaahlal kitaabi lima tuhaajjoona feeaa 'ibraaheema wamaa 'unzil atit-tawraatu wal injeelu 'il laa mim ba'dihiaa 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Haantum haa'ul aa'i haajajtum feemaa lakum bihi 'il m fal ima tuhaajjoona feemaa laysa lakum bihi 'il m wal laahu ya'lamu waantum laa ta'lamoon
Maa kaana 'ibraaheemu yahoodiyya wal aa nasraaniyya wal aakin kaana haneefa mmuslima wamaa kaana minal mushrikeen
'inna 'awlaan-naasi biibraaheema lal lazeenattaba'oohu wahaazaan-nabeeyu wal lazeena 'aamanu wal laahu wal eeyul mu'mineen
Waddat ttaa'ifat mmin 'ahlil kitaabi law yudil loonakum wamaa yudil loona 'il laa 'anfusahum wamaa yash'uroon
Yaahlal kitaabi lima takfuroona biayaatil laahi waantum tashhadoon
Yaahlal kitaabi lima tal bisoonal haqqa bil baatil i wataktumoonal haqqa waantum ta'lamoon
Waqaal at ttaa'ifat mmin 'ahlil kitaabi 'aaminu bil lazeeaa 'unzil a 'al aal lazeena 'aamanu wajhan-nahaari wakfurooaa 'aakhirahu la'al laahum yarji'oon

Wal aa tu'minooaa 'il laa liman tabi'a deenakum qul 'innal hudaa hudaal laahi 'any yu'taa 'ahad mmithla maa 'ooteetum 'aw yuhaajjookum 'inda rabbikum qul 'innal fadla beeadil laahi yu'teehi many yashaa'u wal laahu waasi'un 'al eem
Yakhtassu birahmatihi many yashaa'u wal laahu zoo al fadlil'azeem

Wamin 'ahlil kitaabi man 'in tamanhu biqintaar yu'addihiaa 'il ayka waminhum mman 'in tamanhu bideenaar llaa yu'addihiaa 'il ayka 'il laa maa dumta 'al ayhi qaa'ima zaal ika biannahum qaal u laysa 'al aynaa fee al ummeeyina sabeel wayaqooloona 'al aal laahil kaziba wahum ya'lamoon
Bal aa man 'awfaa bi'ahdihi wattaqaa fainnal laaha yuhibbul muttaqeen

'innal lazeena yashtaroona bi'ahdil laahi waymaanihim thamana qal eelana 'ul aa'ika laa khal aaqa lahum fee al aakhirati wal aa yukal limuhumul laahu wal aa yanzuru 'il ayhim yawmal qeeaamati wal aa yuzakkeehim wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eem

Wainna minhum lafareeqa yal wuna 'al sinatahum bil kitaabi litahsaboohu minal kitaabi wamaa hooa minal kitaabi wayaqooloona hooa min 'indil laahi wamaa hooa min 'indil laahi wayaqooloona 'al aal laahil kaziba wahum ya'lamoon

Maa kaana libasharin 'any yu'teeahul laahul kitaaba wal hukma wan-nuboowata thumma yaqoola lin-naasi koonu 'ibaada llee min doonil laahi wal aakin koonu rabbaaneeyina bimaa kuntum tu'al limoonal kitaaba wabimaa kuntum tadrusoon
Wal aa yamurakum 'an tattakhizul mal aa'ikata wan-nabeeyina 'arbaabana 'ayamurukum bil kufri ba'da 'iz 'antum mmuslimoon

Waiz 'akhazal laahu meethaaqan-nabeeyina lamaa 'aataytukum mmin kitaab wahikmat thumma jaa'akum rasool mmusaddiq llimaa ma'akum latu'minunna bihi wal atansurunnahu qaal a 'aaqrartum waakhaztum 'al aa zaal ikum 'isree qaal ooaa 'aqrarnaa qaal a fashhadu waanaa ma'akum mminash-shaahideen
Faman tawal laa ba'da zaal ika faul aa'ika humul faasiqoon
'afaghayra deenil laahi yabghoona wal ahuaa 'aslama man fee as-samaawaati wal ardi taw'a wakarha wail ayhi yurja'oon

Qul 'aamannaa bil laahi wamaa 'unzil a 'al aynaa wamaa 'unzil a 'al aa 'ibraaheema waismaa'eela waishaaqa waya'qooba wal asbaati wamaa 'ooteea moosaa wa'eesaa wan-nabeeyoona mir rrabbihim laa nufarriqu bayna 'ahad mminhum wanahnu lahu muslimoon
Wamany yabtaghi ghayral islaami deena fal any yuqbal a minhu wahooa fee al aakhirati minal khaasireen
Kayfa yahdee al laahu qawma kafaru ba'da 'eemaanihim washahidooaa 'annar-rasoola haqq wajaa'ahumul bayyinaatu wal laahu laa yahdee al qawmaz-zaal imeen
'ul aa'ika jazaa'uhum 'anna 'al ayhim la'natal laahi wal mal aa'ikati wan-naasi 'ajma'een
Khaal ideena feehaa laa yukhaffafu 'anhumul'azaabu wal aa hum yunzaroon
'il laal lazeena taabu mim ba'di zaal ika waaslahu fainnal laaha ghafoor rraheem
'innal lazeena kafaru ba'da 'eemaanihim thummazdaadu kufra llan tuqbal a tawbatuhum waul aa'ika humud-daal loon
'innal lazeena kafaru wamaatu wahum kuffaar fal any yuqbal a min 'ahadihim mmil'ul ardi zahaba wal awiftadaa bihiaa 'ul aa'ika lahum 'azaabun 'al eem wamaa lahum mmin nnaasireen
Lan tanaal ul birra hattaa tunfiqu mimmaa tuhibboona wamaa tunfiqu min shay' fainnal laaha bihi 'al eem
Kul lut-ta'aami kaana hil la llibaneeaa 'israa'eela 'il laa maa harrama 'israa'eelu 'al aa nafsihi min qabli 'an tunazzal at-tawraatu qul fatu bit-tawraati fatloohaa 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Famaniftaraa 'al aal laahil kaziba mim ba'di zaal ika faul aa'ika humuz-zaal imoon
Qul sadaqal laahu fattabi'u mil lata 'ibraaheema haneefa wamaa kaana minal mushrikeen
'inna 'awwal a bayt wudi'a lin-naasi lal lazee bibakkata mubaaraka wahuda llil'aal ameen
Feehi 'ayaatu bayyinaat mmaqaamu 'ibraaheema waman dakhal ahu kaana 'aamina wal il laahi 'al aan-naasi hijjul bayti manistataa'a 'il ayhi sabeela waman kafara fainnal laaha ghaneeyun 'anil'aal ameen
Qul yaahlal kitaabi lima takfuroona biayaatil laahi wal laahu shaheedun 'al aa maa ta'mal oon
Qul yaahlal kitaabi lima tasuddoona 'an sabeelil laahi man 'aamana tabghoonahaa 'iwaja waantum shuhadaa'u wamaal laahu bighaafil in 'ammaa ta'mal oon
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'in tutee'u fareeqa mminal lazeena 'ootul kitaaba yaruddookum ba'da 'eemaanikum kaafireen
Wakayfa takfuroona waantum tutlaa 'al aykum 'ayaatul laahi wafeekum rasooluhu wamany ya'tasim bil laahi faqad hudeea 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanuttaqul laaha haqqa tuqaatihi wal aa tamootunna 'il laa waantum mmuslimoon

Wa'tasimu bihablil laahi jamee'a wal aa tafarraqu wazkuru ni'matal laahi 'al aykum 'iz kuntum 'a'daa' faal lafa bayna qul oobikum faasbahtum bini'matihiaa 'ikhwaana wakuntum 'al aa shafaa hufrat mminan-naari faanqazakum mminhaa kazaal ika yubayyinul laahu lakum 'ayaatihi la'al lakum tahtadoon
Wal takum mminkum 'ummat yad'oona 'il aal khayri wayamuroona bil ma'roofi wayanhawna 'anil munkari waul aa'ika humul muflihoon
Wal aa takoonu kal lazeena tafarraqu wakhtal afu mim ba'di maa jaa'ahumul bayyinaatu waul aa'ika lahum 'azaabun 'azeem
Yawma tabyaddu wujooh wataswaddu wujooh faammaal lazeenaswaddat wujoohuhum 'akafartum ba'da 'eemaanikum fazooqul'azaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon
Waammaal lazeenabyaddat wujoohuhum fafee rahmatil laahi hum feehaa khaal idoon
Til ka 'ayaatul laahi natloohaa 'al ayka bil haqqi wamaal laahu yureedu zul ma llil'aal ameen
Wal il laahi maa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardi wail aal laahi turja'ul umoor

Kuntum khayra 'ummatin 'ukhrijat lin-naasi tamuroona bil ma'roofi watanhawna 'anil munkari watu'minoona bil laahi wal aw 'aamana 'ahlul kitaabi lakaana khayra llaahum mminhumul mu'minoona waaktharuhumul faasiqoon
Lany yadurrookum 'il laa 'aza wainy yuqaatil ookum yooal lookumul adbaara thumma laa yunsaroon

Duribat 'al ayhimuz-zil latu 'ayna maa thuqifooaa 'il laa bihabl mminal laahi wahabl mminan-naasi wabaa'oo bighadab mminal laahi waduribat 'al ayhimul maskanatu zaal ika biannahum kaanu yakfuroona biayaatil laahi wayaqtul oonal anbeeaa'a bighayri haqq zaal ika bimaa 'asa wwakaanu ya'tadoon
Laysu sawaa' mmin 'ahlil kitaabi 'ummat qaa'imat yatloona 'ayaatil laahi 'aanaa'al layli wahum yasjudoon
Yu'minoona bil laahi wal yawmil aakhiri wayamuroona bil ma'roofi wayanhawna 'anil munkari wayusaari'oona fee al khayraati waul aa'ika minas-saal iheen
Wamaa yaf'al u min khayr fal any yukfaroohu wal laahu 'al eemu bil muttaqeen
'innal lazeena kafaru lan tughneea 'anhum 'amwaal uhum wal aa 'awlaaduhum mminal laahi shaya waul aa'ika 'ashaabun-naari hum feehaa khaal idoon
Mathal u maa yunfiqoona fee haazihil hayawaatid-dunyaa kamathal i reeh feehaa sirrun 'asaabat hartha qawm zal amooaa 'anfusahum faahlakathu wamaa zal amahumul laahu wal aakin 'anfusahum yazlimoon

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa tattakhizu bitaanat mmin doonikum laa yal oonakum khabaal a waddu maa 'anittum qad badatil baghdaa'u min 'afwaahihim wamaa tukhfee sudooruhum 'akbaru qad bayyannaa lakumul ayaati 'in kuntum ta'qil oon

Haantum 'oolaa'i tuhibboonahum wal aa yuhibboonakum watu'minoona bil kitaabi kul lihi waizaa laqookum qaal ooaa 'aamannaa waizaa khal awa 'addu 'al aykumul anaamil a minal ghayzi qul mootu bighayzikum 'innal laaha 'al eemu bizaatis-sudoor
'in tamsaskum hasanat tasu'hum wain tusibkum sayyi'at yafrahu bihaa wain tasbiru watattaqu laa yadurrukum kayduhum shayana 'innal laaha bimaa ya'mal oona muheeh
Waiz ghadawta min 'ahlika tubawwi'ul mu'mineena maqaa'ida lil qitaal i wal laahu samee'un 'al eem
'iz hammat ttaa'ifataani minkum 'an tafshal aa wal laahu wal eeyuhumaa wa'al aal laahi fal yatawakkal il mu'minoon
Wal aqad nasarakumul laahu bibadr waantum 'azil lat fattaqul laaha la'al lakum tashkuroon
'iz taqoolu lil mu'mineena 'al any yakfeeakum 'any yumiddakum rabbukum bithal aathati 'aal aaf mminal mal aa'ikati munzal een
Bal aa 'in tasbiru watattaqu wayatookum mmin fawrihim haazaa yumdidkum rabbukum bikhamsati 'aal aaf mminal mal aa'ikati musawwimeen
Wamaa ja'al ahul laahu 'il laa bushraa lakum wal itatma'inna qul oobukum bihi wamaan-nasru 'il laa min 'indil laahil'azeezil hakeem
Leeaqta'a tarafa mminal lazeena kafarooaa 'aw yakbitahum fayanqal ibu khaa'ibeen
Laysa laka minal amri shay'un 'aw yatooba 'al ayhim 'aw yu'azzibahum fainnahum zaal imoon
Wal il laahi maa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardi yaghfiru limany yashaa'u wayu'azzibu many yashaa'u wal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa takul ur-ribawaa 'ad'aafa mmudaa'afat wattaqul laaha la'al lakum tuflihoon
Wattaqun-naaral lateeaa 'u'iddat lil kaafireen
Waatee'ul laaha war-rasoola la'al lakum turhamoon
Wasaari'ooaa 'il aa maghfirat mmir rrabbikum wajannatin 'arduhaas-samaawaatu wal ardu 'u'iddat lil muttaqeen
Al lazeena yunfiqoona fee as-sarraa'i wad-darraa'i wal kaazimeenal ghayza wal'aafeena 'anin-naasi wal laahu yuhibbul muhsineen
Wal lazeena 'izaa fa'al u faahishatan 'aw zal amooaa 'anfusahum zakarul laaha fastaghfaru lizunoobihim wamany yaghfiruz-zunooba 'il laal laahu wal am yusirru 'al aa maa fa'al u wahum ya'lamoon
'ul aa'ika jazaa'uhum mmaghfirat mmir rrabbihim wajannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa wani'ma 'ajrul'aamil een
Qad khal at min qablikum sunan faseeru fee al ardi fanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul mukazzibeen
Haazaa bayaal llin-naasi wahuda wamaw'izat llil muttaqeen
Wal aa tahinu wal aa tahzanu waantumul a'lawna 'in kuntum mmu'mineen

'iny yamsaskum qarh faqad massal qawma qarh mmithluhu watil kal ayyaamu nudaawil uhaa baynan-naasi wal eea'lamal laahul lazeena 'aamanu wayattakhiza minkum shuhadaa'a wal laahu laa yuhibbuz-zaal imeen
Wal eeumahhisal laahul lazeena 'aamanu wayamhaqal kaafireen
'am hasibtum 'an tadkhul ul jannata wal ammaa ya'lamil laahul lazeena jaahadu minkum waya'lamas-saabireen
Wal aqad kuntum tamannawnal mawta min qabli 'an tal qawhu faqad raytumoohu waantum tanzuroon

Wamaa muhammadun 'il laa rasool qad khal at min qablihir-rusul u 'afaeen mmaata 'aw qutil anqal abtum 'al aa 'a'qaabikum wamany yanqal ib 'al aa 'aqibayhi fal any yadurral laaha shaya wasayajzee al laahush-shaakireen
Wamaa kaana linafsin 'an tamoota 'il laa biiznil laahi kitaaba mmu'ajjal a wamany yurid thawaabad-dunyaa nu'tihi minhaa wamany yurid thawaabal aakhirati nu'tihi minhaa wasanajzee ash-shaakireen
Wakayyim mmin nnabeey qaatal a ma'ahu ribbeeyoona katheer famaa wahanu limaa 'asaabahum fee sabeelil laahi wamaa da'ufu wamaastakaanu wal laahu yuhibbus-saabireen
Wamaa kaana qawlahum 'il laa 'an qaal u rabbanaaghfir lanaa zunoobanaa waisraafanaa feeaa 'amrinaa wathabbit 'aqdaamanaa wansurnaa 'al aal qawmil kaafireen
Faataahumul laahu thawaabad-dunyaa wahusna thawaabil aakhirati wal laahu yuhibbul muhsineen
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'in tutee'ul lazeena kafaru yaruddookum 'al aa 'a'qaabikum fatanqal ibu khaasireen
Bal il laahu mawlaakum wahooa khayrun-naasireen
Sanul qee fee qul oobil lazeena kafarur-ru'ba bimaa 'ashraku bil laahi maa lam yunazzil bihi sul taana wamawaahumun-naaru wabi'sa mathwaaz-zaal imeen

Wal aqad sadaqakumul laahu wa'dahuaa 'iz tahussoonahum biiznihi hattaa 'izaa fashil tum watanaaza'tum fee al amri wa'asaytum mmim ba'di maa 'araakum mmaa tuhibboona minkum mmany yureedud-dunyaa waminkum mmany yureedul aakhirata thumma sarafakum 'anhum leeabtal eeakum wal aqad 'afaa 'ankum wal laahu zoo fadlin 'al aal mu'mineen

'iz tus'idoona wal aa tal wuna 'al aa 'ahad war-rasoolu yad'ookum feeaa 'ukhraakum faathaabakum ghammaa bighamm llikaylaa tahzanu 'al aa maa faatakum wal aa maa 'asaabakum wal laahu khabeeru bimaa ta'mal oon

Thumma 'anzal a 'al aykum mmim ba'dil ghammi 'amanat nnu'aasa yaghshaa taa'ifat mminkum wataa'ifat qad 'ahammathum 'anfusuhum yazunnoona bil laahi ghayral haqqi zannal jaahil iyyati yaqooloona hal-lanaa minal amri min shay' qul 'innal amra kul laahu lil laahi yukhfoona feeaa 'anfusihim mmaa laa yubdoona laka yaqooloona law kaana lanaa minal amri shay' mmaa qutil naa haahunaa qul-law kuntum fee buyootikum labarazal lazeena kutiba 'al ayhimul qatlu 'il aa madaaji'ihim wal eeabtal eeal laahu maa fee sudoorikum wal eeumahhisa maa fee qul oobikum wal laahu 'al eemu bizaatis-sudoor
'innal lazeena tawal lawa minkum yawmal taqaal jam'aani 'innamaastazal laahumush-shaytaanu biba'di maa kasabu wal aqad 'afaal laahu 'anhum 'innal laaha ghafoorun hal eem

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa takoonu kal lazeena kafaru waqaal u liikhwaanihim 'izaa darabu fee al ardi 'aw kaanu ghuzza llaw kaanu 'indanaa maa maatu wamaa qutil u leeaj'al al laahu zaal ika hasrat fee qul oobihim wal laahu yuhyi wayumeetu wal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona baseer
Wal a'in qutil tum fee sabeelil laahi 'aw muttum lamaghfirat mminal laahi warahmatun khayr mmimmaa yajma'oon
Wal a'im mmuttum 'aw qutil tum lail aal laahi tuhsharoon

Fabimaa rahmat mminal laahi linta lahum wal aw kunta fazzana ghal eezal qal bi lanfaddu min hawlika fa'fu 'anhum wastaghfir lahum washaawirhum fee al amri faizaa 'azamta fatawakkal 'al aal laahi 'innal laaha yuhibbul mutawakkil een
'iny yansurkumul laahu fal aa ghaal iba lakum wainy yakhzul kum faman zaal lazee yansurukum mmim ba'dihi wa'al aal laahi fal yatawakkal il mu'minoon
Wamaa kaana linabeeyin 'any yaghul la wamany yaghlul yati bimaa ghal la yawmal qeeaamati thumma tooaffaa kul lu nafs mmaa kasabat wahum laa yuzlamoon
'afamanittaba'a ridwaanal laahi kamam baa'a bisakhat mminal laahi wamawaahu jahannamu wabi'sal maseer
Hum darajaatun 'indal laahi wal laahu baseeru bimaa ya'mal oon

Laqad mannal laahu 'al aal mu'mineena 'iz ba'atha feehim rasoola mmin 'anfusihim yatlu 'al ayhim 'ayaatihi wayuzakkeehim wayu'al limuhumul kitaaba wal hikmata wain kaanu min qablu lafee dal aal mmubeen
'awal ammaa 'asaabatkum mmuseebat qad 'asabtum mmithlayhaa qul tum 'annaa haazaa qul hooa min 'indi 'anfusikum 'innal laaha 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
Wamaa 'asaabakum yawmal taqaal jam'aani fabiiznil laahi wal eea'lamal mu'mineen

Wal eea'lamal lazeena naafaqu waqeela lahum ta'aal awa qaatil u fee sabeelil laahi 'awidfa'u qaal u law na'lamu qitaal a llattaba'naakum hum lil kufri yawma'izin 'aqrabu minhum lil eemaani yaqooloona biafwaahihim mmaa laysa fee qul oobihim wal laahu 'a'lamu bimaa yaktumoon
Al lazeena qaal u liikhwaanihim waqa'adu law 'ataa'oonaa maa qutil u qul fadra'u 'an 'anfusikumul mawta 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Wal aa tahsabannal lazeena qutil u fee sabeelil laahi 'amwaataa bal 'ahyaa'un 'inda rabbihim yurzaqoon
Fariheena bimaa 'aataahumul laahu min fadlihi wayastabshiroona bil lazeena lam yal haqu bihim mmin khal fihim 'al laa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
Yastabshiroona bini'mat mminal laahi wafadl waannal laaha laa yudee'u 'ajral mu'mineen
Al lazeenastajaabu lil laahi war-rasooli mim ba'di maa 'asaabahumul qarhu lil lazeena 'ahsanu minhum wattaqawa 'ajrun 'azeem
Al lazeena qaal a lahumun-naasu 'innan-naasa qad jama'u lakum fakhshawhum fazaadahum 'eemaana waqaal u hasbunaal laahu wani'mal wakeel
Fanqal abu bini'mat mminal laahi wafadl llam yamsashum sooaa' wattaba'u ridwaanal laahi wal laahu zoo fadlin 'azeem
'innamaa zaal ikumush-shaytaanu yukhawwifu 'awleeaa'ahu fal aa takhaafoohum wakhaafooni 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
Wal aa yahzunkal lazeena yusaari'oona fee al kufri 'innahum lany yadurrul laaha shaya yureedul laahu 'al laa yaj'al a lahum hazza fee al aakhirati wal ahum 'azaabun 'azeem
'innal lazeenashtarawual kufra bil eemaani lany yadurrul laaha shaya wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Wal aa yahsabannal lazeena kafarooaa 'annamaa numlee lahum khayr llianfusihim 'innamaa numlee lahum leeazdaadooaa 'ithma wal ahum 'azaab mmuheen

Mmaa kaanal laahu leeazaral mu'mineena 'al aa maa 'antum 'al ayhi hattaa yameezal khabeetha minat-tayyibi wamaa kaanal laahu leeutli'akum 'al aal ghaybi wal aakinnal laaha yajtabee mir rrusul ihi many yashaa'u faaminu bil laahi warusul ihi wain tu'minu watattaqu fal akum 'ajrun 'azeem

Wal aa yahsabannal lazeena yabkhal oona bimaa 'aataahumul laahu min fadlihi hooa khayra llaahum bal hooa sharr llaahum sayutawwaqoona maa bakhil u bihi yawmal qeeaamati wal il laahi meeraathus-samaawaati wal ardi wal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer
Llaqad sami'al laahu qawlal lazeena qaal ooaa 'innal laaha faqeer wanahnu 'aghneeaa'u sanaktubu maa qaal u waqatlahumul anbeeaa'a bighayri haqq wanaqoolu zooqu 'azaabal hareeq
Zaal ika bimaa qaddamat 'aydeekum waannal laaha laysa bizal laam llil'abeed

Al lazeena qaal ooaa 'innal laaha 'ahida 'il aynaa 'al laa nu'mina lirasoolin hattaa yateeanaa biqurbaan takul uhun-naaru qul qad jaa'akum rusul mmin qablee bil bayyinaati wabil lazee qul tum fal ima qatal tumoohum 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Fain kazzabooka faqad kuzziba rusul mmin qablika jaa'oo bil bayyinaati waz-zuburi wal kitaabil muneer
Kul lu nafs zaa'iqatul mawti wainnamaa tooaffawna 'ujoorakum yawmal qeeaamati faman zuhziha 'anin-naari waudkhil al jannata faqad faaza wamaal hayawaatud-dunyaa 'il laa mataa'ul ghuroor
Latublawunna feeaa 'amwaal ikum waanfusikum wal atasma'unna minal lazeena 'ootul kitaaba min qablikum waminal lazeena 'ashrakooaa 'aza katheera wain tasbiru watattaqu fainna zaal ika min 'azmil umoor
Waiz 'akhazal laahu meethaaqal lazeena 'ootul kitaaba latubayyinunnahu lin-naasi wal aa taktumoonahu fanabazoohu waraa'a zuhoorihim washtarawa bihi thamana qal eela fabi'sa maa yashtaroon
Laa tahsabannal lazeena yafrahoona bimaa 'ata wwayuhibboona 'any yuhmadu bimaa lam yaf'al u fal aa tahsabannahum bimafaazat mminal'azaabi wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Wal il laahi mul kus-samaawaati wal ardi wal laahu 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
'inna fee khal qis-samaawaati wal ardi wakhtil aafil layli wan-nahaari layaat llioolee al al baab
Al lazeena yazkuroonal laaha qeeaama waqu'ooda wa'al aa junoobihim wayatafakkaroona fee khal qis-samaawaati wal ardi rabbanaa maa khal aqta haazaa baatil a subhaanaka faqinaa 'azaaban-naar
Rabbanaa 'innaka man tudkhil in-naara faqad 'akhzaytahu wamaa liz-zaal imeena min 'ansaar
Rrabbanaa 'innanaa sami'naa munaadeea yunaadee lil eemaani 'an 'aaminu birabbikum faamannaa rabbanaa faghfir lanaa zunoobanaa wakaffir 'annaa sayyiaatinaa watawaffanaa ma'al abraar
Rabbanaa wa'aatinaa maa wa'adttanaa 'al aa rusul ika wal aa tukhzinaa yawmal qeeaamati 'innaka laa tukhliful mee'aad

Fastajaaba lahum rabbuhum 'annee laa 'udee'u 'amal a 'aamil mminkum mmin zakarin 'aw 'unthaa ba'dukum mmim ba'd fal lazeena haajaru waukhriju min deeaarihim waoozu fee sabeelee waqaatal u waqutil u laukaffiranna 'anhum sayyiaatihim wal audkhil annahum jannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru thawaaba mmin 'indil laahi wal laahu 'indahu husnuth-thawaab
Laa yaghurrannaka taqal lubul lazeena kafaru fee al bil aad
Mataa' qal eel thumma mawaahum jahannamu wabi'sal mihaad
Laakinil lazeenattaqawa rabbahum lahum jannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa nuzul a mmin 'indil laahi wamaa 'indal laahi khayr llil abraar

Wainna min 'ahlil kitaabi lamany yu'minu bil laahi wamaa 'unzil a 'il aykum wamaa 'unzil a 'il ayhim khaashi'eena lil laahi laa yashtaroona biayaatil laahi thamana qal eelana 'ul aa'ika lahum 'ajruhum 'inda rabbihim 'innal laaha saree'ul hisaab
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanusbiru wasaabiru waraabitu wattaqul laaha la'al lakum tuflihoon

Yayyuhaan-naasuttaqu rabbakumul lazee khal aqakum mmin nnafs waahidat wakhal aqa minhaa zawjahaa wabaththa minhumaa rijaal a katheera wanisaa' wattaqul laahal lazee tasaa'al oona bihi wal arhaama 'innal laaha kaana 'al aykum raqeeb
