Wa'aatul yataamaa 'amwaal ahum wal aa tatabaddal ul khabeetha bit-tayyibi wal aa takul ooaa 'amwaal ahum 'il aa 'amwaal ikum 'innahu kaana hooba kabeer

Wain khiftum 'al laa tuqsitu fee al yataamaa fankihu maa taaba lakum mminan-nisaa'i mathnaa wathul aatha warubaa'a fain khiftum 'al laa ta'dil u fawaahidatan 'aw maa mal akat 'aymaanukum zaal ika 'adnaa 'al laa ta'ool
Wa'aatun-nisaa'a saduqaatihinna nihlat fain tibna lakum 'an shay' mminhu nafsa fakul oohu haneeaa mmareea
Wal aa tu'tus-sufahaa'a 'amwaal akumul latee ja'al al laahu lakum qeeaama warzuqoohum feehaa waksoohum waqoolu lahum qawla mma'roof

Wabtal ul yataamaa hattaa 'izaa bal aghun-nikaaha fain 'aanastum mminhum rushda fadfa'ooaa 'il ayhim 'amwaal ahum wal aa takul oohaa 'israafa wabidaarana 'any yakbaru waman kaana ghaniyya fal yasta'fif waman kaana faqeera fal yakul bil ma'roofi faizaa dafa'tum 'il ayhim 'amwaal ahum faashhidu 'al ayhim wakafaa bil laahi haseeb
Llir-rijaal i naseeb mmimmaa tarakal waal idaani wal aqraboona wal in-nisaa'i naseeb mmimmaa tarakal waal idaani wal aqraboona mimmaa qal la minhu 'aw kathura naseeba mmafrood
Waizaa hadaral qismata 'oolul qurbaa wal yataamaa wal masaakeenu farzuqoohum mminhu waqoolu lahum qawla mma'roof
Wal yakhshal lazeena law taraku min khal fihim zurriyyat di'aafana khaafu 'al ayhim fal yattaqul laaha wal yaqoolu qawla sadeedan
'innal lazeena yakul oona 'amwaal al yataamaa zul mana 'innamaa yakul oona fee butoonihim naara wasayaslawna sa'eer

Yooseekumul laahu feeaa 'awlaadikum liz-zakari mithlu hazzil unthayayni fain kunna nisaa' fawqathnatayni fal ahunna thul uthaa maa taraka wain kaanat waahidat fal ahaan-nisfu wal iabawayhi likul li waahid mminhumaas-sudusu mimmaa taraka 'in kaana lahu wal ad fail llam yakul llaahu wal ad wawarithahuaa 'abawaahu fal iummihith-thul uthu fain kaana lahuaa 'ikhwat fal iummihis-sudusu mim ba'di wasiyyat yoosee bihaa 'aw daynin 'aabaa'ukum waabnaa'ukum laa tadroona 'ayyuhum 'aqrabu lakum naf'a fareedat mminal laahi 'innal laaha kaana 'al eemana hakeem

Wal akum nisfu maa taraka 'azwaajukum 'il llam yakul llaahunna wal ad fain kaana lahunna wal ad fal akumur-rubu'u mimmaa tarakna mim ba'di wasiyyat yooseena bihaa 'aw dayn wal ahunnar-rubu'u mimmaa taraktum 'il llam yakul llakum wal ad fain kaana lakum wal ad fal ahunnath-thumunu mimmaa taraktum mmim ba'di wasiyyat toosoona bihaa 'aw dayn wain kaana rajul yoorathu kal aal atan 'awimraat wal ahuaa 'akhun 'aw 'ukht fal ikul li waahid mminhumaas-sudusu fain kaanooaa 'akthara min zaal ika fahum shurakaa'u fee ath-thul uthi mim ba'di wasiyyat yoosaa bihaa 'aw daynin ghayra mudaarr wasiyyat mminal laahi wal laahu 'al eemun hal eem
Til ka hudoodul laahi wamany yuti'il laaha warasoolahu yudkhil hu jannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa wazaal ikal fawzul'azeem
Wamany ya'sil laaha warasoolahu wayata'adda hudoodahu yudkhil hu naarana khaal ida feehaa wal ahu 'azaab mmuheen
Wal laatee yateenal faahishata min nnisaa'ikum fastashhidu 'al ayhinna 'arba'at mminkum fain shahidu faamsikoohunna fee al buyooti hattaa yatawaffaahunnal mawtu 'aw yaj'al al laahu lahunna sabeel
Wal lazaani yateeaanihaa minkum faazoohumaa fain taabaa waaslahaa faa'ridu 'anhumaa 'innal laaha kaana tawwaaba rraheeman
'innamaat-tawbatu 'al aal laahi lil lazeena ya'mal oonas-sooaa'a bijahaal at thumma yatooboona min qareeb faul aa'ika yatoobul laahu 'al ayhim wakaanal laahu 'al eemana hakeem

Wal aysatit-tawbatu lil lazeena ya'mal oonas-sayyiaati hattaa 'izaa hadara 'ahadahumul mawtu qaal a 'innee tubtul aana wal aal lazeena yamootoona wahum kuffaarun 'ul aa'ika 'a'tadnaa lahum 'azaabana 'al eem

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa yahil lu lakum 'an tarithun-nisaa'a karha wal aa ta'dul oohunna litazhabu biba'di maa 'aataytumoohunna 'il laa 'any yateena bifaahishat mmubayyinat wa'aashiroohunna bil ma'roofi fain karihtumoohunna fa'asaa 'an takrahu shaya wayaj'al al laahu feehi khayra katheer
Wain 'aradttumustibdaal a zawj mmakaana zawj wa'aataytum 'ihdaahunna qintaara fal aa takhuzu minhu shayana 'atakhuzoonahu buhtaana waithma mmubeen
Wakayfa takhuzoonahu waqad 'afdaa ba'dukum 'il aa ba'd waakhazna minkum mmeethaaqana ghal eez
Wal aa tankihu maa nakaha 'aabaa'ukum mminan-nisaa'i 'il laa maa qad sal afa 'innahu kaana faahishat wamaqta wasaa'a sabeelan

Hurrimat 'al aykum 'ummahaatukum wabanaatukum waakhawaatukum wa'ammaatukum wakhaal aatukum wabanaatul akhi wabanaatul ukhti waummahaatukumul laateeaa 'arda'nakum waakhawaatukum mminar-radaa'ati waummahaatu nisaa'ikum warabaa'ibukumul laatee fee hujoorikum mmin nnisaa'ikumul laatee dakhal tum bihinna fail llam takoonu dakhal tum bihinna fal aa junaaha 'al aykum wahal aa'il u 'abnaa'ikumul lazeena min 'aslaabikum waan tajma'u baynal ukhtayni 'il laa maa qad sal afa 'innal laaha kaana ghafoora rraheem

Wal muhsanaatu minan-nisaa'i 'il laa maa mal akat 'aymaanukum kitaabal laahi 'al aykum wauhil la lakum mmaa waraa'a zaal ikum 'an tabtaghu biamwaal ikum mmuhsineena ghayra musaafiheena famaastamta'tum bihi minhunna faatoohunna 'ujoorahunna fareedat wal aa junaaha 'al aykum feemaa taraadaytum bihi mim ba'dil fareedati 'innal laaha kaana 'al eemana hakeem

Wamal llam yastati' minkum tawlana 'any yankihal muhsanaatil mu'minaati famim mmaa mal akat 'aymaanukum mmin fatayaatikumul mu'minaati wal laahu 'a'lamu bieemaanikum ba'dukum mmim ba'd fankihoohunna biizni 'ahlihinna wa'aatoohunna 'ujoorahunna bil ma'roofi muhsanaatin ghayra musaafihaat wal aa muttakhizaati 'akhdaan faizaa 'uhsinna fain 'atayna bifaahishat fa'al ayhinna nisfu maa 'al aal muhsanaati minal'azaabi zaal ika liman khasheeal'anata minkum waan tasbiru khayr llakum wal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Yureedul laahu leeubayyina lakum wayahdeeakum sunanal lazeena min qablikum wayatooba 'al aykum wal laahu 'al eemun hakeem
Wal laahu yureedu 'any yatooba 'al aykum wayureedul lazeena yattabi'oonash-shahawaati 'an tameelu maylana 'azeem
Yureedul laahu 'any yukhaffifa 'ankum wakhul iqal insaanu da'eef
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa takul ooaa 'amwaal akum baynakum bil baatil i 'il laa 'an takoona tijaaratan 'an taraad mminkum wal aa taqtul ooaa 'anfusakum 'innal laaha kaana bikum raheem
Wamany yaf'al zaal ika 'udwaana wazul ma fasawfa nusleehi naara wakaana zaal ika 'al aal laahi yaseeran
'in tajtanibu kabaa'ira maa tunhawna 'anhu nukaffir 'ankum sayyiaatikum wanudkhil kum mmudkhal a kareem

Wal aa tatamannawa maa faddal al laahu bihi ba'dakum 'al aa ba'd llir-rijaal i naseeb mmimmaaktasabu wal in-nisaa'i naseeb mmimmaaktasabna wasal ul laaha min fadlihiaa 'innal laaha kaana bikul li shay'in 'al eem
Wal ikul l ja'al naa mawaal eea mimmaa tarakal waal idaani wal aqraboona wal lazeena 'aqadat 'aymaanukum faatoohum naseebahum 'innal laaha kaana 'al aa kul li shay' shaheedan

Ar-rijaal u qawwaamoona 'al aan-nisaa'i bimaa faddal al laahu ba'dahum 'al aa ba'd wabimaa 'anfaqu min 'amwaal ihim fas-saal ihaatu qaanitaatun haafizaat llil ghaybi bimaa hafizal laahu wal laatee takhaafoona nushoozahunna fa'izoohunna wahjuroohunna fee al madaaji'i wadriboohunna fain 'ata'nakum fal aa tabghu 'al ayhinna sabeelana 'innal laaha kaana 'al iyya kabeer
Wain khiftum shiqaaqa baynihimaa fab'athu hakama mmin 'ahlihi wahakama mmin 'ahlihaa 'iny yureedaa 'islaaha yooaffiqil laahu baynahumaa 'innal laaha kaana 'al eemana khabeer

Wa'budul laaha wal aa tushriku bihi shaya wabil waal idayni 'ihsaana wabizee al qurbaa wal yataamaa wal masaakeeni wal jaari zee al qurbaa wal jaaril junubi was-saahibi bil janbi wabnis-sabeeli wamaa mal akat 'aymaanukum 'innal laaha laa yuhibbu man kaana mukhtaal a fakhooran
Al lazeena yabkhal oona wayamuroonan-naasa bil bukhli wayaktumoona maa 'aataahumul laahu min fadlihi waa'tadnaa lil kaafireena 'azaaba mmuheen
Wal lazeena yunfiqoona 'amwaal ahum ri'aa'an-naasi wal aa yu'minoona bil laahi wal aa bil yawmil aakhiri wamany yakunish-shaytaanu lahu qareena fasaa'a qareen
Wamaazaa 'al ayhim law 'aamanu bil laahi wal yawmil aakhiri waanfaqu mimmaa razaqahumul laahu wakaanal laahu bihim 'al eeman
'innal laaha laa yazlimu mithqaal a zarrat wain taku hasanat yudaa'ifhaa wayu'ti mil lladunhu 'ajrana 'azeem
Fakayfa 'izaa ji'naa min kul li 'ummati bishaheed waji'naa bika 'al aa haa'ul aa'i shaheed
Yawma'iz yawaddul lazeena kafaru wa'asawuar-rasoola law tusawwaa bihimul ardu wal aa yaktumoonal laaha hadeeth

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa taqrabus-sal aata waantum sukaaraa hattaa ta'lamu maa taqooloona wal aa junubana 'il laa 'aabiree sabeelin hattaa taghtasil u wain kuntum mmardaa 'aw 'al aa safarin 'aw jaa'a 'ahad mminkum mminal ghaa'iti 'aw laamastumun-nisaa'a fal am tajidu maa' fatayammamu sa'eeda tayyiba famsahu biwujoohikum waydeekum 'innal laaha kaana 'afoowana ghafooran
'al am tara 'il aal lazeena 'ootu naseeba mminal kitaabi yashtaroonad-dal aal ata wayureedoona 'an tadil lus-sabeel
Wal laahu 'a'lamu bia'daa'ikum wakafaa bil laahi wal iyya wakafaa bil laahi naseer

Mminal lazeena haadu yuharrifoonal kal ima 'am mmawaadi'ihi wayaqooloona sami'naa wa'asaynaa wasma' ghayra musma' waraa'inaa layyaa bial sinatihim wata'na fee ad-deeni wal aw 'annahum qaal u sami'naa waata'naa wasma' wanzurnaa lakaana khayra llaahum waaqwama wal aakil lla'anahumul laahu bikufrihim fal aa yu'minoona 'il laa qal eel

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'ootul kitaaba 'aaminu bimaa nazzal naa musaddiqa llimaa ma'akum mmin qabli 'an nnatmisa wujooha fanaruddahaa 'al aa 'adbaarihaa 'aw nal'anahum kamaa la'annaa 'ashaabas-sabti wakaana 'amrul laahi maf'oolan
'innal laaha laa yaghfiru 'any yushraka bihi wayaghfiru maa doona zaal ika limany yashaa'u wamany yushrik bil laahi faqadiftaraa 'ithmana 'azeeman
'al am tara 'il aal lazeena yuzakkoona 'anfusahum bal il laahu yuzakkee many yashaa'u wal aa yuzlamoona fateelan
Anzur kayfa yaftaroona 'al aal laahil kaziba wakafaa bihiaa 'ithma mmubeenan
'al am tara 'il aal lazeena 'ootu naseeba mminal kitaabi yu'minoona bil jibti wat-taaghooti wayaqooloona lil lazeena kafaru haa'ul aa'i 'ahdaa minal lazeena 'aamanu sabeelan
'ul aa'ikal lazeena la'anahumul laahu wamany yal'anil laahu fal an tajida lahu naseeran
'am lahum naseeb mminal mul ki faiza llaa yu'toonan-naasa naqeeran
'am yahsudoonan-naasa 'al aa maa 'aataahumul laahu min fadlihi faqad 'aataynaa 'aal a 'ibraaheemal kitaaba wal hikmata wa'aataynaahum mmul kana 'azeem
Faminhum mman 'aamana bihi waminhum mman sadda 'anhu wakafaa bijahannama sa'eeran
'innal lazeena kafaru biayaatinaa sawfa nusleehim naara kul lamaa nadijat jul ooduhum baddal naahum jul oodana ghayrahaa leeazooqul'azaaba 'innal laaha kaana 'azeezana hakeem
Wal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati sanudkhil uhum jannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa 'abada llaahum feehaa 'azwaaj mmutahharat wanudkhil uhum zil la zal eelan
'innal laaha yamurukum 'an tu'addul amaanaati 'il aa 'ahlihaa waizaa hakamtum baynan-naasi 'an tahkumu bil'adli 'innal laaha ni'immaa ya'izukum bihiaa 'innal laaha kaana samee'aa baseer

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'atee'ul laaha waatee'ur-rasoola waoolee al amri minkum fain tanaaza'tum fee shay' faruddoohu 'il aal laahi war-rasooli 'in kuntum tu'minoona bil laahi wal yawmil aakhiri zaal ika khayr waahsanu taweelan

'al am tara 'il aal lazeena yaz'umoona 'annahum 'aamanu bimaa 'unzil a 'il ayka wamaa 'unzil a min qablika yureedoona 'any yatahaakamooaa 'il aat-taaghooti waqad 'umirooaa 'any yakfuru bihi wayureedush-shaytaanu 'any yudil laahum dal aal aa ba'eed
Waizaa qeela lahum ta'aal awa 'il aa maa 'anzal al laahu wail aar-rasooli raytal munaafiqeena yasuddoona 'anka sudood
Fakayfa 'izaa 'asaabathum mmuseebatu bimaa qaddamat 'aydeehim thumma jaa'ooka yahlifoona bil laahi 'in 'aradnaa 'il laa 'ihsaana watawfeeqan
'ul aa'ikal lazeena ya'lamul laahu maa fee qul oobihim faa'rid 'anhum wa'izhum waqul-laahum feeaa 'anfusihim qawlaa bal eegh
Wamaa 'arsal naa mir rrasoolin 'il laa leeutaa'a biiznil laahi wal aw 'annahum 'iz zzal amooaa 'anfusahum jaa'ooka fastaghfarul laaha wastaghfara lahumur-rasoolu lawajadul laaha tawwaaba rraheem
Fal aa warabbika laa yu'minoona hattaa yuhakkimooka feemaa shajara baynahum thumma laa yajidu feeaa 'anfusihim haraja mmimmaa qadayta wayusal limu tasleem

Wal aw 'annaa katabnaa 'al ayhim 'aniqtul ooaa 'anfusakum 'awikhruju min deeaarikum mmaa fa'al oohu 'il laa qal eel mminhum wal aw 'annahum fa'al u maa yoo'azoona bihi lakaana khayra llaahum waashadda tathbeeh
Waiza llaataynaahum mmil lladunnaa 'ajrana 'azeem
Wal ahadaynaahum siraata mmustaqeem
Wamany yuti'il laaha war-rasoola faul aa'ika ma'al lazeena 'an'amal laahu 'al ayhim mminan-nabeeyina was-siddeeqeena wash-shuhadaa'i was-saal iheena wahasuna 'ul aa'ika rafeeq
Zaal ikal fadlu minal laahi wakafaa bil laahi 'al eem
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu khuzu hizrakum fanfiru thubaatin 'awinfiru jamee'
Wainna minkum lamal llayubatti'anna fain 'asaabatkum mmuseebat qaal a qad 'an'amal laahu 'al ayya 'iz lam 'akum mma'ahum shaheed
Wal a'in 'asaabakum fadl mminal laahi layaqoolanna kaal llam takum baynakum wabaynahu mawaddat yaal aytanee kuntu ma'ahum faafooza fawzana 'azeem
Fal yuqaatil fee sabeelil laahil lazeena yashroonal hayawaatad-dunyaa bil aakhirati wamany yuqaatil fee sabeelil laahi fayuqtal 'aw yaghlib fasawfa nu'teehi 'ajrana 'azeem

Wamaa lakum laa tuqaatil oona fee sabeelil laahi wal mustad'afeena minar-rijaal i wan-nisaa'i wal wil daanil lazeena yaqooloona rabbanaa 'akhrijnaa min haazihil qaryatiz-zaal imi 'ahluhaa waj'al-lanaa mil lladunka wal iyya waj'al-lanaa mil lladunka naseeran
Al lazeena 'aamanu yuqaatil oona fee sabeelil laahi wal lazeena kafaru yuqaatil oona fee sabeelit-taaghooti faqaatil ooaa 'awleeaa'ash-shaytaani 'inna kaydash-shaytaani kaana da'eefan

'al am tara 'il aal lazeena qeela lahum kuffooaa 'aydeeakum waaqeemus-sal aata wa'aatuz-zakaata fal ammaa kutiba 'al ayhimul qitaal u 'izaa fareeq mminhum yakhshawnan-naasa kakhashyatil laahi 'aw 'ashadda khashyat waqaal u rabbanaa lima katabta 'al aynaal qitaal a lawlaa 'akhkhartanaa 'il aa 'ajal qareeb qul mataa'ud-dunyaa qal eel wal aakhiratu khayr llimanittaqaa wal aa tuzlamoona fateelan

'aynamaa takoonu yudrikkkumul mawtu wal aw kuntum fee burooj mmushayyadat wain tusibhum hasanat yaqoolu haazihi min 'indil laahi wain tusibhum sayyi'at yaqoolu haazihi min 'indika qul kul l mmin 'indil laahi famaal i haa'ul aa'il qawmi laa yakaadoona yafqahoona hadeeth
Mmaa 'asaabaka min hasanat faminal laahi wamaa 'asaabaka min sayyi'at famin nnafsika waarsal naaka lin-naasi rasoola wakafaa bil laahi shaheed
Mmany yuti'ir-rasoola faqad 'ataa'al laaha waman tawal laa famaa 'arsal naaka 'al ayhim hafeez
Wayaqooloona taa'at faizaa barazu min 'indika bayyata taa'ifat mminhum ghayral lazee taqoolu wal laahu yaktubu maa yubayyitoona faa'rid 'anhum watawakkal 'al aal laahi wakafaa bil laahi wakeelan
'afal aa yatadabbaroonal qur'aana wal aw kaana min 'indi ghayril laahi lawajadu feehikhtil aafa katheer

Waizaa jaa'ahum 'amr mminal amni 'awil khawfi 'azaa'u bihi wal aw raddoohu 'il aar-rasooli wail aa 'oolee al amri minhum la'al imahul lazeena yastanbitoonahu minhum wal awlaa fadlul laahi 'al aykum warahmatuhu lattaba'tumush-shaytaana 'il laa qal eel
Faqaatil fee sabeelil laahi laa tukal lafu 'il laa nafsaka waharridil mu'mineena 'asaal laahu 'any yakuffa basal lazeena kafaru wal laahu 'ashaddu basa waashaddu tankeel
Mmany yashfa' shafaa'atan hasanat yakul llaahu naseeb mminhaa wamany yashfa' shafaa'at sayyi'at yakul llaahu kifl mminhaa wakaanal laahu 'al aa kul li shay' mmuqeeh
Waizaa huyyeetum bitahiyyat fahayyu biahsana minhaa 'aw ruddoohaa 'innal laaha kaana 'al aa kul li shay'in haseeban
Al laahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa layajma'annakum 'il aa yawmil qeeaamati laa rayba feehi waman 'asdaqu minal laahi hadeeth
Famaa lakum fee al munaafiqeena fi'atayni wal laahu 'arkasahum bimaa kasabooaa 'atureedoona 'an tahdu man 'adal lal laahu wamany yudlil il laahu fal an tajida lahu sabeel

Waddu law takfuroona kamaa kafaru fatakoonoona sawaa' fal aa tattakhizu minhum 'awleeaa'a hattaa yuhaajiru fee sabeelil laahi fain tawal lawa fakhuzoohum waqtul oohum haythu wajadttumoohum wal aa tattakhizu minhum wal iyya wal aa naseeran

'il laal lazeena yasil oona 'il aa qawmi baynakum wabaynahum mmeethaaqun 'aw jaa'ookum hasirat sudooruhum 'any yuqaatil ookum 'aw yuqaatil u qawmahum wal aw shaa'al laahu lasal latahum 'al aykum fal aqaatal ookum faini'tazal ookum fal am yuqaatil ookum waal qawa 'il aykumus-sal ama famaa ja'al al laahu lakum 'al ayhim sabeel

Satajidoona 'aakhareena yureedoona 'any yamanookum wayamanu qawmahum kul la maa ruddooaa 'il aal fitnati 'urkisu feehaa fail llam ya'tazil ookum wayul qooaa 'il aykumus-sal ama wayakuffooaa 'aydeeahum fakhuzoohum waqtul oohum haythu thaqiftumoohum waoolaa'ikum ja'al naa lakum 'al ayhim sul taana mmubeen

Wamaa kaana limu'minin 'any yaqtul a mu'minana 'il laa khataa waman qatal a mu'minana khataa fatahreeru raqabat mmu'minat wadeeat mmusal lamatun 'il aa 'ahlihiaa 'il laa 'any yassaddaqu fain kaana min qawmin 'adoow llakum wahooa mu'min fatahreeru raqabat mmu'minat wain kaana min qawmi baynakum wabaynahum mmeethaaq fadeeat mmusal lamatun 'il aa 'ahlihi watahreeru raqabat mmu'minat famal llam yajid faseeaamu shahrayni mutataabi'ayni tawbat mminal laahi wakaanal laahu 'al eemana hakeem
Wamany yaqtul mu'mina mmuta'ammida fajazaa'uhu jahannamu khaal ida feehaa waghadibal laahu 'al ayhi wal a'anahu waa'adda lahu 'azaabana 'azeem

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'izaa darabtum fee sabeelil laahi fatabayyanu wal aa taqoolu liman 'al qaa 'il aykumus-sal aama lasta mu'mina tabtaghoona 'aradal hayawaatid-dunyaa fa'indal laahi maghaanimu katheerat kazaal ika kuntum mmin qablu famannal laahu 'al aykum fatabayyanooaa 'innal laaha kaana bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer

Llaa yastawee al qaa'idoona minal mu'mineena ghayru 'oolee ad-darari wal mujaahidoona fee sabeelil laahi biamwaal ihim waanfusihim faddal al laahul mujaahideena biamwaal ihim waanfusihim 'al aal qaa'ideena darajat wakul la wa'adal laahul husnaa wafaddal al laahul mujaahideena 'al aal qaa'ideena 'ajrana 'azeem
Darajaat mminhu wamaghfirat warahmat wakaanal laahu ghafoora rraheeman

'innal lazeena tawaffaahumul mal aa'ikatu zaal imeeaa 'anfusihim qaal u feema kuntum qaal u kunnaa mustad'afeena fee al ardi qaal ooaa 'al am takun 'ardul laahi waasi'at fatuhaajiru feehaa faul aa'ika mawaahum jahannamu wasaa'at maseeran
'il laal mustad'afeena minar-rijaal i wan-nisaa'i wal wil daani laa yastatee'oona heelat wal aa yahtadoona sabeel
Faul aa'ika 'asaal laahu 'any ya'fooa 'anhum wakaanal laahu 'afoowana ghafoor

Wamany yuhaajir fee sabeelil laahi yajid fee al ardi muraaghama katheera wasa'at wamany yakhruj mim baytihi muhaajirana 'il aal laahi warasoolihi thumma yudrikhul mawtu faqad waqa'a 'ajruhu 'al aal laahi wakaanal laahu ghafoora rraheem
Waizaa darabtum fee al ardi fal aysa 'al aykum junaahun 'an taqsuru minas-sal aati 'in khiftum 'any yaftinakumul lazeena kafarooaa 'innal kaafireena kaanu lakum 'adoowa mmubeen

Waizaa kunta feehim faaqamta lahumus-sal aata fal taqum taa'ifat mminhum mma'aka wal yakhuzooaa 'aslihatahum faizaa sajadu fal yakoonu minw waraa'ikum wal tati taa'ifatun 'ukhraa lam yusal lu fal yusal lu ma'aka wal yakhuzu hizrahum waaslihatahum waddal lazeena kafaru law taghful oona 'an 'aslihatikum waamti'atikum fayameeloona 'al aykum mmaylat waahidat wal aa junaaha 'al aykum 'in kaana bikum 'aza mmim mmatarin 'aw kuntum mmardaa 'an tada'ooaa 'aslihatakum wakhuzu hizrakum 'innal laaha 'a'adda lil kaafireena 'azaaba mmuheen
Faizaa qadaytumus-sal aata fazkurul laaha qeeaama waqu'ooda wa'al aa junoobikum faizaatmanantum faaqeemus-sal aata 'innas-sal aata kaanat 'al aal mu'mineena kitaaba mmawqooh
Wal aa tahinu fee abtighaa'il qawmi 'in takoonu tal amoona fainnahum yal amoona kamaa tal amoona watarjoona minal laahi maa laa yarjoona wakaanal laahu 'al eemana hakeeman
'innaa 'anzal naa 'il aykal kitaaba bil haqqi litahkuma baynan-naasi bimaa 'araakal laahu wal aa takul llil khaa'ineena khaseem
Wastaghfiril laaha 'innal laaha kaana ghafoora rraheem
Wal aa tujaadil 'anil lazeena yakhtaanoona 'anfusahum 'innal laaha laa yuhibbu man kaana khawwaanana 'atheem
Yastakhfoona minan-naasi wal aa yastakhfoona minal laahi wahooa ma'ahum 'iz yubayyitoona maa laa yardaa minal qawli wakaanal laahu bimaa ya'mal oona muheetan
Haantum haa'ul aa'i jaadal tum 'anhum fee al hayawaatid-dunyaa famany yujaadil ul laaha 'anhum yawmal qeeaamati 'am mmany yakoonu 'al ayhim wakeel
Wamany ya'mal sooaa'ana 'aw yazlim nafsahu thumma yastaghfiril laaha yajidil laaha ghafoora rraheem
Wamany yaksib 'ithma fainnamaa yaksibuhu 'al aa nafsihi wakaanal laahu 'al eemana hakeem
Wamany yaksib khateeaatan 'aw 'ithma thumma yarmi bihi bareeaa faqadihtamal a buhtaana waithma mmubeen

Wal awlaa fadlul laahi 'al ayka warahmatuhu lahammat ttaa'ifat mminhum 'any yudil looka wamaa yudil loona 'il laa 'anfusahum wamaa yadurroonaka min shay' waanzal al laahu 'al aykal kitaaba wal hikmata wa'al lamaka maa lam takun ta'lamu wakaana fadlul laahi 'al ayka 'azeem
Llaa khayra fee katheer mmin nnajwaahum 'il laa man 'amara bisadaqatin 'aw ma'roofin 'aw 'islaahi baynan-naasi wamany yaf'al zaal ikabtighaa'a mardaatil laahi fasawfa nu'teehi 'ajrana 'azeem
Wamany yushaaqiqir-rasoola mim ba'di maa tabayyana lahul hudaa wayattabi' ghayra sabeelil mu'mineena nooal lihi maa tawal laa wanuslihi jahannama wasaa'at maseeran
'innal laaha laa yaghfiru 'any yushraka bihi wayaghfiru maa doona zaal ika limany yashaa'u wamany yushrik bil laahi faqad dal la dal aal aa ba'eedan
'iny yad'oona min doonihiaa 'il laa 'inaatha wainy yad'oona 'il laa shaytaana mmareed
Lla'anahul laahu waqaal a laattakhizanna min 'ibaadika naseeba mmafrood

Wal audil lannahum wal aumanneeannahum wal aamurannahum fal ayubattikunna 'aazaanal an'aami wal aamurannahum fal ayughayyirunna khal qal laahi wamany yattakhizish-shaytaana wal iyya mmin doonil laahi faqad khasira khusraana mmubeen
Ya'iduhum wayumanneehim wamaa ya'iduhumush-shaytaanu 'il laa ghurooran
'ul aa'ika mawaahum jahannamu wal aa yajidoona 'anhaa mahees
Wal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati sanudkhil uhum jannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa 'abada wa'dal laahi haqqa waman 'asdaqu minal laahi qeel
Llaysa biamaaneeyikum wal aa 'amaaneeyi 'ahlil kitaabi many ya'mal sooaa'a yujza bihi wal aa yajid lahu min doonil laahi wal iyya wal aa naseer
Wamany ya'mal minas-saal ihaati min zakarin 'aw 'unthaa wahooa mu'min faul aa'ika yadkhul oonal jannata wal aa yuzlamoona naqeer
Waman 'ahsanu deena mmimman 'aslama wajhahu lil laahi wahooa muhsinw wattaba'a mil lata 'ibraaheema haneefa wattakhazal laahu 'ibraaheema khal eel
Wal il laahi maa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardi wakaanal laahu bikul li shay' mmuheeh

Wayastaftoonaka fee an-nisaa'i qul il laahu yufteekum feehinna wamaa yutlaa 'al aykum fee al kitaabi fee yataamaan-nisaa'il laatee laa tu'toonahunna maa kutiba lahunna watarghaboona 'an tankihoohunna wal mustad'afeena minal wil daani waan taqoomu lil yataamaa bil qisti wamaa taf'al u min khayr fainnal laaha kaana bihi 'al eem

Wainimraatun khaafat mim ba'lihaa nushoozana 'aw 'i'raada fal aa junaaha 'al ayhimaa 'any yuslihaa baynahumaa sul ha was-sul hu khayr wauhdiratil anfusush-shuhha wain tuhsinu watattaqu fainnal laaha kaana bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer
Wal an tastatee'ooaa 'an ta'dil u baynan-nisaa'i wal aw harastum fal aa tameelu kul lal mayli fatazaroohaa kal mu'al laqati wain tuslihu watattaqu fainnal laaha kaana ghafoora rraheem
Wainy yatafarraqaa yughnil laahu kul la mmin sa'atihi wakaanal laahu waasi'ana hakeem

Wal il laahi maa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardi wal aqad wassaynaal lazeena 'ootul kitaaba min qablikum waiyyaakum 'anittaqul laaha wain takfuru fainna lil laahi maa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardi wakaanal laahu ghaniyyana hameed
Wal il laahi maa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardi wakafaa bil laahi wakeelan
'iny yasha yuzhibkum 'ayyuhaan-naasu wayati biaakhareena wakaanal laahu 'al aa zaal ika qadeer
Mman kaana yureedu thawaabad-dunyaa fa'indal laahi thawaabud-dunyaa wal aakhirati wakaanal laahu samee'aa baseer

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu koonu qawwaameena bil qisti shuhadaa'a lil laahi wal aw 'al aa 'anfusikum 'awil waal idayni wal aqrabeena 'iny yakun ghaniyyana 'aw faqeera fal laahu 'awlaa bihimaa fal aa tattabi'ul hawaa 'an ta'dil u wain tal wuaa 'aw tu'ridu fainnal laaha kaana bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'aaminu bil laahi warasoolihi wal kitaabil lazee nazzal a 'al aa rasoolihi wal kitaabil lazeeaa 'anzal a min qablu wamany yakfur bil laahi wamal aa'ikatihi wakutubihi warusul ihi wal yawmil aakhiri faqad dal la dal aal aa ba'eedan
'innal lazeena 'aamanu thumma kafaru thumma 'aamanu thumma kafaru thummazdaadu kufra llam yakunil laahu leeaghfira lahum wal aa leeahdeeahum sabeela
Bashshiril munaafiqeena bianna lahum 'azaabana 'al eeman
Al lazeena yattakhizoonal kaafireena 'awleeaa'a min doonil mu'mineena 'ayabtaghoona 'indahumul'izzata fainnal'izzata lil laahi jamee'

Waqad nazzal a 'al aykum fee al kitaabi 'an 'izaa sami'tum 'ayaatil laahi yukfaru bihaa wayustahzau bihaa fal aa taq'udu ma'ahum hattaa yakhoodu fee hadeethin ghayrihiaa 'innakum 'iza mmithluhum 'innal laaha jaami'ul munaafiqeena wal kaafireena fee jahannama jamee'an

Al lazeena yatarabbasoona bikum fain kaana lakum fath mminal laahi qaal ooaa 'al am nakum mma'akum wain kaana lil kaafireena naseeb qaal ooaa 'al am nastahwiz 'al aykum wanamna'kum mminal mu'mineena fal laahu yahkumu baynakum yawmal qeeaamati wal any yaj'al al laahu lil kaafireena 'al aal mu'mineena sabeelan
'innal munaafiqeena yukhaadi'oonal laaha wahooa khaadi'uhum waizaa qaamooaa 'il aas-sal aati qaamu kusaal aa yuraa'oonan-naasa wal aa yazkuroonal laaha 'il laa qal eel
Mmuzabzabeena bayna zaal ika laa 'il aa haa'ul aa'i wal aa 'il aa haa'ul aa'i wamany yudlil il laahu fal an tajida lahu sabeel
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa tattakhizul kaafireena 'awleeaa'a min doonil mu'mineena 'atureedoona 'an taj'al u lil laahi 'al aykum sul taana mmubeenan
'innal munaafiqeena fee ad-darkil asfal i minan-naari wal an tajida lahum naseeran
'il laal lazeena taabu waaslahu wa'tasamu bil laahi waakhlasu deenahum lil laahi faul aa'ika ma'al mu'mineena wasawfa yu'til laahul mu'mineena 'ajrana 'azeem
Mmaa yaf'al ul laahu bi'azaabikum 'in shakartum wa'aamantum wakaanal laahu shaakirana 'al eem
Llaa yuhibbul laahul jahra bis-sooaa'i minal qawli 'il laa man zul ima wakaanal laahu samee'ana 'al eeman
'in tubdu khayrana 'aw tukhfoohu 'aw ta'fu 'an sooaa' fainnal laaha kaana 'afoowa qadeeran
'innal lazeena yakfuroona bil laahi warusul ihi wayureedoona 'any yufarriqu baynal laahi warusul ihi wayaqooloona nu'minu biba'd wanakfuru biba'd wayureedoona 'any yattakhizu bayna zaal ika sabeelan
'ul aa'ika humul kaafiroona haqqa waa'tadnaa lil kaafireena 'azaaba mmuheen
Wal lazeena 'aamanu bil laahi warusul ihi wal am yufarriqu bayna 'ahad mminhum 'ul aa'ika sawfa yu'teehim 'ujoorahum wakaanal laahu ghafoora rraheem

Yasal uka 'ahlul kitaabi 'an tunazzil a 'al ayhim kitaaba mminas-samaa'i faqad saal u moosaa 'akbara min zaal ika faqaal ooaa 'arinaal laaha jahrat faakhazathumus-saa'iqatu bizul mihim thummattakhazul'ijla mim ba'di maa jaa'athumul bayyinaatu fa'afawnaa 'an zaal ika wa'aataynaa moosaa sul taana mmubeen
Warafa'naa fawqahumut-toora bimeethaaqihim waqul naa lahumudkhul ul baaba sujjada waqul naa lahum laa ta'du fee as-sabti waakhaznaa minhum mmeethaaqana ghal eez
Fabimaa naqdihim mmeethaaqahum wakufrihim biayaatil laahi waqatlihimul anbeeaa'a bighayri haqq waqawlihim qul oobunaa ghul fu bal taba'al laahu 'al ayhaa bikufrihim fal aa yu'minoona 'il laa qal eel
Wabikufrihim waqawlihim 'al aa maryama buhtaanana 'azeem

Waqawlihim 'innaa qatal naal maseeha 'eesaabna maryama rasoolal laahi wamaa qatal oohu wamaa sal aboohu wal aakin shubbiha lahum wainnal lazeenakhtal afu feehi lafee shakk mminhu maa lahum bihi min 'il min 'il laattibaa'az-zanni wamaa qatal oohu yaqeena
Bar-rafa'ahul laahu 'il ayhi wakaanal laahu 'azeezana hakeem
Waim mmin 'ahlil kitaabi 'il laa layu'minanna bihi qabla mawtihi wayawmal qeeaamati yakoonu 'al ayhim shaheed
Fabizul m mminal lazeena haadu harramnaa 'al ayhim tayyibaatin 'uhil lat lahum wabisaddihim 'an sabeelil laahi katheer
Waakhzihimur-ribawaa waqad nuhu 'anhu waaklihim 'amwaal an-naasi bil baatil i waa'tadnaa lil kaafireena minhum 'azaabana 'al eem

Llaakinir-raasikhoona fee al'il mi minhum wal mu'minoona yu'minoona bimaa 'unzil a 'il ayka wamaa 'unzil a min qablika wal muqeemeenas-sal aata wal mu'toonaz-zakaata wal mu'minoona bil laahi wal yawmil aakhiri 'ul aa'ika sanu'teehim 'ajrana 'azeeman

'innaa 'awhaynaa 'il ayka kamaa 'awhaynaa 'il aa nooh wan-nabeeyina mim ba'dihi waawhaynaa 'il aa 'ibraaheema waismaa'eela waishaaqa waya'qooba wal asbaati wa'eesaa wayyooba wayoonusa wahaaroona wasul aymaana wa'aataynaa daawuda zaboor
Warusul a qad qasasnaahum 'al ayka min qablu warusul a llam naqsushum 'al ayka wakal lamal laahu moosaa takleem
Rrusul a mmubashshireena wamunzireena li'al laa yakoona lin-naasi 'al aal laahi hujjatu ba'dar-rusul i wakaanal laahu 'azeezana hakeem
Llaakinil laahu yashhadu bimaa 'anzal a 'il ayka 'anzal ahu bi'il mihi wal mal aa'ikatu yashhadoona wakafaa bil laahi shaheedan
'innal lazeena kafaru wasaddu 'an sabeelil laahi qad dal lu dal aal aa ba'eedan
'innal lazeena kafaru wazal amu lam yakunil laahu leeaghfira lahum wal aa leeahdeeahum tareeqan
'il laa tareeqa jahannama khaal ideena feehaa 'abada wakaana zaal ika 'al aal laahi yaseer
Yayyuhaan-naasu qad jaa'akumur-rasoolu bil haqqi mir rrabbikum faaminu khayra llakum wain takfuru fainna lil laahi maa fee as-samaawaati wal ardi wakaanal laahu 'al eemana hakeem

Yaahlal kitaabi laa taghlu fee deenikum wal aa taqoolu 'al aal laahi 'il laal haqqa 'innamaal maseehu 'eesaabnu maryama rasoolul laahi wakal imatuhuaa 'al qaahaa 'il aa maryama warooh mminhu faaminu bil laahi warusul ihi wal aa taqoolu thal aathatun antahu khayra llakum 'innamaal laahu 'il aah waahid subhaanahuaa 'any yakoona lahu wal ad llaahu maa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardi wakafaa bil laahi wakeel
Llany yastankifal maseehu 'any yakoona 'abda llil laahi wal aal mal aa'ikatul muqarraboona wamany yastankif 'an 'ibaadatihi wayastakbir fasayahshuruhum 'il ayhi jamee'

Faammaal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati fayooaffeehim 'ujoorahum wayazeeduhum mmin fadlihi waammaal lazeenastankafu wastakbaru fayu'azzibuhum 'azaabana 'al eema wal aa yajidoona lahum mmin doonil laahi wal iyya wal aa naseer
Yayyuhaan-naasu qad jaa'akum burhaam mmir rrabbikum waanzal naa 'il aykum noora mmubeen
Faammaal lazeena 'aamanu bil laahi wa'tasamu bihi fasayudkhil uhum fee rahmat mminhu wafadl wayahdeehim 'il ayhi siraata mmustaqeem

Yastaftoonaka qul il laahu yufteekum fee al kal aal ati 'inimru'una hal aka laysa lahu wal ad wal ahuaa 'ukht fal ahaa nisfu maa taraka wahooa yarithuhaa 'il llam yakul llaahaa wal ad fain kaanataathnatayni fal ahumaath-thul uthaani mimmaa taraka wain kaanooaa 'ikhwat rrijaal a wanisaa' fal iz-zakari mithlu hazzil unthayayni yubayyinul laahu lakum 'an tadil lu wal laahu bikul li shay'in 'al eem
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'awfu bil'uqoodi 'uhil lat lakum baheematul an'aami 'il laa maa yutlaa 'al aykum ghayra muhil lee as-saydi waantum hurumun 'innal laaha yahkumu maa yureed

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa tuhil lu sha'aa'iral laahi wal aash-shahral haraama wal aal hadya wal aal qal aa'ida wal aa 'aammeenal baytal haraama yabtaghoona fadla mmir rrabbihim waridwaana waizaa hal al tum fastaadu wal aa yajrimannakum shanaanu qawmin 'an saddookum 'anil masjidil haraami 'an ta'tadu wata'aawanu 'al aal birri wat-taqwaa wal aa ta'aawanu 'al aal ithmi wal'udwaani wattaqul laaha 'innal laaha shadeedul'iqaab

Hurrimat 'al aykumul maytatu wad-damu wal ahmul khinzeeri wamaa 'uhil la lighayril laahi bihi wal munkhaniqatu wal mawqoozatu wal mutaraddeeatu wan-nateehatu wamaa 'akal as-sabu'u 'il laa maa zakkaytum wamaa zubiha 'al aan-nusubi waan tastaqsimu bil azlaami zaal ikum fisqun al yawma ya'isal lazeena kafaru min deenikum fal aa takhshawhum wakhshawnil yawma 'akmal tu lakum deenakum waatmamtu 'al aykum ni'matee waradeetu lakumul islaama deena famanidturra fee makhmasatin ghayra mutajaanif lliithm fainnal laaha ghafoor rraheem

Yasal oonaka maazaa 'uhil la lahum qul 'uhil la lakumut-tayyibaatu wamaa 'al lamtum mminal jawaarihi mukal libeena tu'al limoonahunna mimmaa 'al lamakumul laahu fakul u mimmaa 'amsakna 'al aykum wazkurusmal laahi 'al ayhi wattaqul laaha 'innal laaha saree'ul hisaab

Al yawma 'uhil la lakumut-tayyibaatu wata'aamul lazeena 'ootul kitaaba hil l llakum wata'aamukum hil l llaahum wal muhsanaatu minal mu'minaati wal muhsanaatu minal lazeena 'ootul kitaaba min qablikum 'izaa 'aataytumoohunna 'ujoorahunna muhsineena ghayra musaafiheena wal aa muttakhizeeaa 'akhdaanw wamany yakfur bil eemaani faqad habita 'amal uhu wahooa fee al aakhirati minal khaasireen

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'izaa qumtum 'il aas-sal aati faghsil u wujoohakum waydeeakum 'il aal maraafiqi wamsahu biru'oosikum waarjul akum 'il aal ka'bayni wain kuntum junuba fattahharu wain kuntum mmardaa 'aw 'al aa safarin 'aw jaa'a 'ahad mminkum mminal ghaa'iti 'aw laamastumun-nisaa'a fal am tajidu maa' fatayammamu sa'eeda tayyiba famsahu biwujoohikum waydeekum mminhu maa yureedul laahu leeaj'al a 'al aykum mmin haraj wal aakiny yureedu leeutahhirakum wal eeutimma ni'matahu 'al aykum la'al lakum tashkuroon
Wazkuru ni'matal laahi 'al aykum wameethaaqahul lazee waathaqakum bihiaa 'iz qul tum sami'naa waata'naa wattaqul laaha 'innal laaha 'al eemu bizaatis-sudoor

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu koonu qawwaameena lil laahi shuhadaa'a bil qisti wal aa yajrimannakum shanaanu qawmin 'al aa 'al laa ta'dil u'dil u hooa 'aqrabu lit-taqwaa wattaqul laaha 'innal laaha khabeeru bimaa ta'mal oon
Wa'adal laahul lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati lahum mmaghfirat waajrun 'azeem
Wal lazeena kafaru wakazzabu biayaatinaa 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabul jaheem
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanuzkuru ni'matal laahi 'al aykum 'iz hamma qawmun 'any yabsutooaa 'il aykum 'aydeeahum fakaffa 'aydeeahum 'ankum wattaqul laaha wa'al aal laahi fal yatawakkal il mu'minoon

Wal aqad 'akhazal laahu meethaaqa baneeaa 'israa'eela waba'athnaa minhumuthnay 'ashara naqeeba waqaal al laahu 'innee ma'akum la'in 'aqamtumus-sal aata wa'aataytumuz-zakaata wa'aamantum birusul ee wa'azzartumoohum waaqradtumul laaha qardana hasana llaukaffiranna 'ankum sayyiaatikum wal audkhil annakum jannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru faman kafara ba'da zaal ika minkum faqad dal la sawaa'as-sabeel

Fabimaa naqdihim mmeethaaqahum la'annaahum waja'al naa qul oobahum qaaseeat yuharrifoonal kal ima 'am mmawaadi'ihi wanasu hazza mmimmaa zukkiru bihi wal aa tazaal u tattal i'u 'al aa khaa'inat mminhum 'il laa qal eela mminhum fa'fu 'anhum wasfah 'innal laaha yuhibbul muhsineen

Waminal lazeena qaal ooaa 'innaa nasaaraa 'akhaznaa meethaaqahum fanasu hazza mmimmaa zukkiru bihi faaghraynaa baynahumul'adaawata wal baghdaa'a 'il aa yawmil qeeaamati wasawfa yunabbi'uhumul laahu bimaa kaanu yasna'oon
Yaahlal kitaabi qad jaa'akum rasoolunaa yubayyinu lakum katheera mmimmaa kuntum tukhfoona minal kitaabi waya'fu 'an katheer qad jaa'akum mminal laahi noor wakitaab mmubeen
Yahdee bihil laahu manittaba'a ridwaanahu subul as-sal aami wayukhrijuhum mminaz-zul umaati 'il aan-noori biiznihi wayahdeehim 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem

Llaqad kafaral lazeena qaal ooaa 'innal laaha hooal maseehubnu maryama qul famany yamliku minal laahi shayana 'in 'araada 'any yuhlikal maseehabna maryama waummahu waman fee al ardi jamee'a wal il laahi mul kus-samaawaati wal ardi wamaa baynahumaa yakhluqu maa yashaa'u wal laahu 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer

Waqaal atil yahoodu wan-nasaaraa nahnu 'abnaa'ual laahi waahibbaa'uhu qul fal ima yu'azzibukum bizunoobikum bal 'antum bashar mmimman khal aqa yaghfiru limany yashaa'u wayu'azzibu many yashaa'u wal il laahi mul kus-samaawaati wal ardi wamaa baynahumaa wail ayhil maseer

Yaahlal kitaabi qad jaa'akum rasoolunaa yubayyinu lakum 'al aa fatrat mminar-rusul i 'an taqoolu maa jaa'anaa mim basheer wal aa nazeer faqad jaa'akum basheer wanazeer wal laahu 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
Waiz qaal a moosaa liqawmihi yaaqawmizkuru ni'matal laahi 'al aykum 'iz ja'al a feekum 'anbeeaa'a waja'al akum mmul ooka wa'aataakum mmaa lam yu'ti 'ahada mminal'aal ameen
Yaaqawmidkhul ul ardal muqaddasatal latee katabal laahu lakum wal aa tartaddu 'al aa 'adbaarikum fatanqal ibu khaasireen
Qaal u yaamoosaa 'inna feehaa qawma jabbaareena wainnaa lan nnadkhul ahaa hattaa yakhruju minhaa fainy yakhruju minhaa fainnaa daakhil oon
Qaal a rajul aani minal lazeena yakhaafoona 'an'amal laahu 'al ayhimaadkhul u 'al ayhimul baaba faizaa dakhal tumoohu fainnakum ghaal iboona wa'al aal laahi fatawakkal ooaa 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
Qaal u yaamoosaa 'innaa lan nnadkhul ahaa 'abada mmaa daamu feehaa fazhab 'anta warabbuka faqaatil aa 'innaa haahunaa qaa'idoon
Qaal a rabbi 'innee laa 'amliku 'il laa nafsee waakhee fafruq baynanaa wabaynal qawmil faasiqeen
Qaal a fainnahaa muharramatun 'al ayhim 'arba'eena sanat yateehoona fee al ardi fal aa tasa 'al aal qawmil faasiqeen

Watlu 'al ayhim nabaabnay 'aadama bil haqqi 'iz qarrabaa qurbaana fatuqubbil a min 'ahadihimaa wal am yutaqabbal minal aakhari qaal a laaqtul annaka qaal a 'innamaa yataqabbal ul laahu minal muttaqeen
La'im basatta 'il ayya yadaka litaqtul anee maa 'anaa bibaasit yadeea 'il ayka liaqtul aka 'inneeaa 'akhaaful laaha rabbal'aal ameen
'inneeaa 'ureedu 'an tabooaa biithmee waithmika fatakoona min 'ashaabin-naari wazaal ika jazaa'uaz-zaal imeen
Fatawwa'at lahu nafsuhu qatla 'akheehi faqatal ahu faasbaha minal khaasireen

Faba'athal laahu ghuraaba yabhathu fee al ardi leeureeahu kayfa yooaaree saw'ata 'akheehi qaal a yaawaylataa 'a'ajaztu 'an 'akoona mithla haazaal ghuraabi faooaareea saw'ata 'akhee faasbaha minan-naadimeen

Min 'ajli zaal ika katabnaa 'al aa baneeaa 'israa'eela 'annahu man qatal a nafsaa bighayri nafsin 'aw fasaad fee al ardi fakaannamaa qatal an-naasa jamee'a waman 'ahyaahaa fakaannamaa 'ahyaan-naasa jamee'a wal aqad jaa'athum rusul unaa bil bayyinaati thumma 'inna katheera mminhum ba'da zaal ika fee al ardi lamusrifoon

'innamaa jazaa'ual lazeena yuhaariboonal laaha warasoolahu wayas'awna fee al ardi fasaadana 'any yuqattal ooaa 'aw yusal labooaa 'aw tuqatta'a 'aydeehim waarjul uhum mmin khil aafin 'aw yunfawa minal ardi zaal ika lahum khizy fee ad-dunyaa wal ahum fee al aakhirati 'azaabun 'azeem
'il laal lazeena taabu min qabli 'an taqdiru 'al ayhim fa'lamooaa 'annal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanuttaqul laaha wabtaghooaa 'il ayhil waseelata wajaahidu fee sabeelihi la'al lakum tuflihoon
'innal lazeena kafaru law 'anna lahum mmaa fee al ardi jamee'a wamithlahu ma'ahu leeaftadu bihi min 'azaabi yawmil qeeaamati maa tuqubbil a minhum wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Yureedoona 'any yakhruju minan-naari wamaa hum bikhaarijeena minhaa wal ahum 'azaab mmuqeem
Was-saariqu was-saariqatu faqta'ooaa 'aydeeahumaa jazaa'a bimaa kasabaa nakaal a mminal laahi wal laahu 'azeezun hakeem
Faman taaba mim ba'di zul mihi waaslaha fainnal laaha yatoobu 'al ayhi 'innal laaha ghafoor rraheem
'al am ta'lam 'annal laaha lahu mul kus-samaawaati wal ardi yu'azzibu many yashaa'u wayaghfiru limany yashaa'u wal laahu 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer

Yayyuhaar-rasoolu laa yahzunkal lazeena yusaari'oona fee al kufri minal lazeena qaal ooaa 'aamannaa biafwaahihim wal am tu'min qul oobuhum waminal lazeena haadu sammaa'oona lil kazibi sammaa'oona liqawmin 'aakhareena lam yatooka yuharrifoonal kal ima mim ba'di mawaadi'ihi yaqooloona 'in 'ooteetum haazaa fakhuzoohu wail llam tu'tawhu fahzaru wamany yuridil laahu fitnatahu fal an tamlika lahu minal laahi shayana 'ul aa'ikal lazeena lam yuridil laahu 'any yutahhira qul oobahum lahum fee ad-dunyaa khizy wal ahum fee al aakhirati 'azaabun 'azeem

Sammaa'oona lil kazibi 'akkaal oona lis-suhti fain jaa'ooka fahkum baynahum 'aw 'a'rid 'anhum wain tu'rid 'anhum fal any yadurrooka shaya wain hakamta fahkum baynahum bil qisti 'innal laaha yuhibbul muqsiteen
Wakayfa yuhakkimoonaka wa'indahumut-tawraatu feehaa hukmul laahi thumma yatawal lawna mim ba'di zaal ika wamaa 'ul aa'ika bil mu'mineen

'innaa 'anzal naat-tawraata feehaa huda wanoor yahkumu bihaan-nabeeyoonal lazeena 'aslamu lil lazeena haadu war-rabbaaneeyoona wal ahbaaru bimaastuhfizu min kitaabil laahi wakaanu 'al ayhi shuhadaa'a fal aa takhshawuan-naasa wakhshawni wal aa tashtaru biayaatee thamana qal eela wamal llam yahkum bimaa 'anzal al laahu faul aa'ika humul kaafiroon

Wakatabnaa 'al ayhim feehaa 'annan-nafsa bin-nafsi wal'ayna bil'ayni wal anfa bil anfi wal uzuna bil uzuni was-sinna bis-sinni wal jurooha qisaas faman tasaddaqa bihi fahooa kaffaarat llaahu wamal llam yahkum bimaa 'anzal al laahu faul aa'ika humuz-zaal imoon

Waqaffaynaa 'al aa 'aathaarihim bi'eesaabni maryama musaddiqa llimaa bayna yadayhi minat-tawraati wa'aataynaahul injeela feehi huda wanoor wamusaddiqa llimaa bayna yadayhi minat-tawraati wahuda wamaw'izat llil muttaqeen
Wal yahkum 'ahlul injeeli bimaa 'anzal al laahu feehi wamal llam yahkum bimaa 'anzal al laahu faul aa'ika humul faasiqoon

Waanzal naa 'il aykal kitaaba bil haqqi musaddiqa llimaa bayna yadayhi minal kitaabi wamuhayminana 'al ayhi fahkum baynahum bimaa 'anzal al laahu wal aa tattabi' 'ahwaa'ahum 'ammaa jaa'aka minal haqqi likul l ja'al naa minkum shir'at waminhaaja wal aw shaa'al laahu laja'al akum 'ummat waahidat wal aakil lleeablooakum fee maa 'aataakum fastabiqul khayraati 'il aal laahi marji'ukum jamee'a fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum feehi takhtal ifoon

Waanihkum baynahum bimaa 'anzal al laahu wal aa tattabi' 'ahwaa'ahum wahzarhum 'any yaftinooka 'am ba'di maa 'anzal al laahu 'il ayka fain tawal lawa fa'lam 'annamaa yureedul laahu 'any yuseebahum biba'di zunoobihim wainna katheera mminan-naasi lafaasiqoon
'afahukmal jaahil iyyati yabghoona waman 'ahsanu minal laahi hukma lliqawm yooqinoon
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa tattakhizul yahooda wan-nasaaraa 'awleeaa'a ba'duhum 'awleeaa'u ba'd wamany yatawal laahum mminkum fainnahu minhum 'innal laaha laa yahdee al qawmaz-zaal imeen

Fataraal lazeena fee qul oobihim mmarad yusaari'oona feehim yaqooloona nakhshaa 'an tuseebanaa daa'irat fa'asaal laahu 'any yateea bil fathi 'aw 'amr mmin 'indihi fayusbihu 'al aa maa 'asarru feeaa 'anfusihim naadimeen
Wayaqoolul lazeena 'aamanooaa 'ahaa'ul aa'il lazeena 'aqsamu bil laahi jahda 'aymaanihim 'innahum lama'akum habitat 'a'maal uhum faasbahu khaasireen

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu many yartadda minkum 'an deenihi fasawfa yatee al laahu biqawm yuhibbuhum wayuhibboonahuaa 'azil latin 'al aal mu'mineena 'a'izzatin 'al aal kaafireena yujaahidoona fee sabeelil laahi wal aa yakhaafoona lawmata laa'im zaal ika fadlul laahi yu'teehi many yashaa'u wal laahu waasi'un 'al eem
'innamaa wal eeyukumul laahu warasooluhu wal lazeena 'aamanul lazeena yuqeemoonas-sal aata wayu'toonaz-zakaata wahum raaki'oon
Wamany yatawal lal laaha warasoolahu wal lazeena 'aamanu fainna hizbal laahi humul ghaal iboon
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa tattakhizul lazeenattakhazu deenakum huzooa wal a'iba mminal lazeena 'ootul kitaaba min qablikum wal kuffaara 'awleeaa'a wattaqul laaha 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
Waizaa naadaytum 'il aas-sal aatittakhazoohaa huzooa wal a'iba zaal ika biannahum qawm llaa ya'qil oon
Qul yaahlal kitaabi hal tanqimoona minnaa 'il laa 'an 'aamannaa bil laahi wamaa 'unzil a 'il aynaa wamaa 'unzil a min qablu waanna 'aktharakum faasiqoon

Qul hal 'unabbi'ukum bisharr mmin zaal ika mathoobatan 'indal laahi mal lla'anahul laahu waghadiba 'al ayhi waja'al a minhumul qiradata wal khanaazeera wa'abadat-taaghoota 'ul aa'ika sharr mmakaana waadal lu 'an sawaa'is-sabeel
Waizaa jaa'ookum qaal ooaa 'aamannaa waqad ddakhal u bil kufri wahum qad kharaju bihi wal laahu 'a'lamu bimaa kaanu yaktumoon
Wataraa katheera mminhum yusaari'oona fee al ithmi wal'udwaani waaklihimus-suhta labi'sa maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Lawlaa yanhaahumur-rabbaaneeyoona wal ahbaaru 'an qawlihimul ithma waaklihimus-suhta labi'sa maa kaanu yasna'oon

Waqaal atil yahoodu yadul laahi maghloolatun ghul lat 'aydeehim wal u'inu bimaa qaal u bal yadaahu mabsootataani yunfiqu kayfa yashaa'u wal ayazeedanna katheera mminhum mmaa 'unzil a 'il ayka mir rrabbika tughyaana wakufra waal qaynaa baynahumul'adaawata wal baghdaa'a 'il aa yawmil qeeaamati kul lamaa 'awqadu naara llil harbi 'atfaahaal laahu wayas'awna fee al ardi fasaada wal laahu laa yuhibbul mufsideen
Wal aw 'anna 'ahlal kitaabi 'aamanu wattaqawa lakaffarnaa 'anhum sayyiaatihim wal aadkhal naahum jannaatin-na'eem
Wal aw 'annahum 'aqaamut-tawraata wal injeela wamaa 'unzil a 'il ayhim mmir rrabbihim laakal u min fawqihim wamin tahti 'arjul ihim mminhum 'ummat mmuqtasidat wakatheer mminhum saa'a maa ya'mal oon
Yayyuhaar-rasoolu bal ligh maa 'unzil a 'il ayka mir rrabbika wail llam taf'al famaa bal laghta risaal atahu wal laahu ya'simuka minan-naasi 'innal laaha laa yahdee al qawmal kaafireen

Qul yaahlal kitaabi lastum 'al aa shay'in hattaa tuqeemut-tawraata wal injeela wamaa 'unzil a 'il aykum mmir rrabbikum wal ayazeedanna katheera mminhum mmaa 'unzil a 'il ayka mir rrabbika tughyaana wakufra fal aa tasa 'al aal qawmil kaafireen
'innal lazeena 'aamanu wal lazeena haadu was-saabioona wan-nasaaraa man 'aamana bil laahi wal yawmil aakhiri wa'amil a saal iha fal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
Laqad 'akhaznaa meethaaqa baneeaa 'israa'eela waarsal naa 'il ayhim rusul a kul lamaa jaa'ahum rasoolu bimaa laa tahwaa 'anfusuhum fareeqa kazzabu wafareeqa yaqtul oon
Wahasibooaa 'al laa takoona fitnat fa'amu wasammu thumma taabal laahu 'al ayhim thumma 'amu wasammu katheer mminhum wal laahu baseeru bimaa ya'mal oon

Laqad kafaral lazeena qaal ooaa 'innal laaha hooal maseehubnu maryama waqaal al maseehu yaabaneeaa 'israa'eela'budul laaha rabbee warabbakum 'innahu many yushrik bil laahi faqad harramal laahu 'al ayhil jannata wamawaahun-naaru wamaa liz-zaal imeena min 'ansaar

Llaqad kafaral lazeena qaal ooaa 'innal laaha thaal ithu thal aathat wamaa min 'il aahin 'il laa 'il aah waahid wail llam yantahu 'ammaa yaqooloona layamassannal lazeena kafaru minhum 'azaabun 'al eem
'afal aa yatooboona 'il aal laahi wayastaghfiroonahu wal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Mmaal maseehubnu maryama 'il laa rasool qad khal at min qablihir-rusul u waummuhu siddeeqat kaanaa yakul aanit-ta'aamanzur kayfa nubayyinu lahumul ayaati thummanzur 'annaa yu'fakoon
Qul 'ata'budoona min doonil laahi maa laa yamliku lakum darra wal aa naf'a wal laahu hooas-samee'ul'al eem
Qul yaahlal kitaabi laa taghlu fee deenikum ghayral haqqi wal aa tattabi'ooaa 'ahwaa'a qawm qad dal lu min qablu waadal lu katheera wadal lu 'an sawaa'is-sabeel
Lu'inal lazeena kafaru mim baneeaa 'israa'eela 'al aa lisaani daawuda wa'eesaabni maryama zaal ika bimaa 'asa wwakaanu ya'tadoon
Kaanu laa yatanaahawna 'am mmunkar fa'al oohu labi'sa maa kaanu yaf'al oon
Taraa katheera mminhum yatawal lawnal lazeena kafaru labi'sa maa qaddamat lahum 'anfusuhum 'an sakhital laahu 'al ayhim wafee al'azaabi hum khaal idoon
Wal aw kaanu yu'minoona bil laahi wan-nabeeyi wamaa 'unzil a 'il ayhi maattakhazoohum 'awleeaa'a wal aakinna katheera mminhum faasiqoon

Latajidanna 'ashaddan-naasi 'adaawat llil lazeena 'aamanul yahooda wal lazeena 'ashraku wal atajidanna 'aqrabahum mmawaddat llil lazeena 'aamanul lazeena qaal ooaa 'innaa nasaaraa zaal ika bianna minhum qisseeseena waruhbaana waannahum laa yastakbiroon
Waizaa sami'u maa 'unzil a 'il aar-rasooli taraa 'a'yunahum tafeedu minad-dam'i mimmaa 'arafu minal haqqi yaqooloona rabbanaa 'aamannaa faktubnaa ma'ash-shaahideen
Wamaa lanaa laa nu'minu bil laahi wamaa jaa'anaa minal haqqi wanatma'u 'any yudkhil anaa rabbunaa ma'al qawmis-saal iheen
Faathaabahumul laahu bimaa qaal u jannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa wazaal ika jazaa'ul muhsineen
Wal lazeena kafaru wakazzabu biayaatinaa 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabul jaheem
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa tuharrimu tayyibaati maa 'ahal lal laahu lakum wal aa ta'tadooaa 'innal laaha laa yuhibbul mu'tadeen
Wakul u mimmaa razaqakumul laahu hal aal a tayyiba wattaqul laahal lazeeaa 'antum bihi mu'minoon

Laa yu'aakhizukumul laahu bil laghwi feeaa 'aymaanikum wal aakiny yu'aakhizukum bimaa 'aqqadttumul aymaana fakaffaaratuhuaa 'it'aamu 'asharati masaakeena min 'awsati maa tut'imoona 'ahleekum 'aw kiswatuhum 'aw tahreeru raqabat famal llam yajid faseeaamu thal aathati 'ayyaam zaal ika kaffaaratu 'aymaanikum 'izaa hal aftum wahfazooaa 'aymaanakum kazaal ika yubayyinul laahu lakum 'ayaatihi la'al lakum tashkuroon
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'innamaal khamru wal maysiru wal ansaabu wal azlaamu rijs mmin 'amal ish-shaytaani fajtaniboohu la'al lakum tuflihoon
'innamaa yureedush-shaytaanu 'any yooqi'a baynakumul'adaawata wal baghdaa'a fee al khamri wal maysiri wayasuddakum 'an zikril laahi wa'anis-sal aati fahal 'antum mmuntahoon
Waatee'ul laaha waatee'ur-rasoola wahzaru fain tawal laytum fa'lamooaa 'annamaa 'al aa rasoolinaal bal aaghul mubeen
Laysa 'al aal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati junaah feemaa ta'imooaa 'izaa maattaqa wwa'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati thummattaqa wwa'aamanu thummattaqa wwaahsanu wal laahu yuhibbul muhsineen

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu layablooannakumul laahu bishay' mminas-saydi tanaal uhuaa 'aydeekum warimaahukum leea'lamal laahu many yakhaafuhu bil ghaybi famani'tadaa ba'da zaal ika fal ahu 'azaabun 'al eem

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa taqtul us-sayda waantum hurum waman qatal ahu minkum mmuta'ammida fajazaa' mmithlu maa qatal a minan-na'ami yahkumu bihi zawaa 'adl mminkum hadyaa baal ighal ka'bati 'aw kaffaarat ta'aamu masaakeena 'aw 'adlu zaal ika seeaama lleeazooqa wabaal a 'amrihi 'afaal laahu 'ammaa sal afa waman 'aada fayantaqimul laahu minhu wal laahu 'azeez zoo antiqaam
'uhil la lakum saydul bahri wata'aamuhu mataa'a llakum wal is-sayyaarati wahurrima 'al aykum saydul barri maa dumtum huruma wattaqul laahal lazeeaa 'il ayhi tuhsharoon

Ja'al al laahul ka'batal baytal haraama qeeaama llin-naasi wash-shahral haraama wal hadya wal qal aa'ida zaal ika lita'lamooaa 'annal laaha ya'lamu maa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardi waannal laaha bikul li shay'in 'al eem
A'lamooaa 'annal laaha shadeedul'iqaabi waannal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Mmaa 'al aar-rasooli 'il laal bal aaghu wal laahu ya'lamu maa tubdoona wamaa taktumoon
Qul-laa yastawee al khabeethu wat-tayyibu wal aw 'a'jabaka kathratul khabeethi fattaqul laaha yaaoolee al al baabi la'al lakum tuflihoon
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa tasal u 'an 'ashyaa'a 'in tubda lakum tasu'kum wain tasal u 'anhaa heena yunazzal ul qur'aanu tubda lakum 'afaal laahu 'anhaa wal laahu ghafoorun hal eem
Qad saal ahaa qawm mmin qablikum thumma 'asbahu bihaa kaafireen
Maa ja'al al laahu mim baheerat wal aa saa'ibat wal aa waseelat wal aa haam wal aakinnal lazeena kafaru yaftaroona 'al aal laahil kaziba waaktharuhum laa ya'qil oon
Waizaa qeela lahum ta'aal awa 'il aa maa 'anzal al laahu wail aar-rasooli qaal u hasbunaa maa wajadnaa 'al ayhi 'aabaa'anaa 'awal aw kaana 'aabaa'uhum laa ya'lamoona shaya wal aa yahtadoon
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu 'al aykum 'anfusakum laa yadurrukum mman dal la 'izaahtadaytum 'il aal laahi marji'ukum jamee'a fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu shahaadatu baynikum 'izaa hadara 'ahadakumul mawtu heenal wasiyyatithnaani zawaa 'adl mminkum 'aw 'aakharaani min ghayrikum 'in 'antum darabtum fee al ardi faasaabatkum mmuseebatul mawti tahbisoonahumaa mim ba'dis-sal aati fayuqsimaani bil laahi 'inirtabtum laa nashtaree bihi thamana wal aw kaana zaa qurbaa wal aa naktumu shahaadatal laahi 'innaa 'iza llaminal aathimeen

Fain 'uthira 'al aa 'annahumaastahaqqaa 'ithma faakharaani yaqoomaani maqaamahumaa minal lazeenastahaqqa 'al ayhimul awlayaani fayuqsimaani bil laahi lashahaadatunaa 'ahaqqu min shahaadatihimaa wamaa'tadaynaa 'innaa 'iza llaminaz-zaal imeen
Zaal ika 'adnaa 'any yatu bish-shahaadati 'al aa wajhihaa 'aw yakhaafooaa 'an turadda 'aymaanu ba'da 'aymaanihim wattaqul laaha wasma'u wal laahu laa yahdee al qawmal faasiqeen
Yawma yajma'ul laahur-rusul a fayaqoolu maazaa 'ujibtum qaal u laa 'il ma lanaa 'innaka 'anta 'al laamul ghuyoob

'iz qaal al laahu yaa'eesaabna maryamazkur ni'matee 'al ayka wa'al aa waal idatika 'iz 'ayyadttuka biroohil qudusi tukal limun-naasa fee al mahdi wakahla waiz 'al lamtukal kitaaba wal hikmata wat-tawraata wal injeela waiz takhluqu minat-teeni kahayatit-tayri biiznee fatanfukhu feehaa fatakoonu tayraa biiznee watubri'ul akmaha wal abrasa biiznee waiz tukhrijul mawtaa biiznee waiz kafaftu baneeaa 'israa'eela 'anka 'iz ji'tahum bil bayyinaati faqaal al lazeena kafaru minhum 'in haazaa 'il laa sihr mmubeen
Waiz 'awhaytu 'il aal hawaareeyina 'an 'aaminu bee wabirasoolee qaal ooaa 'aamannaa washhad biannanaa muslimoon
'iz qaal al hawaareeyoona yaa'eesaabna maryama hal yastatee'u rabbuka 'any yunazzil a 'al aynaa maa'idat mminas-samaa'i qaal attaqul laaha 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
Qaal u nureedu 'an nnakul a minhaa watatma'inna qul oobunaa wana'lama 'an qad sadaqtanaa wanakoona 'al ayhaa minash-shaahideen
Qaal a 'eesaabnu maryamal laahumma rabbanaa 'anzil 'al aynaa maa'idat mminas-samaa'i takoonu lanaa 'eeda lliawwal inaa wa'aakhirinaa wa'ayat mminka warzuqnaa waanta khayrur-raaziqeen
Qaal al laahu 'innee munazzil uhaa 'al aykum famany yakfur ba'du minkum fainneeaa 'u'azzibuhu 'azaaba llaa 'u'azzibuhuaa 'ahada mminal'aal ameen

Waiz qaal al laahu yaa'eesaabna maryama 'aanta qul ta lin-naasittakhizoonee waummeea 'il aahayni min doonil laahi qaal a subhaanaka maa yakoonu leeaa 'an 'aqoola maa laysa lee bihaqqin 'in kuntu qul tuhu faqad 'al imtahu ta'lamu maa fee nafsee wal aa 'a'lamu maa fee nafsika 'innaka 'anta 'al laamul ghuyoob

Maa qul tu lahum 'il laa maa 'amartanee bihiaa 'ani'budul laaha rabbee warabbakum wakuntu 'al ayhim shaheeda mmaa dumtu feehim fal ammaa tawaffaytanee kunta 'antar-raqeeba 'al ayhim waanta 'al aa kul li shay' shaheed
'in tu'azzibhum fainnahum 'ibaaduka wain taghfir lahum fainnaka 'antal'azeezul hakeem
Qaal al laahu haazaa yawmu yanfa'us-saadiqeena sidquhum lahum jannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa 'abada rradeeal laahu 'anhum waradu 'anhu zaal ikal fawzul'azeem
Lil laahi mul kus-samaawaati wal ardi wamaa feehinna wahooa 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
Al hamdu lil laahil lazee khal aqas-samaawaati wal arda waja'al az-zul umaati wan-noora thummal lazeena kafaru birabbihim ya'dil oon
Hooal lazee khal aqakum mmin teen thumma qadaa 'ajal a waajal mmusammana 'indahu thumma 'antum tamtaroon
Wahooal laahu fee as-samaawaati wafee al ardi ya'lamu sirrakum wajahrakum waya'lamu maa taksiboon
Wamaa tateehim mmin 'ayat mmin 'ayaati rabbihim 'il laa kaanu 'anhaa mu'rideen
Faqad kazzabu bil haqqi lammaa jaa'ahum fasawfa yateehim 'anbaa'ua maa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon

'al am yarawa kam 'ahlaknaa min qablihim mmin qarn mmakkannaahum fee al ardi maa lam numakkil llakum waarsal naas-samaa'a 'al ayhim mmidraara waja'al naal anhaara tajree min tahtihim faahlaknaahum bizunoobihim waanshanaa mim ba'dihim qarnana 'aakhareen
Wal aw nazzal naa 'al ayka kitaaba fee qirtaas fal amasoohu biaydeehim laqaal al lazeena kafarooaa 'in haazaa 'il laa sihr mmubeen
Waqaal u lawlaa 'unzil a 'al ayhi mal ak wal aw 'anzal naa mal aka llaqudeeal amru thumma laa yunzaroon
Wal aw ja'al naahu mal aka llaja'al naahu rajul a wal al abasnaa 'al ayhim mmaa yal bisoon
Wal aqadistuhzi'a birusul mmin qablika fahaaqa bil lazeena sakhiru minhum mmaa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Qul seeru fee al ardi thummanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul mukazzibeen
Qul-limam mmaa fee as-samaawaati wal ardi qul-lil laahi kataba 'al aa nafsihir-rahmata layajma'annakum 'il aa yawmil qeeaamati laa rayba feehil lazeena khasirooaa 'anfusahum fahum laa yu'minoon
Wal ahu maa sakana fee al layli wan-nahaari wahooas-samee'ul'al eem
Qul 'aghayral laahi 'attakhizu wal iyya faatiris-samaawaati wal ardi wahooa yut'imu wal aa yut'amu qul 'inneeaa 'umirtu 'an 'akoona 'awwal a man 'aslama wal aa takoonanna minal mushrikeen
Qul 'inneeaa 'akhaafu 'in 'asaytu rabbee 'azaaba yawmin 'azeem
Mmany yusraf 'anhu yawma'iz faqad rahimahu wazaal ikal fawzul mubeen
Wainy yamsaskal laahu bidurr fal aa kaashifa lahuaa 'il laa hooa wainy yamsaska bikhayr fahooa 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
Wahooal qaahiru fawqa 'ibaadihi wahooal hakeemul khabeer

Qul 'ayyu shay'in 'akbaru shahaadat qul il laahu shaheedu baynee wabaynakum waooheea 'il ayya haazaal qur'aanu liunzirakum bihi wamam bal agha 'a'innakum latashhadoona 'anna ma'al laahi 'aal ihatan 'ukhraa qul-laa 'ashhadu qul 'innamaa hooa 'il aah waahid wainnanee bareeaa' mmimmaa tushrikoon
Al lazeena 'aataynaahumul kitaaba ya'rifoonahu kamaa ya'rifoona 'abnaa'ahumul lazeena khasirooaa 'anfusahum fahum laa yu'minoon
Waman 'azlamu mimmaniftaraa 'al aal laahi kazibana 'aw kazzaba biayaatihiaa 'innahu laa yuflihuz-zaal imoon
Wayawma nahshuruhum jamee'a thumma naqoolu lil lazeena 'ashrakooaa 'ayna shurakaa'ukumul lazeena kuntum taz'umoon
Thumma lam takun fitnatuhum 'il laa 'an qaal u wal laahi rabbinaa maa kunnaa mushrikeen
Anzur kayfa kazabu 'al aa 'anfusihim wadal la 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaftaroon

Waminhum mmany yastami'u 'il ayka waja'al naa 'al aa qul oobihim 'akinnatan 'any yafqahoohu wafeeaa 'aazaanihim waqra wainy yarawa kul la 'ayat llaa yu'minu bihaa hattaa 'izaa jaa'ooka yujaadil oonaka yaqoolul lazeena kafarooaa 'in haazaa 'il laa 'asaateerul awwal een
Wahum yanhawna 'anhu wayanawna 'anhu wainy yuhlikoona 'il laa 'anfusahum wamaa yash'uroon
Wal aw taraa 'iz wuqifu 'al aan-naari faqaal u yaal aytanaa nuraddu wal aa nukazziba biayaati rabbinaa wanakoona minal mu'mineen
Bal badaa lahum mmaa kaanu yukhfoona min qablu wal aw ruddu la'aadu limaa nuhu 'anhu wainnahum lakaaziboon
Waqaal ooaa 'in heea 'il laa hayaatunaad-dunyaa wamaa nahnu bimab'ootheen
Wal aw taraa 'iz wuqifu 'al aa rabbihim qaal a 'al aysa haazaa bil haqqi qaal u bal aa warabbinaa qaal a fazooqul'azaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon

Qad khasiral lazeena kazzabu bil iqaa'il laahi hattaa 'izaa jaa'athumus-saa'atu baghtat qaal u yaahasratanaa 'al aa maa farratnaa feehaa wahum yahmil oona 'awzaarahum 'al aa zuhoorihim 'al aa saa'a maa yaziroon
Wamaal hayawaatud-dunyaa 'il laa la'ib wal ahw wal ad-daarul aakhiratu khayr llil lazeena yattaqoona 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Qad na'lamu 'innahu layahzunukal lazee yaqooloona fainnahum laa yukazziboonaka wal aakinnaz-zaal imeena biayaatil laahi yajhadoon
Wal aqad kuzzibat rusul mmin qablika fasabaru 'al aa maa kuzzibu waoozu hattaa 'ataahum nasrunaa wal aa mubaddil a likal imaatil laahi wal aqad jaa'aka min nnabaee al mursal een

Wain kaana kabura 'al ayka 'i'raaduhum fainistata'ta 'an tabtagheea nafaqa fee al ardi 'aw sul lama fee as-samaa'i fatateeahum biayat wal aw shaa'al laahu lajama'ahum 'al aal hudaa fal aa takoonanna minal jaahil een
'innamaa yastajeebul lazeena yasma'oona wal mawtaa yab'athuhumul laahu thumma 'il ayhi yurja'oon
Waqaal u lawlaa nuzzil a 'al ayhi 'ayat mmir rrabbihi qul 'innal laaha qaadirun 'al aa 'any yunazzil a 'ayat wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Wamaa min daabbat fee al ardi wal aa taa'ir yateeru bijanaahayhi 'il laa 'umamun 'amthaal ukum mmaa farratnaa fee al kitaabi min shay' thumma 'il aa rabbihim yuhsharoon
Wal lazeena kazzabu biayaatinaa summ wabukm fee az-zul umaati many yashail laahu yudlil hu wamany yasha yaj'al hu 'al aa siraat mmustaqeem
Qul 'ara'aytakum 'in 'ataakum 'azaabul laahi 'aw 'atatkumus-saa'atu 'aghayral laahi tad'oona 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Bal 'iyyaahu tad'oona fayakshifu maa tad'oona 'il ayhi 'in shaa'a watansawna maa tushrikoon
Wal aqad 'arsal naa 'il aa 'umam mmin qablika faakhaznaahum bil basaa'i wad-darraa'i la'al laahum yatadarra'oon
Fal awlaa 'iz jaa'ahum basunaa tadarra'u wal aakin qasat qul oobuhum wazayyana lahumush-shaytaanu maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Fal ammaa nasu maa zukkiru bihi fatahnaa 'al ayhim 'abwaaba kul li shay'in hattaa 'izaa farihu bimaa 'ootooaa 'akhaznaahum baghtat faizaa hum mmublisoon
Faquti'a daabirul qawmil lazeena zal amu wal hamdu lil laahi rabbil'aal ameen
Qul 'ara'aytum 'in 'akhazal laahu sam'akum waabsaarakum wakhatama 'al aa qul oobikum mman 'il aahun ghayrul laahi yateekum bihinzur kayfa nusarriful ayaati thumma hum yasdifoon
Qul 'ara'aytakum 'in 'ataakum 'azaabul laahi baghtatan 'aw jahratan hal yuhlaku 'il laal qawmuz-zaal imoon
Wamaa nursil ul mursal eena 'il laa mubashshireena wamunzireena faman 'aamana waaslaha fal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
Wal lazeena kazzabu biayaatinaa yamassuhumul'azaabu bimaa kaanu yafsuqoon

Qul-laa 'aqoolu lakum 'indee khazaa'inul laahi wal aa 'a'lamul ghayba wal aa 'aqoolu lakum 'innee mal akun 'in 'attabi'u 'il laa maa yoohaa 'il ayya qul hal yastawee al a'maa wal baseeru 'afal aa tatafakkaroon
Waanzir bihil lazeena yakhaafoona 'any yuhsharooaa 'il aa rabbihim laysa lahum mmin doonihi wal eey wal aa shafee' lla'al laahum yattaqoon

Wal aa tatrudil lazeena yad'oona rabbahum bil ghadawaati wal'asheeyi yureedoona wajhahu maa 'al ayka min hisaabihim mmin shay' wamaa min hisaabika 'al ayhim mmin shay' fatatrudahum fatakoona minaz-zaal imeen
Wakazaal ika fatannaa ba'dahum biba'd lleeaqoolooaa 'ahaa'ul aa'i mannal laahu 'al ayhim mmim bayninaa 'al aysal laahu bia'lama bish-shaakireen

Waizaa jaa'akal lazeena yu'minoona biayaatinaa faqul sal aamun 'al aykum kataba rabbukum 'al aa nafsihir-rahmata 'annahu man 'amil a minkum sooaa'aa bijahaal at thumma taaba mim ba'dihi waaslaha faannahu ghafoor rraheem
Wakazaal ika nufassil ul ayaati wal itastabeena sabeelul mujrimeen
Qul 'innee nuheetu 'an 'a'budal lazeena tad'oona min doonil laahi qul-laa 'attabi'u 'ahwaa'akum qad dal al tu 'iza wamaa 'anaa minal muhtadeen
Qul 'innee 'al aa bayyinat mmir rrabbee wakazzabtum bihi maa 'indee maa tasta'jil oona bihiaa 'inil hukmu 'il laa lil laahi yaqussul haqqa wahooa khayrul faasil een
Qul-law 'anna 'indee maa tasta'jil oona bihi laqudeeal amru baynee wabaynakum wal laahu 'a'lamu biz-zaal imeen

Wa'indahu mafaatihul ghaybi laa ya'lamuhaa 'il laa hooa waya'lamu maa fee al barri wal bahri wamaa tasqutu minw waraqatin 'il laa ya'lamuhaa wal aa habbat fee zul umaatil ardi wal aa ratb wal aa yaabisin 'il laa fee kitaab mmubeen
Wahooal lazee yatawaffaakum bil layli waya'lamu maa jarahtum bin-nahaari thumma yab'athukum feehi leeuqdaa 'ajal mmusamma thumma 'il ayhi marji'ukum thumma yunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Wahooal qaahiru fawqa 'ibaadihi wayursil u 'al aykum hafazatan hattaa 'izaa jaa'a 'ahadakumul mawtu tawaffathu rusul unaa wahum laa yufarritoon
Thumma ruddooaa 'il aal laahi mawlaahumul haqqi 'al aa lahul hukmu wahooa 'asra'ul haasibeen
Qul many yunajjeekum mmin zul umaatil barri wal bahri tad'oonahu tadarru'a wakhufyat lla'in 'anjaanaa min haazihi lanakoonanna minash-shaakireen
Qul il laahu yunajjeekum mminhaa wamin kul li karb thumma 'antum tushrikoon

Qul hooal qaadiru 'al aa 'any yab'atha 'al aykum 'azaaba mmin fawqikum 'aw min tahti 'arjul ikum 'aw yal bisakum sheea'a wayuzeeqa ba'dakum basa ba'din anzur kayfa nusarriful ayaati la'al laahum yafqahoon
Wakazzaba bihi qawmuka wahooal haqqu qul-lastu 'al aykum biwakeel
Llikul li naba mmustaqarr wasawfa ta'lamoon
Waizaa raytal lazeena yakhoodoona feeaa 'ayaatinaa faa'rid 'anhum hattaa yakhoodu fee hadeethin ghayrihi waimmaa yunseeannakash-shaytaanu fal aa taq'ud ba'daz-zikraa ma'al qawmiz-zaal imeen
Wamaa 'al aal lazeena yattaqoona min hisaabihim mmin shay' wal aakin zikraa la'al laahum yattaqoon

Wazaril lazeenattakhazu deenahum la'iba wal ahwa wagharrathumul hayawaatud-dunyaa wazakkir bihiaa 'an tubsal a nafsu bimaa kasabat laysa lahaa min doonil laahi wal eey wal aa shafee' wain ta'dil kul la 'adl llaa yu'khaz minhaa 'ul aa'ikal lazeena 'ubsil u bimaa kasabu lahum sharaab mmin hameem wa'azaabun 'al eemu bimaa kaanu yakfuroon

Qul 'anad'u min doonil laahi maa laa yanfa'unaa wal aa yadurrunaa wanuraddu 'al aa 'a'qaabinaa ba'da 'iz hadaanaal laahu kal lazee astahwathush-shayaateenu fee al ardi hayraana lahuaa 'ashaab yad'oonahuaa 'il aal hudaa'tinaa qul 'inna hudaal laahi hooal hudaa waumirnaa linuslima lirabbil'aal ameen
Waan 'aqeemus-sal aata wattaqoohu wahooal lazeeaa 'il ayhi tuhsharoon

Wahooal lazee khal aqas-samaawaati wal arda bil haqqi wayawma yaqoolu kun fayakoonu qawluhul haqqu wal ahul mul ku yawma yunfakhu fee as-soori 'aal imul ghaybi wash-shahaadati wahooal hakeemul khabeer
Waiz qaal a 'ibraaheemu liabeehi 'aazara 'atattakhizu 'asnaamana 'aal ihatan 'inneeaa 'araaka waqawmaka fee dal aal mmubeen
Wakazaal ika nureeaa 'ibraaheema mal akootas-samaawaati wal ardi wal eeakoona minal mooqineen
Fal ammaa janna 'al ayhil laylu ra'aa kawkaba qaal a haazaa rabbee fal ammaa 'afal a qaal a laa 'uhibbul aafil een
Fal ammaa ra'aal qamara baazigha qaal a haazaa rabbee fal ammaa 'afal a qaal a la'il llam yahdinee rabbee laakoonanna minal qawmid-daal leen
Fal ammaa ra'aash-shamsa baazighat qaal a haazaa rabbee haazaa 'akbaru fal ammaa 'afal at qaal a yaaqawmi 'innee bareeaa' mmimmaa tushrikoon
'innee wajjahtu wajheea lil lazee fataras-samaawaati wal arda haneefa wamaa 'anaa minal mushrikeen

Wahaajjahu qawmuhu qaal a 'atuhaajjooaannee fee al laahi waqad hadaani wal aa 'akhaafu maa tushrikoona bihiaa 'il laa 'any yashaa'a rabbee shaya wasi'a rabbee kul la shay'in 'il mana 'afal aa tatazakkaroon
Wakayfa 'akhaafu maa 'ashraktum wal aa takhaafoona 'annakum 'ashraktum bil laahi maa lam yunazzil bihi 'al aykum sul taana fayyul fareeqayni 'ahaqqu bil amni 'in kuntum ta'lamoon
Al lazeena 'aamanu wal am yal bisooaa 'eemaanahum bizul min 'ul aa'ika lahumul amnu wahum mmuhtadoon
Watil ka hujjatunaa 'aataynaahaa 'ibraaheema 'al aa qawmihi narfa'u darajaat mman nnashaa'u 'inna rabbaka hakeemun 'al eem
Wawahabnaa lahuaa 'ishaaqa waya'qooba kul lana hadaynaa wanoohana hadaynaa min qablu wamin zurriyyatihi daawuda wasul aymaana wayyooba wayoosufa wamoosaa wahaaroona wakazaal ika najzee al muhsineen
Wazakariyyaa wayahyaa wa'eesaa wail yaasa kul l mminas-saal iheen
Waismaa'eela wal yasa'a wayoonusa wal oota wakul la faddal naa 'al aal'aal ameen
Wamin 'aabaa'ihim wazurriyyaatihim waikhwaanihim wajtabaynaahum wahadaynaahum 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem
Zaal ika hudaal laahi yahdee bihi many yashaa'u min 'ibaadihi wal aw 'ashraku lahabita 'anhum mmaa kaanu ya'mal oon
'ul aa'ikal lazeena 'aataynaahumul kitaaba wal hukma wan-nuboowata fainy yakfur bihaa haa'ul aa'i faqad wakkal naa bihaa qawma llaysu bihaa bikaafireen
'ul aa'ikal lazeena hadaal laahu fabihudaahumuqtadih qul-laa 'asal ukum 'al ayhi 'ajrana 'in hooa 'il laa zikraa lil'aal ameen

Wamaa qadarul laaha haqqa qadrihiaa 'iz qaal u maa 'anzal al laahu 'al aa bashar mmin shay' qul man 'anzal al kitaabal lazee jaa'a bihi moosaa noora wahuda llin-naasi taj'al oonahu qaraateesa tubdoonahaa watukhfoona katheera wa'ul limtum mmaa lam ta'lamooaa 'antum wal aa 'aabaa'ukum qul il laahu thumma zarhum fee khawdihim yal'aboon

Wahaazaa kitaabun 'anzal naahu mubaarak mmusaddiqul lazee bayna yadayhi wal itunzira 'ummal quraa waman hawlahaa wal lazeena yu'minoona bil aakhirati yu'minoona bihi wahum 'al aa sal aatihim yuhaafizoon

Waman 'azlamu mimmaniftaraa 'al aal laahi kazibana 'aw qaal a 'ooheea 'il ayya wal am yooha 'il ayhi shay' waman qaal a saunzil u mithla maa 'anzal al laahu wal aw taraa 'iziz-zaal imoona fee ghamaraatil mawti wal mal aa'ikatu baasitooaa 'aydeehim 'akhrijooaa 'anfusakumul yawma tujzawna 'azaabal hooni bimaa kuntum taqooloona 'al aal laahi ghayral haqqi wakuntum 'an 'ayaatihi tastakbiroon

Wal aqad ji'tumoonaa furaadaa kamaa khal aqnaakum 'awwal a marrat wataraktum mmaa khawwal naakum waraa'a zuhoorikum wamaa naraa ma'akum shufa'aa'akumul lazeena za'amtum 'annahum feekum shurakaa'ua laqad ttaqatta'a baynakum wadal la 'ankum mmaa kuntum taz'umoon
'innal laaha faal iqul habbi wan-nawaa yukhrijul hayya minal mayyiti wamukhrijul mayyiti minal hayyi zaal ikumul laahu faannaa tu'fakoon
Faal iqul isbaahi waja'al al layla sakana wash-shamsa wal qamara husbaana zaal ika taqdeerul'azeezil'al eem
Wahooal lazee ja'al a lakumun-nujooma litahtadu bihaa fee zul umaatil barri wal bahri qad fassal naal ayaati liqawm ya'lamoon
Wahooal lazeeaa 'anshaakum mmin nnafs waahidat famustaqarr wamustawda' qad fassal naal ayaati liqawm yafqahoon

Wahooal lazeeaa 'anzal a minas-samaa'i maa' faakhrajnaa bihi nabaata kul li shay' faakhrajnaa minhu khadira nnukhriju minhu habba mmutaraakiba waminan-nakhli min tal'ihaa qinwaan daaneeat wajannaat mmin 'a'naab waz-zaytoona war-rummaana mushtabiha waghayra mutashaabihin anzurooaa 'il aa thamarihiaa 'izaa 'athmara wayan'ihiaa 'inna fee zaal ikum layaat lliqawm yu'minoon
Waja'al u lil laahi shurakaa'al jinna wakhal aqahum wakharaqu lahu baneena wabanaati bighayri 'il m subhaanahu wata'aal aa 'ammaa yasifoon
Badee'us-samaawaati wal ardi 'annaa yakoonu lahu wal ad wal am takul llaahu saahibat wakhal aqa kul la shay' wahooa bikul li shay'in 'al eem
Zaal ikumul laahu rabbukum laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa khaal iqu kul li shay' fa'budoohu wahooa 'al aa kul li shay' wakeel
Llaa tudrikuhul absaaru wahooa yudrikul absaara wahooal lateeful khabeer
Qad jaa'akum basaa'iru mir rrabbikum faman 'absara fal inafsihi waman 'ameea fa'al ayhaa wamaa 'anaa 'al aykum bihafeez
Wakazaal ika nusarriful ayaati wal eeaqoolu darasta wal inubayyinahu liqawm ya'lamoon
Attabi' maa 'ooheea 'il ayka mir rrabbika laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa waa'rid 'anil mushrikeen
Wal aw shaa'al laahu maa 'ashraku wamaa ja'al naaka 'al ayhim hafeeza wamaa 'anta 'al ayhim biwakeel

Wal aa tasubbul lazeena yad'oona min doonil laahi fayasubbul laaha 'adwaa bighayri 'il m kazaal ika zayyannaa likul li 'ummatin 'amal ahum thumma 'il aa rabbihim mmarji'uhum fayunabbi'uhum bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Waaqsamu bil laahi jahda 'aymaanihim la'in jaa'athum 'ayat llayu'minunna bihaa qul 'innamaal ayaatu 'indal laahi wamaa yush'irukum 'annahaa 'izaa jaa'at laa yu'minoon
Wanuqal libu 'afidatahum waabsaarahum kamaa lam yu'minu bihiaa 'awwal a marrat wanazaruhum fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon

Wal aw 'annanaa nazzal naa 'il ayhimul mal aa'ikata wakal lamahumul mawtaa wahasharnaa 'al ayhim kul la shay' qubul a mmaa kaanu leeu'minooaa 'il laa 'any yashaa'al laahu wal aakinna 'aktharahum yajhal oon
Wakazaal ika ja'al naa likul li nabeeyin 'adoowa shayaateenal insi wal jinni yoohee ba'duhum 'il aa ba'd zukhrufal qawli ghuroora wal aw shaa'a rabbuka maa fa'al oohu fazarhum wamaa yaftaroon
Wal itasghaa 'il ayhi 'afidatul lazeena laa yu'minoona bil aakhirati wal eeardawhu wal eeaqtarifu maa hum mmuqtarifoon

'afaghayral laahi 'abtaghee hakama wahooal lazeeaa 'anzal a 'il aykumul kitaaba mufassal a wal lazeena 'aataynaahumul kitaaba ya'lamoona 'annahu munazzal mmir rrabbika bil haqqi fal aa takoonanna minal mumtareen
Watammat kal imatu rabbika sidqa wa'adla llaa mubaddil a likal imaatihi wahooas-samee'ul'al eem
Wain tuti' 'akthara man fee al ardi yudil looka 'an sabeelil laahi 'iny yattabi'oona 'il laaz-zanna wain hum 'il laa yakhrusoon
'inna rabbaka hooa 'a'lamu many yadil lu 'an sabeelihi wahooa 'a'lamu bil muhtadeen
Fakul u mimmaa zukirasmul laahi 'al ayhi 'in kuntum biayaatihi mu'mineen

Wamaa lakum 'al laa takul u mimmaa zukirasmul laahi 'al ayhi waqad fassal a lakum mmaa harrama 'al aykum 'il laa maadturirtum 'il ayhi wainna katheera llayudil loona biahwaa'ihim bighayri 'il min 'inna rabbaka hooa 'a'lamu bil mu'tadeen
Wazaru zaahiral ithmi wabaatinahuaa 'innal lazeena yaksiboonal ithma sayujzawna bimaa kaanu yaqtarifoon
Wal aa takul u mimmaa lam yuzkarismul laahi 'al ayhi wainnahu lafisq wainnash-shayaateena layoohoona 'il aa 'awleeaa'ihim leeujaadil ookum wain 'ata'tumoohum 'innakum lamushrikoon
'awaman kaana mayta faahyaynaahu waja'al naa lahu noora yamshee bihi fee an-naasi kamam mmathal uhu fee az-zul umaati laysa bikhaarij mminhaa kazaal ika zuyyina lil kaafireena maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Wakazaal ika ja'al naa fee kul li qaryatin 'akaabira mujrimeehaa leeamkuru feehaa wamaa yamkuroona 'il laa bianfusihim wamaa yash'uroon

Waizaa jaa'athum 'ayat qaal u lan nnu'mina hattaa nu'taa mithla maa 'ooteea rusul ul laahil laahu 'a'lamu haythu yaj'al u risaal atahu sayuseebul lazeena 'ajramu saghaarun 'indal laahi wa'azaab shadeedu bimaa kaanu yamkuroon

Famany yuridil laahu 'any yahdeeahu yashrah sadrahu lil islaami wamany yurid 'any yudil laahu yaj'al sadrahu dayyiqana haraja kaannamaa yassa'adu fee as-samaa'i kazaal ika yaj'al ul laahur-rijsa 'al aal lazeena laa yu'minoon
Wahaazaa siraatu rabbika mustaqeema qad fassal naal ayaati liqawm yazzakkaroon
Lahum daarus-sal aami 'inda rabbihim wahooa wal eeyuhum bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon

Wayawma yahshuruhum jamee'a yaama'sharal jinni qadistakthartum mminal insi waqaal a 'awleeaa'uhum mminal insi rabbanaastamta'a ba'dunaa biba'd wabal aghnaa 'ajal anaal lazeeaa 'ajjal ta lanaa qaal an-naaru mathwaakum khaal ideena feehaa 'il laa maa shaa'al laahu 'inna rabbaka hakeemun 'al eem
Wakazaal ika nooal lee ba'daz-zaal imeena ba'daa bimaa kaanu yaksiboon

Yaama'sharal jinni wal insi 'al am yatikum rusul mminkum yaqussoona 'al aykum 'ayaatee wayunziroonakum liqaa'a yawmikum haazaa qaal u shahidnaa 'al aa 'anfusinaa wagharrathumul hayawaatud-dunyaa washahidu 'al aa 'anfusihim 'annahum kaanu kaafireen
Zaal ika 'al llam yakur rrabbuka muhlikal quraa bizul m waahluhaa ghaafil oon
Wal ikul l darajaat mmimmaa 'amil u wamaa rabbuka bighaafil in 'ammaa ya'mal oon
Warabbukal ghaneeyu zoo ar-rahmati 'iny yasha yuzhibkum wayastakhlif mim ba'dikum mmaa yashaa'u kamaa 'anshaakum mmin zurriyyati qawmin 'aakhareen
'inna maa too'adoona laat wamaa 'antum bimu'jizeen
Qul yaaqawmi'mal u 'al aa makaanatikum 'innee 'aamil fasawfa ta'lamoona man takoonu lahu 'aaqibatud-daari 'innahu laa yuflihuz-zaal imoon

Waja'al u lil laahi mimmaa zaraa minal harthi wal an'aami naseeba faqaal u haazaa lil laahi biza'mihim wahaazaa lishurakaa'inaa famaa kaana lishurakaa'ihim fal aa yasil u 'il aal laahi wamaa kaana lil laahi fahooa yasil u 'il aa shurakaa'ihim saa'a maa yahkumoon
Wakazaal ika zayyana likatheer mminal mushrikeena qatla 'awlaadihim shurakaa'uhum leeurdoohum wal eeal bisu 'al ayhim deenahum wal aw shaa'al laahu maa fa'al oohu fazarhum wamaa yaftaroon

Waqaal u haazihiaa 'an'aam waharthun hijr llaa yat'amuhaa 'il laa man nnashaa'u biza'mihim waan'aamun hurrimat zuhooruhaa waan'aam llaa yazkuroonasmal laahi 'al ayhaaftiraa'an 'al ayhi sayajzeehim bimaa kaanu yaftaroon
Waqaal u maa fee butooni haazihil an'aami khaal isat llizukoorinaa wamuharramun 'al aa 'azwaajinaa wainy yakum mmaytat fahum feehi shurakaa'u sayajzeehim wasfahum 'innahu hakeemun 'al eem
Qad khasiral lazeena qatal ooaa 'awlaadahum safahaa bighayri 'il m waharramu maa razaqahumul laahuftiraa'an 'al aal laahi qad dal lu wamaa kaanu muhtadeen

Wahooal lazeeaa 'anshaa jannaat mma'rooshaat waghayra ma'rooshaat wan-nakhla waz-zar'a mukhtal ifana 'ukul uhu waz-zaytoona war-rummaana mutashaabiha waghayra mutashaabih kul u min thamarihiaa 'izaa 'athmara wa'aatu haqqahu yawma hasaadihi wal aa tusrifooaa 'innahu laa yuhibbul musrifeen
Waminal an'aami hamoolat wafarsha kul u mimmaa razaqakumul laahu wal aa tattabi'u khutooaatish-shaytaani 'innahu lakum 'adoow mmubeen
Thamaaneeata 'azwaaj mminad-danithnayni waminal ma'zithnayni qul 'aaz-zakarayni harrama 'amil unthayayni 'ammaashtamal at 'al ayhi 'arhaamul unthayayni nabbioonee bi'il min 'in kuntum saadiqeen

Waminal ibil ithnayni waminal baqarithnayni qul 'aaz-zakarayni harrama 'amil unthayayni 'ammaashtamal at 'al ayhi 'arhaamul unthayayni 'am kuntum shuhadaa'a 'iz wassaakumul laahu bihaazaa faman 'azlamu mimmaniftaraa 'al aal laahi kaziba lleeudil lan-naasa bighayri 'il min 'innal laaha laa yahdee al qawmaz-zaal imeen

Qul-laa 'ajidu fee maa 'ooheea 'il ayya muharramana 'al aa taa'im yat'amuhuaa 'il laa 'any yakoona maytatan 'aw dama mmasfoohana 'aw lahma khinzeer fainnahu rijsun 'aw fisqana 'uhil la lighayril laahi bihi famanidturra ghayra baagh wal aa 'aad fainna rabbaka ghafoor rraheem

Wa'al aal lazeena haadu harramnaa kul la zee zufur waminal baqari wal ghanami harramnaa 'al ayhim shuhoomahumaa 'il laa maa hamal at zuhooruhumaa 'awil hawayaa 'aw maakhtal ata bi'azm zaal ika jazaynaahum bibaghyihim wainnaa lasaadiqoon
Fain kazzabooka faqur-rabbukum zoo rahmat waasi'at wal aa yuraddu basuhu 'anil qawmil mujrimeen

Sayaqoolul lazeena 'ashraku law shaa'al laahu maa 'ashraknaa wal aa 'aabaa'unaa wal aa harramnaa min shay' kazaal ika kazzabal lazeena min qablihim hattaa zaaqu basanaa qul hal 'indakum mmin 'il m fatukhrijoohu lanaa 'in tattabi'oona 'il laaz-zanna wain 'antum 'il laa takhrusoon
Qul fal il laahil hujjatul baal ighatu fal aw shaa'a lahadaakum 'ajma'een

Qul hal umma shuhadaa'akumul lazeena yashhadoona 'annal laaha harrama haazaa fain shahidu fal aa tashhad ma'ahum wal aa tattabi' 'ahwaa'al lazeena kazzabu biayaatinaa wal lazeena laa yu'minoona bil aakhirati wahum birabbihim ya'dil oon

Qul ta'aal awa 'atlu maa harrama rabbukum 'al aykum 'al laa tushriku bihi shaya wabil waal idayni 'ihsaana wal aa taqtul ooaa 'awlaadakum mmin 'imlaaq nnahnu narzuqukum waiyyaahum wal aa taqrabul fawaahisha maa zahara minhaa wamaa batana wal aa taqtul un-nafsal latee harramal laahu 'il laa bil haqqi zaal ikum wassaakum bihi la'al lakum ta'qil oon

Wal aa taqrabu maal al yateemi 'il laa bil latee heea 'ahsanu hattaa yablugha 'ashuddahu waawful kayla wal meezaana bil qisti laa nukal lifu nafsana 'il laa wus'ahaa waizaa qul tum fa'dil u wal aw kaana zaa qurbaa wabi'ahdil laahi 'awfu zaal ikum wassaakum bihi la'al lakum tazakkaroon
Waanna haazaa siraatee mustaqeema fattabi'oohu wal aa tattabi'us-subul a fatafarraqa bikum 'an sabeelihi zaal ikum wassaakum bihi la'al lakum tattaqoon
Thumma 'aataynaa moosaal kitaaba tamaamana 'al aal lazeeaa 'ahsana watafseela llikul li shay' wahuda warahmat lla'al laahum bil iqaa'i rabbihim yu'minoon
Wahaazaa kitaabun 'anzal naahu mubaarak fattabi'oohu wattaqu la'al lakum turhamoon
'an taqoolooaa 'innamaa 'unzil al kitaabu 'al aa taa'ifatayni min qablinaa wain kunnaa 'an diraasatihim laghaafil een

'aw taqoolu law 'annaa 'unzil a 'al aynaal kitaabu lakunnaa 'ahdaa minhum faqad jaa'akum bayyinat mmir rrabbikum wahuda warahmat faman 'azlamu mimman kazzaba biayaatil laahi wasadafa 'anhaa sanajzee al lazeena yasdifoona 'an 'ayaatinaa sooaa'al'azaabi bimaa kaanu yasdifoon

Hal yanzuroona 'il laa 'an tateeahumul mal aa'ikatu 'aw yateea rabbuka 'aw yateea ba'du 'ayaati rabbika yawma yatee ba'du 'ayaati rabbika laa yanfa'u nafsana 'eemaanuhaa lam takun 'aamanat min qablu 'aw kasabat feeaa 'eemaanihaa khayra qul intazirooaa 'innaa muntaziroon
'innal lazeena farraqu deenahum wakaanu sheea'a llasta minhum fee shay'in 'innamaa 'amruhum 'il aal laahi thumma yunabbi'uhum bimaa kaanu yaf'al oon
Man jaa'a bil hasanati fal ahu 'ashru 'amthaal ihaa waman jaa'a bis-sayyi'ati fal aa yujzaa 'il laa mithlahaa wahum laa yuzlamoon
Qul 'innanee hadaanee rabbeeaa 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem deena qeeama mmil lata 'ibraaheema haneefa wamaa kaana minal mushrikeen
Qul 'inna sal aatee wanusukee wamahyaya wamamaatee lil laahi rabbil'aal ameen
Laa shareeka lahu wabizaal ika 'umirtu waanaa 'awwal ul muslimeen

Qul 'aghayral laahi 'abghee rabba wahooa rabbu kul li shay' wal aa taksibu kul lu nafsin 'il laa 'al ayhaa wal aa taziru waazirat wizra 'ukhraa thumma 'il aa rabbikum mmarji'ukum fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum feehi takhtal ifoon
Wahooal lazee ja'al akum khal aa'ifal ardi warafa'a ba'dakum fawqa ba'd darajaat lleeablooakum fee maa 'aataakum 'inna rabbaka saree'ul'iqaabi wainnahu laghafoor rraheem
Alif-Laaam-Meeem-Saaad
Kitaabun 'unzil a 'il ayka fal aa yakun fee sadrika haraj mminhu litunzira bihi wazikraa lil mu'mineen
Attabi'u maa 'unzil a 'il aykum mmir rrabbikum wal aa tattabi'u min doonihiaa 'awleeaa'a qal eela mmaa tazakkaroon
Wakam mmin qaryatin 'ahlaknaahaa fajaa'ahaa basunaa bayaatana 'aw hum qaa'il oon
Famaa kaana da'waahum 'iz jaa'ahum basunaa 'il laa 'an qaal ooaa 'innaa kunnaa zaal imeen
Fal anasal annal lazeena 'ursil a 'il ayhim wal anasal annal mursal een
Fal anaqussanna 'al ayhim bi'il m wamaa kunnaa ghaa'ibeen
Wal waznu yawma'izin al haqqu faman thaqul at mawaazeenuhu faul aa'ika humul muflihoon
