Waman khaffat mawaazeenuhu faul aa'ikal lazeena khasirooaa 'anfusahum bimaa kaanu biayaatinaa yazlimoon
Wal aqad makkannaakum fee al ardi waja'al naa lakum feehaa ma'ayisha qal eela mmaa tashkuroon
Wal aqad khal aqnaakum thumma sawwarnaakum thumma qul naa lil mal aa'ikatisjudu liaadama fasajadooaa 'il laa 'ibleesa lam yakum mminas-saajideen
Qaal a maa mana'aka 'al laa tasjuda 'iz 'amartuka qaal a 'anaa khayr mminhu khal aqtanee min nnaar wakhal aqtahu min teen
Qaal a fahbit minhaa famaa yakoonu laka 'an tatakabbara feehaa fakhruj 'innaka minas-saaghireen
Qaal a 'anzirneeaa 'il aa yawmi yub'athoon
Qaal a 'innaka minal munzareen
Qaal a fabimaa 'aghwaytanee laaq'udanna lahum siraatakal mustaqeem
Thumma laateeannahum mmim bayni 'aydeehim wamin khal fihim wa'an 'aymaanihim wa'an shamaa'il ihim wal aa tajidu 'aktharahum shaakireen
Qaal akhruj minhaa maz'ooma mmadhoora llaman tabi'aka minhum laamlaanna jahannama minkum 'ajma'een
Wayaadamuskun 'anta wazawjukal jannata fakul aa min haythu shi'tumaa wal aa taqrabaa haazihish-shajarata fatakoonaa minaz-zaal imeen

Fawaswasa lahumaash-shaytaanu leeubdeea lahumaa maa wureea 'anhumaa min saw'aatihimaa waqaal a maa nahaakumaa rabbukumaa 'an haazihish-shajarati 'il laa 'an takoonaa mal akayni 'aw takoonaa minal khaal ideen
Waqaasamahumaa 'innee lakumaa laminan-naasiheen

Fadal laahumaa bighuroor fal ammaa zaaqaash-shajarata badat lahumaa saw'aatuhumaa watafiqaa yakhsifaani 'al ayhimaa minw waraqil jannati wanaadaahumaa rabbuhumaa 'al am 'anhakumaa 'an til kumaash-shajarati waaqul-lakumaa 'innash-shaytaana lakumaa 'adoow mmubeen
Qaal aa rabbanaa zal amnaa 'anfusanaa wail llam taghfir lanaa watarhamnaa lanakoonanna minal khaasireen
Qaal ahbitu ba'dukum liba'din 'adoow wal akum fee al ardi mustaqarr wamataa'un 'il aa heen
Qaal a feehaa tahyawna wafeehaa tamootoona waminhaa tukhrajoon
Yaabaneeaa 'aadama qad 'anzal naa 'al aykum libaasa yooaaree saw'aatikum wareesha wal ibaasut-taqwaa zaal ika khayr zaal ika min 'ayaatil laahi la'al laahum yazzakkaroon

Yaabaneeaa 'aadama laa yaftinannakumush-shaytaanu kamaa 'akhraja 'abawaykum mminal jannati yanzi'u 'anhumaa libaasahumaa leeureeahumaa saw'aatihimaa 'innahu yaraakum hooa waqabeeluhu min haythu laa tarawnahum 'innaa ja'al naash-shayaateena 'awleeaa'a lil lazeena laa yu'minoon
Waizaa fa'al u faahishat qaal u wajadnaa 'al ayhaa 'aabaa'anaa wal laahu 'amaranaa bihaa qul 'innal laaha laa yamuru bil fahshaa'i 'ataqooloona 'al aal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Qul 'amara rabbee bil qisti waaqeemu wujoohakum 'inda kul li masjid wad'oohu mukhliseena lahud-deena kamaa badaakum ta'oodoon
Fareeqana hadaa wafareeqana haqqa 'al ayhimud-dal aal atu 'innahumuttakhazush-shayaateena 'awleeaa'a min doonil laahi wayahsaboona 'annahum mmuhtadoon
Yaabaneeaa 'aadama khuzu zeenatakum 'inda kul li masjid wakul u washrabu wal aa tusrifooaa 'innahu laa yuhibbul musrifeen

Qul man harrama zeenatal laahil lateeaa 'akhraja li'ibaadihi wat-tayyibaati minar-rizqi qul heea lil lazeena 'aamanu fee al hayawaatid-dunyaa khaal isat yawmal qeeaamati kazaal ika nufassil ul ayaati liqawm ya'lamoon

Qul 'innamaa harrama rabbeeal fawaahisha maa zahara minhaa wamaa batana wal ithma wal baghya bighayril haqqi waan tushriku bil laahi maa lam yunazzil bihi sul taana waan taqoolu 'al aal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Wal ikul li 'ummatin 'ajal faizaa jaa'a 'ajal uhum laa yastakhiroona saa'at wal aa yastaqdimoon
Yaabaneeaa 'aadama 'immaa yateeannakum rusul mminkum yaqussoona 'al aykum 'ayaatee famanittaqaa waaslaha fal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
Wal lazeena kazzabu biayaatinaa wastakbaru 'anhaa 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabun-naari hum feehaa khaal idoon

Faman 'azlamu mimmaniftaraa 'al aal laahi kazibana 'aw kazzaba biayaatihiaa 'ul aa'ika yanaal uhum naseebuhum mminal kitaabi hattaa 'izaa jaa'athum rusul unaa yatawaffawnahum qaal ooaa 'ayna maa kuntum tad'oona min doonil laahi qaal u dal lu 'annaa washahidu 'al aa 'anfusihim 'annahum kaanu kaafireen

Qaal adkhul u feeaa 'umam qad khal at min qablikum mminal jinni wal insi fee an-naari kul lamaa dakhal at 'ummat lla'anat 'ukhtahaa hattaa 'izaaddaaraku feehaa jamee'a qaal at 'ukhraahum lioolaahum rabbanaa haa'ul aa'i 'adal loonaa faatihim 'azaaba di'fa mminan-naari qaal a likul l di'f wal aakil llaa ta'lamoon
Waqaal at 'oolaahum liukhraahum famaa kaana lakum 'al aynaa min fadl fazooqul'azaaba bimaa kuntum taksiboon
'innal lazeena kazzabu biayaatinaa wastakbaru 'anhaa laa tufattahu lahum 'abwaabus-samaa'i wal aa yadkhul oonal jannata hattaa yal ijal jamal u fee sammil kheeaati wakazaal ika najzee al mujrimeen
Lahum mmin jahannama mihaad wamin fawqihim ghawaash wakazaal ika najzee az-zaal imeen
Wal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati laa nukal lifu nafsana 'il laa wus'ahaa 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabul jannati hum feehaa khaal idoon

Wanaza'naa maa fee sudoorihim mmin ghil l tajree min tahtihimul anhaaru waqaal ul hamdu lil laahil lazee hadaanaa lihaazaa wamaa kunnaa linahtadeea lawlaa 'an hadaanaal laahu laqad jaa'at rusul u rabbinaa bil haqqi wanoodooaa 'an til kumul jannatu 'oorithtumoohaa bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon

Wanaadaa 'ashaabul jannati 'ashaaban-naari 'an qad wajadnaa maa wa'adanaa rabbunaa haqqa fahal wajadttum mmaa wa'ada rabbukum haqqa qaal u na'am faazzana mu'azzinu baynahum 'al lla'natul laahi 'al aaz-zaal imeen
Al lazeena yasuddoona 'an sabeelil laahi wayabghoonahaa 'iwaja wahum bil aakhirati kaafiroon
Wabaynahumaa hijaab wa'al aal a'raafi rijaal ya'rifoona kul laa biseemaahum wanaadawa 'ashaabal jannati 'an sal aamun 'al aykum lam yadkhul oohaa wahum yatma'oon
Waizaa surifat 'absaaruhum til qaa'a 'ashaabin-naari qaal u rabbanaa laa taj'al naa ma'al qawmiz-zaal imeen
Wanaadaa 'ashaabul a'raafi rijaal a ya'rifoonahum biseemaahum qaal u maa 'aghnaa 'ankum jam'ukum wamaa kuntum tastakbiroon
'ahaa'ul aa'il lazeena 'aqsamtum laa yanaal uhumul laahu birahmatin adkhul ul jannata laa khawfun 'al aykum wal aa 'antum tahzanoon
Wanaadaa 'ashaabun-naari 'ashaabal jannati 'an 'afeedu 'al aynaa minal maa'i 'aw mimmaa razaqakumul laahu qaal ooaa 'innal laaha harramahumaa 'al aal kaafireen
Al lazeenattakhazu deenahum lahwa wal a'iba wagharrathumul hayawaatud-dunyaa fal yawma nansaahum kamaa nasu liqaa'a yawmihim haazaa wamaa kaanu biayaatinaa yajhadoon
Wal aqad ji'naahum bikitaab fassal naahu 'al aa 'il min huda warahmat lliqawm yu'minoon

Hal yanzuroona 'il laa taweelahu yawma yatee taweeluhu yaqoolul lazeena nasoohu min qablu qad jaa'at rusul u rabbinaa bil haqqi fahal-lanaa min shufa'aa'a fayashfa'u lanaa 'aw nuraddu fana'mal a ghayral lazee kunnaa na'mal u qad khasirooaa 'anfusahum wadal la 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaftaroon

'inna rabbakumul laahul lazee khal aqas-samaawaati wal arda fee sittati 'ayyaam thummastawaa 'al aal'arshi yughshee al laylan-nahaara yatlubuhu hatheetha wash-shamsa wal qamara wan-nujooma musakhkharaati biamrihiaa 'al aa lahul khal qu wal amru tabaarakal laahu rabbul'aal ameen
Ad'u rabbakum tadarru'a wakhufyatan 'innahu laa yuhibbul mu'tadeen
Wal aa tufsidu fee al ardi ba'da 'islaahihaa wad'oohu khawfa watama'ana 'inna rahmatal laahi qareeb mminal muhsineen

Wahooal lazee yursil ur-reeaaha bushraa bayna yaday rahmatihi hattaa 'izaa 'aqal lat sahaaba thiqaal a suqnaahu libal ad mmayyit faanzal naa bihil maa'a faakhrajnaa bihi min kul lith-thamaraati kazaal ika nukhrijul mawtaa la'al lakum tazakkaroon
Wal bal adut-tayyibu yakhruju nabaatuhu biizni rabbihi wal lazee khabutha laa yakhruju 'il laa nakida kazaal ika nusarriful ayaati liqawm yashkuroon
Laqad 'arsal naa noohana 'il aa qawmihi faqaal a yaaqawmi'budul laaha maa lakum mmin 'il aahin ghayruhuaa 'inneeaa 'akhaafu 'al aykum 'azaaba yawmin 'azeem
Qaal al mal au min qawmihiaa 'innaa lanaraaka fee dal aal mmubeen
Qaal a yaaqawmi laysa bee dal aal at wal aakinnee rasool mmir rrabbil'aal ameen
'ubal lighukum risaal aati rabbee waansahu lakum waa'lamu minal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
'awa'ajibtum 'an jaa'akum zikr mmir rrabbikum 'al aa rajul mminkum leeunzirakum wal itattaqu wal a'al lakum turhamoon
Fakazzaboohu faanjaynaahu wal lazeena ma'ahu fee al ful ki waaghraqnaal lazeena kazzabu biayaatinaa 'innahum kaanu qawmana 'ameen
Wail aa 'aadin 'akhaahum hooda qaal a yaaqawmi'budul laaha maa lakum mmin 'il aahin ghayruhuaa 'afal aa tattaqoon
Qaal al mal aul lazeena kafaru min qawmihiaa 'innaa lanaraaka fee safaahat wainnaa lanazunnuka minal kaazibeen
Qaal a yaaqawmi laysa bee safaahat wal aakinnee rasool mmir rrabbil'aal ameen
'ubal lighukum risaal aati rabbee waanaa lakum naasihun 'ameen

'awa'ajibtum 'an jaa'akum zikr mmir rrabbikum 'al aa rajul mminkum leeunzirakum wazkurooaa 'iz ja'al akum khul afaa'a mim ba'di qawmi nooh wazaadakum fee al khal qi bastat fazkurooaa 'aal aa'al laahi la'al lakum tuflihoon
Qaal ooaa 'aji'tanaa lina'budal laaha wahdahu wanazara maa kaana ya'budu 'aabaa'unaa fatinaa bimaa ta'idunaa 'in kunta minas-saadiqeen

Qaal a qad waqa'a 'al aykum mmir rrabbikum rijs waghadabun 'atujaadil oonanee feeaa 'asmaa' sammaytumoohaa 'antum wa'aabaa'ukum mmaa nazzal al laahu bihaa min sul taan fantazirooaa 'innee ma'akum mminal muntazireen
Faanjaynaahu wal lazeena ma'ahu birahmat mminnaa waqata'naa daabiral lazeena kazzabu biayaatinaa wamaa kaanu mu'mineen

Wail aa thamooda 'akhaahum saal iha qaal a yaaqawmi'budul laaha maa lakum mmin 'il aahin ghayruhu qad jaa'atkum bayyinat mmir rrabbikum haazihi naaqatul laahi lakum 'ayat fazaroohaa takul feeaa 'ardil laahi wal aa tamassoohaa bisooaa' fayakhuzakum 'azaabun 'al eem

Wazkurooaa 'iz ja'al akum khul afaa'a mim ba'di 'aad wabawwaakum fee al ardi tattakhizoona min suhoolihaa qusoora watanhitoonal jibaal a buyoota fazkurooaa 'aal aa'al laahi wal aa ta'thawa fee al ardi mufsideen
Qaal al mal aul lazeenastakbaru min qawmihi lil lazeenastud'ifu liman 'aamana minhum 'ata'lamoona 'anna saal iha mmursal mmir rrabbihi qaal ooaa 'innaa bimaa 'ursil a bihi mu'minoon
Qaal al lazeenastakbarooaa 'innaa bil lazeeaa 'aamantum bihi kaafiroon
Fa'aqarun-naaqata wa'atawa 'an 'amri rabbihim waqaal u yaasaal ihu'tinaa bimaa ta'idunaa 'in kunta minal mursal een
Faakhazathumur-rajfatu faasbahu fee daarihim jaathimeen
Fatawal laa 'anhum waqaal a yaaqawmi laqad 'ablaghtukum risaal ata rabbee wanasahtu lakum wal aakil llaa tuhibboonan-naasiheen
Wal ootana 'iz qaal a liqawmihiaa 'atatoonal faahishata maa sabaqakum bihaa min 'ahad mminal'aal ameen
'innakum latatoonar-rijaal a shahwat mmin doonin-nisaa'i bal 'antum qawm mmusrifoon
Wamaa kaana jawaaba qawmihiaa 'il laa 'an qaal ooaa 'akhrijoohum mmin qaryatikum 'innahum 'unaas yatatahharoon
Faanjaynaahu waahlahuaa 'il laamraatahu kaanat minal ghaabireen
Waamtarnaa 'al ayhim mmatara fanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul mujrimeen

Wail aa madyana 'akhaahum shu'ayba qaal a yaaqawmi'budul laaha maa lakum mmin 'il aahin ghayruhu qad jaa'atkum bayyinat mmir rrabbikum faawful kayla wal meezaana wal aa tabkhasun-naasa 'ashyaa'ahum wal aa tufsidu fee al ardi ba'da 'islaahihaa zaal ikum khayr llakum 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
Wal aa taq'udu bikul li siraat too'idoona watasuddoona 'an sabeelil laahi man 'aamana bihi watabghoonahaa 'iwaja wazkurooaa 'iz kuntum qal eela fakaththarakum wanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul mufsideen
Wain kaana taa'ifat mminkum 'aamanu bil lazeeaa 'ursil tu bihi wataa'ifat llam yu'minu fasbiru hattaa yahkumal laahu baynanaa wahooa khayrul haakimeen
Qaal al mal aul lazeenastakbaru min qawmihi lanukhrijannaka yaashu'aybu wal lazeena 'aamanu ma'aka min qaryatinaa 'aw lata'oodunna fee mil latinaa qaal a 'awal aw kunnaa kaariheen

Qadiftaraynaa 'al aal laahi kazibana 'in 'udnaa fee mil latikum ba'da 'iz najjaanaal laahu minhaa wamaa yakoonu lanaa 'an nna'ooda feehaa 'il laa 'any yashaa'al laahu rabbunaa wasi'a rabbunaa kul la shay'in 'il mana 'al aal laahi tawakkal naa rabbanaaftah baynanaa wabayna qawminaa bil haqqi waanta khayrul faatiheen
Waqaal al mal aul lazeena kafaru min qawmihi la'inittaba'tum shu'aybana 'innakum 'iza llakhaasiroon
Faakhazathumur-rajfatu faasbahu fee daarihim jaathimeen
Al lazeena kazzabu shu'ayba kaal llam yaghnawa feehaal lazeena kazzabu shu'ayba kaanu humul khaasireen
Fatawal laa 'anhum waqaal a yaaqawmi laqad 'ablaghtukum risaal aati rabbee wanasahtu lakum fakayfa 'aasaa 'al aa qawm kaafireen
Wamaa 'arsal naa fee qaryat mmin nnabeeyin 'il laa 'akhaznaa 'ahlahaa bil basaa'i wad-darraa'i la'al laahum yaddarra'oon
Thumma baddal naa makaanas-sayyi'atil hasanata hattaa 'afa wwaqaal u qad massa 'aabaa'anaad-darraa'u was-sarraa'u faakhaznaahum baghtat wahum laa yash'uroon
Wal aw 'anna 'ahlal quraa 'aamanu wattaqawa lafatahnaa 'al ayhim barakaat mminas-samaa'i wal ardi wal aakin kazzabu faakhaznaahum bimaa kaanu yaksiboon
'afaamina 'ahlul quraa 'any yateeahum basunaa bayaata wahum naa'imoon
'awaamina 'ahlul quraa 'any yateeahum basunaa duha wahum yal'aboon
'afaaminu makral laahi fal aa yamanu makral laahi 'il laal qawmul khaasiroon
'awal am yahdi lil lazeena yarithoonal arda mim ba'di 'ahlihaa 'al llaw nashaa'u 'asabnaahum bizunoobihim wanatba'u 'al aa qul oobihim fahum laa yasma'oon
Til kal quraa naqussu 'al ayka min 'anbaa'ihaa wal aqad jaa'athum rusul uhum bil bayyinaati famaa kaanu leeu'minu bimaa kazzabu min qablu kazaal ika yatba'ul laahu 'al aa qul oobil kaafireen
Wamaa wajadnaa liaktharihim mmin 'ahd wainw wajadnaa 'aktharahum lafaasiqeen
Thumma ba'athnaa mim ba'dihim mmoosaa biayaatinaa 'il aa fir'awna wamal aeehi fazal amu bihaa fanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul mufsideen
Waqaal a moosaa yaafir'awnu 'innee rasool mmir rrabbil'aal ameen
Haqeequn 'al aa 'al llaa 'aqoola 'al aal laahi 'il laal haqqa qad ji'tukum bibayyinat mmir rrabbikum faarsil ma'eea baneeaa 'israa'eel
Qaal a 'in kunta ji'ta biayat fati bihaa 'in kunta minas-saadiqeen
Faal qaa 'asaahu faizaa heea thu'baam mmubeen
Wanaza'a yadahu faizaa heea baydaa'u lin-naazireen
Qaal al mal au min qawmi fir'awna 'inna haazaa lasaahirun 'al eem
Yureedu 'any yukhrijakum mmin 'ardikum famaazaa tamuroon
Qaal ooaa 'arjih waakhaahu waarsil fee al madaa'ini haashireen
Yatooka bikul li saahirin 'al eem
Wajaa'as-saharatu fir'awna qaal ooaa 'inna lanaa laajrana 'in kunnaa nahnul ghaal ibeen
Qaal a na'am wainnakum laminal muqarrabeen
Qaal u yaamoosaa 'immaa 'an tul qeea waimmaa 'an nnakoona nahnul mul qeen
Qaal a 'al qu fal ammaa 'al qawa saharooaa 'a'yunan-naasi wastarhaboohum wajaa'oo bisihrin 'azeem
Waawhaynaa 'il aa moosaa 'an 'al qi 'asaaka faizaa heea tal qafu maa yafikoon
Fawaqa'al haqqu wabatal a maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Faghul ibu hunaal ika wanqal abu saaghireen
Waul qeeas-saharatu saajideen
Qaal ooaa 'aamannaa birabbil'aal ameen
Rabbi moosaa wahaaroon
Qaal a fir'awnu 'aamantum bihi qabla 'an 'aazana lakum 'inna haazaa lamakr mmakartumoohu fee al madeenati litukhriju minhaa 'ahlahaa fasawfa ta'lamoon
Lauqatti'anna 'aydeeakum waarjul akum mmin khil aaf thumma lausal libannakum 'ajma'een
Qaal ooaa 'innaa 'il aa rabbinaa munqal iboon
Wamaa tanqimu minnaa 'il laa 'an 'aamannaa biayaati rabbinaa lammaa jaa'atnaa rabbanaa 'afrigh 'al aynaa sabra watawaffanaa muslimeen
Waqaal al mal au min qawmi fir'awna 'atazaru moosaa waqawmahu leeufsidu fee al ardi wayazaraka wa'aal ihataka qaal a sanuqattil u 'abnaa'ahum wanastahyi nisaa'ahum wainnaa fawqahum qaahiroon
Qaal a moosaa liqawmihista'eenu bil laahi wasbirooaa 'innal arda lil laahi yoorithuhaa many yashaa'u min 'ibaadihi wal'aaqibatu lil muttaqeen
Qaal ooaa 'oozeenaa min qabli 'an tateeanaa wamim ba'di maa ji'tanaa qaal a 'asaa rabbukum 'any yuhlika 'adoowakum wayastakhlifakum fee al ardi fayanzura kayfa ta'mal oon
Wal aqad 'akhaznaa 'aal a fir'awna bis-sineena wanaqs mminath-thamaraati la'al laahum yazzakkaroon
Faizaa jaa'athumul hasanatu qaal u lanaa haazihi wain tusibhum sayyi'at yattayyaru bimoosaa wamam mma'ahuaa 'al aa 'innamaa taa'iruhum 'indal laahi wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Waqaal u mahmaa tatinaa bihi min 'ayat llitasharanaa bihaa famaa nahnu laka bimu'mineen
Faarsal naa 'al ayhimut-toofaana wal jaraada wal qummal a wad-dafaadi'a wad-dama 'ayaat mmufassal aat fastakbaru wakaanu qawma mmujrimeen
Wal ammaa waqa'a 'al ayhimur-rijzu qaal u yaamoosaad'u lanaa rabbaka bimaa 'ahida 'indaka la'in kashafta 'annaar-rijza lanu'minanna laka wal anursil anna ma'aka baneeaa 'israa'eel
Fal ammaa kashafnaa 'anhumur-rijza 'il aa 'ajal in hum baal ighoohu 'izaa hum yankuthoon
Fantaqamnaa minhum faaghraqnaahum fee al yammi biannahum kazzabu biayaatinaa wakaanu 'anhaa ghaafil een

Waawrathnaal qawmal lazeena kaanu yustad'afoona mashaariqal ardi wamaghaaribahaal latee baaraknaa feehaa watammat kal imatu rabbikal husnaa 'al aa baneeaa 'israa'eela bimaa sabaru wadammarnaa maa kaana yasna'u fir'awnu waqawmuhu wamaa kaanu ya'rishoon
Wajaawaznaa bibaneeaa 'israa'eelal bahra faatawa 'al aa qawm ya'kufoona 'al aa 'asnaam llaahum qaal u yaamoosaaj'al-lanaa 'il aaha kamaa lahum 'aal ihat qaal a 'innakum qawm tajhal oon
'inna haa'ul aa'i mutabbar mmaa hum feehi wabaatil mmaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Qaal a 'aghayral laahi 'abgheekum 'il aaha wahooa faddal akum 'al aal'aal ameen
Waiz 'anjaynaakum mmin 'aal i fir'awna yasoomoonakum sooaa'al'azaabi yuqattil oona 'abnaa'akum wayastahyoona nisaa'akum wafee zaal ikum bal aa' mmir rrabbikum 'azeem

Wawaa'adnaa moosaa thal aatheena laylat waatmamnaahaa bi'ashr fatamma meeqaatu rabbihiaa 'arba'eena laylat waqaal a moosaa liakheehi haaroonakhlufnee fee qawmee waaslih wal aa tattabi' sabeelal mufsideen

Wal ammaa jaa'a moosaa limeeqaatinaa wakal lamahu rabbuhu qaal a rabbi 'arineeaa 'anzur 'il ayka qaal a lan taraanee wal aakininzur 'il aal jabal i fainistaqarra makaanahu fasawfa taraanee fal ammaa tajal laa rabbuhu lil jabal i ja'al ahu dakka wakharra moosaa sa'iqa fal ammaa 'afaaqa qaal a subhaanaka tubtu 'il ayka waanaa 'awwal ul mu'mineen
Qaal a yaamoosaa 'innee astafaytuka 'al aan-naasi birisaal aatee wabikal aamee fakhuz maa 'aataytuka wakum mminash-shaakireen
Wakatabnaa lahu fee al al waahi min kul li shay' mmaw'izat watafseela llikul li shay' fakhuzhaa biqoowat wamur qawmaka yakhuzu biahsanihaa saooreekum daaral faasiqeen

Saasrifu 'an 'ayaateeal lazeena yatakabbaroona fee al ardi bighayril haqqi wainy yarawa kul la 'ayat llaa yu'minu bihaa wainy yarawa sabeelar-rushdi laa yattakhizoohu sabeela wainy yarawa sabeelal ghayyi yattakhizoohu sabeela zaal ika biannahum kazzabu biayaatinaa wakaanu 'anhaa ghaafil een
Wal lazeena kazzabu biayaatinaa wal iqaa'il aakhirati habitat 'a'maal uhum hal yujzawna 'il laa maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Wattakhaza qawmu moosaa mim ba'dihi min hul eeyihim 'ijla jasada llaahu khooaarun 'al am yarawa 'annahu laa yukal limuhum wal aa yahdeehim sabeelanattakhazoohu wakaanu zaal imeen
Wal ammaa suqita feeaa 'aydeehim waraawa 'annahum qad dal lu qaal u la'il llam yarhamnaa rabbunaa wayaghfir lanaa lanakoonanna minal khaasireen

Wal ammaa raja'a moosaa 'il aa qawmihi ghadbaana 'asifa qaal a bi'samaa khal aftumoonee mim ba'deeaa 'a'ajil tum 'amra rabbikum waal qaal al waaha waakhaza birasi 'akheehi yajurruhuaa 'il ayhi qaal abna 'umma 'innal qawmastad'afoonee wakaadu yaqtul oonanee fal aa tushmit beeal a'daa'a wal aa taj'al nee ma'al qawmiz-zaal imeen
Qaal a rabbighfir lee wal iakhee waadkhil naa fee rahmatika waanta 'arhamur-raahimeen
'innal lazeenattakhazul'ijla sayanaal uhum ghadab mmir rrabbihim wazil lat fee al hayawaatid-dunyaa wakazaal ika najzee al muftareen
Wal lazeena 'amil us-sayyiaati thumma taabu mim ba'dihaa wa'aamanooaa 'inna rabbaka mim ba'dihaa laghafoor rraheem
Wal ammaa sakata 'am mmoosaal ghadabu 'akhazal al waaha wafee nuskhatihaa huda warahmat llil lazeena hum lirabbihim yarhaboon

Wakhtaara moosaa qawmahu sab'eena rajul a llimeeqaatinaa fal ammaa 'akhazathumur-rajfatu qaal a rabbi law shi'ta 'ahlaktahum mmin qablu waiyyaya 'atuhlikunaa bimaa fa'al as-sufahaa'u minnaa 'in heea 'il laa fitnatuka tudil lu bihaa man tashaa'u watahdee man tashaa'u 'anta wal eeyunaa faghfir lanaa warhamnaa waanta khayrul ghaafireen

Waktub lanaa fee haazihid-dunyaa hasanat wafee al aakhirati 'innaa hudnaa 'il ayka qaal a 'azaabeeaa 'useebu bihi man 'ashaa'u warahmatee wasi'at kul la shay' fasaaktubuhaa lil lazeena yattaqoona wayu'toonaz-zakaata wal lazeena hum biayaatinaa yu'minoon

Al lazeena yattabi'oonar-rasoolan-nabiyyal ummiyyal lazee yajidoonahu maktoobana 'indahum fee at-tawraati wal injeeli yamuruhum bil ma'roofi wayanhaahum 'anil munkari wayuhil lu lahumut-tayyibaati wayuharrimu 'al ayhimul khabaa'itha wayada'u 'anhum 'israhum wal aghlaal al latee kaanat 'al ayhim fal lazeena 'aamanu bihi wa'azzaroohu wanasaroohu wattaba'un-nooral lazeeaa 'unzil a ma'ahuaa 'ul aa'ika humul muflihoon

Qul yayyuhaan-naasu 'innee rasoolul laahi 'il aykum jamee'anal lazee lahu mul kus-samaawaati wal ardi laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa yuhyi wayumeetu faaminu bil laahi warasoolihin-nabeeyil ummeeyil lazee yu'minu bil laahi wakal imaatihi wattabi'oohu la'al lakum tahtadoon
Wamin qawmi moosaa 'ummat yahdoona bil haqqi wabihi ya'dil oon

Waqatta'naahumuthnatay 'ashrata 'asbaatana 'umama waawhaynaa 'il aa moosaa 'izistasqaahu qawmuhuaa 'anidrib bbi'asaakal hajara fanbajasat minhuthnataa 'ashrata 'ayna qad 'al ima kul lu 'unaas mmashrabahum wazal lal naa 'al ayhimul ghamaama waanzal naa 'al ayhimul manna was-sal waa kul u min tayyibaati maa razaqnaakum wamaa zal amoonaa wal aakin kaanooaa 'anfusahum yazlimoon
Waiz qeela lahumuskunu haazihil qaryata wakul u minhaa haythu shi'tum waqoolu hittat wadkhul ul baaba sujjada nnaghfir lakum khateeaatikum sanazeedul muhsineen
Fabaddal al lazeena zal amu minhum qawlana ghayral lazee qeela lahum faarsal naa 'al ayhim rijza mminas-samaa'i bimaa kaanu yazlimoon

Wasal hum 'anil qaryatil latee kaanat haadiratal bahri 'iz ya'doona fee as-sabti 'iz tateehim heetaanuhum yawma sabtihim shurra'a wayawma laa yasbitoona laa tateehim kazaal ika nabloohum bimaa kaanu yafsuqoon
Waiz qaal at 'ummat mminhum lima ta'izoona qawmanal laahu muhlikuhum 'aw mu'azzibuhum 'azaaba shadeeda qaal u ma'ziratan 'il aa rabbikum wal a'al laahum yattaqoon
Fal ammaa nasu maa zukkiru bihiaa 'anjaynaal lazeena yanhawna 'anis-sooaa'i waakhaznaal lazeena zal amu bi'azaabi baeesi bimaa kaanu yafsuqoon
Fal ammaa 'atawa 'am mmaa nuhu 'anhu qul naa lahum koonu qiradatan khaasieen
Waiz taazzana rabbuka layab'athanna 'al ayhim 'il aa yawmil qeeaamati many yasoomuhum sooaa'al'azaabi 'inna rabbaka lasaree'ul'iqaabi wainnahu laghafoor rraheem
Waqatta'naahum fee al ardi 'umama mminhumus-saal ihoona waminhum doona zaal ika wabal awnaahum bil hasanaati was-sayyiaati la'al laahum yarji'oon

Fakhal afa mim ba'dihim khal f warithul kitaaba yakhuzoona 'arada haazaal adnaa wayaqooloona sayughfaru lanaa wainy yatihim 'arad mmithluhu yakhuzoohu 'al am yu'khaz 'al ayhim mmeethaaqul kitaabi 'al llaa yaqoolu 'al aal laahi 'il laal haqqa wadarasu maa feehi wad-daarul aakhiratu khayr llil lazeena yattaqoona 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Wal lazeena yumassikoona bil kitaabi waaqaamus-sal aata 'innaa laa nudee'u 'ajral musliheen
Waiz nataqnaal jabal a fawqahum kaannahu zul lat wazannooaa 'annahu waaqi'u bihim khuzu maa 'aataynaakum biqoowat wazkuru maa feehi la'al lakum tattaqoon

Waiz 'akhaza rabbuka mim baneeaa 'aadama min zuhoorihim zurriyyatahum waashhadahum 'al aa 'anfusihim 'al astu birabbikum qaal u bal aa shahidnaa 'an taqoolu yawmal qeeaamati 'innaa kunnaa 'an haazaa ghaafil een
'aw taqoolooaa 'innamaa 'ashraka 'aabaa'unaa min qablu wakunnaa zurriyyat mmim ba'dihim 'afatuhlikunaa bimaa fa'al al mubtil oon
Wakazaal ika nufassil ul ayaati wal a'al laahum yarji'oon
Watlu 'al ayhim nabaal lazeeaa 'aataynaahu 'ayaatinaa fansal akha minhaa faatba'ahush-shaytaanu fakaana minal ghaaween

Wal aw shi'naa larafa'naahu bihaa wal aakinnahuaa 'akhlada 'il aal ardi wattaba'a hawaahu famathal uhu kamathal il kal bi 'in tahmil 'al ayhi yal hath 'aw tatrukhu yal hath zzaal ika mathal ul qawmil lazeena kazzabu biayaatinaa faqsusil qasasa la'al laahum yatafakkaroon
Saa'a mathal anal qawmul lazeena kazzabu biayaatinaa waanfusahum kaanu yazlimoon
Many yahdil laahu fahooal muhtadee wamany yudlil faul aa'ika humul khaasiroon

Wal aqad zaranaa lijahannama katheera mminal jinni wal insi lahum qul oob llaa yafqahoona bihaa wal ahum 'a'yul llaa yubsiroona bihaa wal ahum 'aazaal llaa yasma'oona bihaa 'ul aa'ika kal an'aami bal hum 'adal lu 'ul aa'ika humul ghaafil oon
Wal il laahil asmaa'ul husnaa fad'oohu bihaa wazarul lazeena yul hidoona feeaa 'asmaa'ihi sayujzawna maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Wamimman khal aqnaa 'ummat yahdoona bil haqqi wabihi ya'dil oon
Wal lazeena kazzabu biayaatinaa sanastadrijuhum mmin haythu laa ya'lamoon
Waumlee lahum 'inna kaydee mateen
'awal am yatafakkaru maa bisaahibihim mmin jinnatin 'in hooa 'il laa nazeer mmubeen
'awal am yanzuru fee mal akootis-samaawaati wal ardi wamaa khal aqal laahu min shay' waan 'asaa 'any yakoona qadiqtaraba 'ajal uhum fabiayyi hadeethi ba'dahu yu'minoon
Many yudlil il laahu fal aa haadeea lahu wayazaruhum fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon

Yasal oonaka 'anis-saa'ati 'ayyaana mursaahaa qul 'innamaa 'il muhaa 'inda rabbee laa yujal leehaa liwaqtihaa 'il laa hooa thaqul at fee as-samaawaati wal ardi laa tateekum 'il laa baghtat yasal oonaka kaannaka hafeeyun 'anhaa qul 'innamaa 'il muhaa 'indal laahi wal aakinna 'aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon

Qul-laa 'amliku linafsee naf'a wal aa darrana 'il laa maa shaa'al laahu wal aw kuntu 'a'lamul ghayba lastakthartu minal khayri wamaa massaneeas-sooaa'u 'in 'anaa 'il laa nazeer wabasheer lliqawm yu'minoon

Hooal lazee khal aqakum mmin nnafs waahidat waja'al a minhaa zawjahaa leeaskuna 'il ayhaa fal ammaa taghashshaahaa hamal at hamlana khafeefa famarrat bihi fal ammaa 'athqal at dda'awaal laaha rabbahumaa la'in 'aataytanaa saal iha llanakoonanna minash-shaakireen
Fal ammaa 'aataahumaa saal iha ja'al aa lahu shurakaa'a feemaa 'aataahumaa fata'aal aal laahu 'ammaa yushrikoon
'ayushrikoona maa laa yakhluqu shaya wahum yukhlaqoon
Wal aa yastatee'oona lahum nasra wal aa 'anfusahum yansuroon
Wain tad'oohum 'il aal hudaa laa yattabi'ookum sawaa'un 'al aykum 'ada'awtumoohum 'am 'antum saamitoon
'innal lazeena tad'oona min doonil laahi 'ibaadun 'amthaal ukum fad'oohum fal yastajeebu lakum 'in kuntum saadiqeen
'al ahum 'arjul yamshoona bihaa 'am lahum 'ayd yabtishoona bihaa 'am lahum 'a'yuny yubsiroona bihaa 'am lahum 'aazaany yasma'oona bihaa qul id'u shurakaa'akum thumma keedooni fal aa tunziroon
'inna wal iieeal laahul lazee nazzal al kitaaba wahooa yatawal laas-saal iheen
Wal lazeena tad'oona min doonihi laa yastatee'oona nasrakum wal aa 'anfusahum yansuroon
Wain tad'oohum 'il aal hudaa laa yasma'u wataraahum yanzuroona 'il ayka wahum laa yubsiroon
Khuzil'afwa wamur bil'urfi waa'rid 'anil jaahil een
Waimmaa yanzaghannaka minash-shaytaani nazgh fasta'iz bil laahi 'innahu samee'un 'al eem
'innal lazeenattaqawa 'izaa massahum taa'if mminash-shaytaani tazakkaru faizaa hum mmubsiroon
Waikhwaanuhum yamuddoonahum fee al ghayyi thumma laa yuqsiroon
Waizaa lam tatihim biayat qaal u lawlaajtabaytahaa qul 'innamaa 'attabi'u maa yoohaa 'il ayya mir rrabbee haazaa basaa'iru mir rrabbikum wahuda warahmat lliqawm yu'minoon
Waizaa quri'al qur'aanu fastami'u lahu waansitu la'al lakum turhamoon
Wazkur rrabbaka fee nafsika tadarru'a wakheefat wadoonal jahri minal qawli bil ghudoowi wal aasaal i wal aa takum mminal ghaafil een
'innal lazeena 'inda rabbika laa yastakbiroona 'an 'ibaadatihi wayusabbihoonahu wal ahu yasjudoon
Yasal oonaka 'anil anfaal i qul il anfaal u lil laahi war-rasooli fattaqul laaha waaslihu zaata baynikum waatee'ul laaha warasoolahuaa 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
'innamaal mu'minoonal lazeena 'izaa zukiral laahu wajil at qul oobuhum waizaa tul eeat 'al ayhim 'ayaatuhu zaadathum 'eemaana wa'al aa rabbihim yatawakkal oon
Al lazeena yuqeemoonas-sal aata wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
'ul aa'ika humul mu'minoona haqqa llaahum darajaatun 'inda rabbihim wamaghfirat warizq kareem
Kamaa 'akhrajaka rabbuka mim baytika bil haqqi wainna fareeqa mminal mu'mineena lakaarihoon
Yujaadil oonaka fee al haqqi ba'da maa tabayyana kaannamaa yusaaqoona 'il aal mawti wahum yanzuroon
Waiz ya'idukumul laahu 'ihdaat-taa'ifatayni 'annahaa lakum watawaddoona 'anna ghayra zaatish-shawkati takoonu lakum wayureedul laahu 'any yuhiqqal haqqa bikal imaatihi wayaqta'a daabiral kaafireen
Leeuhiqqal haqqa wayubtil al baatil a wal aw karihal mujrimoon
'iz tastagheethoona rabbakum fastajaaba lakum 'annee mumiddukum bial f mminal mal aa'ikati murdifeen
Wamaa ja'al ahul laahu 'il laa bushraa wal itatma'inna bihi qul oobukum wamaan-nasru 'il laa min 'indil laahi 'innal laaha 'azeezun hakeem

'iz yughashsheekumun-nu'aasa 'amanat mminhu wayunazzil u 'al aykum mminas-samaa'i maa' lleeutahhirakum bihi wayuzhiba 'ankum rijzash-shaytaani wal eearbita 'al aa qul oobikum wayuthabbita bihil aqdaam
'iz yoohee rabbuka 'il aal mal aa'ikati 'annee ma'akum fathabbitul lazeena 'aamanu saul qee fee qul oobil lazeena kafarur-ru'ba fadribu fawqal a'naaqi wadribu minhum kul la bana
Zaal ika biannahum shaaqqul laaha warasoolahu wamany yushaaqiqil laaha warasoolahu fainnal laaha shadeedul'iqaab
Zaal ikum fazooqoohu waanna lil kaafireena 'azaaban-naar
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'izaa laqeetumul lazeena kafaru zahfa fal aa tooal loohumul adbaar
Wamany yooal lihim yawma'iz duburahuaa 'il laa mutaharrifa lliqitaal in 'aw mutahayyizana 'il aa fi'at faqad baa'a bighadab mminal laahi wamawaahu jahannamu wabi'sal maseer
Fal am taqtul oohum wal aakinnal laaha qatal ahum wamaa ramayta 'iz ramayta wal aakinnal laaha ramaa wal eeubleeal mu'mineena minhu bal aa'an hasanana 'innal laaha samee'un 'al eem
Zaal ikum waannal laaha moohinu kaydil kaafireen
'in tastaftihu faqad jaa'akumul fathu wain tantahu fahooa khayr llakum wain ta'oodu na'ud wal an tughneea 'ankum fi'atukum shaya wal aw kathurat waannal laaha ma'al mu'mineen
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'atee'ul laaha warasoolahu wal aa tawal lawa 'anhu waantum tasma'oon
Wal aa takoonu kal lazeena qaal u sami'naa wahum laa yasma'oon
'inna sharrad-dawaabbi 'indal laahis-summul bukmul lazeena laa ya'qil oon
Wal aw 'al imal laahu feehim khayra llaasma'ahum wal aw 'asma'ahum latawal la wwahum mmu'ridoon
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanustajeebu lil laahi wal ir-rasooli 'izaa da'aakum limaa yuhyeekum wa'lamooaa 'annal laaha yahoolu baynal mar'i waqal bihi waannahuaa 'il ayhi tuhsharoon
Wattaqu fitnat llaa tuseebannal lazeena zal amu minkum khaassat wa'lamooaa 'annal laaha shadeedul'iqaab
Wazkurooaa 'iz 'antum qal eel mmustad'afoona fee al ardi takhaafoona 'any yatakhattafakumun-naasu faawaakum wayyadakum binasrihi warazaqakum mminat-tayyibaati la'al lakum tashkuroon
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa takhoonul laaha war-rasoola watakhoonooaa 'amaanaatikum waantum ta'lamoon
Wa'lamooaa 'annamaa 'amwaal ukum waawlaadukum fitnat waannal laaha 'indahuaa 'ajrun 'azeem
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'in tattaqul laaha yaj'al-lakum furqaana wayukaffir 'ankum sayyiaatikum wayaghfir lakum wal laahu zoo al fadlil'azeem
Waiz yamkuru bikal lazeena kafaru leeuthbitooka 'aw yaqtul ooka 'aw yukhrijooka wayamkuroona wayamkurul laahu wal laahu khayrul maakireen
Waizaa tutlaa 'al ayhim 'ayaatunaa qaal u qad sami'naa law nashaa'u laqul naa mithla haazaa 'in haazaa 'il laa 'asaateerul awwal een
Waiz qaal ul laahumma 'in kaana haazaa hooal haqqa min 'indika faamtir 'al aynaa hijaarat mminas-samaa'i 'awi'tinaa bi'azaabin 'al eem
Wamaa kaanal laahu leeu'azzibahum waanta feehim wamaa kaanal laahu mu'azzibahum wahum yastaghfiroon
Wamaa lahum 'al laa yu'azzibahumul laahu wahum yasuddoona 'anil masjidil haraami wamaa kaanooaa 'awleeaa'ahuaa 'in 'awleeaa'uhuaa 'il laal muttaqoona wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Wamaa kaana sal aatuhum 'indal bayti 'il laa mukaa' watasdeeat fazooqul'azaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon
'innal lazeena kafaru yunfiqoona 'amwaal ahum leeasuddu 'an sabeelil laahi fasayunfiqoonahaa thumma takoonu 'al ayhim hasrat thumma yughlaboona wal lazeena kafarooaa 'il aa jahannama yuhsharoon
Leeameezal laahul khabeetha minat-tayyibi wayaj'al al khabeetha ba'dahu 'al aa ba'd fayarkumahu jamee'a fayaj'al ahu fee jahannama 'ul aa'ika humul khaasiroon
Qul-lil lazeena kafarooaa 'iny yantahu yughfar lahum mmaa qad sal afa wainy ya'oodu faqad madat sunnatul awwal een
Waqaatil oohum hattaa laa takoona fitnat wayakoonad-deenu kul luhu lil laahi fainintahawa fainnal laaha bimaa ya'mal oona baseer
Wain tawal lawa fa'lamooaa 'annal laaha mawlaakum ni'mal mawlaa wani'man-naseer

Wa'lamooaa 'annamaa ghanimtum mmin shay' faanna lil laahi khumusahu wal ir-rasooli wal izee al qurbaa wal yataamaa wal masaakeeni wabnis-sabeeli 'in kuntum 'aamantum bil laahi wamaa 'anzal naa 'al aa 'abdinaa yawmal furqaani yawmal taqaal jam'aani wal laahu 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer

'iz 'antum bil'udwatid-dunyaa wahum bil'udwatil quswaa war-rakbu 'asfal a minkum wal aw tawaa'adttum lakhtal aftum fee al mee'aadi wal aakil lleeaqdeeal laahu 'amra kaana maf'oola lleeahlika man hal aka 'am bayyinat wayahyaa man hayya 'am bayyinat wainnal laaha lasamee'un 'al eem
'iz yureekahumul laahu fee manaamika qal eela wal aw 'araakahum katheera llafashil tum wal atanaaza'tum fee al amri wal aakinnal laaha sal lama 'innahu 'al eemu bizaatis-sudoor
Waiz yureekumoohum 'izil taqaytum feeaa 'a'yunikum qal eela wayuqal lil ukum feeaa 'a'yunihim leeaqdeeal laahu 'amra kaana maf'oola wail aal laahi turja'ul umoor
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'izaa laqeetum fi'at fathbutu wazkurul laaha katheera lla'al lakum tuflihoon
Waatee'ul laaha warasoolahu wal aa tanaaza'u fatafshal u watazhaba reehukum wasbirooaa 'innal laaha ma'as-saabireen
Wal aa takoonu kal lazeena kharaju min deeaarihim batara wari'aa'an-naasi wayasuddoona 'an sabeelil laahi wal laahu bimaa ya'mal oona muheeh

Waiz zayyana lahumush-shaytaanu 'a'maal ahum waqaal a laa ghaal iba lakumul yawma minan-naasi wainnee jaar llakum fal ammaa taraa'atil fi'ataani nakasa 'al aa 'aqibayhi waqaal a 'innee bareeaa' mminkum 'inneeaa 'araa maa laa tarawna 'inneeaa 'akhaaful laaha wal laahu shadeedul'iqaab
'iz yaqoolul munaafiqoona wal lazeena fee qul oobihim mmaradun gharra haa'ul aa'i deenuhum wamany yatawakkal 'al aal laahi fainnal laaha 'azeezun hakeem
Wal aw taraa 'iz yatawaffaal lazeena kafarul mal aa'ikatu yadriboona wujoohahum waadbaarahum wazooqu 'azaabal hareeq
Zaal ika bimaa qaddamat 'aydeekum waannal laaha laysa bizal laam llil'abeed
Kadabi 'aal i fir'awna wal lazeena min qablihim kafaru biayaatil laahi faakhazahumul laahu bizunoobihim 'innal laaha qaweey shadeedul'iqaab
Zaal ika biannal laaha lam yaku mughayyira nni'matan 'an'amahaa 'al aa qawmin hattaa yughayyiru maa bianfusihim waannal laaha samee'un 'al eem
Kadabi 'aal i fir'awna wal lazeena min qablihim kazzabu biayaati rabbihim faahlaknaahum bizunoobihim waaghraqnaa 'aal a fir'awna wakul l kaanu zaal imeen
'inna sharrad-dawaabbi 'indal laahil lazeena kafaru fahum laa yu'minoon
Al lazeena 'aahadtta minhum thumma yanqudoona 'ahdahum fee kul li marrat wahum laa yattaqoon
Faimmaa tathqafannahum fee al harbi fasharrid bihim mman khal fahum la'al laahum yazzakkaroon
Waimmaa takhaafanna min qawmin kheeaanat fanbiz 'il ayhim 'al aa sawaa'in 'innal laaha laa yuhibbul khaa'ineen
Wal aa yahsabannal lazeena kafaru sabaqooaa 'innahum laa yu'jizoon

Waa'iddu lahum mmaastata'tum mmin qoowat wamir rribaatil khayli turhiboona bihi 'adoowal laahi wa'adoowakum wa'aakhareena min doonihim laa ta'lamoonahumul laahu ya'lamuhum wamaa tunfiqu min shay' fee sabeelil laahi yooaffa 'il aykum waantum laa tuzlamoon
Wain janahu lis-sal mi fajnah lahaa watawakkal 'al aal laahi 'innahu hooas-samee'ul'al eem
Wainy yureedooaa 'any yakhda'ooka fainna hasbakal laahu hooal lazeeaa 'ayyadaka binasrihi wabil mu'mineen
Waal lafa bayna qul oobihim law 'anfaqta maa fee al ardi jamee'a mmaa 'al lafta bayna qul oobihim wal aakinnal laaha 'al lafa baynahum 'innahu 'azeezun hakeem
Yayyuhaan-nabeeyu hasbukal laahu wamanittaba'aka minal mu'mineen

Yayyuhaan-nabeeyu harridil mu'mineena 'al aal qitaal i 'iny yakum mminkum 'ishroona saabiroona yaghlibu mia'atayni wainy yakum mminkum mmia'at yaghlibooaa 'al fa mminal lazeena kafaru biannahum qawm llaa yafqahoon

Al aana khaffafal laahu 'ankum wa'al ima 'anna feekum da'fa fainy yakum mminkum mmia'at saabirat yaghlibu mia'atayni wainy yakum mminkum 'al f yaghlibooaa 'al fayni biiznil laahi wal laahu ma'as-saabireen
Maa kaana linabeeyin 'any yakoona lahuaa 'asraa hattaa yuthkhina fee al ardi tureedoona 'aradad-dunyaa wal laahu yureedul aakhirata wal laahu 'azeezun hakeem
Llawlaa kitaab mminal laahi sabaqa lamassakum feemaa 'akhaztum 'azaabun 'azeem
Fakul u mimmaa ghanimtum hal aal a tayyiba wattaqul laaha 'innal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Yayyuhaan-nabeeyu qul-liman feeaa 'aydeekum mminal asraa 'iny ya'lamil laahu fee qul oobikum khayra yu'tikum khayra mmimmaa 'ukhiza minkum wayaghfir lakum wal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Wainy yureedu kheeaanataka faqad khaanul laaha min qablu faamkana minhum wal laahu 'al eemun hakeem

'innal lazeena 'aamanu wahaajaru wajaahadu biamwaal ihim waanfusihim fee sabeelil laahi wal lazeena 'aawa wwanasarooaa 'ul aa'ika ba'duhum 'awleeaa'u ba'd wal lazeena 'aamanu wal am yuhaajiru maa lakum mminw wal ayatihim mmin shay'in hattaa yuhaajiru wainistansarookum fee ad-deeni fa'al aykumun-nasru 'il laa 'al aa qawmi baynakum wabaynahum mmeethaaq wal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona baseer
Wal lazeena kafaru ba'duhum 'awleeaa'u ba'din 'il laa taf'al oohu takun fitnat fee al ardi wafasaad kabeer
Wal lazeena 'aamanu wahaajaru wajaahadu fee sabeelil laahi wal lazeena 'aawa wwanasarooaa 'ul aa'ika humul mu'minoona haqqa llaahum mmaghfirat warizq kareem
Wal lazeena 'aamanu mim ba'du wahaajaru wajaahadu ma'akum faul aa'ika minkum waoolul arhaami ba'duhum 'awlaa biba'd fee kitaabil laahi 'innal laaha bikul li shay'in 'al eem
Baraa'at mminal laahi warasoolihiaa 'il aal lazeena 'aahadttum mminal mushrikeen
Faseehu fee al ardi 'arba'ata 'ashhur wa'lamooaa 'annakum ghayru mu'jizee al laahi waannal laaha mukhzee al kaafireen

Waazaam mminal laahi warasoolihiaa 'il aan-naasi yawmal hajjil akbari 'annal laaha bareeaa' mminal mushrikeena warasooluhu fain tubtum fahooa khayr llakum wain tawal laytum fa'lamooaa 'annakum ghayru mu'jizee al laahi wabashshiril lazeena kafaru bi'azaabin 'al eem
'il laal lazeena 'aahadttum mminal mushrikeena thumma lam yanqusookum shaya wal am yuzaahiru 'al aykum 'ahada faatimmooaa 'il ayhim 'ahdahum 'il aa muddatihim 'innal laaha yuhibbul muttaqeen

Faizaansal akhal ashhurul hurumu faqtul ul mushrikeena haythu wajadttumoohum wakhuzoohum wahsuroohum waq'udu lahum kul la marsad fain taabu waaqaamus-sal aata wa'aatawuaz-zakaata fakhal lu sabeelahum 'innal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Wain 'ahad mminal mushrikeenastajaaraka faajirhu hattaa yasma'a kal aamal laahi thumma 'ablighhu mamanahu zaal ika biannahum qawm llaa ya'lamoon
Kayfa yakoonu lil mushrikeena 'ahdun 'indal laahi wa'inda rasoolihiaa 'il laal lazeena 'aahadttum 'indal masjidil haraami famaastaqaamu lakum fastaqeemu lahum 'innal laaha yuhibbul muttaqeen
Kayfa wainy yazharu 'al aykum laa yarqubu feekum 'il la wal aa zimmat yurdoonakum biafwaahihim watabaa qul oobuhum waaktharuhum faasiqoon
Ashtarawa biayaatil laahi thamana qal eela fasaddu 'an sabeelihiaa 'innahum saa'a maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Laa yarquboona fee mu'minin 'il la wal aa zimmat waul aa'ika humul mu'tadoon
Fain taabu waaqaamus-sal aata wa'aatawuaz-zakaata faikhwaanukum fee ad-deeni wanufassil ul ayaati liqawm ya'lamoon
Wain nnakathooaa 'aymaanahum mmim ba'di 'ahdihim wata'anu fee deenikum faqaatil ooaa 'a'immatal kufri 'innahum laa 'aymaana lahum la'al laahum yantahoon
'al aa tuqaatil oona qawma nnakathooaa 'aymaanahum wahammu biikhraajir-rasooli wahum bada'ookum 'awwal a marratin 'atakhshawnahum fal laahu 'ahaqqu 'an takhshawhu 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
Qaatil oohum yu'azzibhumul laahu biaydeekum wayukhzihim wayansurkum 'al ayhim wayashfi sudoora qawm mmu'mineen
Wayuzhib ghayza qul oobihim wayatoobul laahu 'al aa many yashaa'u wal laahu 'al eemun hakeem
'am hasibtum 'an tutraku wal ammaa ya'lamil laahul lazeena jaahadu minkum wal am yattakhizu min doonil laahi wal aa rasoolihi wal aal mu'mineena wal eejat wal laahu khabeeru bimaa ta'mal oon
Maa kaana lil mushrikeena 'any ya'muru masaajidal laahi shaahideena 'al aa 'anfusihim bil kufri 'ul aa'ika habitat 'a'maal uhum wafee an-naari hum khaal idoon
'innamaa ya'muru masaajidal laahi man 'aamana bil laahi wal yawmil aakhiri waaqaamas-sal aata wa'aataaz-zakaata wal am yakhsha 'il laal laaha fa'asaa 'ul aa'ika 'any yakoonu minal muhtadeen
'aja'al tum siqayatal haajji wa'imaaratal masjidil haraami kaman 'aamana bil laahi wal yawmil aakhiri wajaahada fee sabeelil laahi laa yastawuna 'indal laahi wal laahu laa yahdee al qawmaz-zaal imeen
Al lazeena 'aamanu wahaajaru wajaahadu fee sabeelil laahi biamwaal ihim waanfusihim 'a'zamu darajatan 'indal laahi waul aa'ika humul faa'izoon
Yubashshiruhum rabbuhum birahmat mminhu waridwaanw wajannaat llaahum feehaa na'eem mmuqeem
Khaal ideena feehaa 'abadana 'innal laaha 'indahuaa 'ajrun 'azeem
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa tattakhizooaa 'aabaa'akum waikhwaanakum 'awleeaa'a 'inistahabbul kufra 'al aal eemaani wamany yatawal laahum mminkum faul aa'ika humuz-zaal imoon

Qul 'in kaana 'aabaa'ukum waabnaa'ukum waikhwaanukum waazwaajukum wa'asheeratukum waamwaal un aqtaraftumoohaa watijaarat takhshawna kasaadahaa wamasaakinu tardawnahaa 'ahabba 'il aykum mminal laahi warasoolihi wajihaad fee sabeelihi fatarabbasu hattaa yateeal laahu biamrihi wal laahu laa yahdee al qawmal faasiqeen
Laqad nasarakumul laahu fee mawaatina katheerat wayawma hunaynin 'iz 'a'jabatkum kathratukum fal am tughni 'ankum shaya wadaaqat 'al aykumul ardu bimaa rahubat thumma wal laytum mmudbireen
Thumma 'anzal al laahu sakeenatahu 'al aa rasoolihi wa'al aal mu'mineena waanzal a junooda llam tarawhaa wa'azzabal lazeena kafaru wazaal ika jazaa'ul kaafireen
Thumma yatoobul laahu mim ba'di zaal ika 'al aa many yashaa'u wal laahu ghafoor rraheem

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'innamaal mushrikoona najas fal aa yaqrabul masjidal haraama ba'da 'aamihim haazaa wain khiftum 'aylat fasawfa yughneekumul laahu min fadlihiaa 'in shaa'a 'innal laaha 'al eemun hakeem

Qaatil ul lazeena laa yu'minoona bil laahi wal aa bil yawmil aakhiri wal aa yuharrimoona maa harramal laahu warasooluhu wal aa yadeenoona deenal haqqi minal lazeena 'ootul kitaaba hattaa yu'tul jizyata 'any yad wahum saaghiroon
Waqaal atil yahoodu 'uzayrun abnul laahi waqaal atin-nasaaraal maseehubnul laahi zaal ika qawluhum biafwaahihim yudaahioona qawlal lazeena kafaru min qablu qaatal ahumul laahu 'annaa yu'fakoon
Attakhazooaa 'ahbaarahum waruhbaanahum 'arbaaba mmin doonil laahi wal maseehabna maryama wamaa 'umirooaa 'il laa leea'budooaa 'il aaha waahida llaa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa subhaanahu 'ammaa yushrikoon
Yureedoona 'any yutfiu nooral laahi biafwaahihim wayabaal laahu 'il laa 'any yutimma noorahu wal aw karihal kaafiroon
Hooal lazeeaa 'arsal a rasoolahu bil hudaa wadeenil haqqi leeuzhirahu 'al aad-deeni kul lihi wal aw karihal mushrikoon

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'inna katheera mminal ahbaari war-ruhbaani layakul oona 'amwaal an-naasi bil baatil i wayasuddoona 'an sabeelil laahi wal lazeena yaknizoonaz-zahaba wal fiddata wal aa yunfiqoonahaa fee sabeelil laahi fabashshirhum bi'azaabin 'al eem
Yawma yuhmaa 'al ayhaa fee naari jahannama fatukwaa bihaa jibaahuhum wajunoobuhum wazuhooruhum haazaa maa kanaztum lianfusikum fazooqu maa kuntum taknizoon

'inna 'iddatash-shuhoori 'indal laahithnaa 'ashara shahra fee kitaabil laahi yawma khal aqas-samaawaati wal arda minhaa 'arba'atun hurum zaal ikad-deenul qayyimu fal aa tazlimu feehinna 'anfusakum waqaatil ul mushrikeena kaaffat kamaa yuqaatil oonakum kaaffat wa'lamooaa 'annal laaha ma'al muttaqeen

'innamaan-naseeaa'u zeeaadat fee al kufri yudal lu bihil lazeena kafaru yuhil loonahu 'aama wayuharrimoonahu 'aama lleeooaatiu 'iddata maa harramal laahu fayuhil lu maa harramal laahu zuyyina lahum sooaa'u 'a'maal ihim wal laahu laa yahdee al qawmal kaafireen

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu maa lakum 'izaa qeela lakumunfiru fee sabeelil laahiththaaqal tum 'il aal ardi 'aradeetum bil hayawaatid-dunyaa minal aakhirati famaa mataa'ul hayawaatid-dunyaa fee al aakhirati 'il laa qal eel
'il laa tanfiru yu'azzibkum 'azaabana 'al eema wayastabdil qawmana ghayrakum wal aa tadurroohu shaya wal laahu 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer

'il laa tansuroohu faqad nasarahul laahu 'iz 'akhrajahul lazeena kafaru thaaneeathnayni 'iz humaa fee al ghaari 'iz yaqoolu lisaahibihi laa tahzan 'innal laaha ma'anaa faanzal al laahu sakeenatahu 'al ayhi wayyadahu bijunood llam tarawhaa waja'al a kal imatal lazeena kafarus-suflaa wakal imatul laahi heeal'ul yaa wal laahu 'azeezun hakeem
Anfiru khifaafa wathiqaal a wajaahidu biamwaal ikum waanfusikum fee sabeelil laahi zaal ikum khayr llakum 'in kuntum ta'lamoon

Law kaana 'arada qareeba wasafara qaasida llattaba'ooka wal aakim ba'udat 'al ayhimush-shuqqatu wasayahlifoona bil laahi lawistata'naa lakharajnaa ma'akum yuhlikoona 'anfusahum wal laahu ya'lamu 'innahum lakaaziboon
'afaal laahu 'anka lima 'azinta lahum hattaa yatabayyana lakal lazeena sadaqu wata'lamal kaazibeen
Laa yastazinukal lazeena yu'minoona bil laahi wal yawmil aakhiri 'any yujaahidu biamwaal ihim waanfusihim wal laahu 'al eemu bil muttaqeen
'innamaa yastazinukal lazeena laa yu'minoona bil laahi wal yawmil aakhiri wartaabat qul oobuhum fahum fee raybihim yataraddadoon
Wal aw 'araadul khurooja laa'addu lahu 'uddat wal aakin karihal laahunbi'aathahum fathabbatahum waqeelaq'udu ma'al qaa'ideen
Law kharaju feekum mmaa zaadookum 'il laa khabaal a wal aawda'u khil aal akum yabghoonakumul fitnata wafeekum sammaa'oona lahum wal laahu 'al eemu biz-zaal imeen
Laqadibtaghawual fitnata min qablu waqal labu lakal umoora hattaa jaa'al haqqu wazahara 'amrul laahi wahum kaarihoon
Waminhum mmany yaqoolu'zal llee wal aa taftinneeaa 'al aa fee al fitnati saqatu wainna jahannama lamuheetatu bil kaafireen
'in tusibka hasanat tasu'hum wain tusibka museebat yaqoolu qad 'akhaznaa 'amranaa min qablu wayatawal la wwahum farihoon
Qul-lany yuseebanaa 'il laa maa katabal laahu lanaa hooa mawlaanaa wa'al aal laahi fal yatawakkal il mu'minoon
Qul hal tarabbasoona binaa 'il laa 'ihdaal husnayayni wanahnu natarabbasu bikum 'any yuseebakumul laahu bi'azaab mmin 'indihiaa 'aw biaydeenaa fatarabbasooaa 'innaa ma'akum mmutarabbisoon
Qul 'anfiqu taw'ana 'aw karha llany yutaqabbal a minkum 'innakum kuntum qawma faasiqeen
Wamaa mana'ahum 'an tuqbal a minhum nafaqaatuhum 'il laa 'annahum kafaru bil laahi wabirasoolihi wal aa yatoonas-sal aata 'il laa wahum kusaal aa wal aa yunfiqoona 'il laa wahum kaarihoon
Fal aa tu'jibka 'amwaal uhum wal aa 'awlaaduhum 'innamaa yureedul laahu leeu'azzibahum bihaa fee al hayawaatid-dunyaa watazhaqa 'anfusuhum wahum kaafiroon
Wayahlifoona bil laahi 'innahum laminkum wamaa hum mminkum wal aakinnahum qawm yafraqoon
Law yajidoona mal jaana 'aw maghaaraatin 'aw muddakhal a llawal lawa 'il ayhi wahum yajmahoon
Waminhum mmany yal mizuka fee as-sadaqaati fain 'u'tu minhaa radu wail llam yu'tawa minhaa 'izaa hum yaskhatoon
Wal aw 'annahum radu maa 'aataahumul laahu warasooluhu waqaal u hasbunaal laahu sayu'teenaal laahu min fadlihi warasooluhuaa 'innaa 'il aal laahi raaghiboon

'innamaas-sadaqaatu lil fuqaraa'i wal masaakeeni wal'aamil eena 'al ayhaa wal mu'al lafati qul oobuhum wafee ar-riqaabi wal ghaarimeena wafee sabeelil laahi wabnis-sabeeli fareedat mminal laahi wal laahu 'al eemun hakeem

Waminhumul lazeena yu'zoonan-nabiyya wayaqooloona hooa 'uzun qul 'uzunu khayr llakum yu'minu bil laahi wayu'minu lil mu'mineena warahmat llil lazeena 'aamanu minkum wal lazeena yu'zoona rasoolal laahi lahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Yahlifoona bil laahi lakum leeurdookum wal laahu warasooluhuaa 'ahaqqu 'any yurdoohu 'in kaanu mu'mineen
'al am ya'lamooaa 'annahu many yuhaadidil laaha warasoolahu faanna lahu naara jahannama khaal ida feehaa zaal ikal khizyul'azeem
Yahzarul munaafiqoona 'an tunazzal a 'al ayhim soorat tunabbi'uhum bimaa fee qul oobihim qul istahzi'ooaa 'innal laaha mukhrij mmaa tahzaroon
Wal a'in saal tahum layaqoolunna 'innamaa kunnaa nakhoodu wanal'abu qul 'abil laahi wa'ayaatihi warasoolihi kuntum tastahzi'oon
Laa ta'taziru qad kafartum ba'da 'eemaanikum 'in nna'fu 'an taa'ifat mminkum nu'azzib taa'ifata biannahum kaanu mujrimeen
Al munaafiqoona wal munaafiqaatu ba'duhum mmim ba'd yamuroona bil munkari wayanhawna 'anil ma'roofi wayaqbidoona 'aydeeahum nasul laaha fanaseeahum 'innal munaafiqeena humul faasiqoon
Wa'adal laahul munaafiqeena wal munaafiqaati wal kuffaara naara jahannama khaal ideena feehaa heea hasbuhum wal a'anahumul laahu wal ahum 'azaab mmuqeem

Kal lazeena min qablikum kaanooaa 'ashadda minkum qoowat waakthara 'amwaal a waawlaada fastamta'u bikhal aaqihim fastamta'tum bikhal aaqikum kamaastamta'al lazeena min qablikum bikhal aaqihim wakhudtum kal lazee khaadooaa 'ul aa'ika habitat 'a'maal uhum fee ad-dunyaa wal aakhirati waul aa'ika humul khaasiroon

'al am yatihim nabaul lazeena min qablihim qawmi nooh wa'aad wathamooda waqawmi 'ibraaheema waashaabi madyana wal mu'tafikaati 'atathum rusul uhum bil bayyinaati famaa kaanal laahu leeazlimahum wal aakin kaanooaa 'anfusahum yazlimoon

Wal mu'minoona wal mu'minaatu ba'duhum 'awleeaa'u ba'd yamuroona bil ma'roofi wayanhawna 'anil munkari wayuqeemoonas-sal aata wayu'toonaz-zakaata wayutee'oonal laaha warasoolahuaa 'ul aa'ika sayarhamuhumul laahu 'innal laaha 'azeezun hakeem
Wa'adal laahul mu'mineena wal mu'minaati jannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa wamasaakina tayyibat fee jannaati 'adn waridwaam mminal laahi 'akbaru zaal ika hooal fawzul'azeem
Yayyuhaan-nabeeyu jaahidil kuffaara wal munaafiqeena waghluz 'al ayhim wamawaahum jahannamu wabi'sal maseer

Yahlifoona bil laahi maa qaal u wal aqad qaal u kal imatal kufri wakafaru ba'da 'islaamihim wahammu bimaa lam yanaal u wamaa naqamooaa 'il laa 'an 'aghnaahumul laahu warasooluhu min fadlihi fainy yatoobu yaku khayra llaahum wainy yatawal lawa yu'azzibhumul laahu 'azaabana 'al eema fee ad-dunyaa wal aakhirati wamaa lahum fee al ardi minw wal eey wal aa naseer
Waminhum mman 'aahadal laaha la'in 'aataanaa min fadlihi lanassaddaqanna wal anakoonanna minas-saal iheen
Fal ammaa 'aataahum mmin fadlihi bakhil u bihi watawal la wwahum mmu'ridoon
Faa'qabahum nifaaqa fee qul oobihim 'il aa yawmi yal qawnahu bimaa 'akhlaful laaha maa wa'adoohu wabimaa kaanu yakziboon
'al am ya'lamooaa 'annal laaha ya'lamu sirrahum wanajwaahum waannal laaha 'al laamul ghuyoob
Al lazeena yal mizoonal muttawwi'eena minal mu'mineena fee as-sadaqaati wal lazeena laa yajidoona 'il laa juhdahum fayaskharoona minhum sakhiral laahu minhum wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Astaghfir lahum 'aw laa tastaghfir lahum 'in tastaghfir lahum sab'eena marrat fal any yaghfiral laahu lahum zaal ika biannahum kafaru bil laahi warasoolihi wal laahu laa yahdee al qawmal faasiqeen

Farihal mukhal lafoona bimaq'adihim khil aafa rasoolil laahi wakarihooaa 'any yujaahidu biamwaal ihim waanfusihim fee sabeelil laahi waqaal u laa tanfiru fee al harri qul naaru jahannama 'ashaddu harra llaw kaanu yafqahoon
Fal yadhaku qal eela wal yabku katheera jazaa'a bimaa kaanu yaksiboon

Fair rraja'akal laahu 'il aa taa'ifat mminhum fastazanooka lil khurooji faqul-lan takhruju ma'eea 'abada wal an tuqaatil u ma'eea 'adoowana 'innakum radeetum bil qu'oodi 'awwal a marrat faq'udu ma'al khaal ifeen
Wal aa tusal li 'al aa 'ahad mminhum mmaata 'abada wal aa taqum 'al aa qabrihiaa 'innahum kafaru bil laahi warasoolihi wamaatu wahum faasiqoon
Wal aa tu'jibka 'amwaal uhum waawlaaduhum 'innamaa yureedul laahu 'any yu'azzibahum bihaa fee ad-dunyaa watazhaqa 'anfusuhum wahum kaafiroon
Waizaa 'unzil at sooratun 'an 'aaminu bil laahi wajaahidu ma'a rasoolihistazanaka 'oolut-tawli minhum waqaal u zarnaa nakum mma'al qaa'ideen
Radu biany yakoonu ma'al khawaal ifi watubi'a 'al aa qul oobihim fahum laa yafqahoon
Laakinir-rasoolu wal lazeena 'aamanu ma'ahu jaahadu biamwaal ihim waanfusihim waul aa'ika lahumul khayraatu waul aa'ika humul muflihoon
'a'addal laahu lahum jannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa zaal ikal fawzul'azeem
Wajaa'al mu'azziroona minal a'raabi leeu'zana lahum waqa'adal lazeena kazabul laaha warasoolahu sayuseebul lazeena kafaru minhum 'azaabun 'al eem

Llaysa 'al aad-du'afaa'i wal aa 'al aal mardaa wal aa 'al aal lazeena laa yajidoona maa yunfiqoona harajun 'izaa nasahu lil laahi warasoolihi maa 'al aal muhsineena min sabeel wal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Wal aa 'al aal lazeena 'izaa maa 'atawka litahmil ahum qul ta laa 'ajidu maa 'ahmil ukum 'al ayhi tawal la wwaa'yunuhum tafeedu minad-dam'i hazanana 'al laa yajidu maa yunfiqoon
'innamaas-sabeelu 'al aal lazeena yastazinoonaka wahum 'aghneeaa'u radu biany yakoonu ma'al khawaal ifi wataba'al laahu 'al aa qul oobihim fahum laa ya'lamoon

Ya'taziroona 'il aykum 'izaa raja'tum 'il ayhim qul-laa ta'taziru lan nnu'mina lakum qad nabbaanaal laahu min 'akhbaarikum wasayaraal laahu 'amal akum warasooluhu thumma turaddoona 'il aa 'aal imil ghaybi wash-shahaadati fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Sayahlifoona bil laahi lakum 'izaanqal abtum 'il ayhim litu'ridu 'anhum faa'ridu 'anhum 'innahum rijs wamawaahum jahannamu jazaa'a bimaa kaanu yaksiboon
Yahlifoona lakum litardawa 'anhum fain tardawa 'anhum fainnal laaha laa yardaa 'anil qawmil faasiqeen
Al a'raabu 'ashaddu kufra wanifaaqa waajdaru 'al laa ya'lamu hudooda maa 'anzal al laahu 'al aa rasoolihi wal laahu 'al eemun hakeem
Waminal a'raabi many yattakhizu maa yunfiqu maghrama wayatarabbasu bikumud-dawaa'ira 'al ayhim daa'iratus-saw'i wal laahu samee'un 'al eem

Waminal a'raabi many yu'minu bil laahi wal yawmil aakhiri wayattakhizu maa yunfiqu qurubaatin 'indal laahi wasal awaatir-rasooli 'al aa 'innahaa qurbat llaahum sayudkhil uhumul laahu fee rahmatihiaa 'innal laaha ghafoor rraheem

Was-saabiqoonal awwal oona minal muhaajireena wal ansaari wal lazeenattaba'oohum biihsaar rradeeal laahu 'anhum waradu 'anhu waa'adda lahum jannaat tajree tahtahaal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa 'abada zaal ikal fawzul'azeem
Wamimman hawlakum mminal a'raabi munaafiqoona wamin 'ahlil madeenati maradu 'al aan-nifaaqi laa ta'lamuhum nahnu na'lamuhum sanu'azzibuhum mmarratayni thumma yuraddoona 'il aa 'azaabin 'azeem
Wa'aakharoona'tarafu bizunoobihim khal atu 'amal a saal iha wa'aakhara sayyi'ana 'asaal laahu 'any yatooba 'al ayhim 'innal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Khuz min 'amwaal ihim sadaqat tutahhiruhum watuzakkeehim bihaa wasal li 'al ayhim 'inna sal awaataka sakal llaahum wal laahu samee'un 'al eem
'al am ya'lamooaa 'annal laaha hooa yaqbal ut-tawbata 'an 'ibaadihi wayakhuzus-sadaqaati waannal laaha hooat-tawwaabur-raheem
Waqul i'mal u fasayaraal laahu 'amal akum warasooluhu wal mu'minoona wasaturaddoona 'il aa 'aal imil ghaybi wash-shahaadati fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Wa'aakharoona murjawna liamril laahi 'immaa yu'azzibuhum waimmaa yatoobu 'al ayhim wal laahu 'al eemun hakeem

Wal lazeenattakhazu masjida diraara wakufra watafreeqaa baynal mu'mineena wairsaada lliman haarabal laaha warasoolahu min qablu wal ayahlifunna 'in 'aradnaa 'il laal husnaa wal laahu yashhadu 'innahum lakaaziboon
Laa taqum feehi 'abada llamasjidun 'ussisa 'al aat-taqwaa min 'awwal i yawmin 'ahaqqu 'an taqooma feehi feehi rijaal yuhibboona 'any yatatahharu wal laahu yuhibbul muttahhireen

'afaman 'assasa bunyaanahu 'al aa taqwaa minal laahi waridwaanin khayrun 'am mman 'assasa bunyaanahu 'al aa shafaa jurufin haar fanhaara bihi fee naari jahannama wal laahu laa yahdee al qawmaz-zaal imeen
Laa yazaal u bunyaanuhumul lazee banawa reebat fee qul oobihim 'il laa 'an taqatta'a qul oobuhum wal laahu 'al eemun hakeem

'innal laahashtaraa minal mu'mineena 'anfusahum waamwaal ahum bianna lahumul jannata yuqaatil oona fee sabeelil laahi fayaqtul oona wayuqtal oona wa'dana 'al ayhi haqqa fee at-tawraati wal injeeli wal qur'aani waman 'awfaa bi'ahdihi minal laahi fastabshiru bibay'ikumul lazee baya'tum bihi wazaal ika hooal fawzul'azeem
At-taa'iboonal'aabidoonal haamidoonas-saa'ihoonar-raaki'oonas-saajidoonal aamiroona bil ma'roofi wan-naahoona 'anil munkari wal haafizoona lihudoodil laahi wabashshiril mu'mineen
Maa kaana lin-nabeeyi wal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'any yastaghfiru lil mushrikeena wal aw kaanooaa 'oolee qurbaa mim ba'di maa tabayyana lahum 'annahum 'ashaabul jaheem
Wamaa kaanastighfaaru 'ibraaheema liabeehi 'il laa 'am mmaw'idat wa'adahaa 'iyyaahu fal ammaa tabayyana lahuaa 'annahu 'adoow llil laahi tabarraa minhu 'inna 'ibraaheema laawwaahun hal eem
Wamaa kaanal laahu leeudil la qawmaa ba'da 'iz hadaahum hattaa yubayyina lahum mmaa yattaqoona 'innal laaha bikul li shay'in 'al eem
'innal laaha lahu mul kus-samaawaati wal ardi yuhyi wayumeetu wamaa lakum mmin doonil laahi minw wal eey wal aa naseer

Llaqad ttaabal laahu 'al aan-nabeeyi wal muhaajireena wal ansaaril lazeenattaba'oohu fee saa'atil'usrati mim ba'di maa kaada yazeeghu qul oobu fareeq mminhum thumma taaba 'al ayhim 'innahu bihim ra'oof rraheem

Wa'al aath-thal aathatil lazeena khul lifu hattaa 'izaa daaqat 'al ayhimul ardu bimaa rahubat wadaaqat 'al ayhim 'anfusuhum wazannooaa 'al llaa mal jaa minal laahi 'il laa 'il ayhi thumma taaba 'al ayhim leeatoobooaa 'innal laaha hooat-tawwaabur-raheem
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanuttaqul laaha wakoonu ma'as-saadiqeen

Maa kaana liahlil madeenati waman hawlahum mminal a'raabi 'any yatakhal lafu 'ar rrasoolil laahi wal aa yarghabu bianfusihim 'an nnafsihi zaal ika biannahum laa yuseebuhum zama wal aa nasab wal aa makhmasat fee sabeelil laahi wal aa yataoona mawti'a yagheezul kuffaara wal aa yanaal oona min 'adoow nnaylana 'il laa kutiba lahum bihi 'amal saal ihun 'innal laaha laa yudee'u 'ajral muhsineen
Wal aa yunfiqoona nafaqat sagheerat wal aa kabeerat wal aa yaqta'oona waadeeana 'il laa kutiba lahum leeajzeeahumul laahu 'ahsana maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Wamaa kaanal mu'minoona leeanfiru kaaffat fal awlaa nafara min kul li firqat mminhum taa'ifat lleeatafaqqahu fee ad-deeni wal eeunziru qawmahum 'izaa raja'ooaa 'il ayhim la'al laahum yahzaroon
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu qaatil ul lazeena yal oonakum mminal kuffaari wal yajidu feekum ghil zat wa'lamooaa 'annal laaha ma'al muttaqeen
Waizaa maa 'unzil at soorat faminhum mmany yaqoolu 'ayyukum zaadathu haazihiaa 'eemaana faammaal lazeena 'aamanu fazaadathum 'eemaana wahum yastabshiroon
Waammaal lazeena fee qul oobihim mmarad fazaadathum rijsana 'il aa rijsihim wamaatu wahum kaafiroon
'awal aa yarawna 'annahum yuftanoona fee kul li 'aam mmarratan 'aw marratayni thumma laa yatooboona wal aa hum yazzakkaroon
Waizaa maa 'unzil at soorat nnazara ba'duhum 'il aa ba'din hal yaraakum mmin 'ahad thummansarafu sarafal laahu qul oobahum biannahum qawm llaa yafqahoon
Laqad jaa'akum rasool mmin 'anfusikum 'azeezun 'al ayhi maa 'anittum hareesun 'al aykum bil mu'mineena ra'oof rraheem
Fain tawal lawa faqul hasbeeal laahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa 'al ayhi tawakkal tu wahooa rabbul'arshil'azeem
Al aar til ka 'ayaatul kitaabil hakeem

'akaana lin-naasi 'ajabana 'an 'awhaynaa 'il aa rajul mminhum 'an 'anzirin-naasa wabashshiril lazeena 'aamanooaa 'anna lahum qadama sidqin 'inda rabbihim qaal al kaafiroona 'inna haazaa lasaahir mmubeen

'inna rabbakumul laahul lazee khal aqas-samaawaati wal arda fee sittati 'ayyaam thummastawaa 'al aal'arshi yudabbirul amra maa min shafee'in 'il laa mim ba'di 'iznihi zaal ikumul laahu rabbukum fa'budoohu 'afal aa tazakkaroon

'il ayhi marji'ukum jamee'a wa'dal laahi haqqana 'innahu yabda'ual khal qa thumma yu'eeduhu leeajzeeal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati bil qisti wal lazeena kafaru lahum sharaab mmin hameem wa'azaabun 'al eemu bimaa kaanu yakfuroon
Hooal lazee ja'al ash-shamsa deeaa' wal qamara noora waqaddarahu manaazil a lita'lamu 'adadas-sineena wal hisaaba maa khal aqal laahu zaal ika 'il laa bil haqqi yufassil ul ayaati liqawm ya'lamoon
'inna fee akhtil aafil layli wan-nahaari wamaa khal aqal laahu fee as-samaawaati wal ardi layaat lliqawm yattaqoon
'innal lazeena laa yarjoona liqaa'anaa waradu bil hayawaatid-dunyaa watmaannu bihaa wal lazeena hum 'an 'ayaatinaa ghaafil oon
'ul aa'ika mawaahumun-naaru bimaa kaanu yaksiboon
'innal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati yahdeehim rabbuhum bieemaanihim tajree min tahtihimul anhaaru fee jannaatin-na'eem
Da'waahum feehaa subhaanakal laahumma watahiyyatuhum feehaa sal aam wa'aakhiru da'waahum 'anil hamdu lil laahi rabbil'aal ameen
Wal aw yu'ajjil ul laahu lin-naasish-sharrasti'jaal ahum bil khayri laqudeea 'il ayhim 'ajal uhum fanazarul lazeena laa yarjoona liqaa'anaa fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon

Waizaa massal insaanad-durru da'aanaa lijanbihiaa 'aw qaa'idana 'aw qaa'ima fal ammaa kashafnaa 'anhu durrahu marra kaal llam yad'unaa 'il aa durr mmassahu kazaal ika zuyyina lil musrifeena maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Wal aqad 'ahlaknaal quroona min qablikum lammaa zal amu wajaa'athum rusul uhum bil bayyinaati wamaa kaanu leeu'minu kazaal ika najzee al qawmal mujrimeen
Thumma ja'al naakum khal aa'ifa fee al ardi mim ba'dihim linanzura kayfa ta'mal oon

Waizaa tutlaa 'al ayhim 'ayaatunaa bayyinaat qaal al lazeena laa yarjoona liqaa'anaa'ti biqur'aanin ghayri haazaa 'aw baddil hu qul maa yakoonu leeaa 'an 'ubaddil ahu min til qayi nafseeaa 'in 'attabi'u 'il laa maa yoohaa 'il ayya 'inneeaa 'akhaafu 'in 'asaytu rabbee 'azaaba yawmin 'azeem
Qul-law shaa'al laahu maa tal awtuhu 'al aykum wal aa 'adraakum bihi faqad labithtu feekum 'umura mmin qablihiaa 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Faman 'azlamu mimmaniftaraa 'al aal laahi kazibana 'aw kazzaba biayaatihiaa 'innahu laa yuflihul mujrimoon

Waya'budoona min doonil laahi maa laa yadurruhum wal aa yanfa'uhum wayaqooloona haa'ul aa'i shufa'aa'unaa 'indal laahi qul 'atunabbioonal laaha bimaa laa ya'lamu fee as-samaawaati wal aa fee al ardi subhaanahu wata'aal aa 'ammaa yushrikoon
Wamaa kaanan-naasu 'il laa 'ummat waahidat fakhtal afu wal awlaa kal imat sabaqat mir rrabbika laqudeea baynahum feemaa feehi yakhtal ifoon
Wayaqooloona lawlaa 'unzil a 'al ayhi 'ayat mmir rrabbihi faqul 'innamaal ghaybu lil laahi fantazirooaa 'innee ma'akum mminal muntazireen
Waizaa 'azaqnaan-naasa rahmat mmim ba'di darraa'a massathum 'izaa lahum mmakr feeaa 'ayaatinaa qul il laahu 'asra'u makrana 'inna rusul anaa yaktuboona maa tamkuroon

Hooal lazee yusayyirukum fee al barri wal bahri hattaa 'izaa kuntum fee al ful ki wajarayna bihim bireeh tayyibat wafarihu bihaa jaa'athaa reehun 'aasif wajaa'ahumul mawju min kul li makaanw wazannooaa 'annahum 'uheeta bihim da'awual laaha mukhliseena lahud-deena la'in 'anjaytanaa min haazihi lanakoonanna minash-shaakireen

Fal ammaa 'anjaahum 'izaa hum yabghoona fee al ardi bighayril haqqi yayyuhaan-naasu 'innamaa baghyukum 'al aa 'anfusikum mmataa'al hayawaatid-dunyaa thumma 'il aynaa marji'ukum fanunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon

'innamaa mathal ul hayawaatid-dunyaa kamaa'in 'anzal naahu minas-samaa'i fakhtal ata bihi nabaatul ardi mimmaa yakul un-naasu wal an'aamu hattaa 'izaa 'akhazatil ardu zukhrufahaa wazzayyanat wazanna 'ahluhaa 'annahum qaadiroona 'al ayhaa 'ataahaa 'amrunaa laylana 'aw nahaara faja'al naahaa haseeda kaal llam taghna bil amsi kazaal ika nufassil ul ayaati liqawm yatafakkaroon
Wal laahu yad'ooaa 'il aa daaris-sal aami wayahdee many yashaa'u 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem
Llil lazeena 'ahsanul husnaa wazeeaadat wal aa yarhaqu wujoohahum qatar wal aa zil latun 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabul jannati hum feehaa khaal idoon

Wal lazeena kasabus-sayyiaati jazaa'u sayyi'ati bimithlihaa watarhaquhum zil lat mmaa lahum mminal laahi min 'aasim kaannamaa 'ughsheeat wujoohuhum qita'a mminal layli muzlimana 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabun-naari hum feehaa khaal idoon
Wayawma nahshuruhum jamee'a thumma naqoolu lil lazeena 'ashraku makaanakum 'antum washurakaa'ukum fazayyal naa baynahum waqaal a shurakaa'uhum mmaa kuntum 'iyyaanaa ta'budoon
Fakafaa bil laahi shaheedaa baynanaa wabaynakum 'in kunnaa 'an 'ibaadatikum laghaafil een
Hunaal ika tablu kul lu nafs mmaa 'aslafat waruddooaa 'il aal laahi mawlaahumul haqqi wadal la 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaftaroon

Qul many yarzuqukum mminas-samaa'i wal ardi 'ammany yamlikus-sam'a wal absaara wamany yukhrijul hayya minal mayyiti wayukhrijul mayyita minal hayyi wamany yudabbirul amra fasayaqooloonal laahu faqul 'afal aa tattaqoon
Fazaal ikumul laahu rabbukumul haqqu famaazaa ba'dal haqqi 'il laad-dal aal u faannaa tusrafoon
Kazaal ika haqqat kal imatu rabbika 'al aal lazeena fasaqooaa 'annahum laa yu'minoon
Qul hal min shurakaa'ikum mmany yabda'ual khal qa thumma yu'eeduhu qul il laahu yabda'ual khal qa thumma yu'eeduhu faannaa tu'fakoon

Qul hal min shurakaa'ikum mmany yahdeeaa 'il aal haqqi qul il laahu yahdee lil haqqi 'afamany yahdeeaa 'il aal haqqi 'ahaqqu 'any yuttaba'a 'ammal llaa yahiddeeaa 'il laa 'any yuhdaa famaa lakum kayfa tahkumoon
Wamaa yattabi'u 'aktharuhum 'il laa zannana 'innaz-zanna laa yughnee minal haqqi shayana 'innal laaha 'al eemu bimaa yaf'al oon
Wamaa kaana haazaal qur'aanu 'any yuftaraa min doonil laahi wal aakin tasdeeqal lazee bayna yadayhi watafseelal kitaabi laa rayba feehi mir rrabbil'aal ameen
'am yaqooloonaftaraahu qul fatu bisoorat mmithlihi wad'u manistata'tum mmin doonil laahi 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Bal kazzabu bimaa lam yuheetu bi'il mihi wal ammaa yatihim taweeluhu kazaal ika kazzabal lazeena min qablihim fanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatuz-zaal imeen
Waminhum mmany yu'minu bihi waminhum mmal llaa yu'minu bihi warabbuka 'a'lamu bil mufsideen
Wain kazzabooka faqul-lee 'amal ee wal akum 'amal ukum 'antum bareeaaoona mimmaa 'a'mal u waanaa bareeaa' mmimmaa ta'mal oon
Waminhum mmany yastami'oona 'il ayka 'afaanta tusmi'us-summa wal aw kaanu laa ya'qil oon
Waminhum mmany yanzuru 'il ayka 'afaanta tahdee al'umya wal aw kaanu laa yubsiroon
'innal laaha laa yazlimun-naasa shaya wal aakinnan-naasa 'anfusahum yazlimoon
Wayawma yahshuruhum kaal llam yal bathooaa 'il laa saa'at mminan-nahaari yata'aarafoona baynahum qad khasiral lazeena kazzabu bil iqaa'il laahi wamaa kaanu muhtadeen
Waimmaa nureeannaka ba'dal lazee na'iduhum 'aw natawaffayannaka fail aynaa marji'uhum thummal laahu shaheedun 'al aa maa yaf'al oon
Wal ikul li 'ummat rrasool faizaa jaa'a rasooluhum qudeea baynahum bil qisti wahum laa yuzlamoon
Wayaqooloona mataa haazaal wa'du 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul-laa 'amliku linafsee darra wal aa naf'ana 'il laa maa shaa'al laahu likul li 'ummatin 'ajal un 'izaa jaa'a 'ajal uhum fal aa yastakhiroona saa'at wal aa yastaqdimoon
Qul 'ara'aytum 'in 'ataakum 'azaabuhu bayaatana 'aw nahaara mmaazaa yasta'jil u minhul mujrimoon
'athumma 'izaa maa waqa'a 'aamantum bihiaa 'aal aana waqad kuntum bihi tasta'jil oon
Thumma qeela lil lazeena zal amu zooqu 'azaabal khul di hal tujzawna 'il laa bimaa kuntum taksiboon
Wayastanbioonaka 'ahaqqun hooa qul 'ee warabbeeaa 'innahu lahaqq wamaa 'antum bimu'jizeen
Wal aw 'anna likul li nafs zal amat maa fee al ardi laftadat bihi waasarrun-nadaamata lammaa raawual'azaaba waqudeea baynahum bil qisti wahum laa yuzlamoon
'al aa 'inna lil laahi maa fee as-samaawaati wal ardi 'al aa 'inna wa'dal laahi haqq wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Hooa yuhyi wayumeetu wail ayhi turja'oon
Yayyuhaan-naasu qad jaa'atkum mmaw'izat mmir rrabbikum washifaa' llimaa fee as-sudoori wahuda warahmat llil mu'mineen
Qul bifadlil laahi wabirahmatihi fabizaal ika fal yafrahu hooa khayr mmimmaa yajma'oon
Qul 'ara'aytum mmaa 'anzal al laahu lakum mmir rrizq faja'al tum mminhu haraama wahal aal a qul 'aal laahu 'azina lakum 'am 'al aal laahi taftaroon
Wamaa zannul lazeena yaftaroona 'al aal laahil kaziba yawmal qeeaamati 'innal laaha lazoo fadlin 'al aan-naasi wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa yashkuroon

Wamaa takoonu fee shanw wamaa tatlu minhu min qur'aanw wal aa ta'mal oona min 'amal in 'il laa kunnaa 'al aykum shuhoodana 'iz tufeedoona feehi wamaa ya'zubu 'ar rrabbika mim mmithqaal i zarrat fee al ardi wal aa fee as-samaa'i wal aa 'asghara min zaal ika wal aa 'akbara 'il laa fee kitaab mmubeen
'al aa 'inna 'awleeaa'al laahi laa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
Al lazeena 'aamanu wakaanu yattaqoon
Lahumul bushraa fee al hayawaatid-dunyaa wafee al aakhirati laa tabdeela likal imaatil laahi zaal ika hooal fawzul'azeem
Wal aa yahzunka qawluhum 'innal'izzata lil laahi jamee'ana hooas-samee'ul'al eem
'al aa 'inna lil laahi man fee as-samaawaati waman fee al ardi wamaa yattabi'ul lazeena yad'oona min doonil laahi shurakaa'a 'iny yattabi'oona 'il laaz-zanna wain hum 'il laa yakhrusoon
Hooal lazee ja'al a lakumul layla litaskunu feehi wan-nahaara mubsirana 'inna fee zaal ika layaat lliqawm yasma'oon
Qaal uttakhazal laahu wal ada subhaanahu hooal ghaneeyu lahu maa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardi 'in 'indakum mmin sul taani bihaazaa 'ataqooloona 'al aal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Qul 'innal lazeena yaftaroona 'al aal laahil kaziba laa yuflihoon
Mataa' fee ad-dunyaa thumma 'il aynaa marji'uhum thumma nuzeequhumul'azaabash-shadeeda bimaa kaanu yakfuroon

Watlu 'al ayhim nabaa noohin 'iz qaal a liqawmihi yaaqawmi 'in kaana kabura 'al aykum mmaqaamee watazkeeree biayaatil laahi fa'al aal laahi tawakkal tu faajmi'ooaa 'amrakum washurakaa'akum thumma laa yakun 'amrukum 'al aykum ghummat thummaqdooaa 'il ayya wal aa tunziroon
Fain tawal laytum famaa saal tukum mmin 'ajrin 'in 'ajreea 'il laa 'al aal laahi waumirtu 'an 'akoona minal muslimeen
Fakazzaboohu fanajjaynaahu wamam mma'ahu fee al ful ki waja'al naahum khal aa'ifa waaghraqnaal lazeena kazzabu biayaatinaa fanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul munzareen
Thumma ba'athnaa mim ba'dihi rusul ana 'il aa qawmihim fajaa'oohum bil bayyinaati famaa kaanu leeu'minu bimaa kazzabu bihi min qablu kazaal ika natba'u 'al aa qul oobil mu'tadeen
Thumma ba'athnaa mim ba'dihim mmoosaa wahaaroona 'il aa fir'awna wamal aeehi biayaatinaa fastakbaru wakaanu qawma mmujrimeen
Fal ammaa jaa'ahumul haqqu min 'indinaa qaal ooaa 'inna haazaa lasihr mmubeen
Qaal a moosaa 'ataqooloona lil haqqi lammaa jaa'akum 'asihrun haazaa wal aa yuflihus-saahiroon
Qaal ooaa 'aji'tanaa lital fitanaa 'ammaa wajadnaa 'al ayhi 'aabaa'anaa watakoona lakumaal kibreeaa'u fee al ardi wamaa nahnu lakumaa bimu'mineen
Waqaal a fir'awnu'toonee bikul li saahirin 'al eem
Fal ammaa jaa'as-saharatu qaal a lahum mmoosaa 'al qu maa 'antum mmul qoon
Fal ammaa 'al qawa qaal a moosaa maa ji'tum bihis-sihru 'innal laaha sayubtil uhuaa 'innal laaha laa yuslihu 'amal al mufsideen
Wayuhiqqul laahul haqqa bikal imaatihi wal aw karihal mujrimoon
Famaa 'aamana limoosaa 'il laa zurriyyat mmin qawmihi 'al aa khawf mmin fir'awna wamal aeehim 'any yaftinahum wainna fir'awna la'aal fee al ardi wainnahu laminal musrifeen
Waqaal a moosaa yaaqawmi 'in kuntum 'aamantum bil laahi fa'al ayhi tawakkal ooaa 'in kuntum mmuslimeen
Faqaal u 'al aal laahi tawakkal naa rabbanaa laa taj'al naa fitnat llil qawmiz-zaal imeen
Wanajjinaa birahmatika minal qawmil kaafireen
Waawhaynaa 'il aa moosaa waakheehi 'an tabawwa'aa liqawmikumaa bimisra buyoota waj'al u buyootakum qiblat waaqeemus-sal aata wabashshiril mu'mineen

Waqaal a moosaa rabbanaa 'innaka 'aatayta fir'awna wamal aahu zeenat waamwaal a fee al hayawaatid-dunyaa rabbanaa leeudil lu 'an sabeelika rabbanaatmis 'al aa 'amwaal ihim washdud 'al aa qul oobihim fal aa yu'minu hattaa yarawual'azaabal al eem
Qaal a qad 'ujeebat dda'watukumaa fastaqeemaa wal aa tattabi'aanni sabeelal lazeena laa ya'lamoon

Wajaawaznaa bibaneeaa 'israa'eelal bahra faatba'ahum fir'awnu wajunooduhu baghya wa'adwana hattaa 'izaa 'adrakahul gharaqu qaal a 'aamantu 'annahu laa 'il aaha 'il laal lazeeaa 'aamanat bihi banooaa 'israa'eela waanaa minal muslimeen
'aal aana waqad 'asayta qablu wakunta minal mufsideen
Fal yawma nunajjeeka bibadanika litakoona liman khal faka 'ayat wainna katheera mminan-naasi 'an 'ayaatinaa laghaafil oon

Wal aqad bawwanaa baneeaa 'israa'eela mubawwaa sidq warazaqnaahum mminat-tayyibaati famaakhtal afu hattaa jaa'ahumul'il mu 'inna rabbaka yaqdee baynahum yawmal qeeaamati feemaa kaanu feehi yakhtal ifoon
Fain kunta fee shakk mmimmaa 'anzal naa 'il ayka fasal il lazeena yaqra'oonal kitaaba min qablika laqad jaa'akal haqqu mir rrabbika fal aa takoonanna minal mumtareen
Wal aa takoonanna minal lazeena kazzabu biayaatil laahi fatakoona minal khaasireen
'innal lazeena haqqat 'al ayhim kal imatu rabbika laa yu'minoon
Wal aw jaa'athum kul lu 'ayatin hattaa yarawual'azaabal al eem
Fal awlaa kaanat qaryatun 'aamanat fanafa'ahaa 'eemaanuhaa 'il laa qawma yoonusa lammaa 'aamanu kashafnaa 'anhum 'azaabal khizyi fee al hayawaatid-dunyaa wamatta'naahum 'il aa heen
Wal aw shaa'a rabbuka laamana man fee al ardi kul luhum jamee'ana 'afaanta tukrihun-naasa hattaa yakoonu mu'mineen
Wamaa kaana linafsin 'an tu'mina 'il laa biiznil laahi wayaj'al ur-rijsa 'al aal lazeena laa ya'qil oon
Qul inzuru maazaa fee as-samaawaati wal ardi wamaa tughnee al ayaatu wan-nuzuru 'an qawm llaa yu'minoon
Fahal yantaziroona 'il laa mithla 'ayyaamil lazeena khal awa min qablihim qul fantazirooaa 'innee ma'akum mminal muntazireen
Thumma nunajjee rusul anaa wal lazeena 'aamanu kazaal ika haqqana 'al aynaa nunjil mu'mineen
Qul yayyuhaan-naasu 'in kuntum fee shakk mmin deenee fal aa 'a'budul lazeena ta'budoona min doonil laahi wal aakin 'a'budul laahal lazee yatawaffaakum waumirtu 'an 'akoona minal mu'mineen
Waan 'aqim wajhaka lid-deeni haneefa wal aa takoonanna minal mushrikeen
Wal aa tad'u min doonil laahi maa laa yanfa'uka wal aa yadurruka fain fa'al ta fainnaka 'iza mminaz-zaal imeen
Wainy yamsaskal laahu bidurr fal aa kaashifa lahuaa 'il laa hooa wainy yuridka bikhayr fal aa raadda lifadlihi yuseebu bihi many yashaa'u min 'ibaadihi wahooal ghafoorur-raheem
Qul yayyuhaan-naasu qad jaa'akumul haqqu mir rrabbikum famanihtadaa fainnamaa yahtadee linafsihi waman dal la fainnamaa yadil lu 'al ayhaa wamaa 'anaa 'al aykum biwakeel
Wattabi' maa yoohaa 'il ayka wasbir hattaa yahkumal laahu wahooa khayrul haakimeen
Al aar kitaabun 'uhkimat 'ayaatuhu thumma fussil at mil lladun hakeemin khabeer
'al laa ta'budooaa 'il laal laaha 'innanee lakum mminhu nazeer wabasheer
Waanistaghfiru rabbakum thumma toobooaa 'il ayhi yumatti'kum mmataa'ana hasanana 'il aa 'ajal mmusamma wayu'ti kul la zee fadl fadlahu wain tawal lawa fainneeaa 'akhaafu 'al aykum 'azaaba yawm kabeer
'il aal laahi marji'ukum wahooa 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
'al aa 'innahum yathnoona sudoorahum leeastakhfu minhu 'al aa heena yastaghshoona theeaabahum ya'lamu maa yusirroona wamaa yu'linoona 'innahu 'al eemu bizaatis-sudoor
Wamaa min daabbat fee al ardi 'il laa 'al aal laahi rizquhaa waya'lamu mustaqarrahaa wamustawda'ahaa kul l fee kitaab mmubeen

Wahooal lazee khal aqas-samaawaati wal arda fee sittati 'ayyaam wakaana 'arshuhu 'al aal maa'i leeablooakum 'ayyukum 'ahsanu 'amal a wal a'in qul ta 'innakum mmab'oothoona mim ba'dil mawti layaqoolannal lazeena kafarooaa 'in haazaa 'il laa sihr mmubeen
Wal a'in 'akhkharnaa 'anhumul'azaaba 'il aa 'ummat mma'doodat llayaqoolunna maa yahbisuhuaa 'al aa yawma yateehim laysa masroofana 'anhum wahaaqa bihim mmaa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Wal a'in 'azaqnaal insaana minnaa rahmat thumma naza'naahaa minhu 'innahu layaoos kafoor
Wal a'in 'azaqnaahu na'maa'a ba'da darraa'a massathu layaqoolanna zahabas-sayyiaatu 'anneeaa 'innahu lafarih fakhoor
'il laal lazeena sabaru wa'amil us-saal ihaati 'ul aa'ika lahum mmaghfirat waajr kabeer

Fal a'al laka taariku ba'da maa yoohaa 'il ayka wadaa'iqu bihi sadruka 'any yaqoolu lawlaa 'unzil a 'al ayhi kanzun 'aw jaa'a ma'ahu mal akun 'innamaa 'anta nazeer wal laahu 'al aa kul li shay' wakeel
'am yaqooloonaftaraahu qul fatu bi'ashri sooar mmithlihi muftarayaat wad'u manistata'tum mmin doonil laahi 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Fail lam yastajeebu lakum fa'lamooaa 'annamaa 'unzil a bi'il mil laahi waal llaa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa fahal 'antum mmuslimoon
Man kaana yureedul hayawaatad-dunyaa wazeenatahaa nooaffi 'il ayhim 'a'maal ahum feehaa wahum feehaa laa yubkhasoon
'ul aa'ikal lazeena laysa lahum fee al aakhirati 'il laan-naaru wahabita maa sana'u feehaa wabaatil mmaa kaanu ya'mal oon

'afaman kaana 'al aa bayyinat mmir rrabbihi wayatloohu shaahid mminhu wamin qablihi kitaabu moosaa 'imaama warahmatan 'ul aa'ika yu'minoona bihi wamany yakfur bihi minal ahzaabi fan-naaru maw'iduhu fal aa taku fee miryat mminhu 'innahul haqqu mir rrabbika wal aakinna 'aktharan-naasi laa yu'minoon
Waman 'azlamu mimmaniftaraa 'al aal laahi kazibana 'ul aa'ika yu'radoona 'al aa rabbihim wayaqoolul ashhaadu haa'ul aa'il lazeena kazabu 'al aa rabbihim 'al aa la'natul laahi 'al aaz-zaal imeen
Al lazeena yasuddoona 'an sabeelil laahi wayabghoonahaa 'iwaja wahum bil aakhirati hum kaafiroon
'ul aa'ika lam yakoonu mu'jizeena fee al ardi wamaa kaana lahum mmin doonil laahi min 'awleeaa'a yudaa'afu lahumul'azaabu maa kaanu yastatee'oonas-sam'a wamaa kaanu yubsiroon
'ul aa'ikal lazeena khasirooaa 'anfusahum wadal la 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaftaroon
Laa jarama 'annahum fee al aakhirati humul akhsaroon
'innal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati waakhbatooaa 'il aa rabbihim 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabul jannati hum feehaa khaal idoon
Mathal ul fareeqayni kal a'maa wal asammi wal baseeri was-samee'i hal yastaweeaani mathal ana 'afal aa tazakkaroon
Wal aqad 'arsal naa noohana 'il aa qawmihiaa 'innee lakum nazeer mmubeen
'al llaa ta'budooaa 'il laal laaha 'inneeaa 'akhaafu 'al aykum 'azaaba yawmin 'al eem

Faqaal al mal aul lazeena kafaru min qawmihi maa naraaka 'il laa bashara mmithlanaa wamaa naraakattaba'aka 'il laal lazeena hum 'araazil unaa baadeear-rayi wamaa naraa lakum 'al aynaa min fadli bal nazunnukum kaazibeen
Qaal a yaaqawmi 'ara'aytum 'in kuntu 'al aa bayyinat mmir rrabbee wa'aataanee rahmat mmin 'indihi fa'ummeeat 'al aykum 'anul zimukumoohaa waantum lahaa kaarihoon
Wayaaqawmi laa 'asal ukum 'al ayhi maal ana 'in 'ajreea 'il laa 'al aal laahi wamaa 'anaa bitaaridil lazeena 'aamanooaa 'innahum mmul aaqu rabbihim wal aakinneeaa 'araakum qawma tajhal oon
Wayaaqawmi many yansurunee minal laahi 'in taradttuhum 'afal aa tazakkaroon

Wal aa 'aqoolu lakum 'indee khazaa'inul laahi wal aa 'a'lamul ghayba wal aa 'aqoolu 'innee mal ak wal aa 'aqoolu lil lazeena tazdareeaa 'a'yunukum lany yu'teeahumul laahu khayranal laahu 'a'lamu bimaa feeaa 'anfusihim 'inneeaa 'iza llaminaz-zaal imeen
Qaal u yaanoohu qad jaadal tanaa faaktharta jidaal anaa fatinaa bimaa ta'idunaa 'in kunta minas-saadiqeen
Qaal a 'innamaa yateekum bihil laahu 'in shaa'a wamaa 'antum bimu'jizeen
Wal aa yanfa'ukum nusheeaa 'in 'aradttu 'an 'ansaha lakum 'in kaanal laahu yureedu 'any yughweeakum hooa rabbukum wail ayhi turja'oon
'am yaqooloonaftaraahu qul 'iniftaraytuhu fa'al ayya 'ijraamee waanaa bareeaa' mmimmaa tujrimoon
Waooheea 'il aa noohin 'annahu lany yu'mina min qawmika 'il laa man qad 'aamana fal aa tabta'is bimaa kaanu yaf'al oon
Wasna'il ful ka bia'yuninaa wawahyinaa wal aa tukhaatibnee fee al lazeena zal amooaa 'innahum mmughraqoon
Wayasna'ul ful ka wakul lamaa marra 'al ayhi mal a mmin qawmihi sakhiru minhu qaal a 'in taskharu minnaa fainnaa naskharu minkum kamaa taskharoon
Fasawfa ta'lamoona many yateehi 'azaab yukhzeehi wayahil lu 'al ayhi 'azaab mmuqeem
Hattaa 'izaa jaa'a 'amrunaa wafaarat-tannooru qul naahmil feehaa min kul l zawjaynithnayni waahlaka 'il laa man sabaqa 'al ayhil qawlu waman 'aamana wamaa 'aamana ma'ahuaa 'il laa qal eel
Waqaal arkabu feehaa bismil laahi majraahaa wamursaahaa 'inna rabbee laghafoor rraheem
Waheea tajree bihim fee mawj kal jibaal i wanaadaa noohun abnahu wakaana fee ma'zil yaabunayyarkab mma'anaa wal aa takum mma'al kaafireen
Qaal a saaweeaa 'il aa jabal ya'simunee minal maa'i qaal a laa 'aasimal yawma min 'amril laahi 'il laa mar rrahima wahaal a baynahumaal mawju fakaana minal mughraqeen
Waqeela yaardubla'ee maa'aki wayaasamaa'u 'aqli'ee wagheedal maa'u waqudeeal amru wastawat 'al aal joodeeyi waqeela bu'da llil qawmiz-zaal imeen
Wanaadaa nooh rrabbahu faqaal a rabbi 'innabnee min 'ahlee wainna wa'dakal haqqu waanta 'ahkamul haakimeen
Qaal a yaanoohu 'innahu laysa min 'ahlika 'innahu 'amal un ghayru saal ih fal aa tasal ni maa laysa laka bihi 'il mun 'inneeaa 'a'izuka 'an takoona minal jaahil een
Qaal a rabbi 'inneeaa 'a'oozu bika 'an 'asal aka maa laysa lee bihi 'il m wail laa taghfir lee watarhamneeaa 'akum mminal khaasireen
Qeela yaanoohuhbit bisal aam mminnaa wabarakaatin 'al ayka wa'al aa 'umam mmimmam mma'aka waumam sanumatti'uhum thumma yamassuhum mminnaa 'azaabun 'al eem
