Til ka min 'anbaa'il ghaybi nooheehaa 'il ayka maa kunta ta'lamuhaa 'anta wal aa qawmuka min qabli haazaa fasbir 'innal'aaqibata lil muttaqeen
Wail aa 'aadin 'akhaahum hooda qaal a yaaqawmi'budul laaha maa lakum mmin 'il aahin ghayruhuaa 'in 'antum 'il laa muftaroon
Yaaqawmi laa 'asal ukum 'al ayhi 'ajrana 'in 'ajreea 'il laa 'al aal lazee fataraneeaa 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Wayaaqawmistaghfiru rabbakum thumma toobooaa 'il ayhi yursil is-samaa'a 'al aykum mmidraara wayazidkum qoowatan 'il aa qoowatikum wal aa tatawal lawa mujrimeen
Qaal u yaahoodu maa ji'tanaa bibayyinat wamaa nahnu bitaarikeeaa 'aal ihatinaa 'an qawlika wamaa nahnu laka bimu'mineen
'in nnaqoolu 'il laa'taraaka ba'du 'aal ihatinaa bisooaa' qaal a 'inneeaa 'ushhidul laaha washhadooaa 'annee bareeaa' mmimmaa tushrikoon
Min doonihi fakeedoonee jamee'a thumma laa tunziroon
'innee tawakkal tu 'al aal laahi rabbee warabbikum mmaa min daabbatin 'il laa hooa 'aakhizu binaaseeatihaa 'inna rabbee 'al aa siraat mmustaqeem
Fain tawal lawa faqad 'ablaghtukum mmaa 'ursil tu bihiaa 'il aykum wayastakhlifu rabbee qawmana ghayrakum wal aa tadurroonahu shayana 'inna rabbee 'al aa kul li shay'in hafeez
Wal ammaa jaa'a 'amrunaa najjaynaa hooda wal lazeena 'aamanu ma'ahu birahmat mminnaa wanajjaynaahum mmin 'azaabin ghal eez
Watil ka 'aad jahadu biayaati rabbihim wa'asawa rusul ahu wattaba'ooaa 'amra kul li jabbaarin 'aneed
Wautbi'u fee haazihid-dunyaa la'nat wayawmal qeeaamati 'al aa 'inna 'aada kafaru rabbahum 'al aa bu'da lli'aad qawmi hood

Wail aa thamooda 'akhaahum saal iha qaal a yaaqawmi'budul laaha maa lakum mmin 'il aahin ghayruhu hooa 'anshaakum mminal ardi wasta'marakum feehaa fastaghfiroohu thumma toobooaa 'il ayhi 'inna rabbee qareeb mmujeeb
Qaal u yaasaal ihu qad kunta feenaa marjoowa qabla haazaa 'atanhaanaa 'an nna'buda maa ya'budu 'aabaa'unaa wainnanaa lafee shakk mmimmaa tad'oonaa 'il ayhi mureeb
Qaal a yaaqawmi 'ara'aytum 'in kuntu 'al aa bayyinat mmir rrabbee wa'aataanee minhu rahmat famany yansurunee minal laahi 'in 'asaytuhu famaa tazeedoonanee ghayra takhseer
Wayaaqawmi haazihi naaqatul laahi lakum 'ayat fazaroohaa takul feeaa 'ardil laahi wal aa tamassoohaa bisooaa' fayakhuzakum 'azaab qareeb
Fa'aqaroohaa faqaal a tamatta'u fee daarikum thal aathata 'ayyaam zaal ika wa'dun ghayru makzoob
Fal ammaa jaa'a 'amrunaa najjaynaa saal iha wal lazeena 'aamanu ma'ahu birahmat mminnaa wamin khizyi yawmi'izin 'inna rabbaka hooal qaweeyul'azeez
Waakhazal lazeena zal amus-sayhatu faasbahu fee deeaarihim jaathimeen
Kaal llam yaghnawa feehaa 'al aa 'inna thamoodaa kafaru rabbahum 'al aa bu'da llithamood
Wal aqad jaa'at rusul unaa 'ibraaheema bil bushraa qaal u sal aama qaal a sal aam famaa labitha 'an jaa'a bi'ijlin haneez
Fal ammaa ra'aa 'aydeeahum laa tasil u 'il ayhi nakirahum waawjasa minhum kheefat qaal u laa takhaf 'innaa 'ursil naa 'il aa qawmi looh
Wamraatuhu qaa'imat fadahikat fabashsharnaahaa biishaaqa waminw waraa'i 'ishaaqa ya'qoob
Qaal at yaawaylataa 'aal idu waanaa 'ajooz wahaazaa ba'lee shaykhana 'inna haazaa lashay'un 'ajeeb
Qaal ooaa 'ata'jabeena min 'amril laahi rahmatul laahi wabarakaatuhu 'al aykum 'ahlal bayti 'innahu hameed mmajeed
Fal ammaa zahaba 'an 'ibraaheemar-raw'u wajaa'athul bushraa yujaadil unaa fee qawmi looh
'inna 'ibraaheema lahal eemun 'awwaah mmuneeb
Yaaibraaheemu 'a'rid 'an haazaa 'innahu qad jaa'a 'amru rabbika wainnahum 'aateehim 'azaabun ghayru mardood
Wal ammaa jaa'at rusul unaa loota seeaa'a bihim wadaaqa bihim zar'a waqaal a haazaa yawmun 'aseeb

Wajaa'ahu qawmuhu yuhra'oona 'il ayhi wamin qablu kaanu ya'mal oonas-sayyiaati qaal a yaaqawmi haa'ul aa'i banaatee hunna 'atharu lakum fattaqul laaha wal aa tukhzooni fee dayfeeaa 'al aysa minkum rajur-rasheed
Qaal u laqad 'al imta maa lanaa fee banaatika min haqq wainnaka lata'lamu maa nureed
Qaal a law 'anna lee bikum qoowatan 'aw 'aaweeaa 'il aa rukn shadeed

Qaal u yaal ootu 'innaa rusul u rabbika lany yasil ooaa 'il ayka faasri biahlika biqit' mminal layli wal aa yal tafit minkum 'ahadun 'il laamraataka 'innahu museebuhaa maa 'asaabahum 'inna maw'idahumus-subhu 'al aysas-subhu biqareeb
Fal ammaa jaa'a 'amrunaa ja'al naa 'aal eeahaa saafil ahaa waamtarnaa 'al ayhaa hijaarat mmin sijjeel mmandood
Mmusawwamatan 'inda rabbika wamaa heea minaz-zaal imeena biba'eed

Wail aa madyana 'akhaahum shu'ayba qaal a yaaqawmi'budul laaha maa lakum mmin 'il aahin ghayruhu wal aa tanqusul mikyaal a wal meezaana 'inneeaa 'araakum bikhayr wainneeaa 'akhaafu 'al aykum 'azaaba yawm mmuheeh
Wayaaqawmi 'awful mikyaal a wal meezaana bil qisti wal aa tabkhasun-naasa 'ashyaa'ahum wal aa ta'thawa fee al ardi mufsideen
Baqiyyatul laahi khayr llakum 'in kuntum mmu'mineena wamaa 'anaa 'al aykum bihafeez
Qaal u yaashu'aybu 'asal awaatuka tamuruka 'an nnatruka maa ya'budu 'aabaa'unaa 'aw 'an nnaf'al a feeaa 'amwaal inaa maa nashaa'ua 'innaka laantal hal eemur-rasheed

Qaal a yaaqawmi 'ara'aytum 'in kuntu 'al aa bayyinat mmir rrabbee warazaqanee minhu rizqana hasana wamaa 'ureedu 'an 'ukhaal ifakum 'il aa maa 'anhaakum 'anhu 'in 'ureedu 'il laal islaaha maastata'tu wamaa tawfeeqeeaa 'il laa bil laahi 'al ayhi tawakkal tu wail ayhi 'uneeb
Wayaaqawmi laa yajrimannakum shiqaaqeeaa 'any yuseebakum mmithlu maa 'asaaba qawma noohin 'aw qawma hoodin 'aw qawma saal ih wamaa qawmu loot mminkum biba'eed
Wastaghfiru rabbakum thumma toobooaa 'il ayhi 'inna rabbee raheem wadood
Qaal u yaashu'aybu maa nafqahu katheera mmimmaa taqoolu wainnaa lanaraaka feenaa da'eefa wal awlaa rahtuka larajamnaaka wamaa 'anta 'al aynaa bi'azeez
Qaal a yaaqawmi 'arahteeaa 'a'azzu 'al aykum mminal laahi wattakhaztumoohu waraa'akum zihriyyana 'inna rabbee bimaa ta'mal oona muheeh
Wayaaqawmi'mal u 'al aa makaanatikum 'innee 'aamil sawfa ta'lamoona many yateehi 'azaab yukhzeehi waman hooa kaazib wartaqibooaa 'innee ma'akum raqeeb
Wal ammaa jaa'a 'amrunaa najjaynaa shu'ayba wal lazeena 'aamanu ma'ahu birahmat mminnaa waakhazatil lazeena zal amus-sayhatu faasbahu fee deeaarihim jaathimeen
Kaal llam yaghnawa feehaa 'al aa bu'da llimadyana kamaa ba'idat thamood
Wal aqad 'arsal naa moosaa biayaatinaa wasul taam mmubeen
'il aa fir'awna wamal aeehi fattaba'ooaa 'amra fir'awna wamaa 'amru fir'awna birasheed
Yaqdumu qawmahu yawmal qeeaamati faawradahumun-naara wabi'sal wirdul mawrood
Wautbi'u fee haazihi la'nat wayawmal qeeaamati bi'sar-rifdul marfood
Zaal ika min 'anbaa'il quraa naqussuhu 'al ayka minhaa qaa'im wahaseed
Wamaa zal amnaahum wal aakin zal amooaa 'anfusahum famaa 'aghnat 'anhum 'aal ihatuhumul latee yad'oona min doonil laahi min shay' llammaa jaa'a 'amru rabbika wamaa zaadoohum ghayra tatbeeb
Wakazaal ika 'akhzu rabbika 'izaa 'akhazal quraa waheea zaal imatun 'inna 'akhzahuaa 'al eem shadeed
'inna fee zaal ika layat lliman khaafa 'azaabal aakhirati zaal ika yawm mmajmoo' llaahun-naasu wazaal ika yawm mmashhood
Wamaa nu'akhkhiruhuaa 'il laa liajal mma'dood
Yawma yati laa takal lamu nafsun 'il laa biiznihi faminhum shaqeey wasa'eed
Faammaal lazeena shaqu fafee an-naari lahum feehaa zafeer washaheeq
Khaal ideena feehaa maa daamatis-samaawaatu wal ardu 'il laa maa shaa'a rabbuka 'inna rabbaka fa'aal-limaa yureed
Waammaal lazeena su'idu fafee al jannati khaal ideena feehaa maa daamatis-samaawaatu wal ardu 'il laa maa shaa'a rabbuka 'ataa'an ghayra majzooz
Fal aa taku fee miryat mmimmaa ya'budu haa'ul aa'i maa ya'budoona 'il laa kamaa ya'budu 'aabaa'uhum mmin qablu wainnaa lamooaffoohum naseebahum ghayra manqoos
Wal aqad 'aataynaa moosaal kitaaba fakhtul ifa feehi wal awlaa kal imat sabaqat mir rrabbika laqudeea baynahum wainnahum lafee shakk mminhu mureeb
Wainna kul la llammaa layooaffeeannahum rabbuka 'a'maal ahum 'innahu bimaa ya'mal oona khabeer
Fastaqim kamaa 'umirta waman taaba ma'aka wal aa tatghawa 'innahu bimaa ta'mal oona baseer
Wal aa tarkanooaa 'il aal lazeena zal amu fatamassakumun-naaru wamaa lakum mmin doonil laahi min 'awleeaa'a thumma laa tunsaroon
Waaqimis-sal aata tarafayin-nahaari wazul afa mminal layli 'innal hasanaati yuzhibnas-sayyiaati zaal ika zikraa liz-zaakireen
Wasbir fainnal laaha laa yudee'u 'ajral muhsineen
Fal awlaa kaana minal qurooni min qablikum 'oolu baqiyyat yanhawna 'anil fasaadi fee al ardi 'il laa qal eela mmimman 'anjaynaa minhum wattaba'al lazeena zal amu maa 'utrifu feehi wakaanu mujrimeen
Wamaa kaana rabbuka leeuhlikal quraa bizul m waahluhaa muslihoon
Wal aw shaa'a rabbuka laja'al an-naasa 'ummat waahidat wal aa yazaal oona mukhtal ifeen
'il laa mar rrahima rabbuka wal izaal ika khal aqahum watammat kal imatu rabbika laamlaanna jahannama minal jinnati wan-naasi 'ajma'een
Wakul la nnaqussu 'al ayka min 'anbaa'ir-rusul i maa nuthabbitu bihi fu'aadaka wajaa'aka fee haazihil haqqu wamaw'izat wazikraa lil mu'mineen
Waqul-lil lazeena laa yu'minoona'mal u 'al aa makaanatikum 'innaa 'aamil oon
Wantazirooaa 'innaa muntaziroon
Wal il laahi ghaybus-samaawaati wal ardi wail ayhi yurja'ul amru kul luhu fa'budhu watawakkal 'al ayhi wamaa rabbuka bighaafil in 'ammaa ta'mal oon
Al aar til ka 'ayaatul kitaabil mubeen
'innaa 'anzal naahu qur'aanana 'arabiyya lla'al lakum ta'qil oon
Nahnu naqussu 'al ayka 'ahsanal qasasi bimaa 'awhaynaa 'il ayka haazaal qur'aana wain kunta min qablihi laminal ghaafil een
'iz qaal a yoosufu liabeehi yaabati 'innee raytu 'ahada 'ashara kawkaba wash-shamsa wal qamara raytuhum lee saajideen
Qaal a yaabunayya laa taqsus ru'yaaka 'al aa 'ikhwatika fayakeedu laka kaydana 'innash-shaytaana lil insaani 'adoow mmubeen

Wakazaal ika yajtabeeka rabbuka wayu'al limuka min taweelil ahaadeethi wayutimmu ni'matahu 'al ayka wa'al aa 'aal i ya'qooba kamaa 'atammahaa 'al aa 'abawayka min qablu 'ibraaheema waishaaqa 'inna rabbaka 'al eemun hakeem
Llaqad kaana fee yoosufa waikhwatihiaa 'ayaat llis-saa'il een
'iz qaal u layoosufu waakhoohu 'ahabbu 'il aa 'abeenaa minnaa wanahnu 'usbatun 'inna 'abaanaa lafee dal aal mmubeen
Aqtul u yoosufa 'awitrahoohu 'arda yakhlu lakum wajhu 'abeekum watakoonu mim ba'dihi qawma saal iheen
Qaal a qaa'il mminhum laa taqtul u yoosufa waal qoohu fee ghayaabatil jubbi yal taqithu ba'dus-sayyaarati 'in kuntum faa'il een
Qaal u yaabaanaa maa laka laa tamannaa 'al aa yoosufa wainnaa lahu lanaasihoon
'arsil hu ma'anaa ghada yarta' wayal'ab wainnaa lahu lahaafizoon
Qaal a 'innee layahzununeeaa 'an tazhabu bihi waakhaafu 'any yakul ahuz-zi'bu waantum 'anhu ghaafil oon
Qaal u la'in 'akal ahuz-zi'bu wanahnu 'usbatun 'innaa 'iza llakhaasiroon
Fal ammaa zahabu bihi waajma'ooaa 'any yaj'al oohu fee ghayaabatil jubbi waawhaynaa 'il ayhi latunabbi'annahum biamrihim haazaa wahum laa yash'uroon
Wajaa'ooaa 'abaahum 'ishaa' yabkoon
Qaal u yaabaanaa 'innaa zahabnaa nastabiqu wataraknaa yoosufa 'inda mataa'inaa faakal ahuz-zi'bu wamaa 'anta bimu'mil llanaa wal aw kunnaa saadiqeen
Wajaa'oo 'al aa qameesihi bidam kazib qaal a bal sawwal at lakum 'anfusukum 'amra fasabr jameel wal laahul musta'aanu 'al aa maa tasifoon
Wajaa'at sayyaarat faarsal u waaridahum faadlaa dal wahu qaal a yaabushraa haazaa ghul aam waasarroohu bidaa'at wal laahu 'al eemu bimaa ya'mal oon
Washarawhu bithamani bakhs daraahima ma'doodat wakaanu feehi minaz-zaahideen

Waqaal al lazee ashtaraahu mim mmisra limraatihiaa 'akrimee mathwaahu 'asaa 'any yanfa'anaa 'aw nattakhizahu wal ada wakazaal ika makkannaa leeoosufa fee al ardi wal inu'al limahu min taweelil ahaadeethi wal laahu ghaal ibun 'al aa 'amrihi wal aakinna 'aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Wal ammaa bal agha 'ashuddahuaa 'aataynaahu hukma wa'il ma wakazaal ika najzee al muhsineen
Waraawadathul latee hooa fee baytihaa 'an nnafsihi waghal laqatil abwaaba waqaal at hayta laka qaal a ma'aazal laahi 'innahu rabbeeaa 'ahsana mathwaya 'innahu laa yuflihuz-zaal imoon
Wal aqad hammat bihi wahamma bihaa lawlaa 'ar rra'aa burhaana rabbihi kazaal ika linasrifa 'anhus-sooaa'a wal fahshaa'a 'innahu min 'ibaadinaal mukhlaseen
Wastabaqaal baaba waqaddat qameesahu min dubur waal fayaa sayyidahaa ladaal baabi qaal at maa jazaa'u man 'araada biahlika sooaa'ana 'il laa 'any yusjana 'aw 'azaabun 'al eem
Qaal a heea raawadatnee 'an nnafsee washahida shaahid mmin 'ahlihaa 'in kaana qameesuhu qudda min qubul fasadaqat wahooa minal kaazibeen
Wain kaana qameesuhu qudda min dubur fakazabat wahooa minas-saadiqeen
Fal ammaa ra'aa qameesahu qudda min dubur qaal a 'innahu min kaydikunna 'inna kaydakunna 'azeem
Yoosufu 'a'rid 'an haazaa wastaghfiree lizanbiki 'innaki kunti minal khaatieen
Waqaal a niswat fee al madeenatimraatul'azeezi turaawidu fataahaa 'an nnafsihi qad shaghafahaa hubbana 'innaa lanaraahaa fee dal aal mmubeen

Fal ammaa sami'at bimakrihinna 'arsal at 'il ayhinna waa'tadat lahunna muttakaa wa'aatat kul la waahidat mminhunna sikkeena waqaal atikhruj 'al ayhinna fal ammaa raynahuaa 'akbarnahu waqatta'na 'aydeeahunna waqul na haasha lil laahi maa haazaa basharana 'in haazaa 'il laa mal ak kareem
Qaal at fazaal ikunnal lazee lumtunnanee feehi wal aqad raawadttuhu 'an nnafsihi fasta'sama wal a'il llam yaf'al maa 'aamuruhu layusjananna wal ayakoona mminas-saaghireen
Qaal a rabbis-sijnu 'ahabbu 'il ayya mimmaa yad'oonaneeaa 'il ayhi wail laa tasrif 'annee kaydahunna 'asbu 'il ayhinna waakum mminal jaahil een
Fastajaaba lahu rabbuhu fasarafa 'anhu kaydahunna 'innahu hooas-samee'ul'al eem
Thumma badaa lahum mmim ba'di maa raawual ayaati layasjununnahu hattaa heen

Wadakhal a ma'ahus-sijna fatayaani qaal a 'ahaduhumaa 'inneeaa 'araaneeaa 'a'siru khamra waqaal al aakharu 'inneeaa 'araaneeaa 'ahmil u fawqa rasee khubza takul ut-tayru minhu nabbi'naa bitaweelihiaa 'innaa naraaka minal muhsineen

Qaal a laa yateekumaa ta'aam turzaqaanihiaa 'il laa nabbatukumaa bitaweelihi qabla 'any yateeakumaa zaal ikumaa mimmaa 'al lamanee rabbeeaa 'innee taraktu mil lata qawm llaa yu'minoona bil laahi wahum bil aakhirati hum kaafiroon

Wattaba'tu mil lata 'aabaa'eeaa 'ibraaheema waishaaqa waya'qooba maa kaana lanaa 'an nnushrika bil laahi min shay' zaal ika min fadlil laahi 'al aynaa wa'al aan-naasi wal aakinna 'aktharan-naasi laa yashkuroon
Yaasaahibayis-sijni 'aarbaab mmutafarriqoona khayrun 'amil laahul waahidul qahhaar

Maa ta'budoona min doonihiaa 'il laa 'asmaa' sammaytumoohaa 'antum wa'aabaa'ukum mmaa 'anzal al laahu bihaa min sul taanin 'inil hukmu 'il laa lil laahi 'amara 'al laa ta'budooaa 'il laa 'iyyaahu zaal ikad-deenul qayyimu wal aakinna 'aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Yaasaahibayis-sijni 'ammaa 'ahadukumaa fayasqee rabbahu khamra waammaal aakharu fayuslabu fatakul ut-tayru mir rrasihi qudeeal amrul lazee feehi tastafteeaan
Waqaal a lil lazee zanna 'annahu naaj mminhumaazkurnee 'inda rabbika faansaahush-shaytaanu zikra rabbihi fal abitha fee as-sijni bid'a sineen
Waqaal al mal iku 'inneeaa 'araa sab'a baqaraat simaany yakul uhunna sab'un 'ijaaf wasab'a sunbul aatin khudr waukhara yaabisaat yayyuhaal mal au 'aftoonee fee ru'yaya 'in kuntum lir-ru'yaa ta'buroon
Qaal ooaa 'adghaathu 'ahlaam wamaa nahnu bitaweelil ahlaami bi'aal imeen
Waqaal al lazee najaa minhumaa waddakara ba'da 'ummatin 'anaa 'unabbi'ukum bitaweelihi faarsil oon
Yoosufu 'ayyuhaas-siddeequ 'aftinaa fee sab'i baqaraat simaany yakul uhunna sab'un 'ijaaf wasab'i sunbul aatin khudr waukhara yaabisaat lla'al leeaa 'arji'u 'il aan-naasi la'al laahum ya'lamoon
Qaal a tazra'oona sab'a sineena daaba famaa hasadttum fazaroohu fee sunbul ihiaa 'il laa qal eela mmimmaa takul oon
Thumma yatee mim ba'di zaal ika sab' shidaad yakul na maa qaddamtum lahunna 'il laa qal eela mmimmaa tuhsinoon
Thumma yatee mim ba'di zaal ika 'aam feehi yughaathun-naasu wafeehi ya'siroon
Waqaal al mal iku'toonee bihi fal ammaa jaa'ahur-rasoolu qaal arji' 'il aa rabbika fasal hu maa baal un-niswatil laatee qatta'na 'aydeeahunna 'inna rabbee bikaydihinna 'al eem

Qaal a maa khatbukunna 'iz raawadttunna yoosufa 'an nnafsihi qul na haasha lil laahi maa 'al imnaa 'al ayhi min sooaa' qaal atimraatul'azeezil aana hashasal haqqu 'anaa raawadttuhu 'an nnafsihi wainnahu laminas-saadiqeen
Zaal ika leea'lama 'annee lam 'akhunhu bil ghaybi waannal laaha laa yahdee kaydal khaa'ineen
Wamaa 'ubarri'u nafseeaa 'innan-nafsa laammaaratu bis-sooaa'i 'il laa maa rahima rabbeeaa 'inna rabbee ghafoor rraheem
Waqaal al mal iku'toonee bihiaa 'astakhlishu linafsee fal ammaa kal lamahu qaal a 'innakal yawma ladaynaa makeenun 'ameen
Qaal aj'al nee 'al aa khazaa'inil ardi 'innee hafeezun 'al eem
Wakazaal ika makkannaa leeoosufa fee al ardi yatabawwau minhaa haythu yashaa'u nuseebu birahmatinaa man nnashaa'u wal aa nudee'u 'ajral muhsineen
Wal aajrul aakhirati khayr llil lazeena 'aamanu wakaanu yattaqoon
Wajaa'a 'ikhwatu yoosufa fadakhal u 'al ayhi fa'arafahum wahum lahu munkiroon
Wal ammaa jahhazahum bijahaazihim qaal a'toonee biakh llakum mmin 'abeekum 'al aa tarawna 'anneeaa 'oofee al kayla waanaa khayrul munzil een
Fail llam tatoonee bihi fal aa kayla lakum 'indee wal aa taqraboon
Qaal u sanuraawidu 'anhu 'abaahu wainnaa lafaa'il oon
Waqaal a lifityaanihij'al u bidaa'atahum fee rihaal ihim la'al laahum ya'rifoonahaa 'izaanqal abooaa 'il aa 'ahlihim la'al laahum yarji'oon
Fal ammaa raja'ooaa 'il aa 'abeehim qaal u yaabaanaa muni'a minnaal kaylu faarsil ma'anaa 'akhaanaa naktal wainnaa lahu lahaafizoon
Qaal a hal 'aamanukum 'al ayhi 'il laa kamaa 'amintukum 'al aa 'akheehi min qablu fal laahu khayrun haafiza wahooa 'arhamur-raahimeen

Wal ammaa fatahu mataa'ahum wajadu bidaa'atahum ruddat 'il ayhim qaal u yaabaanaa maa nabghee haazihi bidaa'atunaa ruddat 'il aynaa wanameeru 'ahlanaa wanahfazu 'akhaanaa wanazdaadu kayla ba'eer zaal ika kayl yaseer
Qaal a lan 'ursil ahu ma'akum hattaa tu'tooni mawthiqa mminal laahi latatunnanee bihiaa 'il laa 'any yuhaata bikum fal ammaa 'aatawhu mawthiqahum qaal al laahu 'al aa maa naqoolu wakeel

Waqaal a yaabaniyya laa tadkhul u mim baab waahid wadkhul u min 'abwaab mmutafarriqat wamaa 'ughnee 'ankum mminal laahi min shay'in 'inil hukmu 'il laa lil laahi 'al ayhi tawakkal tu wa'al ayhi fal yatawakkal il mutawakkil oon

Wal ammaa dakhal u min haythu 'amarahum 'aboohum mmaa kaana yughnee 'anhum mminal laahi min shay'in 'il laa haajat fee nafsi ya'qooba qadaahaa wainnahu lazoo 'il m llimaa 'al lamnaahu wal aakinna 'aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Wal ammaa dakhal u 'al aa yoosufa 'aawaa 'il ayhi 'akhaahu qaal a 'inneeaa 'anaa 'akhooka fal aa tabta'is bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Fal ammaa jahhazahum bijahaazihim ja'al as-siqayata fee rahli 'akheehi thumma 'azzana mu'azzinun 'ayyatuhaal'eeru 'innakum lasaariqoon
Qaal u waaqbal u 'al ayhim mmaazaa tafqidoon
Qaal u nafqidu sooaa'al mal iki wal iman jaa'a bihi himlu ba'eer waanaa bihi za'eem
Qaal u tal laahi laqad 'al imtum mmaa ji'naa linufsida fee al ardi wamaa kunnaa saariqeen
Qaal u famaa jazaa'uhuaa 'in kuntum kaazibeen
Qaal u jazaa'uhu manw wujida fee rahlihi fahooa jazaa'uhu kazaal ika najzee az-zaal imeen

Fabadaa biaw'eeatihim qabla wi'aa'i 'akheehi thummastakhrajahaa minw wi'aa'i 'akheehi kazaal ika kidnaa leeoosufa maa kaana leeakhuza 'akhaahu fee deenil mal iki 'il laa 'any yashaa'al laahu narfa'u darajaat mman nnashaa'u wafawqa kul li zee 'il min 'al eem
Qaal ooaa 'iny yasriq faqad saraqa 'akh llaahu min qablu faasarrahaa yoosufu fee nafsihi wal am yubdihaa lahum qaal a 'antum sharr mmakaana wal laahu 'a'lamu bimaa tasifoon
Qaal u yayyuhaal'azeezu 'inna lahuaa 'aba shaykha kabeera fakhuz 'ahadanaa makaanahuaa 'innaa naraaka minal muhsineen
Qaal a ma'aazal laahi 'an nnakhuza 'il laa manw wajadnaa mataa'anaa 'indahuaa 'innaa 'iza llazaal imoon

Fal ammaastayasu minhu khal asu najiyya qaal a kabeeruhum 'al am ta'lamooaa 'anna 'abaakum qad 'akhaza 'al aykum mmawthiqa mminal laahi wamin qablu maa farrattum fee yoosufa fal an 'abrahal arda hattaa yazana leeaa 'abeeaa 'aw yahkumal laahu lee wahooa khayrul haakimeen
Arji'ooaa 'il aa 'abeekum faqoolu yaabaanaa 'innabnaka saraqa wamaa shahidnaa 'il laa bimaa 'al imnaa wamaa kunnaa lil ghaybi haafizeen
Wasal il qaryatal latee kunnaa feehaa wal'eeral lateeaa 'aqbal naa feehaa wainnaa lasaadiqoon
Qaal a bal sawwal at lakum 'anfusukum 'amra fasabr jameelun 'asaal laahu 'any yateeanee bihim jamee'ana 'innahu hooal'al eemul hakeem
Watawal laa 'anhum waqaal a yaasafaa 'al aa yoosufa wabyaddat 'aynaahu minal huzni fahooa kazeem
Qaal u tal laahi tafta'ua tazkuru yoosufa hattaa takoona haradana 'aw takoona minal haal ikeen
Qaal a 'innamaa 'ashku baththee wahuzneeaa 'il aal laahi waa'lamu minal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Yaabaniyyazhabu fatahassasu miny yoosufa waakheehi wal aa tayasu mir rrawhil laahi 'innahu laa yayasu mir rrawhil laahi 'il laal qawmul kaafiroon
Fal ammaa dakhal u 'al ayhi qaal u yayyuhaal'azeezu massanaa waahlanaad-durru waji'naa bibidaa'at mmuzjaat faawfi lanaal kayla watasaddaq 'al aynaa 'innal laaha yajzee al mutasaddiqeen
Qaal a hal 'al imtum mmaa fa'al tum beeoosufa waakheehi 'iz 'antum jaahil oon
Qaal ooaa 'a'innaka laanta yoosufu qaal a 'anaa yoosufu wahaazaa 'akhee qad mannal laahu 'al aynaa 'innahu many yattaqi wayasbir fainnal laaha laa yudee'u 'ajral muhsineen
Qaal u tal laahi laqad 'aatharakal laahu 'al aynaa wain kunnaa lakhaatieen
Qaal a laa tathreeba 'al aykumul yawma yaghfirul laahu lakum wahooa 'arhamur-raahimeen
Azhabu biqameesee haazaa faal qoohu 'al aa wajhi 'abee yati baseera watoonee biahlikum 'ajma'een
Wal ammaa fasal atil'eeru qaal a 'aboohum 'innee laajidu reeha yoosufa lawlaa 'an tufannidoon
Qaal u tal laahi 'innaka lafee dal aal ikal qadeem
Fal ammaa 'an jaa'al basheeru 'al qaahu 'al aa wajhihi fartadda baseera qaal a 'al am 'aqul-lakum 'inneeaa 'a'lamu minal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Qaal u yaabaanaastaghfir lanaa zunoobanaa 'innaa kunnaa khaatieen
Qaal a sawfa 'astaghfiru lakum rabbeeaa 'innahu hooal ghafoorur-raheem
Fal ammaa dakhal u 'al aa yoosufa 'aawaa 'il ayhi 'abawayhi waqaal adkhul u misra 'in shaa'al laahu 'aamineen

Warafa'a 'abawayhi 'al aal'arshi wakharru lahu sujjada waqaal a yaabati haazaa taweelu ru'yaya min qablu qad ja'al ahaa rabbee haqqa waqad 'ahsana beeaa 'iz 'akhrajanee minas-sijni wajaa'a bikum mminal badwi mim ba'di 'an nnazaghash-shaytaanu baynee wabayna 'ikhwateeaa 'inna rabbee lateef llimaa yashaa'u 'innahu hooal'al eemul hakeem
Rabbi qad 'aataytanee minal mul ki wa'al lamtanee min taweelil ahaadeethi faatiras-samaawaati wal ardi 'anta wal eeyi fee ad-dunyaa wal aakhirati tawaffanee muslima waal hiqnee bis-saal iheen
Zaal ika min 'anbaa'il ghaybi nooheehi 'il ayka wamaa kunta ladayhim 'iz 'ajma'ooaa 'amrahum wahum yamkuroon
Wamaa 'aktharun-naasi wal aw harasta bimu'mineen
Wamaa tasal uhum 'al ayhi min 'ajrin 'in hooa 'il laa zikr llil'aal ameen
Wakayyim mmin 'ayat fee as-samaawaati wal ardi yamurroona 'al ayhaa wahum 'anhaa mu'ridoon
Wamaa yu'minu 'aktharuhum bil laahi 'il laa wahum mmushrikoon
'afaaminooaa 'an tateeahum ghaasheeat mmin 'azaabil laahi 'aw tateeahumus-saa'atu baghtat wahum laa yash'uroon
Qul haazihi sabeeleeaa 'ad'ooaa 'il aal laahi 'al aa baseeratin 'anaa wamanittaba'anee wasubhaanal laahi wamaa 'anaa minal mushrikeen

Wamaa 'arsal naa min qablika 'il laa rijaal a nnooheeaa 'il ayhim mmin 'ahlil quraa 'afal am yaseeru fee al ardi fayanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul lazeena min qablihim wal adaarul aakhirati khayr llil lazeenattaqawa 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Hattaa 'izaastayasar-rusul u wazannooaa 'annahum qad kuzibu jaa'ahum nasrunaa fanujjeea man nnashaa'u wal aa yuraddu basunaa 'anil qawmil mujrimeen
Laqad kaana fee qasasihim 'ibrat llioolee al al baabi maa kaana hadeetha yuftaraa wal aakin tasdeeqal lazee bayna yadayhi watafseela kul li shay' wahuda warahmat lliqawm yu'minoon
Al aamaar til ka 'ayaatul kitaabi wal lazeeaa 'unzil a 'il ayka mir rrabbikal haqqu wal aakinna 'aktharan-naasi laa yu'minoon

Al laahul lazee rafa'as-samaawaati bighayri 'amad tarawnahaa thummastawaa 'al aal'arshi wasakhkharash-shamsa wal qamara kul l yajree liajal mmusamma yudabbirul amra yufassil ul ayaati la'al lakum bil iqaa'i rabbikum tooqinoon
Wahooal lazee maddal arda waja'al a feehaa rawaaseea waanhaara wamin kul lith-thamaraati ja'al a feehaa zawjaynithnayni yughshee al laylan-nahaara 'inna fee zaal ika layaat lliqawm yatafakkaroon

Wafee al ardi qita' mmutajaawiraat wajannaat mmin 'a'naab wazar' wanakheel sinwaanw waghayru sinwaany yusqaa bimaa' waahid wanufaddil u ba'dahaa 'al aa ba'd fee al ukul i 'inna fee zaal ika layaat lliqawm ya'qil oon

Wain ta'jab fa'ajab qawluhum 'a'izaa kunnaa turaabana 'a'innaa lafee khal q jadeedin 'ul aa'ikal lazeena kafaru birabbihim waul aa'ikal aghlaal u feeaa 'a'naaqihim waul aa'ika 'ashaabun-naari hum feehaa khaal idoon
Wayasta'jil oonaka bis-sayyi'ati qablal hasanati waqad khal at min qablihimul mathul aatu wainna rabbaka lazoo maghfirat llin-naasi 'al aa zul mihim wainna rabbaka lashadeedul'iqaab
Wayaqoolul lazeena kafaru lawlaa 'unzil a 'al ayhi 'ayat mmir rrabbihiaa 'innamaa 'anta munzir wal ikul li qawmin haad
Al laahu ya'lamu maa tahmil u kul lu 'unthaa wamaa tagheedul arhaamu wamaa tazdaadu wakul lu shay'in 'indahu bimiqdaar
'aal imul ghaybi wash-shahaadatil kabeerul muta'aal
Sawaa' mminkum mman 'asarral qawla waman jahara bihi waman hooa mustakhfi bil layli wasaaribu bin-nahaar

Lahu mu'aqqibaat mmim bayni yadayhi wamin khal fihi yahfazoonahu min 'amril laahi 'innal laaha laa yughayyiru maa biqawmin hattaa yughayyiru maa bianfusihim waizaa 'araadal laahu biqawm sooaa'a fal aa maradda lahu wamaa lahum mmin doonihi minw waal
Hooal lazee yureekumul barqa khawfa watama'a wayunshi'us-sahaabath-thiqaal
Wayusabbihur-ra'du bihamdihi wal mal aa'ikatu min kheefatihi wayursil us-sawaa'iqa fayuseebu bihaa many yashaa'u wahum yujaadil oona fee al laahi wahooa shadeedul mihaal

Lahu da'watul haqqi wal lazeena yad'oona min doonihi laa yastajeeboona lahum bishay'in 'il laa kabaasiti kaffayhi 'il aal maa'i leeablugha faahu wamaa hooa bibaal ighihi wamaa du'aa'ul kaafireena 'il laa fee dal aal
Wal il laahi yasjudu man fee as-samaawaati wal ardi taw'a wakarha wazil aal uhum bil ghudoowi wal aasaal

Qul mar rrabbus-samaawaati wal ardi qul il laahu qul 'afattakhaztum mmin doonihiaa 'awleeaa'a laa yamlikoona lianfusihim naf'a wal aa darra qul hal yastawee al a'maa wal baseeru 'am hal tastawee az-zul umaatu wan-nooru 'am ja'al u lil laahi shurakaa'a khal aqu kakhal qihi fatashaabahal khal qu 'al ayhim qul il laahu khaal iqu kul li shay' wahooal waahidul qahhaar

'anzal a minas-samaa'i maa' fasaal at 'awdeeatu biqadarihaa fahtamal as-saylu zabada rraabeea wamimmaa yooqidoona 'al ayhi fee an-naaribtighaa'a hil yatin 'aw mataa' zabad mmithluhu kazaal ika yadribul laahul haqqa wal baatil a faammaaz-zabadu fayazhabu jufaa' waammaa maa yanfa'un-naasa fayamkuthu fee al ardi kazaal ika yadribul laahul amthaal

Lil lazeenastajaabu lirabbihimul husnaa wal lazeena lam yastajeebu lahu law 'anna lahum mmaa fee al ardi jamee'a wamithlahu ma'ahu laftadawa bihiaa 'ul aa'ika lahum sooaa'ul hisaabi wamawaahum jahannamu wabi'sal mihaad
'afamany ya'lamu 'annamaa 'unzil a 'il ayka mir rrabbikal haqqu kaman hooa 'a'maa 'innamaa yatazakkaru 'oolul al baab
Al lazeena yoofoona bi'ahdil laahi wal aa yanqudoonal meethaaq
Wal lazeena yasil oona maa 'amaral laahu bihiaa 'any yoosal a wayakhshawna rabbahum wayakhaafoona sooaa'al hisaab
Wal lazeena sabarubtighaa'a wajhi rabbihim waaqaamus-sal aata waanfaqu mimmaa razaqnaahum sirra wa'al aaneeat wayadra'oona bil hasanatis-sayyi'ata 'ul aa'ika lahum 'uqbaad-daar
Jannaatu 'adn yadkhul oonahaa waman sal aha min 'aabaa'ihim waazwaajihim wazurriyyaatihim wal mal aa'ikatu yadkhul oona 'al ayhim mmin kul li baab
Sal aamun 'al aykum bimaa sabartum fani'ma 'uqbaad-daar
Wal lazeena yanqudoona 'ahdal laahi mim ba'di meethaaqihi wayaqta'oona maa 'amaral laahu bihiaa 'any yoosal a wayufsidoona fee al ardi 'ul aa'ika lahumul la'natu wal ahum sooaa'ud-daar
Al laahu yabsutur-rizqa limany yashaa'u wayaqdiru wafarihu bil hayawaatid-dunyaa wamaal hayawaatud-dunyaa fee al aakhirati 'il laa mataa'
Wayaqoolul lazeena kafaru lawlaa 'unzil a 'al ayhi 'ayat mmir rrabbihi qul 'innal laaha yudil lu many yashaa'u wayahdeeaa 'il ayhi man 'anaab
Al lazeena 'aamanu watatma'innu qul oobuhum bizikril laahi 'al aa bizikril laahi tatma'innul qul oob
Al lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati toobaa lahum wahusnu maab

Kazaal ika 'arsal naaka feeaa 'ummat qad khal at min qablihaa 'umam llitatlooaa 'al ayhimul lazeeaa 'awhaynaa 'il ayka wahum yakfuroona bir-rahmaani qul hooa rabbee laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa 'al ayhi tawakkal tu wail ayhi mataab

Wal aw 'anna qur'aana suyyirat bihil jibaal u 'aw qutti'at bihil ardu 'aw kul lima bihil mawtaa bal-lil laahil amru jamee'ana 'afal am yayasil lazeena 'aamanooaa 'al llaw yashaa'ul laahu lahadaan-naasa jamee'a wal aa yazaal ul lazeena kafaru tuseebuhum bimaa sana'u qaari'atun 'aw tahul lu qareeba mmin daarihim hattaa yateea wa'dul laahi 'innal laaha laa yukhliful mee'aad
Wal aqadistuhzi'a birusul mmin qablika faamlaytu lil lazeena kafaru thumma 'akhaztuhum fakayfa kaana 'iqaab

'afaman hooa qaa'imun 'al aa kul li nafsi bimaa kasabat waja'al u lil laahi shurakaa'a qul sammoohum 'am tunabbioonahu bimaa laa ya'lamu fee al ardi 'am bizaahir mminal qawli bal zuyyina lil lazeena kafaru makruhum wasuddu 'anis-sabeeli wamany yudlil il laahu famaa lahu min haad
Llaahum 'azaab fee al hayawaatid-dunyaa wal a'azaabul aakhirati 'ashaqqu wamaa lahum mminal laahi minw waaq
Mmathal ul jannatil latee wu'idal muttaqoona tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru 'ukul uhaa daa'im wazil luhaa til ka 'uqbaal lazeenattaqa wwa'uqbaal kaafireenan-naar
Wal lazeena 'aataynaahumul kitaaba yafrahoona bimaa 'unzil a 'il ayka waminal ahzaabi many yunkiru ba'dahu qul 'innamaa 'umirtu 'an 'a'budal laaha wal aa 'ushrika bihiaa 'il ayhi 'ad'u wail ayhi maab
Wakazaal ika 'anzal naahu hukmana 'arabiyya wal a'inittaba'ta 'ahwaa'ahum ba'da maa jaa'aka minal'il mi maa laka minal laahi minw wal eey wal aa waaq
Wal aqad 'arsal naa rusul a mmin qablika waja'al naa lahum 'azwaaja wazurriyyat wamaa kaana lirasoolin 'any yateea biayatin 'il laa biiznil laahi likul li 'ajal kitaab
Yamhul laahu maa yashaa'u wayuthbitu wa'indahuaa 'ummul kitaab
Waim mmaa nureeannaka ba'dal lazee na'iduhum 'aw natawaffayannaka fainnamaa 'al aykal bal aaghu wa'al aynaal hisaab
'awal am yarawa 'annaa natee al arda nanqusuhaa min 'atraafihaa wal laahu yahkumu laa mu'aqqiba lihukmihi wahooa saree'ul hisaab
Waqad makaral lazeena min qablihim fal il laahil makru jamee'a ya'lamu maa taksibu kul lu nafs wasaya'lamul kuffaaru liman 'uqbaad-daar
Wayaqoolul lazeena kafaru lasta mursal a qul kafaa bil laahi shaheedaa baynee wabaynakum waman 'indahu 'il mul kitaab
Al aar kitaabun 'anzal naahu 'il ayka litukhrijan-naasa minaz-zul umaati 'il aan-noori biizni rabbihim 'il aa siraatil'azeezil hameed
Al laahil lazee lahu maa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardi wawayl llil kaafireena min 'azaab shadeed
Al lazeena yastahibboonal hayawaatad-dunyaa 'al aal aakhirati wayasuddoona 'an sabeelil laahi wayabghoonahaa 'iwajana 'ul aa'ika fee dal aal i ba'eed
Wamaa 'arsal naa mir rrasoolin 'il laa bil isaani qawmihi leeubayyina lahum fayudil lul laahu many yashaa'u wayahdee many yashaa'u wahooal'azeezul hakeem
Wal aqad 'arsal naa moosaa biayaatinaa 'an 'akhrij qawmaka minaz-zul umaati 'il aan-noori wazakkirhum biayyaamil laahi 'inna fee zaal ika layaat llikul li sabbaar shakoor

Waiz qaal a moosaa liqawmihizkuru ni'matal laahi 'al aykum 'iz 'anjaakum mmin 'aal i fir'awna yasoomoonakum sooaa'al'azaabi wayuzabbihoona 'abnaa'akum wayastahyoona nisaa'akum wafee zaal ikum bal aa' mmir rrabbikum 'azeem
Waiz taazzana rabbukum la'in shakartum laazeedannakum wal a'in kafartum 'inna 'azaabee lashadeed
Waqaal a moosaa 'in takfurooaa 'antum waman fee al ardi jamee'a fainnal laaha laghaneeyun hameed

'al am yatikum naba'ual lazeena min qablikum qawmi nooh wa'aad wathamooda wal lazeena mim ba'dihim laa ya'lamuhum 'il laal laahu jaa'athum rusul uhum bil bayyinaati faraddooaa 'aydeeahum feeaa 'afwaahihim waqaal ooaa 'innaa kafarnaa bimaa 'ursil tum bihi wainnaa lafee shakk mmimmaa tad'oonanaa 'il ayhi mureeb

Qaal at rusul uhum 'afee al laahi shakk faatiris-samaawaati wal ardi yad'ookum leeaghfira lakum mmin zunoobikum wayu'akhkhirakum 'il aa 'ajal mmusamma qaal ooaa 'in 'antum 'il laa bashar mmithlunaa tureedoona 'an tasuddoonaa 'ammaa kaana ya'budu 'aabaa'unaa fatoonaa bisul taam mmubeen

Qaal at lahum rusul uhum 'in nnahnu 'il laa bashar mmithlukum wal aakinnal laaha yamunnu 'al aa many yashaa'u min 'ibaadihi wamaa kaana lanaa 'an nnateeakum bisul taanin 'il laa biiznil laahi wa'al aal laahi fal yatawakkal il mu'minoon
Wamaa lanaa 'al laa natawakkal a 'al aal laahi waqad hadaanaa subul anaa wal anasbiranna 'al aa maa 'aazaytumoonaa wa'al aal laahi fal yatawakkal il mutawakkil oon
Waqaal al lazeena kafaru lirusul ihim lanukhrijannakum mmin 'ardinaa 'aw lata'oodunna fee mil latinaa faawhaa 'il ayhim rabbuhum lanuhlikannaz-zaal imeen
Wal anuskinannakumul arda mim ba'dihim zaal ika liman khaafa maqaamee wakhaafa wa'eed
Wastaftahu wakhaaba kul lu jabbaarin 'aneed
Mminw waraa'ihi jahannamu wayusqaa mim mmaa' sadeed
Yatajarra'uhu wal aa yakaadu yuseeghuhu wayateehil mawtu min kul li makaanw wamaa hooa bimayyit waminw waraa'ihi 'azaabun ghal eez
Mmathal ul lazeena kafaru birabbihim 'a'maal uhum karamaadin ashtaddat bihir-reehu fee yawmin 'aasif llaa yaqdiroona mimmaa kasabu 'al aa shay' zaal ika hooad-dal aal ul ba'eed
'al am tara 'annal laaha khal aqas-samaawaati wal arda bil haqqi 'iny yasha yuzhibkum wayati bikhal q jadeed
Wamaa zaal ika 'al aal laahi bi'azeez

Wabarazu lil laahi jamee'a faqaal ad-du'afaa'ua lil lazeenastakbarooaa 'innaa kunnaa lakum taba'a fahal 'antum mmughnoona 'annaa min 'azaabil laahi min shay' qaal u law hadaanaal laahu lahadaynaakum sawaa'un 'al aynaa 'ajazi'naa 'am sabarnaa maa lanaa mim mmahees

Waqaal ash-shaytaanu lammaa qudeeal amru 'innal laaha wa'adakum wa'dal haqqi wawa'adttukum faakhlaftukum wamaa kaana leea 'al aykum mmin sul taanin 'il laa 'an da'awtukum fastajabtum lee fal aa tal oomoonee wal oomooaa 'anfusakum mmaa 'anaa bimusrikhikum wamaa 'antum bimusrikhiyya 'innee kafartu bimaa 'ashraktumooni min qablu 'innaz-zaal imeena lahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Waudkhil al lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati jannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa biizni rabbihim tahiyyatuhum feehaa sal aam
'al am tara kayfa darabal laahu mathal a kal imat tayyibat kashajarat tayyibatin 'asluhaa thaabit wafar'uhaa fee as-samaa'
Tu'teeaa 'ukul ahaa kul la heeni biizni rabbihaa wayadribul laahul amthaal a lin-naasi la'al laahum yatazakkaroon
Wamathal u kal imatin khabeethat kashajaratin khabeethatin ajtuththat min fawqil ardi maa lahaa min qaraar
Yuthabbitul laahul lazeena 'aamanu bil qawlith-thaabiti fee al hayawaatid-dunyaa wafee al aakhirati wayudil lul laahuz-zaal imeena wayaf'al ul laahu maa yashaa'
'al am tara 'il aal lazeena baddal u ni'matal laahi kufra waahal lu qawmahum daaral bawaar
Jahannama yaslawnahaa wabi'sal qaraar
Waja'al u lil laahi 'andaada lleeudil lu 'an sabeelihi qul tamatta'u fainna maseerakum 'il aan-naar
Qul-li'ibaadeeal lazeena 'aamanu yuqeemus-sal aata wayunfiqu mimmaa razaqnaahum sirra wa'al aaneeat mmin qabli 'any yateea yawm llaa bay' feehi wal aa khil aal

Al laahul lazee khal aqas-samaawaati wal arda waanzal a minas-samaa'i maa' faakhraja bihi minath-thamaraati rizqa llakum wasakhkhara lakumul ful ka litajreea fee al bahri biamrihi wasakhkhara lakumul anhaar
Wasakhkhara lakumush-shamsa wal qamara daa'ibayni wasakhkhara lakumul layla wan-nahaar
Wa'aataakum mmin kul li maa saal tumoohu wain ta'uddu ni'matal laahi laa tuhsoohaa 'innal insaana lazal oom kaffaar
Waiz qaal a 'ibraaheemu rabbij'al haazaal bal ada 'aamina wajnubnee wabaniyya 'an nna'budal asnaam
Rabbi 'innahunna 'adlal na katheera mminan-naasi faman tabi'anee fainnahu minnee waman 'asaanee fainnaka ghafoor rraheem

Rrabbanaa 'inneeaa 'askantu min zurriyyatee biwaadin ghayri zee zar'in 'inda baytikal muharrami rabbanaa leeuqeemus-sal aata faj'al 'afidat mminan-naasi tahweeaa 'il ayhim warzuqhum mminath-thamaraati la'al laahum yashkuroon
Rabbanaa 'innaka ta'lamu maa nukhfee wamaa nu'linu wamaa yakhfaa 'al aal laahi min shay' fee al ardi wal aa fee as-samaa'
Al hamdu lil laahil lazee wahaba lee 'al aal kibari 'ismaa'eela waishaaqa 'inna rabbee lasamee'ud-du'aa'
Rabbij'al nee muqeemas-sal aati wamin zurriyyatee rabbanaa wataqabbal du'aa'
Rabbanaaghfir lee wal iwaal idayya wal il mu'mineena yawma yaqoomul hisaab
Wal aa tahsabannal laaha ghaafil ana 'ammaa ya'mal uz-zaal imoona 'innamaa yu'akhkhiruhum leeawm tashkhasu feehil absaar
Muhti'eena muqni'ee ru'oosihim laa yartaddu 'il ayhim tarfuhum waafidatuhum hawaa'

Waanzirin-naasa yawma yateehimul'azaabu fayaqoolul lazeena zal amu rabbanaa 'akhkhirnaa 'il aa 'ajal qareeb nnujib da'wataka wanattabi'ir-rusul a 'awal am takoonooaa 'aqsamtum mmin qablu maa lakum mmin zawaal
Wasakantum fee masaakinil lazeena zal amooaa 'anfusahum watabayyana lakum kayfa fa'al naa bihim wadarabnaa lakumul amthaal
Waqad makaru makrahum wa'indal laahi makruhum wain kaana makruhum litazoola minhul jibaal
Fal aa tahsabannal laaha mukhlifa wa'dihi rusul ahuaa 'innal laaha 'azeez zoo antiqaam
Yawma tubaddal ul ardu ghayral ardi was-samaawaatu wabarazu lil laahil waahidil qahhaar
Wataraal mujrimeena yawma'iz mmuqarraneena fee al asfaad
Saraabeeluhum mmin qatiraanw wataghshaa wujoohahumun-naar
Leeajzeeal laahu kul la nafs mmaa kasabat 'innal laaha saree'ul hisaab
Haazaa bal aagh llin-naasi wal eeunzaru bihi wal eea'lamooaa 'annamaa hooa 'il aah waahid wal eeazzakkara 'oolul al baab
Al aar til ka 'ayaatul kitaabi waqur'aam mmubeen
Rrubamaa yawaddul lazeena kafaru law kaanu muslimeen
Zarhum yakul u wayatamatta'u wayul hihimul amal u fasawfa ya'lamoon
Wamaa 'ahlaknaa min qaryatin 'il laa wal ahaa kitaab mma'loom
Mmaa tasbiqu min 'ummatin 'ajal ahaa wamaa yastakhiroon
Waqaal u yayyuhaal lazee nuzzil a 'al ayhiz-zikru 'innaka lamajnoon
Llawmaa tateenaa bil mal aa'ikati 'in kunta minas-saadiqeen
Maa nunazzil ul mal aa'ikata 'il laa bil haqqi wamaa kaanooaa 'iza mmunzareen
'innaa nahnu nazzal naaz-zikra wainnaa lahu lahaafizoon
Wal aqad 'arsal naa min qablika fee sheea'il awwal een
Wamaa yateehim mmir rrasoolin 'il laa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Kazaal ika naslukuhu fee qul oobil mujrimeen
Laa yu'minoona bihi waqad khal at sunnatul awwal een
Wal aw fatahnaa 'al ayhim baaba mminas-samaa'i fazal lu feehi ya'rujoon
Laqaal ooaa 'innamaa sukkirat 'absaarunaa bal nahnu qawm mmashooroon
Wal aqad ja'al naa fee as-samaa'i burooja wazayyannaahaa lin-naazireen
Wahafiznaahaa min kul li shaytaar rrajeem
'il laa manistaraqas-sam'a faatba'ahu shihaab mmubeen
Wal arda madadnaahaa waal qaynaa feehaa rawaaseea waanbatnaa feehaa min kul li shay' mmawzoon
Waja'al naa lakum feehaa ma'ayisha wamal llastum lahu biraaziqeen
Waim mmin shay'in 'il laa 'indanaa khazaa'inuhu wamaa nunazzil uhuaa 'il laa biqadar mma'loom
Waarsal naar-reeaaha lawaaqiha faanzal naa minas-samaa'i maa' faasqaynaakumoohu wamaa 'antum lahu bikhaazineen
Wainnaa lanahnu nuhyi wanumeetu wanahnul waarithoon
Wal aqad 'al imnaal mustaqdimeena minkum wal aqad 'al imnaal mustakhireen
Wainna rabbaka hooa yahshuruhum 'innahu hakeemun 'al eem
Wal aqad khal aqnaal insaana min sal saal mmin hama mmasnoon
Wal jaanna khal aqnaahu min qablu min nnaaris-samoom
Waiz qaal a rabbuka lil mal aa'ikati 'innee khaal iqu bashara mmin sal saal mmin hama mmasnoon
Faizaa sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi mir rroohee faqa'u lahu saajideen
Fasajadal mal aa'ikatu kul luhum 'ajma'oon
'il laa 'ibleesa 'abaa 'any yakoona ma'as-saajideen
Qaal a yaaibleesu maa laka 'al laa takoona ma'as-saajideen
Qaal a lam 'akul lliasjuda libasharin khal aqtahu min sal saal mmin hama mmasnoon
Qaal a fakhruj minhaa fainnaka rajeem
Wainna 'al aykal la'nata 'il aa yawmid-deen
Qaal a rabbi faanzirneeaa 'il aa yawmi yub'athoon
Qaal a fainnaka minal munzareen
'il aa yawmil waqtil ma'loom
Qaal a rabbi bimaa 'aghwaytanee lauzayyinanna lahum fee al ardi wal aughweeannahum 'ajma'een
'il laa 'ibaadaka minhumul mukhlaseen
Qaal a haazaa siraatun 'al ayya mustaqeem
'inna 'ibaadee laysa laka 'al ayhim sul taanun 'il laa manittaba'aka minal ghaaween
Wainna jahannama lamaw'iduhum 'ajma'een
Lahaa sab'atu 'abwaab llikul li baab mminhum juz' mmaqsoom
'innal muttaqeena fee jannaat wa'uyoon
Adkhul oohaa bisal aamin 'aamineen
Wanaza'naa maa fee sudoorihim mmin ghil lin 'ikhwaanana 'al aa surur mmutaqaabil een
Laa yamassuhum feehaa nasab wamaa hum mminhaa bimukhrajeen
Nabbi' 'ibaadeeaa 'anneeaa 'anaal ghafoorur-raheem
Waanna 'azaabee hooal'azaabul al eem
Wanabbi'hum 'an dayfi 'ibraaheem
'iz dakhal u 'al ayhi faqaal u sal aama qaal a 'innaa minkum wajil oon
Qaal u laa tawjal 'innaa nubashshiruka bighul aamin 'al eem
Qaal a 'abashshartumoonee 'al aa 'am mmassaneeal kibaru fabima tubashshiroon
Qaal u bashsharnaaka bil haqqi fal aa takum mminal qaaniteen
Qaal a wamany yaqnatu mir rrahmati rabbihiaa 'il laad-daal loon
Qaal a famaa khatbukum 'ayyuhaal mursal oon
Qaal ooaa 'innaa 'ursil naa 'il aa qawm mmujrimeen
'il laa 'aal a lootin 'innaa lamunajjoohum 'ajma'een
'il laamraatahu qaddarnaa 'innahaa laminal ghaabireen
Fal ammaa jaa'a 'aal a lootin al mursal oon
Qaal a 'innakum qawm mmunkaroon
Qaal u bal ji'naaka bimaa kaanu feehi yamtaroon
Waataynaaka bil haqqi wainnaa lasaadiqoon
Faasri biahlika biqit' mminal layli wattabi' 'adbaarahum wal aa yal tafit minkum 'ahad wamdu haythu tu'maroon
Waqadaynaa 'il ayhi zaal ikal amra 'anna daabira haa'ul aa'i maqtoo' mmusbiheen
Wajaa'a 'ahlul madeenati yastabshiroon
Qaal a 'inna haa'ul aa'i dayfee fal aa tafdahoon
Wattaqul laaha wal aa tukhzoon
Qaal ooaa 'awal am nanhaka 'anil'aal ameen
Qaal a haa'ul aa'i banaateeaa 'in kuntum faa'il een
La'amruka 'innahum lafee sakratihim ya'mahoon
Faakhazathumus-sayhatu mushriqeen
Faja'al naa 'aal eeahaa saafil ahaa waamtarnaa 'al ayhim hijaarat mmin sijjeel
'inna fee zaal ika layaat llil mutawassimeen
Wainnahaa labisabeel mmuqeem
'inna fee zaal ika layat llil mu'mineen
Wain kaana 'ashaabul aykati lazaal imeen
Fantaqamnaa minhum wainnahumaa labiimaam mmubeen
Wal aqad kazzaba 'ashaabul hijril mursal een
Wa'aataynaahum 'ayaatinaa fakaanu 'anhaa mu'rideen
Wakaanu yanhitoona minal jibaal i buyootana 'aamineen
Faakhazathumus-sayhatu musbiheen
Famaa 'aghnaa 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaksiboon
Wamaa khal aqnaas-samaawaati wal arda wamaa baynahumaa 'il laa bil haqqi wainnas-saa'ata laateeat fasfahis-safhal jameel
'inna rabbaka hooal khal laaqul'al eem
Wal aqad 'aataynaaka sab'a mminal mathaanee wal qur'aanal'azeem
Laa tamuddanna 'aynayka 'il aa maa matta'naa bihiaa 'azwaaja mminhum wal aa tahzan 'al ayhim wakhfid janaahaka lil mu'mineen
Waqul 'inneeaa 'anaan-nazeerul mubeen
Kamaa 'anzal naa 'al aal muqtasimeen
Al lazeena ja'al ul qur'aana 'ideen
Fawarabbika lanasal annahum 'ajma'een
'ammaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Fasda' bimaa tu'maru waa'rid 'anil mushrikeen
'innaa kafaynaakal mustahzi'een
Al lazeena yaj'al oona ma'al laahi 'il aahana 'aakhara fasawfa ya'lamoon
Wal aqad na'lamu 'annaka yadeequ sadruka bimaa yaqooloon
Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika wakum mminas-saajideen
Wa'bud rabbaka hattaa yateeakal yaqeen
'ataa 'amrul laahi fal aa tasta'jil oohu subhaanahu wata'aal aa 'ammaa yushrikoon
Yunazzil ul mal aa'ikata bir-roohi min 'amrihi 'al aa many yashaa'u min 'ibaadihiaa 'an 'anzirooaa 'annahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa 'anaa fattaqoon
Khal aqas-samaawaati wal arda bil haqqi ta'aal aa 'ammaa yushrikoon
Khal aqal insaana min nnutfat faizaa hooa khaseem mmubeen
Wal an'aama khal aqahaa lakum feehaa dif' wamanaafi'u waminhaa takul oon
Wal akum feehaa jamaal un heena tureehoona waheena tasrahoon
Watahmil u 'athqaal akum 'il aa bal ad llam takoonu baal igheehi 'il laa bishiqqil anfusi 'inna rabbakum lara'oof rraheem
Wal khayla wal bighaal a wal hameera litarkaboohaa wazeenat wayakhluqu maa laa ta'lamoon
Wa'al aal laahi qasdus-sabeeli waminhaa jaa'ir wal aw shaa'a lahadaakum 'ajma'een
Hooal lazeeaa 'anzal a minas-samaa'i maa' llakum mminhu sharaab waminhu shajar feehi tuseemoon
Yunbitu lakum bihiz-zar'a waz-zaytoona wan-nakheela wal a'naaba wamin kul lith-thamaraati 'inna fee zaal ika layat lliqawm yatafakkaroon
Wasakhkhara lakumul layla wan-nahaara wash-shamsa wal qamara wan-nujoomu musakhkharaatu biamrihiaa 'inna fee zaal ika layaat lliqawm ya'qil oon
Wamaa zaraa lakum fee al ardi mukhtal ifana 'al waanuhuaa 'inna fee zaal ika layat lliqawm yazzakkaroon
Wahooal lazee sakhkharal bahra litakul u minhu lahma tariyya watastakhriju minhu hil yat tal basoonahaa wataraal ful ka mawaakhira feehi wal itabtaghu min fadlihi wal a'al lakum tashkuroon
Waal qaa fee al ardi rawaaseea 'an tameeda bikum waanhaara wasubul a lla'al lakum tahtadoon
Wa'al aamaat wabin-najmi hum yahtadoon
'afamany yakhluqu kamal llaa yakhluqu 'afal aa tazakkaroon
Wain ta'uddu ni'matal laahi laa tuhsoohaa 'innal laaha laghafoor rraheem
Wal laahu ya'lamu maa tusirroona wamaa tu'linoon
Wal lazeena yad'oona min doonil laahi laa yakhluqoona shaya wahum yukhlaqoon
'amwaatun ghayru 'ahyaa' wamaa yash'uroona 'ayyaana yub'athoon
'il aahukum 'il aah waahid fal lazeena laa yu'minoona bil aakhirati qul oobuhum mmunkirat wahum mmustakbiroon
Laa jarama 'annal laaha ya'lamu maa yusirroona wamaa yu'linoona 'innahu laa yuhibbul mustakbireen
Waizaa qeela lahum mmaazaa 'anzal a rabbukum qaal ooaa 'asaateerul awwal een
Leeahmil ooaa 'awzaarahum kaamil at yawmal qeeaamati wamin 'awzaaril lazeena yudil loonahum bighayri 'il min 'al aa saa'a maa yaziroon
Qad makaral lazeena min qablihim faataal laahu bunyaanahum mminal qawaa'idi fakharra 'al ayhimus-saqfu min fawqihim waataahumul'azaabu min haythu laa yash'uroon
Thumma yawmal qeeaamati yukhzeehim wayaqoolu 'ayna shurakaa'eeal lazeena kuntum tushaaqqoona feehim qaal al lazeena 'ootul'il ma 'innal khizyal yawma was-sooaa'a 'al aal kaafireen
Al lazeena tatawaffaahumul mal aa'ikatu zaal imeeaa 'anfusihim faal qawuas-sal ama maa kunnaa na'mal u min sooaa'i bal aa 'innal laaha 'al eemu bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Fadkhul ooaa 'abwaaba jahannama khaal ideena feehaa fal abi'sa mathwaal mutakabbireen
Waqeela lil lazeenattaqawa maazaa 'anzal a rabbukum qaal u khayra llil lazeena 'ahsanu fee haazihid-dunyaa hasanat wal adaarul aakhirati khayr wal ani'ma daarul muttaqeen
Jannaatu 'adn yadkhul oonahaa tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru lahum feehaa maa yashaa'oona kazaal ika yajzee al laahul muttaqeen
Al lazeena tatawaffaahumul mal aa'ikatu tayyibeena yaqooloona sal aamun 'al aykumudkhul ul jannata bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Hal yanzuroona 'il laa 'an tateeahumul mal aa'ikatu 'aw yateea 'amru rabbika kazaal ika fa'al al lazeena min qablihim wamaa zal amahumul laahu wal aakin kaanooaa 'anfusahum yazlimoon
Faasaabahum sayyiaatu maa 'amil u wahaaqa bihim mmaa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon

Waqaal al lazeena 'ashraku law shaa'al laahu maa 'abadnaa min doonihi min shay' nnahnu wal aa 'aabaa'unaa wal aa harramnaa min doonihi min shay' kazaal ika fa'al al lazeena min qablihim fahal 'al aar-rusul i 'il laal bal aaghul mubeen

Wal aqad ba'athnaa fee kul li 'ummat rrasoolana 'ani'budul laaha wajtanibut-taaghoota faminhum mman hadaal laahu waminhum mman haqqat 'al ayhid-dal aal atu faseeru fee al ardi fanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul mukazzibeen
'in tahris 'al aa hudaahum fainnal laaha laa yahdee many yudil lu wamaa lahum mmin nnaasireen
Waaqsamu bil laahi jahda 'aymaanihim laa yab'athul laahu many yamootu bal aa wa'dana 'al ayhi haqqa wal aakinna 'aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Leeubayyina lahumul lazee yakhtal ifoona feehi wal eea'lamal lazeena kafarooaa 'annahum kaanu kaazibeen
'innamaa qawlunaa lishay'in 'izaa 'aradnaahu 'an nnaqoola lahu kun fayakoon
Wal lazeena haajaru fee al laahi mim ba'di maa zul imu lanubawwi'annahum fee ad-dunyaa hasanat wal aajrul aakhirati 'akbaru law kaanu ya'lamoon
Al lazeena sabaru wa'al aa rabbihim yatawakkal oon
Wamaa 'arsal naa min qablika 'il laa rijaal a nnooheeaa 'il ayhim fasal ooaa 'ahlaz-zikri 'in kuntum laa ta'lamoon
Bil bayyinaati waz-zuburi waanzal naa 'il aykaz-zikra litubayyina lin-naasi maa nuzzil a 'il ayhim wal a'al laahum yatafakkaroon
'afaaminal lazeena makarus-sayyiaati 'any yakhsifal laahu bihimul arda 'aw yateeahumul'azaabu min haythu laa yash'uroon
'aw yakhuzahum fee taqal lubihim famaa hum bimu'jizeen
'aw yakhuzahum 'al aa takhawwuf fainna rabbakum lara'oof rraheem
'awal am yarawa 'il aa maa khal aqal laahu min shay' yatafayya'ua zil aal uhu 'anil yameeni wash-shamaa'il i sujjada llil laahi wahum daakhiroon
Wal il laahi yasjudu maa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardi min daabbat wal mal aa'ikatu wahum laa yastakbiroon
Yakhaafoona rabbahum mmin fawqihim wayaf'al oona maa yu'maroon
Waqaal al laahu laa tattakhizooaa 'il aahaynithnayni 'innamaa hooa 'il aah waahid faiyyaya farhaboon
Wal ahu maa fee as-samaawaati wal ardi wal ahud-deenu waasibana 'afaghayral laahi tattaqoon
Wamaa bikum mmin nni'mat faminal laahi thumma 'izaa massakumud-durru fail ayhi tajaroon
Thumma 'izaa kashafad-durra 'ankum 'izaa fareeq mminkum birabbihim yushrikoon
Leeakfuru bimaa 'aataynaahum fatamatta'u fasawfa ta'lamoon
Wayaj'al oona limaa laa ya'lamoona naseeba mmimmaa razaqnaahum tal laahi latusal unna 'ammaa kuntum taftaroon
Wayaj'al oona lil laahil banaati subhaanahu wal ahum mmaa yashtahoon
Waizaa bushshira 'ahaduhum bil unthaa zal la wajhuhu muswadda wahooa kazeem
Yatawaaraa minal qawmi min sooaa'i maa bushshira bihiaa 'ayumsikuhu 'al aa hoonin 'am yadussuhu fee at-turaabi 'al aa saa'a maa yahkumoon
Lil lazeena laa yu'minoona bil aakhirati mathal us-saw'i wal il laahil mathal ul a'laa wahooal'azeezul hakeem
Wal aw yu'aakhizul laahun-naasa bizul mihim mmaa taraka 'al ayhaa min daabbat wal aakiny yu'akhkhiruhum 'il aa 'ajal mmusamma faizaa jaa'a 'ajal uhum laa yastakhiroona saa'at wal aa yastaqdimoon
Wayaj'al oona lil laahi maa yakrahoona watasifu 'al sinatuhumul kaziba 'anna lahumul husnaa laa jarama 'anna lahumun-naara waannahum mmufratoon
Tal laahi laqad 'arsal naa 'il aa 'umam mmin qablika fazayyana lahumush-shaytaanu 'a'maal ahum fahooa wal eeyuhumul yawma wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Wamaa 'anzal naa 'al aykal kitaaba 'il laa litubayyina lahumul lazee akhtal afu feehi wahuda warahmat lliqawm yu'minoon
Wal laahu 'anzal a minas-samaa'i maa' faahyaa bihil arda ba'da mawtihaa 'inna fee zaal ika layat lliqawm yasma'oon
Wainna lakum fee al an'aami la'ibrat nnusqeekum mmimmaa fee butoonihi mim bayni farth wadam llabanana khaal isa saa'igha llish-shaaribeen
Wamin thamaraatin-nakheeli wal a'naabi tattakhizoona minhu sakara warizqana hasanana 'inna fee zaal ika layat lliqawm ya'qil oon
Waawhaa rabbuka 'il aan-nahli 'anittakhizee minal jibaal i buyoota waminash-shajari wamimmaa ya'rishoon

Thumma kul ee min kul lith-thamaraati faslukee subul a rabbiki zul ul a yakhruju mim butoonihaa sharaab mmukhtal ifun 'al waanuhu feehi shifaa' llin-naasi 'inna fee zaal ika layat lliqawm yatafakkaroon
Wal laahu khal aqakum thumma yatawaffaakum waminkum mmany yuraddu 'il aa 'arzal il'umuri likay laa ya'lama ba'da 'il m shayana 'innal laaha 'al eem qadeer
Wal laahu faddal a ba'dakum 'al aa ba'd fee ar-rizqi famaal lazeena fuddil u biraaddee rizqihim 'al aa maa mal akat 'aymaanuhum fahum feehi sawaa'un 'afabini'matil laahi yajhadoon
Wal laahu ja'al a lakum mmin 'anfusikum 'azwaaja waja'al a lakum mmin 'azwaajikum baneena wahafadat warazaqakum mminat-tayyibaati 'afabil baatil i yu'minoona wabini'matil laahi hum yakfuroon
Waya'budoona min doonil laahi maa laa yamliku lahum rizqa mminas-samaawaati wal ardi shaya wal aa yastatee'oon
Fal aa tadribu lil laahil amthaal a 'innal laaha ya'lamu waantum laa ta'lamoon

Darabal laahu mathal ana 'abda mmamlooka llaa yaqdiru 'al aa shay' wamar rrazaqnaahu minnaa rizqana hasana fahooa yunfiqu minhu sirra wajahrana hal yastawunal hamdu lil laahi bal 'aktharuhum laa ya'lamoon

Wadarabal laahu mathal a rrajul ayni 'ahaduhumaa 'abkamu laa yaqdiru 'al aa shay' wahooa kal lun 'al aa mawlaahu 'aynamaa yooajjihhhu laa yati bikhayrin hal yastawee hooa wamany yamuru bil'adli wahooa 'al aa siraat mmustaqeem
Wal il laahi ghaybus-samaawaati wal ardi wamaa 'amrus-saa'ati 'il laa kal amhil basari 'aw hooa 'aqrabu 'innal laaha 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
Wal laahu 'akhrajakum mmim butooni 'ummahaatikum laa ta'lamoona shaya waja'al a lakumus-sam'a wal absaara wal afidata la'al lakum tashkuroon
'al am yarawa 'il aat-tayri musakhkharaat fee jawwis-samaa'i maa yumsikuhunna 'il laal laahu 'inna fee zaal ika layaat lliqawm yu'minoon

Wal laahu ja'al a lakum mmim buyootikum sakana waja'al a lakum mmin jul oodil an'aami buyoota tastakhiffoonahaa yawma za'nikum wayawma 'iqaamatikum wamin 'aswaafihaa waawbaarihaa waash'aarihaa 'athaatha wamataa'ana 'il aa heen

Wal laahu ja'al a lakum mmimmaa khal aqa zil aal a waja'al a lakum mminal jibaal i 'aknaana waja'al a lakum saraabeela taqeekumul harra wasaraabeela taqeekum basakum kazaal ika yutimmu ni'matahu 'al aykum la'al lakum tuslimoon
Fain tawal lawa fainnamaa 'al aykal bal aaghul mubeen
Ya'rifoona ni'matal laahi thumma yunkiroonahaa waaktharuhumul kaafiroon
Wayawma nab'athu min kul li 'ummat shaheeda thumma laa yu'zanu lil lazeena kafaru wal aa hum yusta'taboon
Waizaa ra'aal lazeena zal amul'azaaba fal aa yukhaffafu 'anhum wal aa hum yunzaroon
Waizaa ra'aal lazeena 'ashraku shurakaa'ahum qaal u rabbanaa haa'ul aa'i shurakaa'unaal lazeena kunnaa nad'u min doonika faal qawa 'il ayhimul qawla 'innakum lakaaziboon
Waal qawa 'il aal laahi yawma'izin as-sal ama wadal la 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaftaroon
Al lazeena kafaru wasaddu 'an sabeelil laahi zidnaahum 'azaaba fawqal'azaabi bimaa kaanu yufsidoon

Wayawma nab'athu fee kul li 'ummat shaheedana 'al ayhim mmin 'anfusihim waji'naa bika shaheedana 'al aa haa'ul aa'i wanazzal naa 'al aykal kitaaba tibyaana llikul li shay' wahuda warahmat wabushraa lil muslimeen
'innal laaha yamuru bil'adli wal ihsaani waeetayi zee al qurbaa wayanhaa 'anil fahshaa'i wal munkari wal baghyi ya'izukum la'al lakum tazakkaroon
Waawfu bi'ahdil laahi 'izaa 'aahadttum wal aa tanqudul aymaana ba'da tawkeedihaa waqad ja'al tumul laaha 'al aykum kafeelana 'innal laaha ya'lamu maa taf'al oon

Wal aa takoonu kal latee naqadat ghazlahaa mim ba'di qoowatin 'ankaatha tattakhizoona 'aymaanakum dakhal aa baynakum 'an takoona 'ummatun heea 'arbaa min 'ummatin 'innamaa yablookumul laahu bihi wal ayubayyinanna lakum yawmal qeeaamati maa kuntum feehi takhtal ifoon
Wal aw shaa'al laahu laja'al akum 'ummat waahidat wal aakiny yudil lu many yashaa'u wayahdee many yashaa'u wal atusal unna 'ammaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Wal aa tattakhizooaa 'aymaanakum dakhal aa baynakum fatazil la qadamu ba'da thubootihaa watazooqus-sooaa'a bimaa sadadttum 'an sabeelil laahi wal akum 'azaabun 'azeem
Wal aa tashtaru bi'ahdil laahi thamana qal eelana 'innamaa 'indal laahi hooa khayr llakum 'in kuntum ta'lamoon
Maa 'indakum yanfadu wamaa 'indal laahi baaq wal anajzeeannal lazeena sabarooaa 'ajrahum biahsani maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Man 'amil a saal iha mmin zakarin 'aw 'unthaa wahooa mu'min fal anuhyeeannahu hayawaat tayyibat wal anajzeeannahum 'ajrahum biahsani maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Faizaa qaratal qur'aana fasta'iz bil laahi minash-shaytaanir-rajeem
'innahu laysa lahu sul taanun 'al aal lazeena 'aamanu wa'al aa rabbihim yatawakkal oon
'innamaa sul taanuhu 'al aal lazeena yatawal lawnahu wal lazeena hum bihi mushrikoon
Waizaa baddal naa 'ayat mmakaana 'ayat wal laahu 'a'lamu bimaa yunazzil u qaal ooaa 'innamaa 'anta muftari bal 'aktharuhum laa ya'lamoon
Qul nazzal ahu roohul qudusi mir rrabbika bil haqqi leeuthabbital lazeena 'aamanu wahuda wabushraa lil muslimeen
Wal aqad na'lamu 'annahum yaqooloona 'innamaa yu'al limuhu bashar llisaanul lazee yul hidoona 'il ayhi 'a'jameey wahaazaa lisaanun 'arabeey mmubeen
'innal lazeena laa yu'minoona biayaatil laahi laa yahdeehimul laahu wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eem
'innamaa yaftaree al kazibal lazeena laa yu'minoona biayaatil laahi waul aa'ika humul kaaziboon
Man kafara bil laahi mim ba'di 'eemaanihiaa 'il laa man 'ukriha waqal buhu mutma'innu bil eemaani wal aakim mman sharaha bil kufri sadra fa'al ayhim ghadab mminal laahi wal ahum 'azaabun 'azeem
Zaal ika biannahumustahabbul hayawaatad-dunyaa 'al aal aakhirati waannal laaha laa yahdee al qawmal kaafireen
'ul aa'ikal lazeena taba'al laahu 'al aa qul oobihim wasam'ihim waabsaarihim waul aa'ika humul ghaafil oon
Laa jarama 'annahum fee al aakhirati humul khaasiroon
Thumma 'inna rabbaka lil lazeena haajaru mim ba'di maa futinu thumma jaahadu wasabarooaa 'inna rabbaka mim ba'dihaa laghafoor rraheem
Yawma tatee kul lu nafs tujaadil u 'an nnafsihaa watooaffaa kul lu nafs mmaa 'amil at wahum laa yuzlamoon
Wadarabal laahu mathal a qaryat kaanat 'aaminat mmutma'innat yateehaa rizquhaa raghada mmin kul li makaan fakafarat bian'umil laahi faazaaqahaal laahu libaasal joo'i wal khawfi bimaa kaanu yasna'oon
Wal aqad jaa'ahum rasool mminhum fakazzaboohu faakhazahumul'azaabu wahum zaal imoon
Fakul u mimmaa razaqakumul laahu hal aal a tayyiba washkuru ni'matal laahi 'in kuntum 'iyyaahu ta'budoon
'innamaa harrama 'al aykumul maytata wad-dama wal ahmal khinzeeri wamaa 'uhil la lighayril laahi bihi famanidturra ghayra baagh wal aa 'aad fainnal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Wal aa taqoolu limaa tasifu 'al sinatukumul kaziba haazaa hal aal wahaazaa haraam llitaftaru 'al aal laahil kaziba 'innal lazeena yaftaroona 'al aal laahil kaziba laa yuflihoon
Mataa' qal eel wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Wa'al aal lazeena haadu harramnaa maa qasasnaa 'al ayka min qablu wamaa zal amnaahum wal aakin kaanooaa 'anfusahum yazlimoon
Thumma 'inna rabbaka lil lazeena 'amil us-sooaa'a bijahaal at thumma taabu mim ba'di zaal ika waaslahooaa 'inna rabbaka mim ba'dihaa laghafoor rraheem
'inna 'ibraaheema kaana 'ummat qaanita llil laahi haneefa wal am yaku minal mushrikeen
Shaakira llian'umihijtabaahu wahadaahu 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem
Wa'aataynaahu fee ad-dunyaa hasanat wainnahu fee al aakhirati laminas-saal iheen
Thumma 'awhaynaa 'il ayka 'anittabi' mil lata 'ibraaheema haneefa wamaa kaana minal mushrikeen
'innamaa ju'il as-sabtu 'al aal lazeenakhtal afu feehi wainna rabbaka layahkumu baynahum yawmal qeeaamati feemaa kaanu feehi yakhtal ifoon
Ad'u 'il aa sabeeli rabbika bil hikmati wal maw'izatil hasanati wajaadil hum bil latee heea 'ahsanu 'inna rabbaka hooa 'a'lamu biman dal la 'an sabeelihi wahooa 'a'lamu bil muhtadeen
Wain 'aaqabtum fa'aaqibu bimithli maa 'ooqibtum bihi wal a'in sabartum lahooa khayr llis-saabireen
Wasbir wamaa sabruka 'il laa bil laahi wal aa tahzan 'al ayhim wal aa taku fee dayq mmimmaa yamkuroon
'innal laaha ma'al lazeenattaqa wwal lazeena hum mmuhsinoon
Subhaanal lazeeaa 'asraa bi'abdihi layla mminal masjidil haraami 'il aal masjidil aqsaal lazee baaraknaa hawlahu linureeahu min 'ayaatinaa 'innahu hooas-samee'ul baseer
Wa'aataynaa moosaal kitaaba waja'al naahu huda llibaneeaa 'israa'eela 'al laa tattakhizu min doonee wakeel
Zurriyyata man hamal naa ma'a noohin 'innahu kaana 'abda shakoor
Waqadaynaa 'il aa baneeaa 'israa'eela fee al kitaabi latufsidunna fee al ardi marratayni wal ata'lunna 'ul oowa kabeer
Faizaa jaa'a wa'du 'oolaahumaa ba'athnaa 'al aykum 'ibaada llanaa 'oolee bas shadeed fajaasu khil aal ad-deeaari wakaana wa'da mmaf'ool
Thumma radadnaa lakumul karrata 'al ayhim waamdadnaakum biamwaal wabaneena waja'al naakum 'akthara nafeeran

'in 'ahsantum 'ahsantum lianfusikum wain 'asatum fal ahaa faizaa jaa'a wa'dul aakhirati leeasuu wujoohakum wal eeadkhul ul masjida kamaa dakhal oohu 'awwal a marrat wal eeutabbiru maa 'al awa tatbeeran
'asaa rabbukum 'any yarhamakum wain 'udttum 'udnaa waja'al naa jahannama lil kaafireena haseeran
'inna haazaal qur'aana yahdee lil latee heea 'aqwamu wayubashshirul mu'mineenal lazeena ya'mal oonas-saal ihaati 'anna lahum 'ajra kabeer
Waannal lazeena laa yu'minoona bil aakhirati 'a'tadnaa lahum 'azaabana 'al eem
Wayad'ul insaanu bish-sharri du'aa'ahu bil khayri wakaanal insaanu 'ajool

Waja'al naal layla wan-nahaara 'ayatayni famahawnaa 'ayatal layli waja'al naa 'ayatan-nahaari mubsirat llitabtaghu fadla mmir rrabbikum wal ita'lamu 'adadas-sineena wal hisaaba wakul la shay' fassal naahu tafseel
Wakul la 'insaanin 'al zamnaahu taa'irahu fee 'unuqihi wanukhriju lahu yawmal qeeaamati kitaaba yal qaahu manshooran
Aqra kitaabaka kafaa binafsikal yawma 'al ayka haseeb
Mmanihtadaa fainnamaa yahtadee linafsihi waman dal la fainnamaa yadil lu 'al ayhaa wal aa taziru waazirat wizra 'ukhraa wamaa kunnaa mu'azzibeena hattaa nab'atha rasool
Waizaa 'aradnaa 'an nnuhlika qaryatan 'amarnaa mutrafeehaa fafasaqu feehaa fahaqqa 'al ayhaal qawlu fadammarnaahaa tadmeer
Wakam 'ahlaknaa minal qurooni mim ba'di nooh wakafaa birabbika bizunoobi 'ibaadihi khabeeraa baseer
Mman kaana yureedul'aajil ata 'ajjal naa lahu feehaa maa nashaa'u liman nnureedu thumma ja'al naa lahu jahannama yaslaahaa mazmooma mmadhoor
Waman 'araadal aakhirata wasa'aa lahaa sa'yahaa wahooa mu'min faul aa'ika kaana sa'yuhum mmashkoor
Kul la nnumiddu haa'ul aa'i wahaa'ul aa'i min 'ataa'i rabbika wamaa kaana 'ataa'u rabbika mahzooran
Anzur kayfa faddal naa ba'dahum 'al aa ba'd wal al aakhiratu 'akbaru darajaat waakbaru tafdeel
Llaa taj'al ma'al laahi 'il aahana 'aakhara fataq'uda mazmooma mmakhzool

Waqadaa rabbuka 'al laa ta'budooaa 'il laa 'iyyaahu wabil waal idayni 'ihsaanana 'immaa yablughanna 'indakal kibara 'ahaduhumaa 'aw kil aahumaa fal aa taqul-laahumaa 'uff wal aa tanharhumaa waqul-laahumaa qawla kareem
Wakhfid lahumaa janaahaz-zul li minar-rahmati waqur-rabbirhamhumaa kamaa rabbayaanee sagheer
Rrabbukum 'a'lamu bimaa fee nufoosikum 'in takoonu saal iheena fainnahu kaana lil awwaabeena ghafoor
Wa'aati zaal qurbaa haqqahu wal miskeena wabnas-sabeeli wal aa tubazzir tabzeeran
'innal mubazzireena kaanooaa 'ikhwaanash-shayaateeni wakaanash-shaytaanu lirabbihi kafoor
Waimmaa tu'ridanna 'anhumubtighaa'a rahmat mmir rrabbika tarjoohaa faqul-laahum qawla mmaysoor
Wal aa taj'al yadaka maghloolatan 'il aa 'unuqika wal aa tabsuthaa kul lal basti fataq'uda mal ooma mmahsooran
'inna rabbaka yabsutur-rizqa limany yashaa'u wayaqdiru 'innahu kaana bi'ibaadihi khabeeraa baseer
Wal aa taqtul ooaa 'awlaadakum khashyata 'imlaaq nnahnu narzuquhum waiyyaakum 'inna qatlahum kaana khita kabeer
Wal aa taqrabuz-zinaa 'innahu kaana faahishat wasaa'a sabeel
Wal aa taqtul un-nafsal latee harramal laahu 'il laa bil haqqi waman qutil a mazlooma faqad ja'al naa liwal eeyihi sul taana fal aa yusrif ffee al qatli 'innahu kaana mansoor
Wal aa taqrabu maal al yateemi 'il laa bil latee heea 'ahsanu hattaa yablugha 'ashuddahu waawfu bil'ahdi 'innal'ahda kaana masool
Waawful kayla 'izaa kil tum wazinu bil qistaasil mustaqeemi zaal ika khayr waahsanu taweel
Wal aa taqfu maa laysa laka bihi 'il mun 'innas-sam'a wal basara wal fu'aada kul lu 'ul aa'ika kaana 'anhu masool
Wal aa tamshi fee al ardi marahana 'innaka lan takhriqal arda wal an tablughal jibaal a tool
Kul lu zaal ika kaana sayyi'uhu 'inda rabbika makrooh
Zaal ika mimmaa 'awhaa 'il ayka rabbuka minal hikmati wal aa taj'al ma'al laahi 'il aahana 'aakhara fatul qaa fee jahannama mal ooma mmadhooran
'afaasfaakum rabbukum bil baneena wattakhaza minal mal aa'ikati 'inaathana 'innakum lataqooloona qawlana 'azeem
Wal aqad sarrafnaa fee haazaal qur'aani leeazzakkaru wamaa yazeeduhum 'il laa nufoor
Qul-law kaana ma'ahuaa 'aal ihat kamaa yaqooloona 'iza llabtaghawa 'il aa zee al'arshi sabeel
Subhaanahu wata'aal aa 'ammaa yaqooloona 'ul oowa kabeer
Tusabbihu lahus-samaawaatus-sab'u wal ardu waman feehinna waim mmin shay'in 'il laa yusabbihu bihamdihi wal aakil llaa tafqahoona tasbeehahum 'innahu kaana hal eemana ghafoor
Waizaa qaratal qur'aana ja'al naa baynaka wabaynal lazeena laa yu'minoona bil aakhirati hijaaba mmastoor
Waja'al naa 'al aa qul oobihim 'akinnatan 'any yafqahoohu wafeeaa 'aazaanihim waqra waizaa zakarta rabbaka fee al qur'aani wahdahu wal lawa 'al aa 'adbaarihim nufoor
Nnahnu 'a'lamu bimaa yastami'oona bihiaa 'iz yastami'oona 'il ayka waiz hum najwaa 'iz yaqooluz-zaal imoona 'in tattabi'oona 'il laa rajul a mmashooran
Anzur kayfa darabu lakal amthaal a fadal lu fal aa yastatee'oona sabeel
Waqaal ooaa 'a'izaa kunnaa 'izaama warufaatana 'a'innaa lamab'oothoona khal qa jadeed
Qul koonu hijaaratan 'aw hadeedan

'aw khal qa mmimmaa yakburu fee sudoorikum fasayaqooloona many yu'eedunaa qul il lazee fatarakum 'awwal a marrat fasayunghidoona 'il ayka ru'oosahum wayaqooloona mataa hooa qul 'asaa 'any yakoona qareeb
Yawma yad'ookum fatastajeeboona bihamdihi watazunnoona 'il llabithtum 'il laa qal eel
Waqul-li'ibaadee yaqoolul latee heea 'ahsanu 'innash-shaytaana yanzaghu baynahum 'innash-shaytaana kaana lil insaani 'adoowa mmubeen
Rrabbukum 'a'lamu bikum 'iny yasha yarhamkum 'aw 'iny yasha yu'azzibkum wamaa 'arsal naaka 'al ayhim wakeel
Warabbuka 'a'lamu biman fee as-samaawaati wal ardi wal aqad faddal naa ba'dan-nabeeyina 'al aa ba'd wa'aataynaa daawuda zaboor
Qul id'ul lazeena za'amtum mmin doonihi fal aa yamlikoona kashfad-durri 'ankum wal aa tahweelan
'ul aa'ikal lazeena yad'oona yabtaghoona 'il aa rabbihimul waseelata 'ayyuhum 'aqrabu wayarjoona rahmatahu wayakhaafoona 'azaabahuaa 'inna 'azaaba rabbika kaana mahzoor
Waim mmin qaryatin 'il laa nahnu muhlikoohaa qabla yawmil qeeaamati 'aw mu'azziboohaa 'azaaba shadeeda kaana zaal ika fee al kitaabi mastoor
Wamaa mana'anaa 'an nnursil a bil ayaati 'il laa 'an kazzaba bihaal awwal oona wa'aataynaa thamoodan-naaqata mubsirat fazal amu bihaa wamaa nursil u bil ayaati 'il laa takhweef

Waiz qul naa laka 'inna rabbaka 'ahaata bin-naasi wamaa ja'al naar-ru'yaal lateeaa 'araynaaka 'il laa fitnat llin-naasi wash-shajaratal mal'oonata fee al qur'aani wanukhawwifuhum famaa yazeeduhum 'il laa tughyaana kabeer
Waiz qul naa lil mal aa'ikatisjudu liaadama fasajadooaa 'il laa 'ibleesa qaal a 'aasjudu liman khal aqta teen
Qaal a 'ara'aytaka haazaal lazee karramta 'al ayya la'in 'akhkhartani 'il aa yawmil qeeaamati laahtanikanna zurriyyatahuaa 'il laa qal eel
Qaal azhab faman tabi'aka minhum fainna jahannama jazaa'ukum jazaa' mmawfoor
Wastafziz manistata'ta minhum bisawtika waajlib 'al ayhim bikhaylika warajil ika washaarikhum fee al amwaal i wal awlaadi wa'idhum wamaa ya'iduhumush-shaytaanu 'il laa ghurooran
'inna 'ibaadee laysa laka 'al ayhim sul taanw wakafaa birabbika wakeel
Rrabbukumul lazee yuzjee lakumul ful ka fee al bahri litabtaghu min fadlihiaa 'innahu kaana bikum raheem
Waizaa massakumud-durru fee al bahri dal la man tad'oona 'il laa 'iyyaahu fal ammaa najjaakum 'il aal barri 'a'radtum wakaanal insaanu kafooran
'afaamintum 'any yakhsifa bikum jaanibal barri 'aw yursil a 'al aykum haasiba thumma laa tajidu lakum wakeelan
'am 'amintum 'any yu'eedakum feehi taaratan 'ukhraa fayursil a 'al aykum qaasifa mminar-reehi fayughriqakum bimaa kafartum thumma laa tajidu lakum 'al aynaa bihi tabee'
Wal aqad karramnaa baneeaa 'aadama wahamal naahum fee al barri wal bahri warazaqnaahum mminat-tayyibaati wafaddal naahum 'al aa katheer mmimman khal aqnaa tafdeel
Yawma nad'u kul la 'unaasi biimaamihim faman 'ooteea kitaabahu beeameenihi faul aa'ika yaqra'oona kitaabahum wal aa yuzlamoona fateel
Waman kaana fee haazihiaa 'a'maa fahooa fee al aakhirati 'a'maa waadal lu sabeel
Wain kaadu layaftinoonaka 'anil lazeeaa 'awhaynaa 'il ayka litaftareea 'al aynaa ghayrahu waiza llattakhazooka khal eel
Wal awlaa 'an thabbatnaaka laqad kidtta tarkanu 'il ayhim shaya qal eelan
'iza llaazaqnaaka di'fal hayawaati wadi'fal mamaati thumma laa tajidu laka 'al aynaa naseer
Wain kaadu layastafizzoonaka minal ardi leeukhrijooka minhaa waiza llaa yal bathoona khil aafaka 'il laa qal eel
Sunnata man qad 'arsal naa qablaka mir rrusul inaa wal aa tajidu lisunnatinaa tahweelan
'aqimis-sal aata lidul ookish-shamsi 'il aa ghasaqil layli waqur'aanal fajri 'inna qur'aanal fajri kaana mashhood
Waminal layli fatahajjad bihi naafil at llaka 'asaa 'any yab'athaka rabbuka maqaama mmahmood
Waqur-rabbi 'adkhil nee mudkhal a sidq waakhrijnee mukhraja sidq waj'al-lee mil lladunka sul taana nnaseer
Waqul jaa'al haqqu wazahaqal baatil u 'innal baatil a kaana zahooq
Wanunazzil u minal qur'aani maa hooa shifaa' warahmat llil mu'mineena wal aa yazeeduz-zaal imeena 'il laa khasaar
Waizaa 'an'amnaa 'al aal insaani 'a'rada wanaa bijaanibihi waizaa massahush-sharru kaana yaoos
Qul kul l ya'mal u 'al aa shaakil atihi farabbukum 'a'lamu biman hooa 'ahdaa sabeel
Wayasal oonaka 'anir-roohi qul ir-roohu min 'amri rabbee wamaa 'ooteetum mminal'il mi 'il laa qal eel
Wal a'in shi'naa lanazhabanna bil lazeeaa 'awhaynaa 'il ayka thumma laa tajidu laka bihi 'al aynaa wakeelan
'il laa rahmat mmir rrabbika 'inna fadlahu kaana 'al ayka kabeer
Qul-la'inijtama'atil insu wal jinnu 'al aa 'any yatu bimithli haazaal qur'aani laa yatoona bimithlihi wal aw kaana ba'duhum liba'd zaheer
Wal aqad sarrafnaa lin-naasi fee haazaal qur'aani min kul li mathal faabaa 'aktharun-naasi 'il laa kufoor
Waqaal u lan nnu'mina laka hattaa tafjura lanaa minal ardi yanboo'an
'aw takoona laka jannat mmin nnakheel wa'inab fatufajjiral anhaara khil aal ahaa tafjeeran
'aw tusqitas-samaa'a kamaa za'amta 'al aynaa kisafana 'aw tateea bil laahi wal mal aa'ikati qabeelan
'aw yakoona laka bayt mmin zukhrufin 'aw tarqaa fee as-samaa'i wal an nnu'mina liruqeeyika hattaa tunazzil a 'al aynaa kitaaba nnaqra'uhu qul subhaana rabbee hal kuntu 'il laa bashara rrasool
Wamaa mana'an-naasa 'any yu'minooaa 'iz jaa'ahumul hudaa 'il laa 'an qaal ooaa 'aba'athal laahu bashara rrasool
Qul-law kaana fee al ardi mal aa'ikat yamshoona mutma'inneena lanazzal naa 'al ayhim mminas-samaa'i mal aka rrasool
Qul kafaa bil laahi shaheedaa baynee wabaynakum 'innahu kaana bi'ibaadihi khabeeraa baseer

Wamany yahdil laahu fahooal muhtadi wamany yudlil fal an tajida lahum 'awleeaa'a min doonihi wanahshuruhum yawmal qeeaamati 'al aa wujoohihim 'umya wabukma wasumma mmawaahum jahannamu kul lamaa khabat zidnaahum sa'eer
Zaal ika jazaa'uhum biannahum kafaru biayaatinaa waqaal ooaa 'a'izaa kunnaa 'izaama warufaatana 'a'innaa lamab'oothoona khal qa jadeedan
'awal am yarawa 'annal laahal lazee khal aqas-samaawaati wal arda qaadirun 'al aa 'any yakhluqa mithlahum waja'al a lahum 'ajal a llaa rayba feehi faabaaz-zaal imoona 'il laa kufoor
Qul-law 'antum tamlikoona khazaa'ina rahmati rabbeeaa 'iza llaamsaktum khashyatal infaaqi wakaanal insaanu qatoor
Wal aqad 'aataynaa moosaa tis'a 'ayaati bayyinaat fasal baneeaa 'israa'eela 'iz jaa'ahum faqaal a lahu fir'awnu 'innee laazunnuka yaamoosaa mashoor
Qaal a laqad 'al imta maa 'anzal a haa'ul aa'i 'il laa rabbus-samaawaati wal ardi basaa'ira wainnee laazunnuka yaafir'awnu mathboor
Faaraada 'any yastafizzahum mminal ardi faaghraqnaahu wamam mma'ahu jamee'
Waqul naa mim ba'dihi libaneeaa 'israa'eelaskunul arda faizaa jaa'a wa'dul aakhirati ji'naa bikum lafeef
Wabil haqqi 'anzal naahu wabil haqqi nazal a wamaa 'arsal naaka 'il laa mubashshira wanazeer
Waqur'aana faraqnaahu litaqraahu 'al aan-naasi 'al aa mukth wanazzal naahu tanzeel
Qul 'aaminu bihiaa 'aw laa tu'minooaa 'innal lazeena 'ootul'il ma min qablihiaa 'izaa yutlaa 'al ayhim yakhirroona lil azqaani sujjad
Wayaqooloona subhaana rabbinaa 'in kaana wa'du rabbinaa lamaf'ool
Wayakhirroona lil azqaani yabkoona wayazeeduhum khushoo'
Qul id'ul laaha 'awid'ur-rahmaana 'ayya mmaa tad'u fal ahul asmaa'ul husnaa wal aa tajhar bisal aatika wal aa tukhaafit bihaa wabtaghi bayna zaal ika sabeel
Waqul il hamdu lil laahil lazee lam yattakhiz wal ada wal am yakul llaahu shareek fee al mul ki wal am yakul llaahu wal eey mminaz-zul li wakabbirhu takbeera
Al hamdu lil laahil lazeeaa 'anzal a 'al aa 'abdihil kitaaba wal am yaj'al-laahu 'iwaja
Qayyima lleeunzira basa shadeeda mmil lladunhu wayubashshiral mu'mineenal lazeena ya'mal oonas-saal ihaati 'anna lahum 'ajrana hasan
Mmaakitheena feehi 'abad
Wayunziral lazeena qaal uttakhazal laahu wal ad
Mmaa lahum bihi min 'il m wal aa liaabaa'ihim kaburat kal imat takhruju min 'afwaahihim 'iny yaqooloona 'il laa kazib
Fal a'al laka baakhi' nnafsaka 'al aa 'aathaarihim 'il llam yu'minu bihaazaal hadeethi 'asafan
'innaa ja'al naa maa 'al aal ardi zeenat llaahaa linablooahum 'ayyuhum 'ahsanu 'amal
Wainnaa lajaa'il oona maa 'al ayhaa sa'eeda juruzan
'am hasibta 'anna 'ashaabal kahfi war-raqeemi kaanu min 'ayaatinaa 'ajaban
'iz 'awaal fityatu 'il aal kahfi faqaal u rabbanaa 'aatinaa mil lladunka rahmat wahayyi' lanaa min 'amrinaa rashad
Fadarabnaa 'al aa 'aazaanihim fee al kahfi sineena 'adad
Thumma ba'athnaahum lina'lama 'ayyul hizbayni 'ahsaa limaa labithooaa 'amad
Nnahnu naqussu 'al ayka nabaahum bil haqqi 'innahum fityatun 'aamanu birabbihim wazidnaahum hud
Warabatnaa 'al aa qul oobihim 'iz qaamu faqaal u rabbunaa rabbus-samaawaati wal ardi lan nnad'ooaa min doonihiaa 'il aaha llaqad qul naa 'iza shatatan
Haa'ul aa'i qawmunaattakhazu min doonihiaa 'aal ihat llawlaa yatoona 'al ayhim bisul taani bayyin faman 'azlamu mimmaniftaraa 'al aal laahi kazib
Waizi'tazal tumoohum wamaa ya'budoona 'il laal laaha fawuaa 'il aal kahfi yanshur lakum rabbukum mmir rrahmatihi wayuhayyi' lakum mmin 'amrikum mmirfaq

Wataraash-shamsa 'izaa tal a'at ttazaawaru 'an kahfihim zaatal yameeni waizaa gharabat ttaqriduhum zaatash-shimaal i wahum fee fajwat mminhu zaal ika min 'ayaatil laahi many yahdil laahu fahooal muhtadi wamany yudlil fal an tajida lahu wal iyya mmurshid

Watahsabuhum 'ayqaaza wahum ruqood wanuqal libuhum zaatal yameeni wazaatash-shimaal i wakal buhum baasit ziraa'ayhi bil waseedi lawittal a'ta 'al ayhim lawal layta minhum firaara wal amul i'ta minhum ru'b

Wakazaal ika ba'athnaahum leeatasaa'al u baynahum qaal a qaa'il mminhum kam labithtum qaal u labithnaa yawmana 'aw ba'da yawm qaal u rabbukum 'a'lamu bimaa labithtum fab'athooaa 'ahadakum biwariqikum haazihiaa 'il aal madeenati fal yanzur 'ayyuhaa 'azkaa ta'aama fal yatikum birizq mminhu wal yatal attaf wal aa yush'iranna bikum 'ahadan
'innahum 'iny yazharu 'al aykum yarjumookum 'aw yu'eedookum fee mil latihim wal an tuflihooaa 'izana 'abad

Wakazaal ika 'a'tharnaa 'al ayhim leea'lamooaa 'anna wa'dal laahi haqq waannas-saa'ata laa rayba feehaa 'iz yatanaaza'oona baynahum 'amrahum faqaal ubnu 'al ayhim bunyaana rrabbuhum 'a'lamu bihim qaal al lazeena ghal abu 'al aa 'amrihim lanattakhizanna 'al ayhim mmasjid

Sayaqooloona thal aathat rraabi'uhum kal buhum wayaqooloona khamsat saadisuhum kal buhum rajmaa bil ghaybi wayaqooloona sab'at wathaaminuhum kal buhum qur-rabbeeaa 'a'lamu bi'iddatihim mmaa ya'lamuhum 'il laa qal eel fal aa tumaari feehim 'il laa miraa' zaahira wal aa tastafti feehim mminhum 'ahad
Wal aa taqoolanna lishay'in 'innee faa'il zaal ika ghadan
'il laa 'any yashaa'al laahu wazkur rrabbaka 'izaa naseeta waqul 'asaa 'any yahdeeani rabbee liaqraba min haazaa rashad
Wal abithu fee kahfihim thal aatha mi'at sineena wazdaadu tis'
Qul il laahu 'a'lamu bimaa labithu lahu ghaybus-samaawaati wal ardi 'absir bihi waasmi' maa lahum mmin doonihi minw wal eey wal aa yushriku fee hukmihiaa 'ahad
Watlu maa 'ooheea 'il ayka min kitaabi rabbika laa mubaddil a likal imaatihi wal an tajida min doonihi mul tahad

Wasbir nafsaka ma'al lazeena yad'oona rabbahum bil ghadawaati wal'asheeyi yureedoona wajhahu wal aa ta'du 'aynaaka 'anhum tureedu zeenatal hayawaatid-dunyaa wal aa tuti' man 'aghfal naa qal bahu 'an zikrinaa wattaba'a hawaahu wakaana 'amruhu furuh

Waqul il haqqu mir rrabbikum faman shaa'a fal yu'minw waman shaa'a fal yakfur 'innaa 'a'tadnaa liz-zaal imeena naarana 'ahaata bihim suraadiquhaa wainy yastagheethu yughaathu bimaa' kal muhli yashwee al wujooha bi'sash-sharaabu wasaa'at murtafaqan
'innal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati 'innaa laa nudee'u 'ajra man 'ahsana 'amal an

'ul aa'ika lahum jannaatu 'adn tajree min tahtihimul anhaaru yuhal lawna feehaa min 'asaawira min zahab wayal basoona theeaabana khudra mmin sundus waistabraq mmuttakieena feehaa 'al aal araa'iki ni'math-thawaabu wahasunat murtafaq
Wadrib lahum mmathal a rrajul ayni ja'al naa liahadihimaa jannatayni min 'a'naab wahafafnaahumaa binakhl waja'al naa baynahumaa zar'
Kil taal jannatayni 'aatat 'ukul ahaa wal am tazlim mminhu shaya wafajjarnaa khil aal ahumaa nahar
Wakaana lahu thamar faqaal a lisaahibihi wahooa yuhaawiruhuaa 'anaa 'aktharu minka maal a waa'azzu nafar
Wadakhal a jannatahu wahooa zaal im llinafsihi qaal a maa 'azunnu 'an tabeeda haazihiaa 'abad
Wamaa 'azunnus-saa'ata qaa'imat wal a'ir rrudidttu 'il aa rabbee laajidanna khayra mminhaa munqal ab
Qaal a lahu saahibuhu wahooa yuhaawiruhuaa 'akafarta bil lazee khal aqaka min turaab thumma min nnutfat thumma sawwaaka rajul
Llaakinnaa hooal laahu rabbee wal aa 'ushriku birabbeeaa 'ahad
Wal awlaa 'iz dakhal ta jannataka qul ta maa shaa'al laahu laa qoowata 'il laa bil laahi 'in tarani 'anaa 'aqal la minka maal a wawal ad
Fa'asaa rabbeeaa 'any yu'teeani khayra mmin jannatika wayursil a 'al ayhaa husbaana mminas-samaa'i fatusbiha sa'eeda zal aqan
'aw yusbiha maa'uhaa ghawra fal an tastatee'a lahu tal ab
Wauheeta bithamarihi faasbaha yuqal libu kaffayhi 'al aa maa 'anfaqa feehaa waheea khaaweeatun 'al aa 'urooshihaa wayaqoolu yaal aytanee lam 'ushrik birabbeeaa 'ahad
Wal am takul llaahu fi'at yansuroonahu min doonil laahi wamaa kaana muntasiran
Hunaal ikal wal ayatu lil laahil haqqi hooa khayr thawaaba wakhayrun 'uqb
Wadrib lahum mmathal al hayawaatid-dunyaa kamaa'in 'anzal naahu minas-samaa'i fakhtal ata bihi nabaatul ardi faasbaha hasheema tazroohur-reeaahu wakaanal laahu 'al aa kul li shay' mmuqtadiran
Al maal u wal banoona zeenatul hayawaatid-dunyaa wal baaqeeaatus-saal ihaatu khayrun 'inda rabbika thawaaba wakhayrun 'amal
Wayawma nusayyirul jibaal a wataraal arda baarizat wahasharnaahum fal am nughaadir minhum 'ahad
Wa'uridu 'al aa rabbika saffa llaqad ji'tumoonaa kamaa khal aqnaakum 'awwal a marrati bal za'amtum 'al lan nnaj'al a lakum mmaw'id

Wawudi'al kitaabu fataraal mujrimeena mushfiqeena mimmaa feehi wayaqooloona yaawaylatanaa maal i haazaal kitaabi laa yughaadiru sagheerat wal aa kabeeratan 'il laa 'ahsaahaa wawajadu maa 'amil u haadira wal aa yazlimu rabbuka 'ahad

Waiz qul naa lil mal aa'ikatisjudu liaadama fasajadooaa 'il laa 'ibleesa kaana minal jinni fafasaqa 'an 'amri rabbihiaa 'afatattakhizoonahu wazurriyyatahuaa 'awleeaa'a min doonee wahum lakum 'adoowu bi'sa liz-zaal imeena badal
Mmaa 'ashhadttuhum khal qas-samaawaati wal ardi wal aa khal qa 'anfusihim wamaa kuntu muttakhizal mudil leena 'adud
Wayawma yaqoolu naadu shurakaa'eeal lazeena za'amtum fada'awhum fal am yastajeebu lahum waja'al naa baynahum mmawbiq
Wara'aal mujrimoonan-naara fazannooaa 'annahum mmooaaqi'oohaa wal am yajidu 'anhaa masrif
Wal aqad sarrafnaa fee haazaal qur'aani lin-naasi min kul li mathal wakaanal insaanu 'akthara shay' jadal
Wamaa mana'an-naasa 'any yu'minooaa 'iz jaa'ahumul hudaa wayastaghfiru rabbahum 'il laa 'an tateeahum sunnatul awwal eena 'aw yateeahumul'azaabu qubul
Wamaa nursil ul mursal eena 'il laa mubashshireena wamunzireena wayujaadil ul lazeena kafaru bil baatil i leeudhidu bihil haqqa wattakhazooaa 'ayaatee wamaa 'unziru huzoo

Waman 'azlamu mimman zukkira biayaati rabbihi faa'rada 'anhaa wanaseea maa qaddamat yadaahu 'innaa ja'al naa 'al aa qul oobihim 'akinnatan 'any yafqahoohu wafeeaa 'aazaanihim waqra wain tad'uhum 'il aal hudaa fal any yahtadooaa 'izana 'abad
Warabbukal ghafooru zoo ar-rahmati law yu'aakhizuhum bimaa kasabu la'ajjal a lahumul'azaaba bal-laahum mmaw'id llany yajidu min doonihi maw'il
Watil kal quraa 'ahlaknaahum lammaa zal amu waja'al naa limahlikihim mmaw'id
Waiz qaal a moosaa lifataahu laa 'abrahu hattaa 'ablugha majma'al bahrayni 'aw 'amdeea huqub
Fal ammaa bal aghaa majma'a baynihimaa naseeaa hootahumaa fattakhaza sabeelahu fee al bahri sarab
Fal ammaa jaawazaa qaal a lifataahu 'aatinaa ghadaa'anaa laqad laqeenaa min safarinaa haazaa nasab
Qaal a 'ara'ayta 'iz 'awaynaa 'il aas-sakhrati fainnee naseetul hoota wamaa 'ansaaneehu 'il laash-shaytaanu 'an 'azkurahu wattakhaza sabeelahu fee al bahri 'ajab
Qaal a zaal ika maa kunnaa nabghi fartaddaa 'al aa 'aathaarihimaa qasas
Fawajadaa 'abda mmin 'ibaadinaa 'aataynaahu rahmat mmin 'indinaa wa'al lamnaahu mil lladunnaa 'il m
Qaal a lahu moosaa hal 'attabi'uka 'al aa 'an tu'al limani mimmaa 'ul limta rushd
Qaal a 'innaka lan tastatee'a ma'eea sabr
Wakayfa tasbiru 'al aa maa lam tuhit bihi khubr
Qaal a satajiduneeaa 'in shaa'al laahu saabira wal aa 'a'see laka 'amr
Qaal a fainittaba'tanee fal aa tasal nee 'an shay'in hattaa 'uhditha laka minhu zikr
Fantal aqaa hattaa 'izaa rakibaa fee as-safeenati kharaqahaa qaal a 'akharaqtahaa litughriqa 'ahlahaa laqad ji'ta shayana 'imr
