Qaal a 'al am 'aqul 'innaka lan tastatee'a ma'eea sabr
Qaal a laa tu'aakhiznee bimaa naseetu wal aa turhiqnee min 'amree 'usr
Fantal aqaa hattaa 'izaa laqeeaa ghul aama faqatal ahu qaal a 'aqatal ta nafsa zakiyyata bighayri nafs llaqad ji'ta shaya nnukr
Qaal a 'al am 'aqul-laka 'innaka lan tastatee'a ma'eea sabr
Qaal a 'in saal tuka 'an shay'i ba'dahaa fal aa tusaahibnee qad bal aghta mil lladunnee 'uzr
Fantal aqaa hattaa 'izaa 'atayaa 'ahla qaryatin astat'amaa 'ahlahaa faabawa 'any yudayyifoohumaa fawajadaa feehaa jidaara yureedu 'any yanqadda faaqaamahu qaal a law shi'ta lattakhazta 'al ayhi 'ajr
Qaal a haazaa firaaqu baynee wabaynika saunabbi'uka bitaweeli maa lam tastati' 'al ayhi sabran
'ammaas-safeenatu fakaanat limasaakeena ya'mal oona fee al bahri faaradttu 'an 'a'eebahaa wakaana waraa'ahum mmal ik yakhuzu kul la safeenatin ghasb
Waammaal ghul aamu fakaana 'abawaahu mu'minayni fakhasheenaa 'any yurhiqahumaa tughyaana wakufr
Faaradnaa 'any yubdil ahumaa rabbuhumaa khayra mminhu zakawaat waaqraba ruhm

Waammaal jidaaru fakaana lighul aamayni yateemayni fee al madeenati wakaana tahtahu kanz llaahumaa wakaana 'aboohumaa saal iha faaraada rabbuka 'any yablughaa 'ashuddahumaa wayastakhrijaa kanzahumaa rahmat mmir rrabbika wamaa fa'al tuhu 'an 'amree zaal ika taweelu maa lam tasti' 'al ayhi sabr
Wayasal oonaka 'an zee al qarnayni qul saatlu 'al aykum mminhu zikran
'innaa makkannaa lahu fee al ardi wa'aataynaahu min kul li shay' sabab
Faatba'a sababan
Hattaa 'izaa bal agha maghribash-shamsi wajadahaa taghrubu fee 'aynin hami'at wawajada 'indahaa qawma qul naa yaazaal qarnayni 'immaa 'an tu'azziba waimmaa 'an tattakhiza feehim husn
Qaal a 'ammaa man zal ama fasawfa nu'azzibuhu thumma yuraddu 'il aa rabbihi fayu'azzibuhu 'azaaba nnukr
Waammaa man 'aamana wa'amil a saal iha fal ahu jazaa'an al husnaa wasanaqoolu lahu min 'amrinaa yusr
Thumma 'atba'a sababan
Hattaa 'izaa bal agha matli'ash-shamsi wajadahaa tatlu'u 'al aa qawm llam naj'al-laahum mmin doonihaa sitr
Kazaal ika waqad 'ahatnaa bimaa ladayhi khubr

Laqad 'anzal naa 'il aykum kitaaba feehi zikrukum 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Wakam qasamnaa min qaryat kaanat zaal imat waanshanaa ba'dahaa qawmana 'aakhareen
Fal ammaa 'ahassu basanaa 'izaa hum mminhaa yarkudoon
Laa tarkudu warji'ooaa 'il aa maa 'utriftum feehi wamasaakinikum la'al lakum tusal oon
Qaal u yaawaylanaa 'innaa kunnaa zaal imeen

Wamaa khal aqnaas-samaa'a wal arda wamaa baynahumaa laa'ibeen
Law 'aradnaa 'an nnattakhiza lahwa llattakhaznaahu mil lladunnaa 'in kunnaa faa'il een

Wal ahu man fee as-samaawaati wal ardi waman 'indahu laa yastakbiroona 'an 'ibaadatihi wal aa yastahsiroon
Yusabbihoonal layla wan-nahaara laa yafturoon
'amittakhazooaa 'aal ihat mminal ardi hum yunshiroon
Law kaana feehimaa 'aal ihatun 'il laal laahu lafasadataa fasubhaanal laahi rabbil'arshi 'ammaa yasifoon
Laa yusal u 'ammaa yaf'al u wahum yusal oon

Wamaa 'arsal naa min qablika mir rrasoolin 'il laa nooheeaa 'il ayhi 'annahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa 'anaa fa'budoon
Waqaal uttakhazar-rahmaanu wal ada subhaanahu bal 'ibaad mmukramoon
Laa yasbiqoonahu bil qawli wahum biamrihi ya'mal oon
Ya'lamu maa bayna 'aydeehim wamaa khal fahum wal aa yashfa'oona 'il laa limanirtadaa wahum mmin khashyatihi mushfiqoon
Wamany yaqul minhum 'inneeaa 'il aah mmin doonihi fazaal ika najzeehi jahannama kazaal ika najzee az-zaal imeen
'awal am yaral lazeena kafarooaa 'annas-samaawaati wal arda kaanataa ratqa fafataqnaahumaa waja'al naa minal maa'i kul la shay'in hayyin 'afal aa yu'minoon
Waja'al naa fee al ardi rawaaseea 'an tameeda bihim waja'al naa feehaa fijaaja subul a lla'al laahum yahtadoon
Waja'al naas-samaa'a saqfa mmahfooza wahum 'an 'ayaatihaa mu'ridoon
Wahooal lazee khal aqal layla wan-nahaara wash-shamsa wal qamara kul l fee fal ak yasbahoon
Wamaa ja'al naa libashar mmin qablikal khul da 'afaeen mmitta fahumul khaal idoon
Kul lu nafs zaa'iqatul mawti wanablookum bish-sharri wal khayri fitnat wail aynaa turja'oon
Waizaa ra'aakal lazeena kafarooaa 'iny yattakhizoonaka 'il laa huzooana 'ahaazaal lazee yazkuru 'aal ihatakum wahum bizikrir-rahmaani hum kaafiroon
Khul iqal insaanu min 'ajal saooreekum 'ayaatee fal aa tasta'jil oon
Wayaqooloona mataa haazaal wa'du 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Law ya'lamul lazeena kafaru heena laa yakuffoona 'anw wujoohihimun-naara wal aa 'an zuhoorihim wal aa hum yunsaroon
Bal tateehim baghtat fatabhatuhum fal aa yastatee'oona raddahaa wal aa hum yunzaroon
Wal aqadistuhzi'a birusul mmin qablika fahaaqa bil lazeena sakhiru minhum mmaa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Qul many yakla'ukum bil layli wan-nahaari minar-rahmaani bal hum 'an zikri rabbihim mmu'ridoon
'am lahum 'aal ihat tamna'uhum mmin dooninaa laa yastatee'oona nasra 'anfusihim wal aa hum mminnaa yushaboon
Bal matta'naa haa'ul aa'i wa'aabaa'ahum hattaa taal a 'al ayhimul'umuru 'afal aa yarawna 'annaa natee al arda nanqusuhaa min 'atraafihaa 'afahumul ghaal iboon
Qul 'innamaa 'unzirukum bil wahyi wal aa yasma'us-summud-du'aa'a 'izaa maa yunzaroon
Wal a'im mmassathum nafhat mmin 'azaabi rabbika layaqoolunna yaawaylanaa 'innaa kunnaa zaal imeen
Wanada'ul mawaazeenal qista leeawmil qeeaamati fal aa tuzlamu nafs shaya wain kaana mithqaal a habbat mmin khardal in 'ataynaa bihaa wakafaa binaa haasibeen
Wal aqad 'aataynaa moosaa wahaaroonal furqaana wadeeaa' wazikra llil muttaqeen
Al lazeena yakhshawna rabbahum bil ghaybi wahum mminas-saa'ati mushfiqoon
Wahaazaa zikr mmubaarakun 'anzal naahu 'afaantum lahu munkiroon
Wal aqad 'aataynaa 'ibraaheema rushdahu min qablu wakunnaa bihi 'aal imeen
'iz qaal a liabeehi waqawmihi maa haazihit-tamaatheelul lateeaa 'antum lahaa 'aakifoon
Qaal u wajadnaa 'aabaa'anaa lahaa 'aabideen
Qaal a laqad kuntum 'antum wa'aabaa'ukum fee dal aal mmubeen
Qaal ooaa 'aji'tanaa bil haqqi 'am 'anta minal laa'ibeen
Qaal a bar-rabbukum rabbus-samaawaati wal ardil lazee fatarahunna waanaa 'al aa zaal ikum mminash-shaahideen
Watal laahi laakeedanna 'asnaamakum ba'da 'an tooal lu mudbireen

Qaal u man fa'al a haazaa biaal ihatinaa 'innahu laminaz-zaal imeen

Qaal u fatu bihi 'al aa 'a'yunin-naasi la'al laahum yashhadoon
Qaal ooaa 'aanta fa'al ta haazaa biaal ihatinaa yaaibraaheem

Wanajjaynaahu wal ootana 'il aal ardil latee baaraknaa feehaa lil'aal ameen
Wawahabnaa lahuaa 'ishaaqa waya'qooba naafil at wakul la ja'al naa saal iheen
Waja'al naahum 'a'immat yahdoona biamrinaa waawhaynaa 'il ayhim fi'lal khayraati waiqaamas-sal aati waeetaa'az-zakaati wakaanu lanaa 'aabideen
Wal ootana 'aataynaahu hukma wa'il ma wanajjaynaahu minal qaryatil latee kaanat tta'mal ul khabaa'itha 'innahum kaanu qawma saw' faasiqeen

Wanoohana 'iz naadaa min qablu fastajabnaa lahu fanajjaynaahu waahlahu minal karbil'azeem

Wal lateeaa 'ahsanat farjahaa fanafakhnaa feehaa mir rroohinaa waja'al naahaa wabnahaa 'ayat llil'aal ameen

'innal laaha yudaafi'u 'anil lazeena 'aamanooaa 'innal laaha laa yuhibbu kul la khawwaan kafoor
'uzina lil lazeena yuqaatal oona biannahum zul imu wainnal laaha 'al aa nasrihim laqadeer

Al lazeena 'ukhriju min deeaarihim bighayri haqqin 'il laa 'any yaqoolu rabbunaal laahu wal awlaa daf'ul laahin-naasa ba'dahum biba'd llaahuddimat sawaami'u wabeea' wasal awaat wamasaajidu yuzkaru feehaasmul laahi katheera wal ayansurannal laahu many yansuruhuaa 'innal laaha laqaweeyun 'azeez
Al lazeena 'im mmakkannaahum fee al ardi 'aqaamus-sal aata wa'aatawuaz-zakaata waamaru bil ma'roofi wanahawa 'anil munkari wal il laahi 'aaqibatul umoor
Wainy yukazzibooka faqad kazzabat qablahum qawmu nooh wa'aad wathamood
Waqawmu 'ibraaheema waqawmu looh
Waashaabu madyana wakuzziba moosaa faamlaytu lil kaafireena thumma 'akhaztuhum fakayfa kaana nakeer
Fakayyim mmin qaryatin 'ahlaknaahaa waheea zaal imat faheea khaaweeatun 'al aa 'urooshihaa wabi'r mmu'attal at waqasr mmasheed
'afal am yaseeru fee al ardi fatakoona lahum qul oob ya'qil oona bihaa 'aw 'aazaany yasma'oona bihaa fainnahaa laa ta'maal absaaru wal aakin ta'maal qul oobul latee fee as-sudoor
Wayasta'jil oonaka bil'azaabi wal any yukhlifal laahu wa'dahu wainna yawmana 'inda rabbika kaal fi sanat mmimmaa ta'uddoon
Wakayyim mmin qaryatin 'amlaytu lahaa waheea zaal imat thumma 'akhaztuhaa wail ayyal maseer
Qul yayyuhaan-naasu 'innamaa 'anaa lakum nazeer mmubeen
Fal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati lahum mmaghfirat warizq kareem
Wal lazeena sa'awa feeaa 'ayaatinaa mu'aajizeena 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabul jaheem

Wamaa 'arsal naa min qablika mir rrasool wal aa nabeeyin 'il laa 'izaa tamannaa 'al qaash-shaytaanu feeaa 'umniyyatihi fayansakhul laahu maa yul qee ash-shaytaanu thumma yuhkimul laahu 'ayaatihi wal laahu 'al eemun hakeem
Lleeaj'al a maa yul qee ash-shaytaanu fitnat llil lazeena fee qul oobihim mmarad wal qaaseeati qul oobuhum wainnaz-zaal imeena lafee shiqaaqi ba'eed
Wal eea'lamal lazeena 'ootul'il ma 'annahul haqqu mir rrabbika fayu'minu bihi fatukhbita lahu qul oobuhum wainnal laaha lahaadil lazeena 'aamanooaa 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem
Wal aa yazaal ul lazeena kafaru fee miryat mminhu hattaa tateeahumus-saa'atu baghtatan 'aw yateeahum 'azaabu yawmin 'aqeem
Al mul ku yawma'iz llil laahi yahkumu baynahum fal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati fee jannaatin-na'eem
Wal lazeena kafaru wakazzabu biayaatinaa faul aa'ika lahum 'azaab mmuheen
Wal lazeena haajaru fee sabeelil laahi thumma qutil ooaa 'aw maatu layarzuqannahumul laahu rizqana hasana wainnal laaha lahooa khayrur-raaziqeen
Layudkhil annahum mmudkhal a yardawnahu wainnal laaha la'al eemun hal eem
Zaal ika waman 'aaqaba bimithli maa 'ooqiba bihi thumma bugheea 'al ayhi layansurannahul laahu 'innal laaha la'afoowun ghafoor
Zaal ika biannal laaha yoolijul layla fee an-nahaari wayoolijun-nahaara fee al layli waannal laaha samee'u baseer
Zaal ika biannal laaha hooal haqqu waanna maa yad'oona min doonihi hooal baatil u waannal laaha hooal'al eeyul kabeer
'al am tara 'annal laaha 'anzal a minas-samaa'i maa' fatusbihul ardu mukhdarratan 'innal laaha lateefun khabeer
Llaahu maa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardi wainnal laaha lahooal ghaneeyul hameed
'al am tara 'annal laaha sakhkhara lakum mmaa fee al ardi wal ful ka tajree fee al bahri biamrihi wayumsikus-samaa'a 'an taqa'a 'al aal ardi 'il laa biiznihiaa 'innal laaha bin-naasi lara'oof rraheem
Wahooal lazeeaa 'ahyaakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum 'innal insaana lakafoor
Llikul li 'ummat ja'al naa mansakana hum naasikoohu fal aa yunaazi'unnaka fee al amri wad'u 'il aa rabbika 'innaka la'al aa huda mmustaqeem
Wain jaadal ooka faqul il laahu 'a'lamu bimaa ta'mal oon
Al laahu yahkumu baynakum yawmal qeeaamati feemaa kuntum feehi takhtal ifoon
'al am ta'lam 'annal laaha ya'lamu maa fee as-samaa'i wal ardi 'inna zaal ika fee kitaabin 'inna zaal ika 'al aal laahi yaseer
Waya'budoona min doonil laahi maa lam yunazzil bihi sul taana wamaa laysa lahum bihi 'il m wamaa liz-zaal imeena min nnaseer

Waizaa tutlaa 'al ayhim 'ayaatunaa bayyinaat ta'rifu fee wujoohil lazeena kafarul munkara yakaadoona yastoona bil lazeena yatloona 'al ayhim 'ayaatinaa qul 'afaunabbi'ukum bisharr mmin zaal ikumun-naaru wa'adahaal laahul lazeena kafaru wabi'sal maseer

Yayyuhaan-naasu duriba mathal fastami'u lahuaa 'innal lazeena tad'oona min doonil laahi lany yakhluqu zubaaba wal awijtama'u lahu wainy yaslubhumuz-zubaabu shaya llaa yastanqizoohu minhu da'ufat-taal ibu wal matloob
Maa qadarul laaha haqqa qadrihiaa 'innal laaha laqaweeyun 'azeez
Al laahu yastafee minal mal aa'ikati rusul a waminan-naasi 'innal laaha samee'u baseer
Ya'lamu maa bayna 'aydeehim wamaa khal fahum wail aal laahi turja'ul umoor
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanurka'u wasjudu wa'budu rabbakum waf'al ul khayra la'al lakum tuflihoon

Wajaahidu fee al laahi haqqa jihaadihi hooajtabaakum wamaa ja'al a 'al aykum fee ad-deeni min haraj mmil lata 'abeekum 'ibraaheema hooa sammaakumul muslimeena min qablu wafee haazaa leeakoonar-rasoolu shaheedana 'al aykum watakoonu shuhadaa'a 'al aan-naasi faaqeemus-sal aata wa'aatuz-zakaata wa'tasimu bil laahi hooa mawlaakum fani'mal mawlaa wani'man-naseer
Qad 'aflahal mu'minoon
Al lazeena hum fee sal aatihim khaashi'oon
Wal lazeena hum 'anil laghwi mu'ridoon
Wal lazeena hum liz-zakawaati faa'il oon
Wal lazeena hum lifuroojihim haafizoon
'il laa 'al aa 'azwaajihim 'aw maa mal akat 'aymaanuhum fainnahum ghayru mal oomeen
Famanibtaghaa waraa'a zaal ika faul aa'ika humul'aadoon
Wal lazeena hum liamaanaatihim wa'ahdihim raa'oon
Wal lazeena hum 'al aa sal awaatihim yuhaafizoon
'ul aa'ika humul waarithoon
Al lazeena yarithoonal firdawsa hum feehaa khaal idoon
Wal aqad khal aqnaal insaana min sul aal at mmin teen
Thumma ja'al naahu nutfat fee qaraar mmakeen

Thumma khal aqnaan-nutfata 'al aqat fakhal aqnaal'al aqata mudghat fakhal aqnaal mudghata 'izaama fakasawnaal'izaama lahma thumma 'anshanaahu khal qana 'aakhara fatabaarakal laahu 'ahsanul khaal iqeen
Thumma 'innakum ba'da zaal ika lamayyitoon
Thumma 'innakum yawmal qeeaamati tub'athoon
Wal aqad khal aqnaa fawqakum sab'a taraa'iqa wamaa kunnaa 'anil khal qi ghaafil een
Waanzal naa minas-samaa'i maa'a biqadar faaskannaahu fee al ardi wainnaa 'al aa zahaabi bihi laqaadiroon
Faanshanaa lakum bihi jannaat mmin nnakheel waa'naab llakum feehaa fawaakihu katheerat waminhaa takul oon
Washajarat takhruju min toori saynaa'a tanbutu bid-duhni wasibgh llil aakil een
Wainna lakum fee al an'aami la'ibrat nnusqeekum mmimmaa fee butoonihaa wal akum feehaa manaafi'u katheerat waminhaa takul oon
Wa'al ayhaa wa'al aal ful ki tuhmal oon
Wal aqad 'arsal naa noohana 'il aa qawmihi faqaal a yaaqawmi'budul laaha maa lakum mmin 'il aahin ghayruhuaa 'afal aa tattaqoon

Faqaal al mal a'ual lazeena kafaru min qawmihi maa haazaa 'il laa bashar mmithlukum yureedu 'any yatafaddal a 'al aykum wal aw shaa'al laahu laanzal a mal aa'ikat mmaa sami'naa bihaazaa feeaa 'aabaa'inaal awwal een
'in hooa 'il laa rajul u bihi jinnat fatarabbasu bihi hattaa heen
Qaal a rabbinsurnee bimaa kazzaboon

Faawhaynaa 'il ayhi 'anisna'il ful ka bia'yuninaa wawahyinaa faizaa jaa'a 'amrunaa wafaarat-tannooru fasluk feehaa min kul l zawjaynithnayni waahlaka 'il laa man sabaqa 'al ayhil qawlu minhum wal aa tukhaatibnee fee al lazeena zal amooaa 'innahum mmughraqoon
Faizaastawayta 'anta wamam mma'aka 'al aal ful ki faqul il hamdu lil laahil lazee najjaanaa minal qawmiz-zaal imeen
Waqur-rabbi 'anzil nee munzal a mmubaaraka waanta khayrul munzil een
'inna fee zaal ika layaat wain kunnaa lamubtal een
Thumma 'anshanaa mim ba'dihim qarnana 'aakhareen
Faarsal naa feehim rasoola mminhum 'ani'budul laaha maa lakum mmin 'il aahin ghayruhuaa 'afal aa tattaqoon

Waqaal al mal au min qawmihil lazeena kafaru wakazzabu bil iqaa'il aakhirati waatrafnaahum fee al hayawaatid-dunyaa maa haazaa 'il laa bashar mmithlukum yakul u mimmaa takul oona minhu wayashrabu mimmaa tashraboon
Wal a'in 'ata'tum bashara mmithlakum 'innakum 'iza llakhaasiroon
'aya'idukum 'annakum 'izaa mittum wakuntum turaaba wa'izaamana 'annakum mmukhrajoon
Hayhaata hayhaata limaa too'adoon
'in heea 'il laa hayaatunaad-dunyaa namootu wanahyaa wamaa nahnu bimab'ootheen
'in hooa 'il laa rajul un aftaraa 'al aal laahi kaziba wamaa nahnu lahu bimu'mineen
Qaal a rabbinsurnee bimaa kazzaboon
Qaal a 'ammaa qal eel llayusbihunna naadimeen
Faakhazathumus-sayhatu bil haqqi faja'al naahum ghuthaa' fabu'da llil qawmiz-zaal imeen
Thumma 'anshanaa mim ba'dihim quroonana 'aakhareen
Maa tasbiqu min 'ummatin 'ajal ahaa wamaa yastakhiroon
Thumma 'arsal naa rusul anaa tatraa kul la maa jaa'a 'ummat rrasooluhaa kazzaboohu faatba'naa ba'dahum ba'da waja'al naahum 'ahaadeetha fabu'da lliqawm llaa yu'minoon
Thumma 'arsal naa moosaa waakhaahu haaroona biayaatinaa wasul taam mmubeen
'il aa fir'awna wamal aeehi fastakbaru wakaanu qawmana 'aal een
Faqaal ooaa 'anu'minu libasharayni mithlinaa waqawmuhumaa lanaa 'aabidoon
Fakazzaboohumaa fakaanu minal muhlakeen
Wal aqad 'aataynaa moosaal kitaaba la'al laahum yahtadoon
Waja'al naabna maryama waummahuaa 'ayat wa'aawaynaahumaa 'il aa rabwat zaati qaraar wama'een
Yayyuhaar-rusul u kul u minat-tayyibaati wa'mal u saal ihana 'innee bimaa ta'mal oona 'al eem
Wainna haazihiaa 'ummatukum 'ummat waahidat waanaa rabbukum fattaqoon
Fataqatta'ooaa 'amrahum baynahum zubura kul lu hizbi bimaa ladayhim farihoon
Fazarhum fee ghamratihim hattaa heen
'ayahsaboona 'annamaa numidduhum bihi mim mmaal wabaneen
Nusaari'u lahum fee al khayraati bal-laa yash'uroon
'innal lazeena hum mmin khashyati rabbihim mmushfiqoon
Wal lazeena hum biayaati rabbihim yu'minoon
Wal lazeena hum birabbihim laa yushrikoon
Wal lazeena yu'toona maa 'aata wwaqul oobuhum wajil atun 'annahum 'il aa rabbihim raaji'oon
'ul aa'ika yusaari'oona fee al khayraati wahum lahaa saabiqoon
Wal aa nukal lifu nafsana 'il laa wus'ahaa wal adaynaa kitaab yantiqu bil haqqi wahum laa yuzlamoon
Bal qul oobuhum fee ghamrat mmin haazaa wal ahum 'a'maal mmin dooni zaal ika hum lahaa 'aamil oon
Hattaa 'izaa 'akhaznaa mutrafeehim bil'azaabi 'izaa hum yajaroon
Laa tajarul yawma 'innakum mminnaa laa tunsaroon
Qad kaanat 'ayaatee tutlaa 'al aykum fakuntum 'al aa 'a'qaabikum tankisoon
Mustakbireena bihi saamira tahjuroon
'afal am yaddabbarul qawla 'am jaa'ahum mmaa lam yati 'aabaa'ahumul awwal een
'am lam ya'rifu rasoolahum fahum lahu munkiroon
'am yaqooloona bihi jinnatu bal jaa'ahum bil haqqi waaktharuhum lil haqqi kaarihoon
Wal awittaba'al haqqu 'ahwaa'ahum lafasadatis-samaawaatu wal ardu waman feehinna bal 'ataynaahum bizikrihim fahum 'an zikrihim mmu'ridoon
'am tasal uhum kharja fakharaaju rabbika khayr wahooa khayrur-raaziqeen
Wainnaka latad'oohum 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem
Wainnal lazeena laa yu'minoona bil aakhirati 'anis-siraati lanaakiboon
Wal aw rahimnaahum wakashafnaa maa bihim mmin durr llal ajju fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon
Wal aqad 'akhaznaahum bil'azaabi famaastakaanu lirabbihim wamaa yatadarra'oon
Hattaa 'izaa fatahnaa 'al ayhim baaba zaa 'azaab shadeedin 'izaa hum feehi mublisoon
Wahooal lazeeaa 'anshaa lakumus-sam'a wal absaara wal afidata qal eela mmaa tashkuroon
Wahooal lazee zaraakum fee al ardi wail ayhi tuhsharoon
Wahooal lazee yuhyi wayumeetu wal ahukhtil aaful layli wan-nahaari 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Bal qaal u mithla maa qaal al awwal oon
Qaal ooaa 'a'izaa mitnaa wakunnaa turaaba wa'izaamana 'a'innaa lamab'oothoon
Laqad wu'idnaa nahnu wa'aabaa'unaa haazaa min qablu 'in haazaa 'il laa 'asaateerul awwal een
Qul-limanil ardu waman feehaa 'in kuntum ta'lamoon
Sayaqooloona lil laahi qul 'afal aa tazakkaroon
Qul mar rrabbus-samaawaatis-sab'i warabbul'arshil'azeem
Sayaqooloona lil laahi qul 'afal aa tattaqoon
Qul mam beeadihi mal akootu kul li shay' wahooa yujeeru wal aa yujaaru 'al ayhi 'in kuntum ta'lamoon
Sayaqooloona lil laahi qul faannaa tusharoon
Bal 'ataynaahum bil haqqi wainnahum lakaaziboon
Maattakhazal laahu minw wal ad wamaa kaana ma'ahu min 'il aahin 'iza llazahaba kul lu 'il aahi bimaa khal aqa wal a'al aa ba'duhum 'al aa ba'd subhaanal laahi 'ammaa yasifoon
'aal imil ghaybi wash-shahaadati fata'aal aa 'ammaa yushrikoon
Qur-rabbi 'immaa tureeannee maa yoo'adoon
Rabbi fal aa taj'al nee fee al qawmiz-zaal imeen
Wainnaa 'al aa 'an nnureeaka maa na'iduhum laqaadiroon
Adfa' bil latee heea 'ahsanus-sayyi'ata nahnu 'a'lamu bimaa yasifoon
Waqur-rabbi 'a'oozu bika min hamazaatish-shayaateen
Waa'oozu bika rabbi 'any yahduroon
Hattaa 'izaa jaa'a 'ahadahumul mawtu qaal a rabbirji'oon
La'al leeaa 'a'mal u saal iha feemaa taraktu kal laa 'innahaa kal imatun hooa qaa'il uhaa waminw waraa'ihim barzakhun 'il aa yawmi yub'athoon
Faizaa nufikha fee as-soori fal aa 'ansaaba baynahum yawma'iz wal aa yatasaa'al oon
Faman thaqul at mawaazeenuhu faul aa'ika humul muflihoon
Waman khaffat mawaazeenuhu faul aa'ikal lazeena khasirooaa 'anfusahum fee jahannama khaal idoon
Tal fahu wujoohahumun-naaru wahum feehaa kaal ihoon
'al am takun 'ayaatee tutlaa 'al aykum fakuntum bihaa tukazziboon
Qaal u rabbanaa ghal abat 'al aynaa shiqwatunaa wakunnaa qawma daal leen
Rabbanaa 'akhrijnaa minhaa fain 'udnaa fainnaa zaal imoon
Qaal akhsau feehaa wal aa tukal limoon
'innahu kaana fareeq mmin 'ibaadee yaqooloona rabbanaa 'aamannaa faghfir lanaa warhamnaa waanta khayrur-raahimeen
Fattakhaztumoohum sikhriyyana hattaa 'ansawkum zikree wakuntum mminhum tadhakoon
'innee jazaytuhumul yawma bimaa sabarooaa 'annahum humul faa'izoon
Qaal a kam labithtum fee al ardi 'adada sineen
Qaal u labithnaa yawmana 'aw ba'da yawm fasal il'aaddeen
Qaal a 'il llabithtum 'il laa qal eela llaw 'annakum kuntum ta'lamoon
'afahasibtum 'annamaa khal aqnaakum 'abatha waannakum 'il aynaa laa turja'oon
Fata'aal aal laahul mal ikul haqqu laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa rabbul'arshil kareem
Wamany yad'u ma'al laahi 'il aahana 'aakhara laa burhaana lahu bihi fainnamaa hisaabuhu 'inda rabbihiaa 'innahu laa yuflihul kaafiroon
Waqur-rabbighfir warham waanta khayrur-raahimeen
Sooratun 'anzal naahaa wafaradnaahaa waanzal naa feehaa 'ayaati bayyinaat lla'al lakum tazakkaroon

Az-zaaneeatu waz-zaanee fajlidu kul la waahid mminhumaa mi'ata jal dat wal aa takhuzkum bihimaa rafat fee deenil laahi 'in kuntum tu'minoona bil laahi wal yawmil aakhiri wal yashhad 'azaabahumaa taa'ifat mminal mu'mineen
Az-zaanee laa yankihu 'il laa zaaneeatan 'aw mushrikat waz-zaaneeatu laa yankihuhaa 'il laa zaanin 'aw mushrik wahurrima zaal ika 'al aal mu'mineen
Wal lazeena yarmoonal muhsanaati thumma lam yatu biarba'ati shuhadaa'a fajlidoohum thamaaneena jal dat wal aa taqbal u lahum shahaadatan 'abada waul aa'ika humul faasiqoon
'il laal lazeena taabu mim ba'di zaal ika waaslahu fainnal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Wal lazeena yarmoona 'azwaajahum wal am yakul llaahum shuhadaa'u 'il laa 'anfusuhum fashahaadatu 'ahadihim 'arba'u shahaadaati bil laahi 'innahu laminas-saadiqeen
Wal khaamisatu 'anna la'natal laahi 'al ayhi 'in kaana minal kaazibeen
Wayadra'ua 'anhaal'azaaba 'an tashhada 'arba'a shahaadaati bil laahi 'innahu laminal kaazibeen
Wal khaamisata 'anna ghadabal laahi 'al ayhaa 'in kaana minas-saadiqeen
Wal awlaa fadlul laahi 'al aykum warahmatuhu waannal laaha tawwaabun hakeem
'innal lazeena jaa'oo bil ifki 'usbat mminkum laa tahsaboohu sharra llakum bal hooa khayr llakum likul limree mminhum mmaaktasaba minal ithmi wal lazee tawal laa kibrahu minhum lahu 'azaabun 'azeem
Llawlaa 'iz sami'tumoohu zannal mu'minoona wal mu'minaatu bianfusihim khayra waqaal u haazaa 'ifk mmubeen
Llawlaa jaa'oo 'al ayhi biarba'ati shuhadaa'a faiz lam yatu bish-shuhadaa'i faul aa'ika 'indal laahi humul kaaziboon
Wal awlaa fadlul laahi 'al aykum warahmatuhu fee ad-dunyaa wal aakhirati lamassakum fee maa 'afadtum feehi 'azaabun 'azeem
'iz tal aqqawnahu bial sinatikum wataqooloona biafwaahikum mmaa laysa lakum bihi 'il m watahsaboonahu hayyina wahooa 'indal laahi 'azeem
Wal awlaa 'iz sami'tumoohu qul tum mmaa yakoonu lanaa 'an nnatakal lama bihaazaa subhaanaka haazaa buhtaanun 'azeem
Ya'izukumul laahu 'an ta'oodu limithlihiaa 'abadana 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
Wayubayyinul laahu lakumul ayaati wal laahu 'al eemun hakeem
'innal lazeena yuhibboona 'an tashee'al faahishatu fee al lazeena 'aamanu lahum 'azaabun 'al eem fee ad-dunyaa wal aakhirati wal laahu ya'lamu waantum laa ta'lamoon
Wal awlaa fadlul laahi 'al aykum warahmatuhu waannal laaha ra'oof rraheem

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa tattabi'u khutooaatish-shaytaani wamany yattabi' khutooaatish-shaytaani fainnahu yamuru bil fahshaa'i wal munkari wal awlaa fadlul laahi 'al aykum warahmatuhu maa zakaa minkum mmin 'ahadin 'abada wal aakinnal laaha yuzakkee many yashaa'u wal laahu samee'un 'al eem

Wal aa yatal i 'oolul fadli minkum was-sa'ati 'any yu'tooaa 'oolee al qurbaa wal masaakeena wal muhaajireena fee sabeelil laahi wal ya'fu wal yasfahooaa 'al aa tuhibboona 'any yaghfiral laahu lakum wal laahu ghafoor rraheem
'innal lazeena yarmoonal muhsanaatil ghaafil aatil mu'minaati lu'inu fee ad-dunyaa wal aakhirati wal ahum 'azaabun 'azeem
Yawma tashhadu 'al ayhim 'al sinatuhum waydeehim waarjul uhum bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Yawma'iz yooaffeehimul laahu deenahumul haqqa waya'lamoona 'annal laaha hooal haqqul mubeen
Al khabeethaatu lil khabeetheena wal khabeethoona lil khabeethaati wat-tayyibaatu lit-tayyibeena wat-tayyiboona lit-tayyibaati 'ul aa'ika mubarra'oona mimmaa yaqooloona lahum mmaghfirat warizq kareem
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa tadkhul u buyootana ghayra buyootikum hattaa tastanisu watusal limu 'al aa 'ahlihaa zaal ikum khayr llakum la'al lakum tazakkaroon
Fail llam tajidu feehaa 'ahada fal aa tadkhul oohaa hattaa yu'zana lakum wain qeela lakumurji'u farji'u hooa 'azkaa lakum wal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona 'al eem
Llaysa 'al aykum junaahun 'an tadkhul u buyootana ghayra maskoonat feehaa mataa' llakum wal laahu ya'lamu maa tubdoona wamaa taktumoon
Qul-lil mu'mineena yaghuddu min 'absaarihim wayahfazu furoojahum zaal ika 'azkaa lahum 'innal laaha khabeeru bimaa yasna'oon

Waqul-lil mu'minaati yaghdudna min 'absaarihinna wayahfazna furoojahunna wal aa yubdeena zeenatahunna 'il laa maa zahara minhaa wal yadribna bikhumurihinna 'al aa juyoobihinna wal aa yubdeena zeenatahunna 'il laa libu'oolatihinna 'aw 'aabaa'ihinna 'aw 'aabaa'i bu'oolatihinna 'aw 'abnaa'ihinna 'aw 'abnaa'i bu'oolatihinna 'aw 'ikhwaanihinna 'aw baneeaa 'ikhwaanihinna 'aw baneeaa 'akhawaatihinna 'aw nisaa'ihinna 'aw maa mal akat 'aymaanuhunna 'awit-taabi'eena ghayri 'oolee al irbati minar-rijaal i 'awit-tiflil lazeena lam yazharu 'al aa 'awraatin-nisaa'i wal aa yadribna biarjul ihinna leeu'lama maa yukhfeena min zeenatihinna watoobooaa 'il aal laahi jamee'ana 'ayyuhal mu'minoona la'al lakum tuflihoon
Waankihul ayaamaa minkum was-saal iheena min 'ibaadikum waimaa'ikum 'iny yakoonu fuqaraa'a yughnihimul laahu min fadlihi wal laahu waasi'un 'al eem

Wal yasta'fifil lazeena laa yajidoona nikaahana hattaa yughneeahumul laahu min fadlihi wal lazeena yabtaghoonal kitaaba mimmaa mal akat 'aymaanukum fakaatiboohum 'in 'al imtum feehim khayra wa'aatoohum mmim mmaal il laahil lazeeaa 'aataakum wal aa tukrihu fatayaatikum 'al aal bighaa'i 'in 'aradna tahassuna llitabtaghu 'aradal hayawaatid-dunyaa wamany yukrihhhunna fainnal laaha mim ba'di 'ikraahihinna ghafoor rraheem
Wal aqad 'anzal naa 'il aykum 'ayaat mmubayyinaat wamathal a mminal lazeena khal awa min qablikum wamaw'izat llil muttaqeen

Al laahu noorus-samaawaati wal ardi mathal u noorihi kamishkawaat feehaa misbaahun al misbaahu fee zujaajatin az-zujaajatu kaannahaa kawkab durreey yooqadu min shajarat mmubaarakat zaytoonat llaa sharqiyyat wal aa gharbiyyat yakaadu zaytuhaa yudeeaa'u wal aw lam tamsashu naar nnoorun 'al aa noor yahdee al laahu linoorihi many yashaa'u wayadribul laahul amthaal a lin-naasi wal laahu bikul li shay'in 'al eem
Fee buyootin 'azinal laahu 'an turfa'a wayuzkara feehaasmuhu yusabbihu lahu feehaa bil ghudoowi wal aasaal
Rijaal-laa tul heehim tijaarat wal aa bay'un 'an zikril laahi waiqaamis-sal aati waeetaa'iz-zakaati yakhaafoona yawma tataqal labu feehil qul oobu wal absaar
Leeajzeeahumul laahu 'ahsana maa 'amil u wayazeedahum mmin fadlihi wal laahu yarzuqu many yashaa'u bighayri hisaab
Wal lazeena kafarooaa 'a'maal uhum kasaraabi biqee'at yahsabuhuz-zamaanu maa'an hattaa 'izaa jaa'ahu lam yajidhu shaya wawajadal laaha 'indahu fawaffaahu hisaabahu wal laahu saree'ul hisaab

'aw kazul umaat fee bahr llujjeey yaghshaahu mawj mmin fawqihi mawj mmin fawqihi sahaab zul umaatu ba'duhaa fawqa ba'din 'izaa 'akhraja yadahu lam yakad yaraahaa wamal llam yaj'al il laahu lahu noora famaa lahu min nnoor
'al am tara 'annal laaha yusabbihu lahu man fee as-samaawaati wal ardi wat-tayru saaffaat kul l qad 'al ima sal aatahu watasbeehahu wal laahu 'al eemu bimaa yaf'al oon
Wal il laahi mul kus-samaawaati wal ardi wail aal laahil maseer

'al am tara 'annal laaha yuzjee sahaaba thumma yu'al lifu baynahu thumma yaj'al uhu rukaama fataraal wadqa yakhruju min khil aal ihi wayunazzil u minas-samaa'i min jibaal feehaa mim barad fayuseebu bihi many yashaa'u wayasrifuhu 'am mmany yashaa'u yakaadu sanaa barqihi yazhabu bil absaar
Yuqal libul laahul layla wan-nahaara 'inna fee zaal ika la'ibrat llioolee al absaar

Wal laahu khal aqa kul la daabbat mmim mmaa' faminhum mmany yamshee 'al aa batnihi waminhum mmany yamshee 'al aa rijlayni waminhum mmany yamshee 'al aa 'arba' yakhluqul laahu maa yashaa'u 'innal laaha 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
Llaqad 'anzal naa 'ayaat mmubayyinaat wal laahu yahdee many yashaa'u 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem
Wayaqooloona 'aamannaa bil laahi wabir-rasooli waata'naa thumma yatawal laa fareeq mminhum mmim ba'di zaal ika wamaa 'ul aa'ika bil mu'mineen
Waizaa du'ooaa 'il aal laahi warasoolihi leeahkuma baynahum 'izaa fareeq mminhum mmu'ridoon
Wainy yakul llaahumul haqqu yatooaa 'il ayhi muz'ineen
'afee qul oobihim mmaradun 'amirtaabooaa 'am yakhaafoona 'any yaheefal laahu 'al ayhim warasooluhu bal 'ul aa'ika humuz-zaal imoon
'innamaa kaana qawlal mu'mineena 'izaa du'ooaa 'il aal laahi warasoolihi leeahkuma baynahum 'any yaqoolu sami'naa waata'naa waul aa'ika humul muflihoon
Wamany yuti'il laaha warasoolahu wayakhshal laaha wayattaqhi faul aa'ika humul faa'izoon
Waaqsamu bil laahi jahda 'aymaanihim la'in 'amartahum layakhrujunna qul-laa tuqsimu taa'at mma'roofatun 'innal laaha khabeeru bimaa ta'mal oon
Qul 'atee'ul laaha waatee'ur-rasoola fain tawal lawa fainnamaa 'al ayhi maa hummil a wa'al aykum mmaa hummil tum wain tutee'oohu tahtadu wamaa 'al aar-rasooli 'il laal bal aaghul mubeen

Wa'adal laahul lazeena 'aamanu minkum wa'amil us-saal ihaati layastakhlifannahum fee al ardi kamaastakhlafal lazeena min qablihim wal ayumakkinanna lahum deenahumul lazee artadaa lahum wal ayubaddil annahum mmim ba'di khawfihim 'amna ya'budoonanee laa yushrikoona bee shaya waman kafara ba'da zaal ika faul aa'ika humul faasiqoon
Waaqeemus-sal aata wa'aatuz-zakaata waatee'ur-rasoola la'al lakum turhamoon
Laa tahsabannal lazeena kafaru mu'jizeena fee al ardi wamawaahumun-naaru wal abi'sal maseer

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu leeastazinkumul lazeena mal akat 'aymaanukum wal lazeena lam yablughul hul uma minkum thal aatha marraat mmin qabli sal awaatil fajri waheena tada'oona theeaabakum mminaz-zaheerati wamim ba'di sal awaatil'ishaa'i thal aathu 'awraat llakum laysa 'al aykum wal aa 'al ayhim junaahu ba'dahunna tawwaafoona 'al aykum ba'dukum 'al aa ba'd kazaal ika yubayyinul laahu lakumul ayaati wal laahu 'al eemun hakeem
Waizaa bal aghal atfaal u minkumul hul uma fal yastazinu kamaastazanal lazeena min qablihim kazaal ika yubayyinul laahu lakum 'ayaatihi wal laahu 'al eemun hakeem

Wal qawaa'idu minan-nisaa'il laatee laa yarjoona nikaaha fal aysa 'al ayhinna junaahun 'any yada'na theeaabahunna ghayra mutabarrijaati bizeenat waany yasta'fifna khayr llaahunna wal laahu samee'un 'al eem

Llaysa 'al aal a'maa haraj wal aa 'al aal a'raji haraj wal aa 'al aal mareedi haraj wal aa 'al aa 'anfusikum 'an takul u mim buyootikum 'aw buyooti 'aabaa'ikum 'aw buyooti 'ummahaatikum 'aw buyooti 'ikhwaanikum 'aw buyooti 'akhawaatikum 'aw buyooti 'a'maamikum 'aw buyooti 'ammaatikum 'aw buyooti 'akhwaal ikum 'aw buyooti khaal aatikum 'aw maa mal aktum mmafaatihahuaa 'aw sadeeqikum laysa 'al aykum junaahun 'an takul u jamee'ana 'aw 'ashtaata faizaa dakhal tum buyoota fasal limu 'al aa 'anfusikum tahiyyat mmin 'indil laahi mubaarakat tayyibat kazaal ika yubayyinul laahu lakumul ayaati la'al lakum ta'qil oon

'innamaal mu'minoonal lazeena 'aamanu bil laahi warasoolihi waizaa kaanu ma'ahu 'al aa 'amr jaami' llam yazhabu hattaa yastazinoohu 'innal lazeena yastazinoonaka 'ul aa'ikal lazeena yu'minoona bil laahi warasoolihi faizaastazanooka liba'di shanihim fazal lliman shi'ta minhum wastaghfir lahumul laaha 'innal laaha ghafoor rraheem

Llaa taj'al u du'aa'ar-rasooli baynakum kadu'aa'i ba'dikum ba'da qad ya'lamul laahul lazeena yatasal lal oona minkum liwaaza fal yahzaril lazeena yukhaal ifoona 'an 'amrihiaa 'an tuseebahum fitnatun 'aw yuseebahum 'azaabun 'al eem
'al aa 'inna lil laahi maa fee as-samaawaati wal ardi qad ya'lamu maa 'antum 'al ayhi wayawma yurja'oona 'il ayhi fayunabbi'uhum bimaa 'amil u wal laahu bikul li shay'in 'al eem
Tabaarakal lazee nazzal al furqaana 'al aa 'abdihi leeakoona lil'aal ameena nazeeran
Al lazee lahu mul kus-samaawaati wal ardi wal am yattakhiz wal ada wal am yakul llaahu shareek fee al mul ki wakhal aqa kul la shay' faqaddarahu taqdeer
Wattakhazu min doonihiaa 'aal ihat llaa yakhluqoona shaya wahum yukhlaqoona wal aa yamlikoona lianfusihim darra wal aa naf'a wal aa yamlikoona mawta wal aa hayawaat wal aa nushoor
Waqaal al lazeena kafarooaa 'in haazaa 'il laa 'ifkun aftaraahu waa'aanahu 'al ayhi qawmun 'aakharoona faqad jaa'oo zul ma wazoor
Waqaal ooaa 'asaateerul awwal eenaktatabahaa faheea tumlaa 'al ayhi bukrat waaseel
Qul 'anzal ahul lazee ya'lamus-sirra fee as-samaawaati wal ardi 'innahu kaana ghafoora rraheem
Waqaal u maal i haazaar-rasooli yakul ut-ta'aama wayamshee fee al aswaaqi lawlaa 'unzil a 'il ayhi mal ak fayakoona ma'ahu nazeeran
'aw yul qaa 'il ayhi kanzun 'aw takoonu lahu jannat yakul u minhaa waqaal az-zaal imoona 'in tattabi'oona 'il laa rajul a mmashooran
Anzur kayfa darabu lakal amthaal a fadal lu fal aa yastatee'oona sabeel
Tabaarakal lazeeaa 'in shaa'a ja'al a laka khayra mmin zaal ika jannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru wayaj'al-laka qusoora
Bal kazzabu bis-saa'ati waa'tadnaa liman kazzaba bis-saa'ati sa'eeran
'izaa raathum mmim mmakaani ba'eed sami'u lahaa taghayyuza wazafeer
Waizaa 'ul qu minhaa makaana dayyiqa mmuqarraneena da'awa hunaal ika thuboor
Llaa tad'ul yawma thuboora waahida wad'u thuboora katheer
Qul 'azaal ika khayrun 'am jannatul khul dil latee wu'idal muttaqoona kaanat lahum jazaa' wamaseer
Llaahum feehaa maa yashaa'oona khaal ideena kaana 'al aa rabbika wa'da mmasool
Wayawma yahshuruhum wamaa ya'budoona min doonil laahi fayaqoolu 'aantum 'adlal tum 'ibaadee haa'ul aa'i 'am hum dal lus-sabeel
Qaal u subhaanaka maa kaana yanbaghee lanaa 'an nnattakhiza min doonika min 'awleeaa'a wal aakim mmatta'tahum wa'aabaa'ahum hattaa nasuz-zikra wakaanu qawmaa boor
Faqad kazzabookum bimaa taqooloona famaa tastatee'oona sarfa wal aa nasra wamany yazlim mminkum nuziqhu 'azaaba kabeer
Wamaa 'arsal naa qablaka minal mursal eena 'il laa 'innahum layakul oonat-ta'aama wayamshoona fee al aswaaqi waja'al naa ba'dakum liba'd fitnatan 'atasbiroona wakaana rabbuka baseer
Waqaal al lazeena laa yarjoona liqaa'anaa lawlaa 'unzil a 'al aynaal mal aa'ikatu 'aw naraa rabbanaa laqadistakbaru feeaa 'anfusihim wa'ataw 'utoowa kabeer
Yawma yarawnal mal aa'ikata laa bushraa yawma'iz llil mujrimeena wayaqooloona hijra mmahjoor
Waqadimnaa 'il aa maa 'amil u min 'amal faja'al naahu habaa' mmanthooran
'ashaabul jannati yawma'izin khayr mmustaqarra waahsanu maqeel
Wayawma tashaqqaqus-samaa'u bil ghamaami wanuzzil al mal aa'ikatu tanzeelan
Al mul ku yawma'izin al haqqu lir-rahmaani wakaana yawmana 'al aal kaafireena 'aseer
Wayawma ya'adduz-zaal imu 'al aa yadayhi yaqoolu yaal aytanee attakhaztu ma'ar-rasooli sabeel
Yaawaylataa laytanee lam 'attakhiz ful aanana khal eel
Llaqad 'adal lanee 'aniz-zikri ba'da 'iz jaa'anee wakaanash-shaytaanu lil insaani khazool
Waqaal ar-rasoolu yaarabbi 'inna qawmee attakhazu haazaal qur'aana mahjoor
Wakazaal ika ja'al naa likul li nabeeyin 'adoowa mminal mujrimeena wakafaa birabbika haadeea wanaseer
Waqaal al lazeena kafaru lawlaa nuzzil a 'al ayhil qur'aanu jumlat waahidat kazaal ika linuthabbita bihi fu'aadaka warattal naahu tarteel
Wal aa yatoonaka bimathal in 'il laa ji'naaka bil haqqi waahsana tafseeran
Al lazeena yuhsharoona 'al aa wujoohihim 'il aa jahannama 'ul aa'ika sharr mmakaana waadal lu sabeel
Wal aqad 'aataynaa moosaal kitaaba waja'al naa ma'ahuaa 'akhaahu haaroona wazeer
Faqul naazhabaa 'il aal qawmil lazeena kazzabu biayaatinaa fadammarnaahum tadmeer
Waqawma nooh llammaa kazzabur-rusul a 'aghraqnaahum waja'al naahum lin-naasi 'ayat waa'tadnaa liz-zaal imeena 'azaabana 'al eem
Wa'aada wathamoodaa waashaabar-rassi waquroonaa bayna zaal ika katheer
Wakul la darabnaa lahul amthaal a wakul la tabbarnaa tatbeer
Wal aqad 'atawa 'al aal qaryatil lateeaa 'umtirat mataras-saw'i 'afal am yakoonu yarawnahaa bal kaanu laa yarjoona nushoor
Waizaa raawka 'iny yattakhizoonaka 'il laa huzooana 'ahaazaal lazee ba'athal laahu rasoolan
'in kaada layudil lunaa 'an 'aal ihatinaa lawlaa 'an sabarnaa 'al ayhaa wasawfa ya'lamoona heena yarawnal'azaaba man 'adal lu sabeelan
'ara'ayta manittakhaza 'il aahahu hawaahu 'afaanta takoonu 'al ayhi wakeelan
'am tahsabu 'anna 'aktharahum yasma'oona 'aw ya'qil oona 'in hum 'il laa kal an'aami bal hum 'adal lu sabeelan
'al am tara 'il aa rabbika kayfa maddaz-zil la wal aw shaa'a laja'al ahu saakina thumma ja'al naash-shamsa 'al ayhi dal eel
Thumma qabadnaahu 'il aynaa qabda yaseer
Wahooal lazee ja'al a lakumul layla libaasa wan-nawma subaata waja'al an-nahaara nushoor
Wahooal lazeeaa 'arsal ar-reeaaha bushraa bayna yaday rahmatihi waanzal naa minas-samaa'i maa' tahoor
Llinuheea bihi bal dat mmayta wanusqeeahu mimmaa khal aqnaa 'an'aama waanaasiyya katheer
Wal aqad sarrafnaahu baynahum leeazzakkaru faabaa 'aktharun-naasi 'il laa kufoor
Wal aw shi'naa laba'athnaa fee kul li qaryat nnazeer
Fal aa tuti'il kaafireena wajaahidhum bihi jihaada kabeer
Wahooal lazee marajal bahrayni haazaa 'azb furaat wahaazaa mil hun 'ujaaj waja'al a baynahumaa barzakha wahijra mmahjoor
Wahooal lazee khal aqa minal maa'i bashara faja'al ahu nasaba wasihra wakaana rabbuka qadeer
Waya'budoona min doonil laahi maa laa yanfa'uhum wal aa yadurruhum wakaanal kaafiru 'al aa rabbihi zaheer
Wamaa 'arsal naaka 'il laa mubashshira wanazeer
Qul maa 'asal ukum 'al ayhi min 'ajrin 'il laa man shaa'a 'any yattakhiza 'il aa rabbihi sabeel
Watawakkal 'al aal hayyil lazee laa yamootu wasabbih bihamdihi wakafaa bihi bizunoobi 'ibaadihi khabeeran
Al lazee khal aqas-samaawaati wal arda wamaa baynahumaa fee sittati 'ayyaam thummastawaa 'al aal'arshir-rahmaanu fasal bihi khabeer
Waizaa qeela lahumusjudu lir-rahmaani qaal u wamaar-rahmaanu 'anasjudu limaa tamurunaa wazaadahum nufoor
Tabaarakal lazee ja'al a fee as-samaa'i burooja waja'al a feehaa siraaja waqamara mmuneer
Wahooal lazee ja'al al layla wan-nahaara khil fat lliman 'araada 'any yazzakkara 'aw 'araada shukoor
Wa'ibaadur-rahmaanil lazeena yamshoona 'al aal ardi hawna waizaa khaatabahumul jaahil oona qaal u sal aam
Wal lazeena yabeetoona lirabbihim sujjada waqeeaam
Wal lazeena yaqooloona rabbanaasrif 'annaa 'azaaba jahannama 'inna 'azaabahaa kaana gharaaman
'innahaa saa'at mustaqarra wamuqaam
Wal lazeena 'izaa 'anfaqu lam yusrifu wal am yaqturu wakaana bayna zaal ika qawaam
Wal lazeena laa yad'oona ma'al laahi 'il aahana 'aakhara wal aa yaqtul oonan-nafsal latee harramal laahu 'il laa bil haqqi wal aa yaznoona wamany yaf'al zaal ika yal qa 'athaam
Yudaa'af lahul'azaabu yawmal qeeaamati wayakhlud feehi muhaanan
'il laa man taaba wa'aamana wa'amil a 'amal a saal iha faul aa'ika yubaddil ul laahu sayyiaatihim hasanaat wakaanal laahu ghafoora rraheem
Waman taaba wa'amil a saal iha fainnahu yatoobu 'il aal laahi mataab
Wal lazeena laa yashhadoonaz-zoora waizaa marru bil laghwi marru kiraam
Wal lazeena 'izaa zukkiru biayaati rabbihim lam yakhirru 'al ayhaa summa wa'umyaan
Wal lazeena yaqooloona rabbanaa hab lanaa min 'azwaajinaa wazurriyyaatinaa qurrata 'a'yunw waj'al naa lil muttaqeena 'imaaman
'ul aa'ika yujzawnal ghurfata bimaa sabaru wayul aqqawna feehaa tahiyyat wasal aaman
Khaal ideena feehaa hasunat mustaqarra wamuqaam
Qul maa ya'ba'ua bikum rabbee lawlaa du'aa'ukum faqad kazzabtum fasawfa yakoonu lizaama
Taa-Seeem-Meeem
Til ka 'ayaatul kitaabil mubeen
La'al laka baakhi' nnafsaka 'al laa yakoonu mu'mineen
'in nnasha nunazzil 'al ayhim mminas-samaa'i 'ayat fazal lat 'a'naaquhum lahaa khaadi'een
Wamaa yateehim mmin zikr mminar-rahmaani muhdathin 'il laa kaanu 'anhu mu'rideen
Faqad kazzabu fasayateehim 'anbaa'ua maa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
'awal am yarawa 'il aal ardi kam 'anbatnaa feehaa min kul li zawj kareem
'inna fee zaal ika layat wamaa kaana 'aktharuhum mmu'mineen
Wainna rabbaka lahooal'azeezur-raheem
Waiz naadaa rabbuka moosaa 'ani'til qawmaz-zaal imeen
Qawma fir'awna 'al aa yattaqoon
Qaal a rabbi 'inneeaa 'akhaafu 'any yukazziboon
Wayadeequ sadree wal aa yantal iqu lisaanee faarsil 'il aa haaroon
Wal ahum 'al ayya zanb faakhaafu 'any yaqtul oon
Qaal a kal laa fazhabaa biayaatinaa 'innaa ma'akum mmustami'oon
Fateeaa fir'awna faqoolaa 'innaa rasoolu rabbil'aal ameen
'an 'arsil ma'anaa baneeaa 'israa'eel
Qaal a 'al am nurabbika feenaa wal eeda wal abithta feenaa min 'umurika sineen
Wafa'al ta fa'latakal latee fa'al ta waanta minal kaafireen
Qaal a fa'al tuhaa 'iza waanaa minad-daal leen
Fafarartu minkum lammaa khiftukum fawahaba lee rabbee hukma waja'al anee minal mursal een
Watil ka ni'mat tamunnuhaa 'al ayya 'an 'abbadtta baneeaa 'israa'eel
Qaal a fir'awnu wamaa rabbul'aal ameen
Qaal a rabbus-samaawaati wal ardi wamaa baynahumaa 'in kuntum mmooqineen
Qaal a liman hawlahuaa 'al aa tastami'oon
Qaal a rabbukum warabbu 'aabaa'ikumul awwal een
Qaal a 'inna rasoolakumul lazeeaa 'ursil a 'il aykum lamajnoon
Qaal a rabbul mashriqi wal maghribi wamaa baynahumaa 'in kuntum ta'qil oon
Qaal a la'inittakhazta 'il aahana ghayree laaj'al annaka minal masjooneen
Qaal a 'awal aw ji'tuka bishay' mmubeen
Qaal a fati bihiaa 'in kunta minas-saadiqeen
Faal qaa 'asaahu faizaa heea thu'baam mmubeen
Wanaza'a yadahu faizaa heea baydaa'u lin-naazireen
Qaal a lil mal ai hawlahuaa 'inna haazaa lasaahirun 'al eem
Yureedu 'any yukhrijakum mmin 'ardikum bisihrihi famaazaa tamuroon
Qaal ooaa 'arjih waakhaahu wab'ath fee al madaa'ini haashireen
Yatooka bikul li sahhaarin 'al eem
Fajumi'as-saharatu limeeqaati yawm mma'loom
Waqeela lin-naasi hal 'antum mmujtami'oon
La'al lanaa nattabi'us-saharata 'in kaanu humul ghaal ibeen
Fal ammaa jaa'as-saharatu qaal u lifir'awna 'a'inna lanaa laajrana 'in kunnaa nahnul ghaal ibeen
Qaal a na'am wainnakum 'iza llaminal muqarrabeen
Qaal a lahum mmoosaa 'al qu maa 'antum mmul qoon
Faal qawa hibaal ahum wa'isiyyahum waqaal u bi'izzati fir'awna 'innaa lanahnul ghaal iboon
Faal qaa moosaa 'asaahu faizaa heea tal qafu maa yafikoon
Faul qeeas-saharatu saajideen
Qaal ooaa 'aamannaa birabbil'aal ameen
Rabbi moosaa wahaaroon
Qaal a 'aamantum lahu qabla 'an 'aazana lakum 'innahu lakabeerukumul lazee 'al lamakumus-sihra fal asawfa ta'lamoona lauqatti'anna 'aydeeakum waarjul akum mmin khil aaf wal ausal libannakum 'ajma'een
Qaal u laa dayra 'innaa 'il aa rabbinaa munqal iboon
'innaa natma'u 'any yaghfira lanaa rabbunaa khatayaanaa 'an kunnaa 'awwal al mu'mineen
Waawhaynaa 'il aa moosaa 'an 'asri bi'ibaadeeaa 'innakum mmuttaba'oon

Til ka 'ayaatul kitaabil mubeen
Natlu 'al ayka min nnabai moosaa wafir'awna bil haqqi liqawm yu'minoon
'inna fir'awna 'al aa fee al ardi waja'al a 'ahlahaa sheea'a yastad'ifu taa'ifat mminhum yuzabbihu 'abnaa'ahum wayastahyi nisaa'ahum 'innahu kaana minal mufsideen
Wanureedu 'an nnamunna 'al aal lazeenastud'ifu fee al ardi wanaj'al ahum 'a'immat wanaj'al ahumul waaritheen
Wanumakkina lahum fee al ardi wanureea fir'awna wahaamaana wajunoodahumaa minhum mmaa kaanu yahzaroon
Waawhaynaa 'il aa 'ummi moosaa 'an 'ardi'eehi faizaa khifti 'al ayhi faal qeehi fee al yammi wal aa takhaafee wal aa tahzaneeaa 'innaa raaddoohu 'il ayki wajaa'il oohu minal mursal een
Fal taqatahuaa 'aal u fir'awna leeakoona lahum 'adoowa wahazanana 'inna fir'awna wahaamaana wajunoodahumaa kaanu khaatieen
Waqaal atimraatu fir'awna qurratu 'ayn llee wal aka laa taqtul oohu 'asaa 'any yanfa'anaa 'aw nattakhizahu wal ada wahum laa yash'uroon
Waasbaha fu'aadu 'ummi moosaa faarighana 'in kaadat latubdee bihi lawlaa 'ar rrabatnaa 'al aa qal bihaa litakoona minal mu'mineen
Waqaal at liukhtihi qusseehi fabasurat bihi 'an junub wahum laa yash'uroon
Waharramnaa 'al ayhil maraadi'a min qablu faqaal at hal 'adul lukum 'al aa 'ahli bayt yakful oonahu lakum wahum lahu naasihoon
Faradadnaahu 'il aa 'ummihi kay taqarra 'aynuhaa wal aa tahzana wal ita'lama 'anna wa'dal laahi haqq wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Wal ammaa bal agha 'ashuddahu wastawaa 'aataynaahu hukma wa'il ma wakazaal ika najzee al muhsineen

Wadakhal al madeenata 'al aa heeni ghaflat mmin 'ahlihaa fawajada feehaa rajul ayni yaqtatil aani haazaa min shee'atihi wahaazaa min 'adoowihi fastaghaathahul lazee min shee'atihi 'al aal lazee min 'adoowihi fawakazahu moosaa faqadaa 'al ayhi qaal a haazaa min 'amal ish-shaytaani 'innahu 'adoow mmudil l mmubeen
Qaal a rabbi 'innee zal amtu nafsee faghfir lee faghafara lahuaa 'innahu hooal ghafoorur-raheem
Qaal a rabbi bimaa 'an'amta 'al ayya fal an 'akoona zaheera llil mujrimeen
Faasbaha fee al madeenati khaa'ifa yataraqqabu faizaal lazee astansarahu bil amsi yastasrikhuhu qaal a lahu moosaa 'innaka laghaweey mmubeen

Fal ammaa 'an 'araada 'any yabtisha bil lazee hooa 'adoow llaahumaa qaal a yaamoosaa 'atureedu 'an taqtul anee kamaa qatal ta nafsaa bil amsi 'in tureedu 'il laa 'an takoona jabbaara fee al ardi wamaa tureedu 'an takoona minal musliheen
Wajaa'a rajul mmin 'aqsaal madeenati yas'aa qaal a yaamoosaa 'innal mal aa yatamiroona bika leeaqtul ooka fakhruj 'innee laka minan-naasiheen
Fakharaja minhaa khaa'ifa yataraqqabu qaal a rabbi najjinee minal qawmiz-zaal imeen
Wal ammaa tawajjaha til qaa'a madyana qaal a 'asaa rabbeeaa 'any yahdeeanee sawaa'as-sabeel

Wal ammaa warada maa'a madyana wajada 'al ayhi 'ummat mminan-naasi yasqoona wawajada min doonihimumraatayni tazoodaani qaal a maa khatbukumaa qaal ataa laa nasqee hattaa yusdirar-ri'aa'u waaboonaa shaykh kabeer
Fasaqaa lahumaa thumma tawal laa 'il aaz-zil li faqaal a rabbi 'innee limaa 'anzal ta 'il ayya min khayr faqeer

Fajaa'athu 'ihdaahumaa tamshee 'al aastihyaa' qaal at 'inna 'abee yad'ooka leeajzeeaka 'ajra maa saqayta lanaa fal ammaa jaa'ahu waqassa 'al ayhil qasasa qaal a laa takhaf najawta minal qawmiz-zaal imeen
Qaal at 'ihdaahumaa yaabatistajirhu 'inna khayra manistajartal qaweeyul ameen

Qaal a 'inneeaa 'ureedu 'an 'unkihaka 'ihdaabnatayya haatayni 'al aa 'an tajuranee thamaaneea hijaj fain 'atmamta 'ashra famin 'indika wamaa 'ureedu 'an 'ashuqqa 'al ayka satajiduneeaa 'in shaa'al laahu minas-saal iheen
Qaal a zaal ika baynee wabaynaka 'ayyamaal ajal ayni qadaytu fal aa 'udwaana 'al ayya wal laahu 'al aa maa naqoolu wakeel

Fal ammaa qadaa moosaal ajal a wasaara biahlihiaa 'aanasa min jaanibit-toori naara qaal a liahlihimkuthooaa 'inneeaa 'aanastu naara lla'al leeaa 'aateekum mminhaa bikhabarin 'aw jazwat mminan-naari la'al lakum tastal oon
Fal ammaa 'ataahaa noodeea min shaateeil waadil aymani fee al buq'atil mubaarakati minash-shajarati 'any yaamoosaa 'inneeaa 'anaal laahu rabbul'aal ameen
Waan 'al qi 'asaaka fal ammaa ra'aahaa tahtazzu kaannahaa jaann wal laa mudbira wal am yu'aqqib yaamoosaa 'aqbil wal aa takhaf 'innaka minal aamineen
Asluk yadaka fee jaybika takhruj baydaa'a min ghayri sooaa' wadmum 'il ayka janaahaka minar-rahbi fazaanika burhaanaani mir rrabbika 'il aa fir'awna wamal aeehiaa 'innahum kaanu qawma faasiqeen
Qaal a rabbi 'innee qatal tu minhum nafsa faakhaafu 'any yaqtul oon
Waakhee haaroonu hooa 'afsahu minnee lisaana faarsil hu ma'eea rid'a yusaddiquneeaa 'inneeaa 'akhaafu 'any yukazziboon
Qaal a sanashuddu 'adudaka biakheeka wanaj'al u lakumaa sul taana fal aa yasil oona 'il aykumaa biayaatinaa 'antumaa wamanittaba'akumaal ghaal iboon
Fal ammaa jaa'ahum mmoosaa biayaatinaa bayyinaat qaal u maa haazaa 'il laa sihr mmuftara wamaa sami'naa bihaazaa feeaa 'aabaa'inaal awwal een
Waqaal a moosaa rabbeeaa 'a'lamu biman jaa'a bil hudaa min 'indihi waman takoonu lahu 'aaqibatud-daari 'innahu laa yuflihuz-zaal imoon

Waqaal a fir'awnu yayyuhaal mal au maa 'al imtu lakum mmin 'il aahin ghayree faawqid lee yaahaamaanu 'al aat-teeni faj'al-lee sarha lla'al leeaa 'attal i'u 'il aa 'il aahi moosaa wainnee laazunnuhu minal kaazibeen
Wastakbara hooa wajunooduhu fee al ardi bighayril haqqi wazannooaa 'annahum 'il aynaa laa yurja'oon
Faakhaznaahu wajunoodahu fanabaznaahum fee al yammi fanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatuz-zaal imeen
Waja'al naahum 'a'immat yad'oona 'il aan-naari wayawmal qeeaamati laa yunsaroon
Waatba'naahum fee haazihid-dunyaa la'nat wayawmal qeeaamati hum mminal maqbooheen
Wal aqad 'aataynaa moosaal kitaaba mim ba'di maa 'ahlaknaal quroonal oolaa basaa'ira lin-naasi wahuda warahmat lla'al laahum yatazakkaroon
Wamaa kunta bijaanibil gharbeeyi 'iz qadaynaa 'il aa moosaal amra wamaa kunta minash-shaahideen
Wal aakinnaa 'anshanaa quroona fatataawal a 'al ayhimul'umuru wamaa kunta thaaweea feeaa 'ahli madyana tatlu 'al ayhim 'ayaatinaa wal aakinnaa kunnaa mursil een
Wamaa kunta bijaanibit-toori 'iz naadaynaa wal aakir rrahmat mmir rrabbika litunzira qawma mmaa 'ataahum mmin nnazeer mmin qablika la'al laahum yatazakkaroon
Wal awlaa 'an tuseebahum mmuseebatu bimaa qaddamat 'aydeehim fayaqoolu rabbanaa lawlaa 'arsal ta 'il aynaa rasoola fanattabi'a 'ayaatika wanakoona minal mu'mineen
Fal ammaa jaa'ahumul haqqu min 'indinaa qaal u lawlaa 'ooteea mithla maa 'ooteea moosaa 'awal am yakfuru bimaa 'ooteea moosaa min qablu qaal u sihraani tazaaharaa waqaal ooaa 'innaa bikul l kaafiroon
Qul fatu bikitaab mmin 'indil laahi hooa 'ahdaa minhumaa 'attabi'hu 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Fail llam yastajeebu laka fa'lam 'annamaa yattabi'oona 'ahwaa'ahum waman 'adal lu mimmanittaba'a hawaahu bighayri huda mminal laahi 'innal laaha laa yahdee al qawmaz-zaal imeen
Wal aqad wassal naa lahumul qawla la'al laahum yatazakkaroon
Al lazeena 'aataynaahumul kitaaba min qablihi hum bihi yu'minoon
Waizaa yutlaa 'al ayhim qaal ooaa 'aamannaa bihiaa 'innahul haqqu mir rrabbinaa 'innaa kunnaa min qablihi muslimeen
'ul aa'ika yu'tawna 'ajrahum mmarratayni bimaa sabaru wayadra'oona bil hasanatis-sayyi'ata wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
Waizaa sami'ul laghwa 'a'radu 'anhu waqaal u lanaa 'a'maal unaa wal akum 'a'maal ukum sal aamun 'al aykum laa nabtaghee al jaahil een
'innaka laa tahdee man 'ahbabta wal aakinnal laaha yahdee many yashaa'u wahooa 'a'lamu bil muhtadeen

Waqaal ooaa 'in nnattabi'il hudaa ma'aka nutakhattaf min 'ardinaa 'awal am numakkil llaahum haramana 'aamina yujbaa 'il ayhi thamaraatu kul li shay' rrizqa mmil lladunnaa wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Wakam 'ahlaknaa min qaryati batirat ma'eeshatahaa fatil ka masaakinuhum lam tuskam mmim ba'dihim 'il laa qal eela wakunnaa nahnul waaritheen
Wamaa kaana rabbuka muhlikal quraa hattaa yab'atha feeaa 'ummihaa rasoola yatlu 'al ayhim 'ayaatinaa wamaa kunnaa muhlikee al quraa 'il laa waahluhaa zaal imoon
Wamaa 'ooteetum mmin shay' famataa'ul hayawaatid-dunyaa wazeenatuhaa wamaa 'indal laahi khayr waabqaa 'afal aa ta'qil oon
'afamanw wa'adnaahu wa'dana hasana fahooa laaqeehi kamam mmatta'naahu mataa'al hayawaatid-dunyaa thumma hooa yawmal qeeaamati minal muhdareen
Wayawma yunaadeehim fayaqoolu 'ayna shurakaa'eeal lazeena kuntum taz'umoon
Qaal al lazeena haqqa 'al ayhimul qawlu rabbanaa haa'ul aa'il lazeena 'aghwaynaa 'aghwaynaahum kamaa ghawaynaa tabarranaa 'il ayka maa kaanooaa 'iyyaanaa ya'budoon
Waqeelad'u shurakaa'akum fada'awhum fal am yastajeebu lahum waraawual'azaaba law 'annahum kaanu yahtadoon
Wayawma yunaadeehim fayaqoolu maazaa 'ajabtumul mursal een
Fa'ameeat 'al ayhimul anbaa'u yawma'iz fahum laa yatasaa'al oon
Faammaa man taaba wa'aamana wa'amil a saal iha fa'asaa 'any yakoona minal mufliheen
Warabbuka yakhluqu maa yashaa'u wayakhtaaru maa kaana lahumul kheearatu subhaanal laahi wata'aal aa 'ammaa yushrikoon
Warabbuka ya'lamu maa tukinnu sudooruhum wamaa yu'linoon
Wahooal laahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa lahul hamdu fee al oolaa wal aakhirati wal ahul hukmu wail ayhi turja'oon
Qul 'ara'aytum 'in ja'al al laahu 'al aykumul layla sarmadana 'il aa yawmil qeeaamati man 'il aahun ghayrul laahi yateekum bideeaa'in 'afal aa tasma'oon
Qul 'ara'aytum 'in ja'al al laahu 'al aykumun-nahaara sarmadana 'il aa yawmil qeeaamati man 'il aahun ghayrul laahi yateekum bil ayl taskunoona feehi 'afal aa tubsiroon
Wamir rrahmatihi ja'al a lakumul layla wan-nahaara litaskunu feehi wal itabtaghu min fadlihi wal a'al lakum tashkuroon
Wayawma yunaadeehim fayaqoolu 'ayna shurakaa'eeal lazeena kuntum taz'umoon
Wanaza'naa min kul li 'ummat shaheeda faqul naa haatu burhaanakum fa'al imooaa 'annal haqqa lil laahi wadal la 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaftaroon

'inna qaaroona kaana min qawmi moosaa fabaghaa 'al ayhim wa'aataynaahu minal kunoozi maa 'inna mafaatihahu latanooaau bil'usbati 'oolee al qoowati 'iz qaal a lahu qawmuhu laa tafrah 'innal laaha laa yuhibbul fariheen
Wabtaghi feemaa 'aataakal laahud-daaral aakhirata wal aa tansa naseebaka minad-dunyaa waahsin kamaa 'ahsanal laahu 'il ayka wal aa tabghil fasaada fee al ardi 'innal laaha laa yuhibbul mufsideen

Qaal a 'innamaa 'ooteetuhu 'al aa 'il min 'indeeaa 'awal am ya'lam 'annal laaha qad 'ahlaka min qablihi minal qurooni man hooa 'ashaddu minhu qoowat waaktharu jam'a wal aa yusal u 'an zunoobihimul mujrimoon
Fakharaja 'al aa qawmihi fee zeenatihi qaal al lazeena yureedoonal hayawaatad-dunyaa yaal ayta lanaa mithla maa 'ooteea qaaroonu 'innahu lazoo hazzin 'azeem
Waqaal al lazeena 'ootul'il ma waylakum thawaabul laahi khayr lliman 'aamana wa'amil a saal iha wal aa yul aqqaahaa 'il laas-saabiroon
Fakhasafnaa bihi wabidaarihil arda famaa kaana lahu min fi'at yansuroonahu min doonil laahi wamaa kaana minal muntasireen

Waasbahal lazeena tamannawa makaanahu bil amsi yaqooloona waykaannal laaha yabsutur-rizqa limany yashaa'u min 'ibaadihi wayaqdiru lawlaa 'am mmannal laahu 'al aynaa lakhasafa binaa waykaannahu laa yuflihul kaafiroon
Til kad-daarul aakhiratu naj'al uhaa lil lazeena laa yureedoona 'ul oowa fee al ardi wal aa fasaada wal'aaqibatu lil muttaqeen
Man jaa'a bil hasanati fal ahu khayr mminhaa waman jaa'a bis-sayyi'ati fal aa yujzaal lazeena 'amil us-sayyiaati 'il laa maa kaanu ya'mal oon
'innal lazee farada 'al aykal qur'aana laraadduka 'il aa ma'aad qur-rabbeeaa 'a'lamu man jaa'a bil hudaa waman hooa fee dal aal mmubeen
Wamaa kunta tarjooaa 'any yul qaa 'il aykal kitaabu 'il laa rahmat mmir rrabbika fal aa takoonanna zaheera llil kaafireen
Wal aa yasuddunnaka 'an 'ayaatil laahi ba'da 'iz 'unzil at 'il ayka wad'u 'il aa rabbika wal aa takoonanna minal mushrikeen
Wal aa tad'u ma'al laahi 'il aahana 'aakhara laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa kul lu shay'in haal ikun 'il laa wajhahu lahul hukmu wail ayhi turja'oon
Alif-Laaam-Meeem
'ahasiban-naasu 'any yutrakooaa 'any yaqoolooaa 'aamannaa wahum laa yuftanoon
Wal aqad fatannaal lazeena min qablihim fal aya'lamannal laahul lazeena sadaqu wal aya'lamannal kaazibeen
'am hasibal lazeena ya'mal oonas-sayyiaati 'any yasbiqoonaa saa'a maa yahkumoon
Man kaana yarju liqaa'al laahi fainna 'ajal al laahi laat wahooas-samee'ul'al eem
Waman jaahada fainnamaa yujaahidu linafsihiaa 'innal laaha laghaneeyun 'anil'aal ameen
Wal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati lanukaffiranna 'anhum sayyiaatihim wal anajzeeannahum 'ahsanal lazee kaanu ya'mal oon
Wawassaynaal insaana biwaal idayhi husna wain jaahadaaka litushrika bee maa laysa laka bihi 'il m fal aa tuti'humaa 'il ayya marji'ukum faunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Wal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati lanudkhil annahum fee as-saal iheen

Waminan-naasi many yaqoolu 'aamannaa bil laahi faizaa 'oozeea fee al laahi ja'al a fitnatan-naasi ka'azaabil laahi wal a'in jaa'a nasr mmir rrabbika layaqoolunna 'innaa kunnaa ma'akum 'awal aysal laahu bia'lama bimaa fee sudooril'aal ameen
Wal aya'lamannal laahul lazeena 'aamanu wal aya'lamannal munaafiqeen
Waqaal al lazeena kafaru lil lazeena 'aamanuttabi'u sabeelanaa wal nahmil khatayaakum wamaa hum bihaamil eena min khatayaahum mmin shay'in 'innahum lakaaziboon
Wal ayahmil unna 'athqaal ahum waathqaal a mma'a 'athqaal ihim wal ayusal unna yawmal qeeaamati 'ammaa kaanu yaftaroon
Wal aqad 'arsal naa noohana 'il aa qawmihi fal abitha feehim 'al fa sanatin 'il laa khamseena 'aama faakhazahumut-toofaanu wahum zaal imoon
Faanjaynaahu waashaabas-safeenati waja'al naahaa 'ayat llil'aal ameen
Waibraaheema 'iz qaal a liqawmihi'budul laaha wattaqoohu zaal ikum khayr llakum 'in kuntum ta'lamoon

'innamaa ta'budoona min doonil laahi 'awthaana watakhluqoona 'ifkana 'innal lazeena ta'budoona min doonil laahi laa yamlikoona lakum rizqa fabtaghu 'indal laahir-rizqa wa'budoohu washkuru lahuaa 'il ayhi turja'oon
Wain tukazzibu faqad kazzaba 'umam mmin qablikum wamaa 'al aar-rasooli 'il laal bal aaghul mubeen
'awal am yarawa kayfa yubdi'ul laahul khal qa thumma yu'eeduhuaa 'inna zaal ika 'al aal laahi yaseer
Qul seeru fee al ardi fanzuru kayfa badaal khal qa thummal laahu yunshi'un-nashatal aakhirata 'innal laaha 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
Yu'azzibu many yashaa'u wayarhamu many yashaa'u wail ayhi tuqlaboon
Wamaa 'antum bimu'jizeena fee al ardi wal aa fee as-samaa'i wamaa lakum mmin doonil laahi minw wal eey wal aa naseer
Wal lazeena kafaru biayaatil laahi wal iqaa'ihiaa 'ul aa'ika ya'isu mir rrahmatee waul aa'ika lahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Famaa kaana jawaaba qawmihiaa 'il laa 'an qaal uqtul oohu 'aw harriqoohu faanjaahul laahu minan-naari 'inna fee zaal ika layaat lliqawm yu'minoon

Waqaal a 'innamaattakhaztum mmin doonil laahi 'awthaana mmawaddata baynikum fee al hayawaatid-dunyaa thumma yawmal qeeaamati yakfuru ba'dukum biba'd wayal'anu ba'dukum ba'da wamawaakumun-naaru wamaa lakum mmin nnaasireen
Faamana lahu loot waqaal a 'innee muhaajirun 'il aa rabbeeaa 'innahu hooal'azeezul hakeem
Wawahabnaa lahuaa 'ishaaqa waya'qooba waja'al naa fee zurriyyatihin-nuboowata wal kitaaba wa'aataynaahu 'ajrahu fee ad-dunyaa wainnahu fee al aakhirati laminas-saal iheen
Wal ootana 'iz qaal a liqawmihiaa 'innakum latatoonal faahishata maa sabaqakum bihaa min 'ahad mminal'aal ameen
'a'innakum latatoonar-rijaal a wataqta'oonas-sabeela watatoona fee naadeekumul munkara famaa kaana jawaaba qawmihiaa 'il laa 'an qaal u'tinaa bi'azaabil laahi 'in kunta minas-saadiqeen
Qaal a rabbinsurnee 'al aal qawmil mufsideen
Wal ammaa jaa'at rusul unaa 'ibraaheema bil bushraa qaal ooaa 'innaa muhlikooaa 'ahli haazihil qaryati 'inna 'ahlahaa kaanu zaal imeen
Qaal a 'inna feehaa loota qaal u nahnu 'a'lamu biman feehaa lanunajjeeannahu waahlahuaa 'il laamraatahu kaanat minal ghaabireen
Wal ammaa 'an jaa'at rusul unaa loota seeaa'a bihim wadaaqa bihim zar'a waqaal u laa takhaf wal aa tahzan 'innaa munajjooka waahlaka 'il laamraataka kaanat minal ghaabireen
'innaa munzil oona 'al aa 'ahli haazihil qaryati rijza mminas-samaa'i bimaa kaanu yafsuqoon
Wal aqad ttaraknaa minhaa 'ayata bayyinat lliqawm ya'qil oon
Wail aa madyana 'akhaahum shu'ayba faqaal a yaaqawmi'budul laaha warjul yawmal aakhira wal aa ta'thawa fee al ardi mufsideen
Fakazzaboohu faakhazathumur-rajfatu faasbahu fee daarihim jaathimeen
Wa'aada wathamoodaa waqad ttabayyana lakum mmim mmasaakinihim wazayyana lahumush-shaytaanu 'a'maal ahum fasaddahum 'anis-sabeeli wakaanu mustabsireen
Waqaaroona wafir'awna wahaamaana wal aqad jaa'ahum mmoosaa bil bayyinaati fastakbaru fee al ardi wamaa kaanu saabiqeen

Fakul lana 'akhaznaa bizanbihi faminhum mman 'arsal naa 'al ayhi haasiba waminhum mman 'akhazathus-sayhatu waminhum mman khasafnaa bihil arda waminhum mman 'aghraqnaa wamaa kaanal laahu leeazlimahum wal aakin kaanooaa 'anfusahum yazlimoon
Mathal ul lazeenattakhazu min doonil laahi 'awleeaa'a kamathal il'ankabootittakhazat bayta wainna 'awhanal buyooti labaytul'ankabooti law kaanu ya'lamoon
'innal laaha ya'lamu maa yad'oona min doonihi min shay' wahooal'azeezul hakeem
Watil kal amthaal u nadribuhaa lin-naasi wamaa ya'qil uhaa 'il laal'aal imoon
Khal aqal laahus-samaawaati wal arda bil haqqi 'inna fee zaal ika layat llil mu'mineen
Atlu maa 'ooheea 'il ayka minal kitaabi waaqimis-sal aata 'innas-sal aata tanhaa 'anil fahshaa'i wal munkari wal azikrul laahi 'akbaru wal laahu ya'lamu maa tasna'oon

Wal aa tujaadil ooaa 'ahlal kitaabi 'il laa bil latee heea 'ahsanu 'il laal lazeena zal amu minhum waqoolooaa 'aamannaa bil lazeeaa 'unzil a 'il aynaa waunzil a 'il aykum wail aahunaa wail aahukum waahid wanahnu lahu muslimoon
Wakazaal ika 'anzal naa 'il aykal kitaaba fal lazeena 'aataynaahumul kitaaba yu'minoona bihi wamin haa'ul aa'i many yu'minu bihi wamaa yajhadu biayaatinaa 'il laal kaafiroon
Wamaa kunta tatlu min qablihi min kitaab wal aa takhuttuhu beeameenika 'iza llartaabal mubtil oon
Bal hooa 'ayaatu bayyinaat fee sudooril lazeena 'ootul'il ma wamaa yajhadu biayaatinaa 'il laaz-zaal imoon
Waqaal u lawlaa 'unzil a 'al ayhi 'ayaat mmir rrabbihi qul 'innamaal ayaatu 'indal laahi wainnamaa 'anaa nazeer mmubeen
'awal am yakfihim 'annaa 'anzal naa 'al aykal kitaaba yutlaa 'al ayhim 'inna fee zaal ika larahmat wazikraa liqawm yu'minoon
Qul kafaa bil laahi baynee wabaynakum shaheeda ya'lamu maa fee as-samaawaati wal ardi wal lazeena 'aamanu bil baatil i wakafaru bil laahi 'ul aa'ika humul khaasiroon
Wayasta'jil oonaka bil'azaabi wal awlaa 'ajal mmusamma llajaa'ahumul'azaabu wal ayateeannahum baghtat wahum laa yash'uroon
Yasta'jil oonaka bil'azaabi wainna jahannama lamuheetatu bil kaafireen
Yawma yaghshaahumul'azaabu min fawqihim wamin tahti 'arjul ihim wayaqoolu zooqu maa kuntum ta'mal oon
Yaa'ibaadeeal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'inna 'ardee waasi'at faiyyaya fa'budoon
Kul lu nafs zaa'iqatul mawti thumma 'il aynaa turja'oon
Wal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati lanubawwi'annahum mminal jannati ghurafa tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa ni'ma 'ajrul'aamil een
Al lazeena sabaru wa'al aa rabbihim yatawakkal oon
Wakayyim mmin daabbat llaa tahmil u rizqahaal laahu yarzuquhaa waiyyaakum wahooas-samee'ul'al eem
Wal a'in saal tahum mman khal aqas-samaawaati wal arda wasakhkharash-shamsa wal qamara layaqoolunnal laahu faannaa yu'fakoon
Al laahu yabsutur-rizqa limany yashaa'u min 'ibaadihi wayaqdiru lahuaa 'innal laaha bikul li shay'in 'al eem
Wal a'in saal tahum mman nnazzal a minas-samaa'i maa' faahyaa bihil arda mim ba'di mawtihaa layaqoolunnal laahu qul il hamdu lil laahi bal 'aktharuhum laa ya'qil oon
Wamaa haazihil hayawaatud-dunyaa 'il laa lahw wal a'ib wainnad-daaral aakhirata laheeal hayawaanu law kaanu ya'lamoon
Faizaa rakibu fee al ful ki da'awual laaha mukhliseena lahud-deena fal ammaa najjaahum 'il aal barri 'izaa hum yushrikoon
Leeakfuru bimaa 'aataynaahum wal eeatamatta'u fasawfa ya'lamoon
'awal am yarawa 'annaa ja'al naa haramana 'aamina wayutakhattafun-naasu min hawlihim 'afabil baatil i yu'minoona wabini'matil laahi yakfuroon
Waman 'azlamu mimmaniftaraa 'al aal laahi kazibana 'aw kazzaba bil haqqi lammaa jaa'ahuaa 'al aysa fee jahannama mathwa llil kaafireen
Wal lazeena jaahadu feenaa lanahdeeannahum subul anaa wainnal laaha lama'al muhsineen

Ghul ibatir-room
Feeaa 'adnaal ardi wahum mmim ba'di ghal abihim sayaghliboon
Fee bid'i sineena lil laahil amru min qablu wamim ba'du wayawma'iz yafrahul mu'minoon
Binasril laahi yansuru many yashaa'u wahooal'azeezur-raheem
Wa'dal laahi laa yukhliful laahu wa'dahu wal aakinna 'aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Ya'lamoona zaahira mminal hayawaatid-dunyaa wahum 'anil aakhirati hum ghaafil oon
'awal am yatafakkaru feeaa 'anfusihim mmaa khal aqal laahus-samaawaati wal arda wamaa baynahumaa 'il laa bil haqqi waajal mmusamma wainna katheera mminan-naasi bil iqayi rabbihim lakaafiroon

'awal am yaseeru fee al ardi fayanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul lazeena min qablihim kaanooaa 'ashadda minhum qoowat waathaarul arda wa'amaroohaa 'akthara mimmaa 'amaroohaa wajaa'athum rusul uhum bil bayyinaati famaa kaanal laahu leeazlimahum wal aakin kaanooaa 'anfusahum yazlimoon
Thumma kaana 'aaqibatal lazeena 'asaaus-sooaa 'an kazzabu biayaatil laahi wakaanu bihaa yastahzi'oon
Al laahu yabda'ual khal qa thumma yu'eeduhu thumma 'il ayhi turja'oon
Wayawma taqoomus-saa'atu yublisul mujrimoon
Wal am yakul llaahum mmin shurakaa'ihim shufa'aa'ua wakaanu bishurakaa'ihim kaafireen
Wayawma taqoomus-saa'atu yawma'iz yatafarraqoon
Faammaal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati fahum fee rawdat yuhbaroon
Waammaal lazeena kafaru wakazzabu biayaatinaa wal iqayil aakhirati faul aa'ika fee al'azaabi muhdaroon
Fasubhaanal laahi heena tumsoona waheena tusbihoon
Wal ahul hamdu fee as-samaawaati wal ardi wa'ashiyya waheena tuzhiroon
Yukhrijul hayya minal mayyiti wayukhrijul mayyita minal hayyi wayuhyil arda ba'da mawtihaa wakazaal ika tukhrajoon
Wamin 'ayaatihiaa 'an khal aqakum mmin turaab thumma 'izaa 'antum bashar tantashiroon
Wamin 'ayaatihiaa 'an khal aqa lakum mmin 'anfusikum 'azwaaja llitaskunooaa 'il ayhaa waja'al a baynakum mmawaddat warahmatan 'inna fee zaal ika layaat lliqawm yatafakkaroon
Wamin 'ayaatihi khal qus-samaawaati wal ardi wakhtil aafu 'al sinatikum waal waanikum 'inna fee zaal ika layaat llil'aal imeen
Wamin 'ayaatihi manaamukum bil layli wan-nahaari wabtighaa'ukum mmin fadlihiaa 'inna fee zaal ika layaat lliqawm yasma'oon
Wamin 'ayaatihi yureekumul barqa khawfa watama'a wayunazzil u minas-samaa'i maa' fayuhyi bihil arda ba'da mawtihaa 'inna fee zaal ika layaat lliqawm ya'qil oon
Wamin 'ayaatihiaa 'an taqoomas-samaa'u wal ardu biamrihi thumma 'izaa da'aakum da'wat mminal ardi 'izaa 'antum takhrujoon
Wal ahu man fee as-samaawaati wal ardi kul l llaahu qaanitoon
Wahooal lazee yabda'ual khal qa thumma yu'eeduhu wahooa 'ahwanu 'al ayhi wal ahul mathal ul a'laa fee as-samaawaati wal ardi wahooal'azeezul hakeem

Daraba lakum mmathal a mmin 'anfusikum hal-lakum mmim mmaa mal akat 'aymaanukum mmin shurakaa'a fee maa razaqnaakum faantum feehi sawaa' takhaafoonahum kakheefatikum 'anfusakum kazaal ika nufassil ul ayaati liqawm ya'qil oon
Bal ittaba'al lazeena zal amooaa 'ahwaa'ahum bighayri 'il m famany yahdee man 'adal lal laahu wamaa lahum mmin nnaasireen
Faaqim wajhaka lid-deeni haneefa fitratal laahil latee fataran-naasa 'al ayhaa laa tabdeela likhal qil laahi zaal ikad-deenul qayyimu wal aakinna 'aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Muneebeena 'il ayhi wattaqoohu waaqeemus-sal aata wal aa takoonu minal mushrikeen
Minal lazeena farraqu deenahum wakaanu sheea'a kul lu hizbi bimaa ladayhim farihoon
Waizaa massan-naasa durr da'awa rabbahum mmuneebeena 'il ayhi thumma 'izaa 'azaaqahum mminhu rahmatan 'izaa fareeq mminhum birabbihim yushrikoon
Leeakfuru bimaa 'aataynaahum fatamatta'u fasawfa ta'lamoon
'am 'anzal naa 'al ayhim sul taana fahooa yatakal lamu bimaa kaanu bihi yushrikoon
Waizaa 'azaqnaan-naasa rahmat farihu bihaa wain tusibhum sayyi'atu bimaa qaddamat 'aydeehim 'izaa hum yaqnatoon
'awal am yarawa 'annal laaha yabsutur-rizqa limany yashaa'u wayaqdiru 'inna fee zaal ika layaat lliqawm yu'minoon
Faati zaal qurbaa haqqahu wal miskeena wabnas-sabeeli zaal ika khayr llil lazeena yureedoona wajhal laahi waul aa'ika humul muflihoon
Wamaa 'aataytum mmir rriba lleearbooaa feeaa 'amwaal in-naasi fal aa yarbu 'indal laahi wamaa 'aataytum mmin zakawaat tureedoona wajhal laahi faul aa'ika humul mud'ifoon
Al laahul lazee khal aqakum thumma razaqakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum hal min shurakaa'ikum mmany yaf'al u min zaal ikum mmin shay' subhaanahu wata'aal aa 'ammaa yushrikoon
Zaharal fasaadu fee al barri wal bahri bimaa kasabat 'aydee an-naasi leeuzeeqahum ba'dal lazee 'amil u la'al laahum yarji'oon
Qul seeru fee al ardi fanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul lazeena min qablu kaana 'aktharuhum mmushrikeen
Faaqim wajhaka lid-deenil qayyimi min qabli 'any yateea yawm llaa maradda lahu minal laahi yawma'iz yassadda'oon
Man kafara fa'al ayhi kufruhu waman 'amil a saal iha fal ianfusihim yamhadoon
Leeajzeeal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati min fadlihiaa 'innahu laa yuhibbul kaafireen
Wamin 'ayaatihiaa 'any yursil ar-reeaaha mubashshiraat wal eeuzeeqakum mmir rrahmatihi wal itajreeal ful ku biamrihi wal itabtaghu min fadlihi wal a'al lakum tashkuroon
Wal aqad 'arsal naa min qablika rusul ana 'il aa qawmihim fajaa'oohum bil bayyinaati fantaqamnaa minal lazeena 'ajramu wakaana haqqana 'al aynaa nasrul mu'mineen

Al laahul lazee yursil ur-reeaaha fatutheeru sahaaba fayabsutuhu fee as-samaa'i kayfa yashaa'u wayaj'al uhu kisafa fataraal wadqa yakhruju min khil aal ihi faizaa 'asaaba bihi many yashaa'u min 'ibaadihiaa 'izaa hum yastabshiroon
Wain kaanu min qabli 'any yunazzal a 'al ayhim mmin qablihi lamubliseen
Fanzur 'il aa 'aathaari rahmatil laahi kayfa yuhyil arda ba'da mawtihaa 'inna zaal ika lamuhyil mawtaa wahooa 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
Wal a'in 'arsal naa reeha faraawhu musfarra llazal lu mim ba'dihi yakfuroon
Fainnaka laa tusmi'ul mawtaa wal aa tusmi'us-summad-du'aa'a 'izaa wal lawa mudbireen
Wamaa 'anta bihaadil'umyi 'an dal aal atihim 'in tusmi'u 'il laa many yu'minu biayaatinaa fahum mmuslimoon
Al laahul lazee khal aqakum mmin da'f thumma ja'al a mim ba'di da'f qoowat thumma ja'al a mim ba'di qoowat da'fa washaybat yakhluqu maa yashaa'u wahooal'al eemul qadeer
Wayawma taqoomus-saa'atu yuqsimul mujrimoona maa labithu ghayra saa'at kazaal ika kaanu yu'fakoon
Waqaal al lazeena 'ootul'il ma wal eemaana laqad labithtum fee kitaabil laahi 'il aa yawmil ba'thi fahaazaa yawmul ba'thi wal aakinnakum kuntum laa ta'lamoon
Fayawma'iz llaa yanfa'ul lazeena zal amu ma'ziratuhum wal aa hum yusta'taboon
Wal aqad darabnaa lin-naasi fee haazaal qur'aani min kul li mathal wal a'in ji'tahum biayat llayaqoolannal lazeena kafarooaa 'in 'antum 'il laa mubtil oon
Kazaal ika yatba'ul laahu 'al aa qul oobil lazeena laa ya'lamoon
Fasbir 'inna wa'dal laahi haqq wal aa yastakhiffannakal lazeena laa yooqinoon
Alif-Laaam-Meeem
Til ka 'ayaatul kitaabil hakeem
Huda warahmat llil muhsineen
Al lazeena yuqeemoonas-sal aata wayu'toonaz-zakaata wahum bil aakhirati hum yooqinoon
'ul aa'ika 'al aa huda mmir rrabbihim waul aa'ika humul muflihoon
Waminan-naasi many yashtaree lahwal hadeethi leeudil la 'an sabeelil laahi bighayri 'il m wayattakhizahaa huzooana 'ul aa'ika lahum 'azaab mmuheen
Waizaa tutlaa 'al ayhi 'ayaatunaa wal laa mustakbira kaal llam yasma'haa kaanna feeaa 'uzunayhi waqra fabashshirhu bi'azaabin 'al eem
'innal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati lahum jannaatun-na'eem
Khaal ideena feehaa wa'dal laahi haqqa wahooal'azeezul hakeem

Khal aqas-samaawaati bighayri 'amad tarawnahaa waal qaa fee al ardi rawaaseea 'an tameeda bikum wabaththa feehaa min kul li daabbat waanzal naa minas-samaa'i maa' faanbatnaa feehaa min kul li zawj kareem
Haazaa khal qul laahi faaroonee maazaa khal aqal lazeena min doonihi bal iz-zaal imoona fee dal aal mmubeen
Wal aqad 'aataynaa luqmaanal hikmata 'anishkur lil laahi wamany yashkur fainnamaa yashkuru linafsihi waman kafara fainnal laaha ghaneeyun hameed
Waiz qaal a luqmaanu libnihi wahooa ya'izuhu yaabunayya laa tushrik bil laahi 'innash-shirka lazul mun 'azeem
Wawassaynaal insaana biwaal idayhi hamal athu 'ummuhu wahnana 'al aa wahn wafisaal uhu fee 'aamayni 'anishkur lee wal iwaal idayka 'il ayyal maseer

Wain jaahadaaka 'al aa 'an tushrika bee maa laysa laka bihi 'il m fal aa tuti'humaa wasaahibhumaa fee ad-dunyaa ma'roofa wattabi' sabeela man 'anaaba 'il ayya thumma 'il ayya marji'ukum faunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Yaabunayya 'innahaa 'in taku mithqaal a habbat mmin khardal fatakun fee sakhratin 'aw fee as-samaawaati 'aw fee al ardi yati bihaal laahu 'innal laaha lateefun khabeer
Yaabunayya 'aqimis-sal aata wamur bil ma'roofi wanha 'anil munkari wasbir 'al aa maa 'asaabaka 'inna zaal ika min 'azmil umoor
Wal aa tusa'ir khaddaka lin-naasi wal aa tamshi fee al ardi marahana 'innal laaha laa yuhibbu kul la mukhtaal fakhoor
Waqsid fee mashyika waghdud min sawtika 'inna 'ankaral aswaati lasawtul hameer

'al am tarawa 'annal laaha sakhkhara lakum mmaa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardi waasbagha 'al aykum ni'amahu zaahirat wabaatinat waminan-naasi many yujaadil u fee al laahi bighayri 'il m wal aa huda wal aa kitaab mmuneer
Waizaa qeela lahumuttabi'u maa 'anzal al laahu qaal u bal nattabi'u maa wajadnaa 'al ayhi 'aabaa'anaa 'awal aw kaanash-shaytaanu yad'oohum 'il aa 'azaabis-sa'eer
Wamany yuslim wajhahuaa 'il aal laahi wahooa muhsin faqadistamsaka bil'urwatil wuthqaa wail aal laahi 'aaqibatul umoor
Waman kafara fal aa yahzunka kufruhuaa 'il aynaa marji'uhum fanunabbi'uhum bimaa 'amil ooaa 'innal laaha 'al eemu bizaatis-sudoor
Numatti'uhum qal eela thumma nadtarruhum 'il aa 'azaabin ghal eez
Wal a'in saal tahum mman khal aqas-samaawaati wal arda layaqoolunnal laahu qul il hamdu lil laahi bal 'aktharuhum laa ya'lamoon
Lil laahi maa fee as-samaawaati wal ardi 'innal laaha hooal ghaneeyul hameed
Wal aw 'annamaa fee al ardi min shajaratin 'aqlaam wal bahru yamudduhu mim ba'dihi sab'atu 'abhur mmaa nafidat kal imaatul laahi 'innal laaha 'azeezun hakeem
Mmaa khal qukum wal aa ba'thukum 'il laa kanafs waahidatin 'innal laaha samee'u baseer
'al am tara 'annal laaha yoolijul layla fee an-nahaari wayoolijun-nahaara fee al layli wasakhkharash-shamsa wal qamara kul l yajreeaa 'il aa 'ajal mmusamma waannal laaha bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer
Zaal ika biannal laaha hooal haqqu waanna maa yad'oona min doonihil baatil u waannal laaha hooal'al eeyul kabeer
'al am tara 'annal ful ka tajree fee al bahri bini'matil laahi leeureeakum mmin 'ayaatihiaa 'inna fee zaal ika layaat llikul li sabbaar shakoor
Waizaa ghasheeahum mmawj kaz-zul al i da'awual laaha mukhliseena lahud-deena fal ammaa najjaahum 'il aal barri faminhum mmuqtasid wamaa yajhadu biayaatinaa 'il laa kul lu khattaar kafoor

Yayyuhaan-naasuttaqu rabbakum wakhshawa yawma llaa yajzee waal idun 'anw wal adihi wal aa mawloodun hooa jaazin 'anw waal idihi shayana 'inna wa'dal laahi haqq fal aa taghurrannakumul hayawaatud-dunyaa wal aa yaghurrannakum bil laahil gharoor
