Al laahul lazee khal aqas-samaawaati wal arda wamaa baynahumaa fee sittati 'ayyaam thummastawaa 'al aal'arshi maa lakum mmin doonihi minw wal eey wal aa shafee'in 'afal aa tatazakkaroon
Yudabbirul amra minas-samaa'i 'il aal ardi thumma ya'ruju 'il ayhi fee yawm kaana miqdaaruhuaa 'al fa sanat mmimmaa ta'uddoon
Zaal ika 'aal imul ghaybi wash-shahaadatil'azeezur-raheem
Al lazeeaa 'ahsana kul la shay'in khal aqahu wabadaa khal qal insaani min teen
Thumma ja'al a naslahu min sul aal at mmim mmaa' mmaheen
Thumma sawwaahu wanafakha feehi mir rroohihi waja'al a lakumus-sam'a wal absaara wal afidata qal eela mmaa tashkuroon
Waqaal ooaa 'a'izaa dal al naa fee al ardi 'a'innaa lafee khal q jadeedi bal hum bil iqaa'i rabbihim kaafiroon
Qul yatawaffaakum mmal akul mawtil lazee wukkil a bikum thumma 'il aa rabbikum turja'oon
Wal aw taraa 'izil mujrimoona naakisu ru'oosihim 'inda rabbihim rabbanaa 'absarnaa wasami'naa farji'naa na'mal saal ihana 'innaa mooqinoon
Wal aw shi'naa laataynaa kul la nafsin hudaahaa wal aakin haqqal qawlu minnee laamlaanna jahannama minal jinnati wan-naasi 'ajma'een
Fazooqu bimaa naseetum liqaa'a yawmikum haazaa 'innaa naseenaakum wazooqu 'azaabal khul di bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
'innamaa yu'minu biayaatinaal lazeena 'izaa zukkiru bihaa kharru sujjada wasabbahu bihamdi rabbihim wahum laa yastakbiroon
Tatajaafaa junoobuhum 'anil madaaji'i yad'oona rabbahum khawfa watama'a wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
Fal aa ta'lamu nafs mmaa 'ukhfeea lahum mmin qurrati 'a'yun jazaa'a bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon
'afaman kaana mu'mina kaman kaana faasiqa llaa yastawun
'ammaal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati fal ahum jannaatul mawaa nuzul aa bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Waammaal lazeena fasaqu famawaahumun-naaru kul lamaa 'araadooaa 'any yakhruju minhaa 'u'eedu feehaa waqeela lahum zooqu 'azaaban-naaril lazee kuntum bihi tukazziboon
Wal anuzeeqannahum mminal'azaabil adnaa doonal'azaabil akbari la'al laahum yarji'oon
Waman 'azlamu mimman zukkira biayaati rabbihi thumma 'a'rada 'anhaa 'innaa minal mujrimeena muntaqimoon
Wal aqad 'aataynaa moosaal kitaaba fal aa takun fee miryat mmil lliqaa'ihi waja'al naahu huda llibaneeaa 'israa'eel
Waja'al naa minhum 'a'immat yahdoona biamrinaa lammaa sabaru wakaanu biayaatinaa yooqinoon
'inna rabbaka hooa yafsil u baynahum yawmal qeeaamati feemaa kaanu feehi yakhtal ifoon
'awal am yahdi lahum kam 'ahlaknaa min qablihim mminal qurooni yamshoona fee masaakinihim 'inna fee zaal ika layaatin 'afal aa yasma'oon
'awal am yarawa 'annaa nasooqul maa'a 'il aal ardil juruzi fanukhriju bihi zar'a takul u minhu 'an'aamuhum waanfusuhum 'afal aa yubsiroon
Wayaqooloona mataa haazaal fathu 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul yawmal fathi laa yanfa'ul lazeena kafarooaa 'eemaanuhum wal aa hum yunzaroon
Faa'rid 'anhum wantazir 'innahum mmuntaziroon
Yayyuhaan-nabeeyuttaqil laaha wal aa tuti'il kaafireena wal munaafiqeena 'innal laaha kaana 'al eemana hakeem
Wattabi' maa yoohaa 'il ayka mir rrabbika 'innal laaha kaana bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer
Watawakkal 'al aal laahi wakafaa bil laahi wakeel

Mmaa ja'al al laahu lirajul mmin qal bayni fee jawfihi wamaa ja'al a 'azwaajakumul laaee tuzaahiroona minhunna 'ummahaatikum wamaa ja'al a 'ad'eeaa'akum 'abnaa'akum zaal ikum qawlukum biafwaahikum wal laahu yaqoolul haqqa wahooa yahdee as-sabeel

Ad'oohum liaabaa'ihim hooa 'aqsatu 'indal laahi fail llam ta'lamooaa 'aabaa'ahum faikhwaanukum fee ad-deeni wamawaal eekum wal aysa 'al aykum junaah feemaa 'akhtatum bihi wal aakim mmaa ta'ammadat qul oobukum wakaanal laahu ghafoora rraheeman

An-nabeeyu 'awlaa bil mu'mineena min 'anfusihim waazwaajuhuaa 'ummahaatuhum waoolul arhaami ba'duhum 'awlaa biba'd fee kitaabil laahi minal mu'mineena wal muhaajireena 'il laa 'an taf'al ooaa 'il aa 'awleeaa'ikum mma'roofa kaana zaal ika fee al kitaabi mastoor
Waiz 'akhaznaa minan-nabeeyina meethaaqahum waminka wamin nnooh waibraaheema wamoosaa wa'eesaabni maryama waakhaznaa minhum mmeethaaqana ghal eez
Lleeasal as-saadiqeena 'an sidqihim waa'adda lil kaafireena 'azaabana 'al eem
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanuzkuru ni'matal laahi 'al aykum 'iz jaa'atkum junood faarsal naa 'al ayhim reeha wajunooda llam tarawhaa wakaanal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona baseeran
'iz jaa'ookum mmin fawqikum wamin 'asfal a minkum waiz zaaghatil absaaru wabal aghatil qul oobul hanaajira watazunnoona bil laahiz-zunoona
Hunaal ikabtul eeal mu'minoona wazul zil u zil zaal a shadeed
Waiz yaqoolul munaafiqoona wal lazeena fee qul oobihim mmarad mmaa wa'adanaal laahu warasooluhuaa 'il laa ghuroor
Waiz qaal at ttaa'ifat mminhum yaahla yathriba laa muqaama lakum farji'u wayastazinu fareeq mminhumun-nabiyya yaqooloona 'inna buyootanaa 'awrat wamaa heea bi'awratin 'iny yureedoona 'il laa firaar
Wal aw dukhil at 'al ayhim mmin 'aqtaarihaa thumma su'il ul fitnata laatawhaa wamaa tal abbathu bihaa 'il laa yaseer
Wal aqad kaanu 'aahadul laaha min qablu laa yooal loonal adbaara wakaana 'ahdul laahi masool
Qul-lany yanfa'akumul firaaru 'in farartum mminal mawti 'awil qatli waiza llaa tumatta'oona 'il laa qal eel
Qul man zaal lazee ya'simukum mminal laahi 'in 'araada bikum sooaa'ana 'aw 'araada bikum rahmat wal aa yajidoona lahum mmin doonil laahi wal iyya wal aa naseer
Qad ya'lamul laahul mu'awwiqeena minkum wal qaa'il eena liikhwaanihim hal umma 'il aynaa wal aa yatoonal basa 'il laa qal eelan

'ashihhatan 'al aykum faizaa jaa'al khawfu raytahum yanzuroona 'il ayka tadooru 'a'yunuhum kal lazee yughshaa 'al ayhi minal mawti faizaa zahabal khawfu sal aqookum bial sinatin hidaadin 'ashihhatan 'al aal khayri 'ul aa'ika lam yu'minu faahbatal laahu 'a'maal ahum wakaana zaal ika 'al aal laahi yaseer
Yahsaboonal ahzaaba lam yazhabu wainy yatil ahzaabu yawaddu law 'annahum baadoona fee al a'raabi yasal oona 'an 'anbaa'ikum wal aw kaanu feekum mmaa qaatal ooaa 'il laa qal eel
Llaqad kaana lakum fee rasoolil laahi 'uswatun hasanat lliman kaana yarjul laaha wal yawmal aakhira wazakaral laaha katheer
Wal ammaa ra'aal mu'minoonal ahzaaba qaal u haazaa maa wa'adanaal laahu warasooluhu wasadaqal laahu warasooluhu wamaa zaadahum 'il laa 'eemaana watasleem
Mminal mu'mineena rijaal sadaqu maa 'aahadul laaha 'al ayhi faminhum mman qadaa nahbahu waminhum mmany yantaziru wamaa baddal u tabdeel
Lleeajzeeal laahus-saadiqeena bisidqihim wayu'azzibal munaafiqeena 'in shaa'a 'aw yatooba 'al ayhim 'innal laaha kaana ghafoora rraheem
Waraddal laahul lazeena kafaru bighayzihim lam yanaal u khayra wakafaal laahul mu'mineenal qitaal a wakaanal laahu qawiyyana 'azeez
Waanzal al lazeena zaaharoohum mmin 'ahlil kitaabi min sayaaseehim waqazafa fee qul oobihimur-ru'ba fareeqa taqtul oona watasiroona fareeq
Waawrathakum 'ardahum wadeeaarahum waamwaal ahum waarda llam tataoohaa wakaanal laahu 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
Yayyuhaan-nabeeyu qul-liazwaajika 'in kuntunna turidnal hayawaatad-dunyaa wazeenatahaa fata'aal ayna 'umatti'kunna wausarrihkunna saraaha jameel
Wain kuntunna turidnal laaha warasoolahu wad-daaral aakhirata fainnal laaha 'a'adda lil muhsinaati minkunna 'ajrana 'azeem
Yaanisaa'an-nabeeyi many yati minkunna bifaahishat mmubayyinat yudaa'af lahaal'azaabu di'fayni wakaana zaal ika 'al aal laahi yaseer
Wamany yaqnut minkunna lil laahi warasoolihi wata'mal saal iha nnu'tihaa 'ajrahaa marratayni waa'tadnaa lahaa rizqa kareem
Yaanisaa'an-nabeeyi lastunna kaahad mminan-nisaa'i 'inittaqaytunna fal aa takhda'na bil qawli fayatma'al lazee fee qal bihi marad waqul na qawla mma'roof

Waqarna fee buyootikunna wal aa tabarrajna tabarrujal jaahil iyyatil oolaa waaqimnas-sal aata wa'aateenaz-zakaata waati'nal laaha warasoolahuaa 'innamaa yureedul laahu leeuzhiba 'ankumur-rijsa 'ahlal bayti wayutahhirakum tatheer
Wazkurna maa yutlaa fee buyootikunna min 'ayaatil laahi wal hikmati 'innal laaha kaana lateefana khabeeran

'innal muslimeena wal muslimaati wal mu'mineena wal mu'minaati wal qaaniteena wal qaanitaati was-saadiqeena was-saadiqaati was-saabireena was-saabiraati wal khaashi'eena wal khaashi'aati wal mutasaddiqeena wal mutasaddiqaati was-saa'imeena was-saa'imaati wal haafizeena furoojahum wal haafizaati waz-zaakireenal laaha katheera waz-zaakiraati 'a'addal laahu lahum mmaghfirat waajrana 'azeem
Wamaa kaana limu'minw wal aa mu'minatin 'izaa qadaal laahu warasooluhuaa 'amrana 'any yakoona lahumul kheearatu min 'amrihim wamany ya'sil laaha warasoolahu faqad dal la dal aal a mmubeen

Waiz taqoolu lil lazeeaa 'an'amal laahu 'al ayhi waan'amta 'al ayhi 'amsik 'al ayka zawjaka wattaqil laaha watukhfee fee nafsika maal laahu mubdeehi watakhshaan-naasa wal laahu 'ahaqqu 'an takhshaahu fal ammaa qadaa zayd mminhaa watara zawwajnaakahaa likay laa yakoona 'al aal mu'mineena haraj feeaa 'azwaaji 'ad'eeaa'ihim 'izaa qadawa minhunna watara wakaana 'amrul laahi maf'ool
Mmaa kaana 'al aan-nabeeyi min haraj feemaa faradal laahu lahu sunnatal laahi fee al lazeena khal awa min qablu wakaana 'amrul laahi qadara mmaqdooran
Al lazeena yubal lighoona risaal aatil laahi wayakhshawnahu wal aa yakhshawna 'ahadana 'il laal laaha wakafaa bil laahi haseeb
Mmaa kaana muhammadun 'abaa 'ahad mmir rrijaal ikum wal aakir rrasoolal laahi wakhaataman-nabeeyina wakaanal laahu bikul li shay'in 'al eem
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanuzkurul laaha zikra katheer
Wasabbihoohu bukrat waaseelan
Hooal lazee yusal lee 'al aykum wamal aa'ikatuhu leeukhrijakum mminaz-zul umaati 'il aan-noori wakaana bil mu'mineena raheem
Tahiyyatuhum yawma yal qawnahu sal aam waa'adda lahum 'ajra kareem
Yayyuhaan-nabeeyu 'innaa 'arsal naaka shaahida wamubashshira wanazeer
Wadaa'eeana 'il aal laahi biiznihi wasiraaja mmuneer
Wabashshiril mu'mineena bianna lahum mminal laahi fadla kabeer
Wal aa tuti'il kaafireena wal munaafiqeena wada' 'azaahum watawakkal 'al aal laahi wakafaa bil laahi wakeel

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'izaa nakahtumul mu'minaati thumma tal laqtumoohunna min qabli 'an tamassoohunna famaa lakum 'al ayhinna min 'iddat ta'taddoonahaa famatti'oohunna wasarrihoohunna saraaha jameel

Yayyuhaan-nabeeyu 'innaa 'ahlal naa laka 'azwaajakal laateeaa 'aatayta 'ujoorahunna wamaa mal akat yameenuka mimmaa 'afaa'al laahu 'al ayka wabanaati 'ammika wabanaati 'ammaatika wabanaati khaal ika wabanaati khaal aatikal laatee haajarna ma'aka wamraat mmu'minatan 'inw wahabat nafsahaa lin-nabeeyi 'in 'araadan-nabeeyu 'any yastankihahaa khaal isat llaka min doonil mu'mineena qad 'al imnaa maa faradnaa 'al ayhim feeaa 'azwaajihim wamaa mal akat 'aymaanuhum likaylaa yakoona 'al ayka haraj wakaanal laahu ghafoora rraheem

Turjee man tashaa'u minhunna watooeeaa 'il ayka man tashaa'u wamanibtaghayta mimman 'azal ta fal aa junaaha 'al ayka zaal ika 'adnaa 'an taqarra 'a'yunuhunna wal aa yahzanna wayardayna bimaa 'aataytahunna kul luhunna wal laahu ya'lamu maa fee qul oobikum wakaanal laahu 'al eemana hal eem
Llaa yahil lu lakan-nisaa'u mim ba'du wal aa 'an tabaddal a bihinna min 'azwaaj wal aw 'a'jabaka husnuhunna 'il laa maa mal akat yameenuka wakaanal laahu 'al aa kul li shay' rraqeeb

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa tadkhul u buyootan-nabeeyi 'il laa 'any yu'zana lakum 'il aa ta'aamin ghayra naazireena 'inaahu wal aakin 'izaa du'eetum fadkhul u faizaa ta'imtum fantashiru wal aa mustaniseena lihadeethin 'inna zaal ikum kaana yu'zee an-nabiyya fayastahyi minkum wal laahu laa yastahyi minal haqqi waizaa saal tumoohunna mataa'a fasal oohunna minw waraa'i hijaab zaal ikum 'atharu liqul oobikum waqul oobihinna wamaa kaana lakum 'an tu'zu rasoolal laahi wal aa 'an tankihooaa 'azwaajahu mim ba'dihiaa 'abadana 'inna zaal ikum kaana 'indal laahi 'azeeman
'in tubdu shayana 'aw tukhfoohu fainnal laaha kaana bikul li shay'in 'al eem

Llaa junaaha 'al ayhinna feeaa 'aabaa'ihinna wal aa 'abnaa'ihinna wal aa 'ikhwaanihinna wal aa 'abnaa'i 'ikhwaanihinna wal aa 'abnaa'i 'akhawaatihinna wal aa nisaa'ihinna wal aa maa mal akat 'aymaanuhunna wattaqeenal laaha 'innal laaha kaana 'al aa kul li shay' shaheedan
'innal laaha wamal aa'ikatahu yusal loona 'al aan-nabeeyi yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu sal lu 'al ayhi wasal limu tasleeman
'innal lazeena yu'zoonal laaha warasoolahu la'anahumul laahu fee ad-dunyaa wal aakhirati waa'adda lahum 'azaaba mmuheen
Wal lazeena yu'zoonal mu'mineena wal mu'minaati bighayri maaktasabu faqadihtamal u buhtaana waithma mmubeen
Yayyuhaan-nabeeyu qul-liazwaajika wabanaatika wanisaa'il mu'mineena yudneena 'al ayhinna min jal aabeebihinna zaal ika 'adnaa 'any yu'rafna fal aa yu'zayna wakaanal laahu ghafoora rraheem
Lla'il llam yantahil munaafiqoona wal lazeena fee qul oobihim mmarad wal murjifoona fee al madeenati lanughreeannaka bihim thumma laa yujaawiroonaka feehaa 'il laa qal eel
Mmal'ooneena 'aynamaa thuqifooaa 'ukhizu waquttil u taqteel
Sunnatal laahi fee al lazeena khal awa min qablu wal an tajida lisunnatil laahi tabdeel
Yasal ukan-naasu 'anis-saa'ati qul 'innamaa 'il muhaa 'indal laahi wamaa yudreeka la'al las-saa'ata takoonu qareeban
'innal laaha la'anal kaafireena waa'adda lahum sa'eeran
Khaal ideena feehaa 'abada llaa yajidoona wal iyya wal aa naseer
Yawma tuqal labu wujoohuhum fee an-naari yaqooloona yaal aytanaa 'ata'naal laaha waata'naar-rasoola
Waqaal u rabbanaa 'innaa 'ata'naa saadatanaa wakubaraa'anaa faadal loonaas-sabeela
Rabbanaa 'aatihim di'fayni minal'azaabi wal'anhum la'na kabeer
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa takoonu kal lazeena 'aazawa moosaa fabarraahul laahu mimmaa qaal u wakaana 'indal laahi wajeeh
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanuttaqul laaha waqoolu qawla sadeed
Yuslih lakum 'a'maal akum wayaghfir lakum zunoobakum wamany yuti'il laaha warasoolahu faqad faaza fawzana 'azeeman
'innaa 'aradnaal amaanata 'al aas-samaawaati wal ardi wal jibaal i faabayna 'any yahmil nahaa waashfaqna minhaa wahamal ahaal insaanu 'innahu kaana zal ooma jahool
Lleeu'azzibal laahul munaafiqeena wal munaafiqaati wal mushrikeena wal mushrikaati wayatoobal laahu 'al aal mu'mineena wal mu'minaati wakaanal laahu ghafoora rraheema
Al hamdu lil laahil lazee lahu maa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardi wal ahul hamdu fee al aakhirati wahooal hakeemul khabeer
Ya'lamu maa yal iju fee al ardi wamaa yakhruju minhaa wamaa yanzil u minas-samaa'i wamaa ya'ruju feehaa wahooar-raheemul ghafoor

Waqaal al lazeena kafaru laa tateenaas-saa'atu qul bal aa warabbee latateeannakum 'aal imil ghaybi laa ya'zubu 'anhu mithqaal u zarrat fee as-samaawaati wal aa fee al ardi wal aa 'asgharu min zaal ika wal aa 'akbaru 'il laa fee kitaab mmubeen
Lleeajzeeal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati 'ul aa'ika lahum mmaghfirat warizq kareem
Wal lazeena sa'aw feeaa 'ayaatinaa mu'aajizeena 'ul aa'ika lahum 'azaab mmir rrijzin 'al eem
Wayaraal lazeena 'ootul'il mal lazeeaa 'unzil a 'il ayka mir rrabbika hooal haqqa wayahdeeaa 'il aa siraatil'azeezil hameed
Waqaal al lazeena kafaru hal nadul lukum 'al aa rajul yunabbi'ukum 'izaa muzziqtum kul la mumazzaqin 'innakum lafee khal q jadeed
'aftaraa 'al aal laahi kazibana 'am bihi jinnatu bal il lazeena laa yu'minoona bil aakhirati fee al'azaabi wad-dal aal il ba'eed

'afal am yarawa 'il aa maa bayna 'aydeehim wamaa khal fahum mminas-samaa'i wal ardi 'in nnasha nakhsif bihimul arda 'aw nusqit 'al ayhim kisafa mminas-samaa'i 'inna fee zaal ika layat llikul li 'abd mmuneeb
Wal aqad 'aataynaa daawuda minnaa fadla yaajibaal u 'awwibee ma'ahu wat-tayra waal annaa lahul hadeed
'ani'mal saabighaat waqaddir fee as-sardi wa'mal u saal ihana 'innee bimaa ta'mal oona baseer

Wal isul aymaanar-reeha ghudoowuhaa shahr warawaahuhaa shahr waasal naa lahu 'aynal qitri waminal jinni many ya'mal u bayna yadayhi biizni rabbihi wamany yazigh minhum 'an 'amrinaa nuziqhu min 'azaabis-sa'eer
Ya'mal oona lahu maa yashaa'u mim mmahaareeba watamaatheela wajifaan kal jawaabi waqudoor rraaseeaatin a'mal ooaa 'aal a daawuda shukra waqal eel mmin 'ibaadeeash-shakoor

Fal ammaa qadaynaa 'al ayhil mawta maa dal laahum 'al aa mawtihiaa 'il laa daabbatul ardi takul u minsaatahu fal ammaa kharra tabayyanatil jinnu 'al llaw kaanu ya'lamoonal ghayba maa labithu fee al'azaabil muheen
Laqad kaana lisaba fee maskanihim 'ayat jannataani 'any yameen washimaal kul u mir rrizqi rabbikum washkuru lahu bal dat tayyibat warabbun ghafoor
Faa'radu faarsal naa 'al ayhim saylal'arimi wabaddal naahum bijannatayhim jannatayni zawaatay 'ukul in khamt waathl washay' mmin sidr qal eel
Zaal ika jazaynaahum bimaa kafaru wahal nujaazeeaa 'il laal kafoor
Waja'al naa baynahum wabaynal quraal latee baaraknaa feehaa qura zaahirat waqaddarnaa feehaas-sayra seeru feehaa layaal eea wayyaamana 'aamineen
Faqaal u rabbanaa baa'id bayna 'asfaarinaa wazal amooaa 'anfusahum faja'al naahum 'ahaadeetha wamazzaqnaahum kul la mumazzaqin 'inna fee zaal ika layaat llikul li sabbaar shakoor
Wal aqad saddaqa 'al ayhim 'ibleesu zannahu fattaba'oohu 'il laa fareeqa mminal mu'mineen
Wamaa kaana lahu 'al ayhim mmin sul taanin 'il laa lina'lama many yu'minu bil aakhirati mimman hooa minhaa fee shakk warabbuka 'al aa kul li shay'in hafeez
Qul id'ul lazeena za'amtum mmin doonil laahi laa yamlikoona mithqaal a zarrat fee as-samaawaati wal aa fee al ardi wamaa lahum feehimaa min shirk wamaa lahu minhum mmin zaheer
Wal aa tanfa'ush-shafaa'atu 'indahuaa 'il laa liman 'azina lahu hattaa 'izaa fuzzi'a 'an qul oobihim qaal u maazaa qaal a rabbukum qaal ul haqqa wahooal'al eeyul kabeer
Qul many yarzuqukum mminas-samaawaati wal ardi qul il laahu wainnaa 'aw 'iyyaakum la'al aa hudana 'aw fee dal aal mmubeen
Qul-laa tusal oona 'ammaa 'ajramnaa wal aa nusal u 'ammaa ta'mal oon
Qul yajma'u baynanaa rabbunaa thumma yaftahu baynanaa bil haqqi wahooal fattaahul'al eem
Qul 'arooneeal lazeena 'al haqtum bihi shurakaa'a kal laa bal hooal laahul'azeezul hakeem
Wamaa 'arsal naaka 'il laa kaaffat llin-naasi basheera wanazeera wal aakinna 'aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Wayaqooloona mataa haazaal wa'du 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul-lakum mmee'aadu yawm llaa tastakhiroona 'anhu saa'at wal aa tastaqdimoon

Waqaal al lazeena kafaru lan nnu'mina bihaazaal qur'aani wal aa bil lazee bayna yadayhi wal aw taraa 'iziz-zaal imoona mawqoofoona 'inda rabbihim yarji'u ba'duhum 'il aa ba'din al qawla yaqoolul lazeenastud'ifu lil lazeenastakbaru lawlaa 'antum lakunnaa mu'mineen
Qaal al lazeenastakbaru lil lazeenastud'ifooaa 'anahnu sadadnaakum 'anil hudaa ba'da 'iz jaa'akum bal kuntum mmujrimeen

Waqaal al lazeenastud'ifu lil lazeenastakbaru bal makrul layli wan-nahaari 'iz tamuroonanaa 'an nnakfura bil laahi wanaj'al a lahuaa 'andaada waasarrun-nadaamata lammaa raawual'azaaba waja'al naal aghlaal a feeaa 'a'naaqil lazeena kafaru hal yujzawna 'il laa maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Wamaa 'arsal naa fee qaryat mmin nnazeerin 'il laa qaal a mutrafoohaa 'innaa bimaa 'ursil tum bihi kaafiroon
Waqaal u nahnu 'aktharu 'amwaal a waawlaada wamaa nahnu bimu'azzabeen
Qul 'inna rabbee yabsutur-rizqa limany yashaa'u wayaqdiru wal aakinna 'aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Wamaa 'amwaal ukum wal aa 'awlaadukum bil latee tuqarribukum 'indanaa zul faa 'il laa man 'aamana wa'amil a saal iha faul aa'ika lahum jazaa'ud-di'fi bimaa 'amil u wahum fee al ghurufaati 'aaminoon
Wal lazeena yas'awna feeaa 'ayaatinaa mu'aajizeena 'ul aa'ika fee al'azaabi muhdaroon
Qul 'inna rabbee yabsutur-rizqa limany yashaa'u min 'ibaadihi wayaqdiru lahu wamaa 'anfaqtum mmin shay' fahooa yukhlifuhu wahooa khayrur-raaziqeen
Wayawma yahshuruhum jamee'a thumma yaqoolu lil mal aa'ikati 'ahaa'ul aa'i 'iyyaakum kaanu ya'budoon
Qaal u subhaanaka 'anta wal eeyunaa min doonihim bal kaanu ya'budoonal jinna 'aktharuhum bihim mmu'minoon
Fal yawma laa yamliku ba'dukum liba'd nnaf'a wal aa darra wanaqoolu lil lazeena zal amu zooqu 'azaaban-naaril latee kuntum bihaa tukazziboon

Waizaa tutlaa 'al ayhim 'ayaatunaa bayyinaat qaal u maa haazaa 'il laa rajul yureedu 'any yasuddakum 'ammaa kaana ya'budu 'aabaa'ukum waqaal u maa haazaa 'il laa 'ifk mmuftara waqaal al lazeena kafaru lil haqqi lammaa jaa'ahum 'in haazaa 'il laa sihr mmubeen
Wamaa 'aataynaahum mmin kutub yadrusoonahaa wamaa 'arsal naa 'il ayhim qablaka min nnazeer
Wakazzabal lazeena min qablihim wamaa bal aghu mi'shaara maa 'aataynaahum fakazzabu rusul ee fakayfa kaana nakeer
Qul 'innamaa 'a'izukum biwaahidatin 'an taqoomu lil laahi mathnaa wafuraadaa thumma tatafakkaru maa bisaahibikum mmin jinnatin 'in hooa 'il laa nazeer llakum bayna yaday 'azaab shadeed
Qul maa saal tukum mmin 'ajr fahooa lakum 'in 'ajreea 'il laa 'al aal laahi wahooa 'al aa kul li shay' shaheed
Qul 'inna rabbee yaqzifu bil haqqi 'al laamul ghuyoob
Qul jaa'al haqqu wamaa yubdi'ul baatil u wamaa yu'eed
Qul 'in dal al tu fainnamaa 'adil lu 'al aa nafsee wainihtadaytu fabimaa yooheeaa 'il ayya rabbeeaa 'innahu samee' qareeb
Wal aw taraa 'iz fazi'u fal aa fawta waukhizu mim mmakaan qareeb
Waqaal ooaa 'aamannaa bihi waannaa lahumut-tanaawushu mim mmakaani ba'eed
Waqad kafaru bihi min qablu wayaqzifoona bil ghaybi mim mmakaani ba'eed
Waheela baynahum wabayna maa yashtahoona kamaa fu'il a biashyaa'ihim mmin qablu 'innahum kaanu fee shakk mmureeb

Al hamdu lil laahi faatiris-samaawaati wal ardi jaa'il il mal aa'ikati rusul ana 'ooleeaa 'ajnihat mmathnaa wathul aatha warubaa'a yazeedu fee al khal qi maa yashaa'u 'innal laaha 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
Mmaa yaftahil laahu lin-naasi mir rrahmat fal aa mumsika lahaa wamaa yumsik fal aa mursil a lahu mim ba'dihi wahooal'azeezul hakeem
Yayyuhaan-naasuzkuru ni'matal laahi 'al aykum hal min khaal iqin ghayrul laahi yarzuqukum mminas-samaa'i wal ardi laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa faannaa tu'fakoon
Wainy yukazzibooka faqad kuzzibat rusul mmin qablika wail aal laahi turja'ul umoor
Yayyuhaan-naasu 'inna wa'dal laahi haqq fal aa taghurrannakumul hayawaatud-dunyaa wal aa yaghurrannakum bil laahil gharoor
'innash-shaytaana lakum 'adoow fattakhizoohu 'adoowana 'innamaa yad'u hizbahu leeakoonu min 'ashaabis-sa'eer
Al lazeena kafaru lahum 'azaab shadeed wal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati lahum mmaghfirat waajr kabeer
'afaman zuyyina lahu sooaa'u 'amal ihi fara'aahu hasana fainnal laaha yudil lu many yashaa'u wayahdee many yashaa'u fal aa tazhab nafsuka 'al ayhim hasaraatin 'innal laaha 'al eemu bimaa yasna'oon
Wal laahul lazeeaa 'arsal ar-reeaaha fatutheeru sahaaba fasuqnaahu 'il aa bal ad mmayyit faahyaynaa bihil arda ba'da mawtihaa kazaal ikan-nushoor

Man kaana yureedul'izzata fal il laahil'izzatu jamee'ana 'il ayhi yas'adul kal imut-tayyibu wal'amal us-saal ihu yarfa'uhu wal lazeena yamkuroonas-sayyiaati lahum 'azaab shadeed wamakru 'ul aa'ika hooa yaboor

Wal laahu khal aqakum mmin turaab thumma min nnutfat thumma ja'al akum 'azwaaja wamaa tahmil u min 'unthaa wal aa tada'u 'il laa bi'il mihi wamaa yu'ammaru mim mmu'ammar wal aa yunqasu min 'umurihiaa 'il laa fee kitaabin 'inna zaal ika 'al aal laahi yaseer

Wamaa yastawee al bahraani haazaa 'azb furaat saa'igh sharaabuhu wahaazaa mil hun 'ujaaj wamin kul l takul oona lahma tariyya watastakhrijoona hil yat tal basoonahaa wataraal ful ka feehi mawaakhira litabtaghu min fadlihi wal a'al lakum tashkuroon

Yoolijul layla fee an-nahaari wayoolijun-nahaara fee al layli wasakhkharash-shamsa wal qamara kul l yajree liajal mmusamma zaal ikumul laahu rabbukum lahul mul ku wal lazeena tad'oona min doonihi maa yamlikoona min qitmeer

Wal aqad sabaqat kal imatunaa li'ibaadinaal mursal een
'innahum lahumul mansooroon
Wainna jundanaa lahumul ghaal iboon
Fatawal la 'anhum hattaa heen
Waabsirhum fasawfa yubsiroon
'afabi'azaabinaa yasta'jil oon
Faizaa nazal a bisaahatihim fasaa'a sabaahul munzareen
Watawal la 'anhum hattaa heen
Waabsir fasawfa yubsiroon
Subhaana rabbika rabbil'izzati 'ammaa yasifoon
Wasal aamun 'al aal mursal een
Wal hamdu lil laahi rabbil'aal ameen
Saa wal qur'aani zee az-zikr
Bal il lazeena kafaru fee 'izzat washiqaaq
Kam 'ahlaknaa min qablihim mmin qarn fanaada wwal aata heena manaas
Wa'ajibooaa 'an jaa'ahum mmunzir mminhum waqaal al kaafiroona haazaa saahir kazzaab
'aja'al al aal ihata 'il aaha waahidana 'inna haazaa lashay'un 'ujaab
Wantal aqal mal au minhum 'animshu wasbiru 'al aa 'aal ihatikum 'inna haazaa lashay' yuraad
Maa sami'naa bihaazaa fee al mil latil aakhirati 'in haazaa 'il laakhtil aaq
'a'unzil a 'al ayhiz-zikru mim bayninaa bal hum fee shakk mmin zikree bal-lammaa yazooqu 'azaab
'am 'indahum khazaa'inu rahmati rabbikal'azeezil wahhaab
'am lahum mmul kus-samaawaati wal ardi wamaa baynahumaa fal yartaqu fee al asbaab
Jund mmaa hunaal ika mahzoom mminal ahzaab
Kazzabat qablahum qawmu nooh wa'aad wafir'awnu zoo al awtaad
Wathamoodu waqawmu loot waashaabu laykati 'ul aa'ikal ahzaab
'in kul lun 'il laa kazzabar-rusul a fahaqqa 'iqaab
Wamaa yanzuru haa'ul aa'i 'il laa sayhat waahidat mmaa lahaa min fawaaq
Waqaal u rabbanaa 'ajjil-lanaa qittanaa qabla yawmil hisaab
Asbir 'al aa maa yaqooloona wazkur 'abdanaa daawuda zaal aydi 'innahuaa 'awwaab
'innaa sakhkharnaal jibaal a ma'ahu yusabbihna bil'asheeyi wal ishraaq
Wat-tayra mahshoorat kul l llaahuaa 'awwaab
Washadadnaa mul kahu wa'aataynaahul hikmata wafaslal khitaab
Wahal 'ataaka naba'ual khasmi 'iz tasawwarul mihraab
'iz dakhal u 'al aa daawuda fafazi'a minhum qaal u laa takhaf khasmaani baghaa ba'dunaa 'al aa ba'd fahkum baynanaa bil haqqi wal aa tushtit wahdinaa 'il aa sawaa'is-siraah
'inna haazaa 'akhee lahu tis' watis'oona na'jat wal eea na'jat waahidat faqaal a 'akfil neehaa wa'azzanee fee al khitaab

Qaal a laqad zal amaka bisu'aal i na'jatika 'il aa ni'aajihi wainna katheera mminal khul ataa'i layabghee ba'duhum 'al aa ba'din 'il laal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati waqal eel mmaa hum wazanna daawudu 'annamaa fatannaahu fastaghfara rabbahu wakharra raaki'a waanaab
Faghafarnaa lahu zaal ika wainna lahu 'indanaa lazul faa wahusna maab

Yaadaawudu 'innaa ja'al naaka khal eefat fee al ardi fahkum baynan-naasi bil haqqi wal aa tattabi'il hawaa fayudil laka 'an sabeelil laahi 'innal lazeena yadil loona 'an sabeelil laahi lahum 'azaab shadeedu bimaa nasu yawmal hisaab
Wamaa khal aqnaas-samaa'a wal arda wamaa baynahumaa baatil a zaal ika zannul lazeena kafaru fawayl llil lazeena kafaru minan-naar
'am naj'al ul lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati kal mufsideena fee al ardi 'am naj'al ul muttaqeena kal fujjaar
Kitaabun 'anzal naahu 'il ayka mubaarak lleeaddabbarooaa 'ayaatihi wal eeatazakkara 'oolul al baab
Wawahabnaa lidaawuda sul aymaana ni'mal'abdu 'innahuaa 'awwaab
'iz 'urida 'al ayhi bil'asheeyis-saafinaatul jeeaad
Faqaal a 'inneeaa 'ahbabtu hubbal khayri 'an zikri rabbee hattaa tawaarat bil hijaab
Ruddoohaa 'al ayya fatafiqa mashaa bis-sooqi wal a'naaq
Wal aqad fatannaa sul aymaana waal qaynaa 'al aa kurseeyihi jasada thumma 'anaab
Qaal a rabbighfir lee wahab lee mul ka llaa yanbaghee liahad mmim ba'deeaa 'innaka 'antal wahhaab
Fasakhkharnaa lahur-reeha tajree biamrihi rukhaa'an haythu 'asaab
Wash-shayaateena kul la bannaa' waghawwaas
Wa'aakhareena muqarraneena fee al asfaad
Haazaa 'ataa'unaa famnun 'aw 'amsik bighayri hisaab
Wainna lahu 'indanaa lazul faa wahusna maab
Wazkur 'abdanaa 'ayyooba 'iz naadaa rabbahuaa 'annee massaneeash-shaytaanu binusb wa'azaab
Arkud birijlika haazaa mughtasal u baarid washaraab
Wawahabnaa lahuaa 'ahlahu wamithlahum mma'ahum rahmat mminnaa wazikraa lioolee al al baab
Wakhuz beeadika dightha fadrib bbihi wal aa tahnath 'innaa wajadnaahu saabira nni'mal'abdu 'innahuaa 'awwaab
Wazkur 'ibaadanaa 'ibraaheema waishaaqa waya'qooba 'oolee al aydee wal absaar
'innaa 'akhlasnaahum bikhaal isat zikraad-daar
Wainnahum 'indanaa laminal mustafaynal akhyaar
Wazkur 'ismaa'eela wal yasa'a wazaal kifli wakul l mminal akhyaar
Haazaa zikr wainna lil muttaqeena lahusna maab
Jannaati 'adn mmufattahat llaahumul abwaab
Muttakieena feehaa yad'oona feehaa bifaakihat katheerat washaraab
Wa'indahum qaasiraatut-tarfi 'atraab
Haazaa maa too'adoona leeawmil hisaab
'inna haazaa larizqunaa maa lahu min nnafaad
Haazaa wainna lit-taagheena lasharra maab
Jahannama yaslawnahaa fabi'sal mihaad
Haazaa fal yazooqoohu hameem waghassaaq
Wa'aakharu min shaklihiaa 'azwaaj
Haazaa fawj mmuqtahim mma'akum laa marhabaa bihim 'innahum saal un-naar
Qaal u bal 'antum laa marhabaa bikum 'antum qaddamtumoohu lanaa fabi'sal qaraar
Qaal u rabbanaa man qaddama lanaa haazaa fazidhu 'azaaba di'fa fee an-naar
Waqaal u maa lanaa laa naraa rijaal a kunnaa na'udduhum mminal ashraar
'attakhaznaahum sikhriyyana 'am zaaghat 'anhumul absaar
'inna zaal ika lahaqq takhaasumu 'ahlin-naar
Qul 'innamaa 'anaa munzir wamaa min 'il aahin 'il laal laahul waahidul qahhaar
Rabbus-samaawaati wal ardi wamaa baynahumaal'azeezul ghaffaar
Qul hooa naba'una 'azeem
'antum 'anhu mu'ridoon
Maa kaana leea min 'il mi bil mal ail a'laa 'iz yakhtasimoon
'iny yoohaa 'il ayya 'il laa 'annamaa 'anaa nazeer mmubeen
'iz qaal a rabbuka lil mal aa'ikati 'innee khaal iqu bashara mmin teen
Faizaa sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi mir rroohee faqa'u lahu saajideen
Fasajadal mal aa'ikatu kul luhum 'ajma'oon
'il laa 'ibleesastakbara wakaana minal kaafireen
Qaal a yaaibleesu maa mana'aka 'an tasjuda limaa khal aqtu beeadayya 'astakbarta 'am kunta minal'aal een
Qaal a 'anaa khayr mminhu khal aqtanee min nnaar wakhal aqtahu min teen
Qaal a fakhruj minhaa fainnaka rajeem
Wainna 'al ayka la'nateeaa 'il aa yawmid-deen
Qaal a rabbi faanzirneeaa 'il aa yawmi yub'athoon
Qaal a fainnaka minal munzareen
'il aa yawmil waqtil ma'loom
Qaal a fabi'izzatika laughweeannahum 'ajma'een
'il laa 'ibaadaka minhumul mukhlaseen
Qaal a fal haqqu wal haqqa 'aqool
Laamlaanna jahannama minka wamimman tabi'aka minhum 'ajma'een
Qul maa 'asal ukum 'al ayhi min 'ajr wamaa 'anaa minal mutakal lifeen
'in hooa 'il laa zikr llil'aal ameen
Wal ata'lamunna nabaahu ba'da heen
Tanzeelul kitaabi minal laahil'azeezil hakeem
'innaa 'anzal naa 'il aykal kitaaba bil haqqi fa'budil laaha mukhlisa llaahud-deen

'al aa lil laahid-deenul khaal isu wal lazeenattakhazu min doonihiaa 'awleeaa'a maa na'buduhum 'il laa leeuqarriboonaa 'il aal laahi zul faa 'innal laaha yahkumu baynahum fee maa hum feehi yakhtal ifoona 'innal laaha laa yahdee man hooa kaazib kaffaar
Llaw 'araadal laahu 'any yattakhiza wal ada llastafaa mimmaa yakhluqu maa yashaa'u subhaanahu hooal laahul waahidul qahhaar

Khal aqas-samaawaati wal arda bil haqqi yukawwirul layla 'al aan-nahaari wayukawwirun-nahaara 'al aal layli wasakhkharash-shamsa wal qamara kul l yajree liajal mmusammana 'al aa hooal'azeezul ghaffaar

Khal aqakum mmin nnafs waahidat thumma ja'al a minhaa zawjahaa waanzal a lakum mminal an'aami thamaaneeata 'azwaaj yakhluqukum fee butooni 'ummahaatikum khal qa mmim ba'di khal q fee zul umaat thal aath zaal ikumul laahu rabbukum lahul mul ku laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa faannaa tusrafoon

'in takfuru fainnal laaha ghaneeyun 'ankum wal aa yardaa li'ibaadihil kufra wain tashkuru yardahu lakum wal aa taziru waazirat wizra 'ukhraa thumma 'il aa rabbikum mmarji'ukum fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oona 'innahu 'al eemu bizaatis-sudoor

Waizaa massal insaana durr da'aa rabbahu muneebana 'il ayhi thumma 'izaa khawwal ahu ni'mat mminhu naseea maa kaana yad'ooaa 'il ayhi min qablu waja'al a lil laahi 'andaada lleeudil la 'an sabeelihi qul tamatta' bikufrika qal eelana 'innaka min 'ashaabin-naar
'amman hooa qaanitun 'aanaa'al layli saajida waqaa'ima yahzarul aakhirata wayarju rahmata rabbihi qul hal yastawee al lazeena ya'lamoona wal lazeena laa ya'lamoona 'innamaa yatazakkaru 'oolul al baab
Qul yaa'ibaadil lazeena 'aamanuttaqu rabbakum lil lazeena 'ahsanu fee haazihid-dunyaa hasanat waardul laahi waasi'atun 'innamaa yooaffaas-saabiroona 'ajrahum bighayri hisaab
Qul 'inneeaa 'umirtu 'an 'a'budal laaha mukhlisa llaahud-deen
Waumirtu lian 'akoona 'awwal al muslimeen
Qul 'inneeaa 'akhaafu 'in 'asaytu rabbee 'azaaba yawmin 'azeem
Qul il laaha 'a'budu mukhlisa llaahu deenee
Fa'budu maa shi'tum mmin doonihi qul 'innal khaasireenal lazeena khasirooaa 'anfusahum waahleehim yawmal qeeaamati 'al aa zaal ika hooal khusraanul mubeen
Lahum mmin fawqihim zul al mminan-naari wamin tahtihim zul al zaal ika yukhawwiful laahu bihi 'ibaadahu yaa'ibaadi fattaqoon
Wal lazeenajtanabut-taaghoota 'any ya'budoohaa waanaabooaa 'il aal laahi lahumul bushraa fabashshir 'ibaad
Al lazeena yastami'oonal qawla fayattabi'oona 'ahsanahuaa 'ul aa'ikal lazeena hadaahumul laahu waul aa'ika hum 'oolul al baab
'afaman haqqa 'al ayhi kal imatul'azaabi 'afaanta tunqizu man fee an-naar
Laakinil lazeenattaqawa rabbahum lahum ghuraf mmin fawqihaa ghuraf mmabniyyat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru wa'dal laahi laa yukhliful laahul mee'aad

'al am tara 'annal laaha 'anzal a minas-samaa'i maa' fasal akahu yanaabee'a fee al ardi thumma yukhriju bihi zar'a mmukhtal ifana 'al waanuhu thumma yaheeju fataraahu musfarra thumma yaj'al uhu hutaamana 'inna fee zaal ika lazikraa lioolee al al baab
'afaman sharahal laahu sadrahu lil islaami fahooa 'al aa noor mmir rrabbihi fawayl llil qaaseeati qul oobuhum mmin zikril laahi 'ul aa'ika fee dal aal mmubeen

Al laahu nazzal a 'ahsanal hadeethi kitaaba mmutashaabiha mmathaaneea taqsha'irru minhu jul oodul lazeena yakhshawna rabbahum thumma tal eenu jul ooduhum waqul oobuhum 'il aa zikril laahi zaal ika hudaal laahi yahdee bihi many yashaa'u wamany yudlil il laahu famaa lahu min haad
'afamany yattaqee biwajhihi sooaa'al'azaabi yawmal qeeaamati waqeela liz-zaal imeena zooqu maa kuntum taksiboon
Kazzabal lazeena min qablihim faataahumul'azaabu min haythu laa yash'uroon
Faazaaqahumul laahul khizya fee al hayawaatid-dunyaa wal a'azaabul aakhirati 'akbaru law kaanu ya'lamoon
Wal aqad darabnaa lin-naasi fee haazaal qur'aani min kul li mathal-la'al laahum yatazakkaroon
Qur'aanana 'arabiyyana ghayra zee 'iwaj lla'al laahum yattaqoon
Darabal laahu mathal a rrajul a feehi shurakaa'u mutashaakisoona warajul a sal ama llirajul in hal yastaweeaani mathal anal hamdu lil laahi bal 'aktharuhum laa ya'lamoon
'innaka mayyit wainnahum mmayyitoon
Thumma 'innakum yawmal qeeaamati 'inda rabbikum takhtasimoon
Faman 'azlamu mimman kazaba 'al aal laahi wakazzaba bis-sidqi 'iz jaa'ahuaa 'al aysa fee jahannama mathwa llil kaafireen
Wal lazee jaa'a bis-sidqi wasaddaqa bihiaa 'ul aa'ika humul muttaqoon
Lahum mmaa yashaa'oona 'inda rabbihim zaal ika jazaa'ul muhsineen
Leeukaffiral laahu 'anhum 'aswaal lazee 'amil u wayajzeeahum 'ajrahum biahsanil lazee kaanu ya'mal oon
'al aysal laahu bikaafin 'abdahu wayukhawwifoonaka bil lazeena min doonihi wamany yudlil il laahu famaa lahu min haad
Wamany yahdil laahu famaa lahu mim mmudil lin 'al aysal laahu bi'azeez zee antiqaam

Wal a'in saal tahum mman khal aqas-samaawaati wal arda layaqoolunnal laahu qul 'afara'aytum mmaa tad'oona min doonil laahi 'in 'araadaneeal laahu bidurrin hal hunna kaashifaatu durrihiaa 'aw 'araadanee birahmatin hal hunna mumsikaatu rahmatihi qul hasbeeal laahu 'al ayhi yatawakkal ul mutawakkil oon
Qul yaaqawmi'mal u 'al aa makaanatikum 'innee 'aamil fasawfa ta'lamoon
Many yateehi 'azaab yukhzeehi wayahil lu 'al ayhi 'azaab mmuqeem
'innaa 'anzal naa 'al aykal kitaaba lin-naasi bil haqqi famanihtadaa fal inafsihi waman dal la fainnamaa yadil lu 'al ayhaa wamaa 'anta 'al ayhim biwakeel

Al laahu yatawaffaal anfusa heena mawtihaa wal latee lam tamut fee manaamihaa fayumsikul latee qadaa 'al ayhaal mawta wayursil ul ukhraa 'il aa 'ajal mmusammana 'inna fee zaal ika layaat lliqawm yatafakkaroon
'amittakhazu min doonil laahi shufa'aa'a qul 'awal aw kaanu laa yamlikoona shaya wal aa ya'qil oon
Qul-lil laahish-shafaa'atu jamee'a llaahu mul kus-samaawaati wal ardi thumma 'il ayhi turja'oon
Waizaa zukiral laahu wahdahushmaazzat qul oobul lazeena laa yu'minoona bil aakhirati waizaa zukiral lazeena min doonihiaa 'izaa hum yastabshiroon
Qul il laahumma faatiras-samaawaati wal ardi 'aal imal ghaybi wash-shahaadati 'anta tahkumu bayna 'ibaadika fee maa kaanu feehi yakhtal ifoon
Wal aw 'anna lil lazeena zal amu maa fee al ardi jamee'a wamithlahu ma'ahu laftadawa bihi min sooaa'il'azaabi yawmal qeeaamati wabadaa lahum mminal laahi maa lam yakoonu yahtasiboon
Wabadaa lahum sayyiaatu maa kasabu wahaaqa bihim mmaa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Faizaa massal insaana durr da'aanaa thumma 'izaa khawwal naahu ni'mat mminnaa qaal a 'innamaa 'ooteetuhu 'al aa 'il mi bal heea fitnat wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Qad qaal ahaal lazeena min qablihim famaa 'aghnaa 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaksiboon
Faasaabahum sayyiaatu maa kasabu wal lazeena zal amu min haa'ul aa'i sayuseebuhum sayyiaatu maa kasabu wamaa hum bimu'jizeen
'awal am ya'lamooaa 'annal laaha yabsutur-rizqa limany yashaa'u wayaqdiru 'inna fee zaal ika layaat lliqawm yu'minoon
Qul yaa'ibaadeeal lazeena 'asrafu 'al aa 'anfusihim laa taqnatu mir rrahmatil laahi 'innal laaha yaghfiruz-zunooba jamee'ana 'innahu hooal ghafoorur-raheem
Waaneebooaa 'il aa rabbikum waaslimu lahu min qabli 'any yateeakumul'azaabu thumma laa tunsaroon
Wattabi'ooaa 'ahsana maa 'unzil a 'il aykum mmir rrabbikum mmin qabli 'any yateeakumul'azaabu baghtat waantum laa tash'uroon
'an taqoola nafs yaahasrataa 'al aa maa farrattu fee janbil laahi wain kuntu laminas-saakhireen
'aw taqoola law 'annal laaha hadaanee lakuntu minal muttaqeen
'aw taqoola heena taraal'azaaba law 'anna lee karrat faakoona minal muhsineen
Bal aa qad jaa'atka 'ayaatee fakazzabta bihaa wastakbarta wakunta minal kaafireen
Wayawmal qeeaamati taraal lazeena kazabu 'al aal laahi wujoohuhum mmuswaddatun 'al aysa fee jahannama mathwa llil mutakabbireen
Wayunajjee al laahul lazeenattaqawa bimafaazatihim laa yamassuhumus-sooaa'u wal aa hum yahzanoon
Al laahu khaal iqu kul li shay' wahooa 'al aa kul li shay' wakeel
Llaahu maqaal eedus-samaawaati wal ardi wal lazeena kafaru biayaatil laahi 'ul aa'ika humul khaasiroon
Qul 'afaghayral laahi tamurooaanneeaa 'a'budu 'ayyuhaal jaahil oon
Wal aqad 'ooheea 'il ayka wail aal lazeena min qablika la'in 'ashrakta layahbatanna 'amal uka wal atakoonanna minal khaasireen
Bal il laaha fa'bud wakum mminash-shaakireen
Wamaa qadarul laaha haqqa qadrihi wal ardu jamee'a qabdatuhu yawmal qeeaamati was-samaawaatu matwiyyaatu beeameenihi subhaanahu wata'aal aa 'ammaa yushrikoon
Wanufikha fee as-soori fasa'iqa man fee as-samaawaati waman fee al ardi 'il laa man shaa'al laahu thumma nufikha feehi 'ukhraa faizaa hum qeeaam yanzuroon
Waashraqatil ardu binoori rabbihaa wawudi'al kitaabu wajiayaa'a bin-nabeeyina wash-shuhadaa'i waqudeea baynahum bil haqqi wahum laa yuzlamoon
Wawuffeeat kul lu nafs mmaa 'amil at wahooa 'a'lamu bimaa yaf'al oon

Waseeqal lazeena kafarooaa 'il aa jahannama zumarana hattaa 'izaa jaa'oohaa futihat 'abwaabuhaa waqaal a lahum khazanatuhaa 'al am yatikum rusul mminkum yatloona 'al aykum 'ayaati rabbikum wayunziroonakum liqaa'a yawmikum haazaa qaal u bal aa wal aakin haqqat kal imatul'azaabi 'al aal kaafireen
Qeeladkhul ooaa 'abwaaba jahannama khaal ideena feehaa fabi'sa mathwaal mutakabbireen
Waseeqal lazeenattaqawa rabbahum 'il aal jannati zumarana hattaa 'izaa jaa'oohaa wafutihat 'abwaabuhaa waqaal a lahum khazanatuhaa sal aamun 'al aykum tibtum fadkhul oohaa khaal ideen
Waqaal ul hamdu lil laahil lazee sadaqanaa wa'dahu waawrathanaal arda natabawwau minal jannati haythu nashaa'u fani'ma 'ajrul'aamil een
Wataraal mal aa'ikata haaffeena min hawlil'arshi yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim waqudeea baynahum bil haqqi waqeelal hamdu lil laahi rabbil'aal ameen
Hma
Tanzeelul kitaabi minal laahil'azeezil'al eem
Ghaafiriz-zanbi waqaabil it-tawbi shadeedil'iqaabi zee at-tawli laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa 'il ayhil maseer
Maa yujaadil u feeaa 'ayaatil laahi 'il laal lazeena kafaru fal aa yaghrurka taqal lubuhum fee al bil aad
Kazzabat qablahum qawmu nooh wal ahzaabu mim ba'dihim wahammat kul lu 'ummati birasoolihim leeakhuzoohu wajaadal u bil baatil i leeudhidu bihil haqqa faakhaztuhum fakayfa kaana 'iqaab
Wakazaal ika haqqat kal imatu rabbika 'al aal lazeena kafarooaa 'annahum 'ashaabun-naar

Al lazeena yahmil oonal'arsha waman hawlahu yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wayu'minoona bihi wayastaghfiroona lil lazeena 'aamanu rabbanaa wasi'ta kul la shay' rrahmat wa'il ma faghfir lil lazeena taabu wattaba'u sabeelaka waqihim 'azaabal jaheem
Rabbanaa waadkhil hum jannaati 'adnin al latee wa'adttahum waman sal aha min 'aabaa'ihim waazwaajihim wazurriyyaatihim 'innaka 'antal'azeezul hakeem
Waqihimus-sayyiaati waman taqis-sayyiaati yawma'iz faqad rahimtahu wazaal ika hooal fawzul'azeem
'innal lazeena kafaru yunaadawna lamaqtul laahi 'akbaru mim mmaqtikum 'anfusakum 'iz tud'awna 'il aal eemaani fatakfuroon
Qaal u rabbanaa 'amattanaathnatayni waahyaytanaathnatayni fa'tarafnaa bizunoobinaa fahal 'il aa khurooj mmin sabeel
Zaal ikum biannahuaa 'izaa du'eeal laahu wahdahu kafartum wainy yushrak bihi tu'minu fal hukmu lil laahil'al eeyil kabeer
Hooal lazee yureekum 'ayaatihi wayunazzil u lakum mminas-samaa'i rizqa wamaa yatazakkaru 'il laa many yuneeb
Fad'ul laaha mukhliseena lahud-deena wal aw karihal kaafiroon
Rafee'ud-darajaati zoo al'arshi yul qee ar-rooha min 'amrihi 'al aa many yashaa'u min 'ibaadihi leeunzira yawmat-tal aaq
Yawma hum baarizoona laa yakhfaa 'al aal laahi minhum shay' llimanil mul kul yawma lil laahil waahidil qahhaar
Al yawma tujzaa kul lu nafsi bimaa kasabat laa zul mal yawma 'innal laaha saree'ul hisaab
Waanzirhum yawmal aazifati 'izil qul oobu ladaal hanaajiri kaazimeena maa liz-zaal imeena min hameem wal aa shafee' yutaa'
Ya'lamu khaa'inatal a'yuni wamaa tukhfee as-sudoor
Wal laahu yaqdee bil haqqi wal lazeena yad'oona min doonihi laa yaqdoona bishay'in 'innal laaha hooas-samee'ul baseer

'awal am yaseeru fee al ardi fayanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul lazeena kaanu min qablihim kaanu hum 'ashadda minhum qoowat wa'aathaara fee al ardi faakhazahumul laahu bizunoobihim wamaa kaana lahum mminal laahi minw waaq
Zaal ika biannahum kaanat ttateehim rusul uhum bil bayyinaati fakafaru faakhazahumul laahu 'innahu qaweey shadeedul'iqaab
Wal aqad 'arsal naa moosaa biayaatinaa wasul taam mmubeen
'il aa fir'awna wahaamaana waqaaroona faqaal u saahir kazzaab
Fal ammaa jaa'ahum bil haqqi min 'indinaa qaal uqtul ooaa 'abnaa'al lazeena 'aamanu ma'ahu wastahyu nisaa'ahum wamaa kaydul kaafireena 'il laa fee dal aal
Waqaal a fir'awnu zarooneeaa 'aqtul moosaa wal yad'u rabbahuaa 'inneeaa 'akhaafu 'any yubaddil a deenakum 'aw 'any yuzhira fee al ardil fasaad
Waqaal a moosaa 'innee 'uztu birabbee warabbikum mmin kul li mutakabbir llaa yu'minu beeawmil hisaab

Waqaal a rajul mmu'mim mmin 'aal i fir'awna yaktumu 'eemaanahuaa 'ataqtul oona rajul ana 'any yaqoola rabbeeal laahu waqad jaa'akum bil bayyinaati mir rrabbikum wainy yaku kaaziba fa'al ayhi kazibuhu wainy yaku saadiqa yusibkum ba'dul lazee ya'idukum 'innal laaha laa yahdee man hooa musrif kazzaab
Yaaqawmi lakumul mul kul yawma zaahireena fee al ardi famany yansurunaa mim basil laahi 'in jaa'anaa qaal a fir'awnu maa 'ureekum 'il laa maa 'araa wamaa 'ahdeekum 'il laa sabeelar-rashaad
Waqaal al lazeeaa 'aamana yaaqawmi 'inneeaa 'akhaafu 'al aykum mmithla yawmil ahzaab
Mithla dabi qawmi nooh wa'aad wathamooda wal lazeena mim ba'dihim wamaal laahu yureedu zul ma llil'ibaad
Wayaaqawmi 'inneeaa 'akhaafu 'al aykum yawmat-tanaad
Yawma tooal loona mudbireena maa lakum mminal laahi min 'aasim wamany yudlil il laahu famaa lahu min haad

Wal aqad jaa'akum yoosufu min qablu bil bayyinaati famaa zil tum fee shakk mmimmaa jaa'akum bihi hattaa 'izaa hal aka qul tum lany yab'athal laahu mim ba'dihi rasoola kazaal ika yudil lul laahu man hooa musrif mmurtaab
Al lazeena yujaadil oona feeaa 'ayaatil laahi bighayri sul taanin 'ataahum kabura maqtana 'indal laahi wa'indal lazeena 'aamanu kazaal ika yatba'ul laahu 'al aa kul li qal bi mutakabbir jabbaar
Waqaal a fir'awnu yaahaamaanubni lee sarha lla'al leeaa 'ablughul asbaab
'asbaabas-samaawaati faattal i'a 'il aa 'il aahi moosaa wainnee laazunnuhu kaaziba wakazaal ika zuyyina lifir'awna sooaa'u 'amal ihi wasudda 'anis-sabeeli wamaa kaydu fir'awna 'il laa fee tabaab
Waqaal al lazeeaa 'aamana yaaqawmittabi'ooni 'ahdikum sabeelar-rashaad
Yaaqawmi 'innamaa haazihil hayawaatud-dunyaa mataa' wainnal aakhirata heea daarul qaraar
Man 'amil a sayyi'at fal aa yujzaa 'il laa mithlahaa waman 'amil a saal iha mmin zakarin 'aw 'unthaa wahooa mu'min faul aa'ika yadkhul oonal jannata yurzaqoona feehaa bighayri hisaab
Wayaaqawmi maa leeaa 'ad'ookum 'il aan-najawaati watad'oonaneeaa 'il aan-naar
Tad'oonanee liakfura bil laahi waushrika bihi maa laysa lee bihi 'il m waanaa 'ad'ookum 'il aal'azeezil ghaffaar
Laa jarama 'annamaa tad'oonaneeaa 'il ayhi laysa lahu da'wat fee ad-dunyaa wal aa fee al aakhirati waanna maraddanaa 'il aal laahi waannal musrifeena hum 'ashaabun-naar
Fasatazkuroona maa 'aqoolu lakum waufawwidu 'amreeaa 'il aal laahi 'innal laaha baseeru bil'ibaad
Fawaqaahul laahu sayyiaati maa makaru wahaaqa biaal i fir'awna sooaa'ul'azaab
An-naaru yu'radoona 'al ayhaa ghudoowa wa'ashiyya wayawma taqoomus-saa'atu 'adkhil ooaa 'aal a fir'awna 'ashaddal'azaab
Waiz yatahaajjoona fee an-naari fayaqoolud-du'afaa'ua lil lazeenastakbarooaa 'innaa kunnaa lakum taba'a fahal 'antum mmughnoona 'annaa naseeba mminan-naar
Qaal al lazeenastakbarooaa 'innaa kul l feehaa 'innal laaha qad hakama baynal'ibaad
Waqaal al lazeena fee an-naari likhazanati jahannamad'u rabbakum yukhaffif 'annaa yawma mminal'azaab
Qaal ooaa 'awal am taku tateekum rusul ukum bil bayyinaati qaal u bal aa qaal u fad'u wamaa du'aa'ual kaafireena 'il laa fee dal aal
'innaa lanansuru rusul anaa wal lazeena 'aamanu fee al hayawaatid-dunyaa wayawma yaqoomul ashhaad
Yawma laa yanfa'uz-zaal imeena ma'ziratuhum wal ahumul la'natu wal ahum sooaa'ud-daar
Wal aqad 'aataynaa moosaal hudaa waawrathnaa baneeaa 'israa'eelal kitaab
Huda wazikraa lioolee al al baab
Fasbir 'inna wa'dal laahi haqq wastaghfir lizanbika wasabbih bihamdi rabbika bil'asheeyi wal ibkaar
'innal lazeena yujaadil oona feeaa 'ayaatil laahi bighayri sul taanin 'ataahum 'in fee sudoorihim 'il laa kibr mmaa hum bibaal igheehi fasta'iz bil laahi 'innahu hooas-samee'ul baseer
Lakhal qus-samaawaati wal ardi 'akbaru min khal qin-naasi wal aakinna 'aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Wamaa yastawee al a'maa wal baseeru wal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati wal aal museeaa'u qal eela mmaa tatazakkaroon
'innas-saa'ata laateeat llaa rayba feehaa wal aakinna 'aktharan-naasi laa yu'minoon
Waqaal a rabbukumud'ooneeaa 'astajib lakum 'innal lazeena yastakbiroona 'an 'ibaadatee sayadkhul oona jahannama daakhireen
Al laahul lazee ja'al a lakumul layla litaskunu feehi wan-nahaara mubsirana 'innal laaha lazoo fadlin 'al aan-naasi wal aakinna 'aktharan-naasi laa yashkuroon
Zaal ikumul laahu rabbukum khaal iqu kul li shay' llaa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa faannaa tu'fakoon
Kazaal ika yu'fakul lazeena kaanu biayaatil laahi yajhadoon
Al laahul lazee ja'al a lakumul arda qaraara was-samaa'a binaa' wasawwarakum faahsana sooarakum warazaqakum mminat-tayyibaati zaal ikumul laahu rabbukum fatabaarakal laahu rabbul'aal ameen
Hooal hayyu laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa fad'oohu mukhliseena lahud-deenal hamdu lil laahi rabbil'aal ameen
Qul 'innee nuheetu 'an 'a'budal lazeena tad'oona min doonil laahi lammaa jaa'aneeal bayyinaatu mir rrabbee waumirtu 'an 'uslima lirabbil'aal ameen

Hooal lazee khal aqakum mmin turaab thumma min nnutfat thumma min 'al aqat thumma yukhrijukum tifla thumma litablughooaa 'ashuddakum thumma litakoonu shuyookha waminkum mmany yutawaffaa min qablu wal itablughooaa 'ajal a mmusamma wal a'al lakum ta'qil oon
Hooal lazee yuhyi wayumeetu faizaa qadaa 'amra fainnamaa yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoon
'al am tara 'il aal lazeena yujaadil oona feeaa 'ayaatil laahi 'annaa yusrafoon
Al lazeena kazzabu bil kitaabi wabimaa 'arsal naa bihi rusul anaa fasawfa ya'lamoon
'izil aghlaal u feeaa 'a'naaqihim was-sal aasil u yushaboon
Fee al hameemi thumma fee an-naari yusjaroon
Thumma qeela lahum 'ayna maa kuntum tushrikoon
Min doonil laahi qaal u dal lu 'annaa bal-lam nakun nnad'u min qablu shaya kazaal ika yudil lul laahul kaafireen
Zaal ikum bimaa kuntum tafrahoona fee al ardi bighayril haqqi wabimaa kuntum tamrahoon
Adkhul ooaa 'abwaaba jahannama khaal ideena feehaa fabi'sa mathwaal mutakabbireen
Fasbir 'inna wa'dal laahi haqq faimmaa nureeannaka ba'dal lazee na'iduhum 'aw natawaffayannaka fail aynaa yurja'oon

Wal aqad 'arsal naa rusul a mmin qablika minhum mman qasasnaa 'al ayka waminhum mmal llam naqsus 'al ayka wamaa kaana lirasoolin 'any yateea biayatin 'il laa biiznil laahi faizaa jaa'a 'amrul laahi qudeea bil haqqi wakhasira hunaal ikal mubtil oon
Al laahul lazee ja'al a lakumul an'aama litarkabu minhaa waminhaa takul oon
Wal akum feehaa manaafi'u wal itablughu 'al ayhaa haajat fee sudoorikum wa'al ayhaa wa'al aal ful ki tuhmal oon
Wayureekum 'ayaatihi fayya 'ayaatil laahi tunkiroon
'afal am yaseeru fee al ardi fayanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul lazeena min qablihim kaanooaa 'akthara minhum waashadda qoowat wa'aathaara fee al ardi famaa 'aghnaa 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaksiboon
Fal ammaa jaa'athum rusul uhum bil bayyinaati farihu bimaa 'indahum mminal'il mi wahaaqa bihim mmaa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Fal ammaa raawa basanaa qaal ooaa 'aamannaa bil laahi wahdahu wakafarnaa bimaa kunnaa bihi mushrikeen
Fal am yaku yanfa'uhum 'eemaanuhum lammaa raawa basanaa sunnatal laahil latee qad khal at fee 'ibaadihi wakhasira hunaal ikal kaafiroon
Hma
Tanzeel mminar-rahmaanir-raheem
Kitaab fussil at 'ayaatuhu qur'aanana 'arabiyya lliqawm ya'lamoon
Basheera wanazeera faa'rada 'aktharuhum fahum laa yasma'oon
Waqaal u qul oobunaa feeaa 'akinnat mmimmaa tad'oonaa 'il ayhi wafeeaa 'aazaaninaa waqr wamim bayninaa wabaynika hijaab fa'mal 'innanaa 'aamil oon
Qul 'innamaa 'anaa bashar mmithlukum yoohaa 'il ayya 'annamaa 'il aahukum 'il aah waahid fastaqeemooaa 'il ayhi wastaghfiroohu wawayl llil mushrikeen
Al lazeena laa yu'toonaz-zakaata wahum bil aakhirati hum kaafiroon
'innal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati lahum 'ajrun ghayru mamnoon
Qul 'a'innakum latakfuroona bil lazee khal aqal arda fee yawmayni wataj'al oona lahuaa 'andaada zaal ika rabbul'aal ameen
Waja'al a feehaa rawaaseea min fawqihaa wabaaraka feehaa waqaddara feehaa 'aqwaatahaa feeaa 'arba'ati 'ayyaam sawaa' llis-saa'il een
Thummastawaa 'il aas-samaa'i waheea dukhaan faqaal a lahaa wal il ardi'teeaa taw'ana 'aw karha qaal ataa 'ataynaa taa'i'een
Faqadaahunna sab'a samaawaat fee yawmayni waawhaa fee kul li samaa'in 'amrahaa wazayyannaas-samaa'ad-dunyaa bimasaabeeha wahifza zaal ika taqdeerul'azeezil'al eem
Fain 'a'radu faqul 'anzartukum saa'iqat mmithla saa'iqati 'aad wathamood
'iz jaa'athumur-rusul u mim bayni 'aydeehim wamin khal fihim 'al laa ta'budooaa 'il laal laaha qaal u law shaa'a rabbunaa laanzal a mal aa'ikat fainnaa bimaa 'ursil tum bihi kaafiroon
Faammaa 'aad fastakbaru fee al ardi bighayril haqqi waqaal u man 'ashaddu minnaa qoowatan 'awal am yarawa 'annal laahal lazee khal aqahum hooa 'ashaddu minhum qoowat wakaanu biayaatinaa yajhadoon
Faarsal naa 'al ayhim reeha sarsara feeaa 'ayyaam nnahisaat llinuzeeqahum 'azaabal khizyi fee al hayawaatid-dunyaa wal a'azaabul aakhirati 'akhzaa wahum laa yunsaroon
Waammaa thamoodu fahadaynaahum fastahabbul'amaa 'al aal hudaa faakhazathum saa'iqatul'azaabil hooni bimaa kaanu yaksiboon
Wanajjaynaal lazeena 'aamanu wakaanu yattaqoon
Wayawma yuhsharu 'a'daa'ul laahi 'il aan-naari fahum yooza'oon
Hattaa 'izaa maa jaa'oohaa shahida 'al ayhim sam'uhum waabsaaruhum wajul ooduhum bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Waqaal u lijul oodihim lima shahidttum 'al aynaa qaal ooaa 'antaqanaal laahul lazeeaa 'antaqa kul la shay' wahooa khal aqakum 'awwal a marrat wail ayhi turja'oon
Wamaa kuntum tastatiroona 'any yashhada 'al aykum sam'ukum wal aa 'absaarukum wal aa jul oodukum wal aakin zanantum 'annal laaha laa ya'lamu katheera mmimmaa ta'mal oon
Wazaal ikum zannukumul lazee zanantum birabbikum 'ardaakum faasbahtum mminal khaasireen
Fainy yasbiru fan-naaru mathwa llaahum wainy yasta'tibu famaa hum mminal mu'tabeen
Waqayyadnaa lahum quranaa'a fazayyanu lahum mmaa bayna 'aydeehim wamaa khal fahum wahaqqa 'al ayhimul qawlu feeaa 'umam qad khal at min qablihim mminal jinni wal insi 'innahum kaanu khaasireen
Waqaal al lazeena kafaru laa tasma'u lihaazaal qur'aani wal ghawa feehi la'al lakum taghliboon
Fal anuzeeqannal lazeena kafaru 'azaaba shadeeda wal anajzeeannahum 'aswaal lazee kaanu ya'mal oon
Zaal ika jazaa'u 'a'daa'il laahin-naaru lahum feehaa daarul khul di jazaa'a bimaa kaanu biayaatinaa yajhadoon
Waqaal al lazeena kafaru rabbanaa 'arinaal lazayni 'adal laanaa minal jinni wal insi naj'al humaa tahta 'aqdaaminaa leeakoonaa minal asfal een
'innal lazeena qaal u rabbunaal laahu thummastaqaamu tatanazzal u 'al ayhimul mal aa'ikatu 'al laa takhaafu wal aa tahzanu waabshiru bil jannatil latee kuntum too'adoon
Nahnu 'awleeaa'ukum fee al hayawaatid-dunyaa wafee al aakhirati wal akum feehaa maa tashtaheeaa 'anfusukum wal akum feehaa maa tadda'oon
Nuzul a mmin ghafoor rraheem
Waman 'ahsanu qawla mmimman da'aa 'il aal laahi wa'amil a saal iha waqaal a 'innanee minal muslimeen
Wal aa tastawee al hasanatu wal aas-sayyi'atudfa' bil latee heea 'ahsanu faizaal lazee baynaka wabaynahu 'adaawat kaannahu wal eeyun hameem
Wamaa yul aqqaahaa 'il laal lazeena sabaru wamaa yul aqqaahaa 'il laa zoo hazzin 'azeem
Waimmaa yanzaghannaka minash-shaytaani nazgh fasta'iz bil laahi 'innahu hooas-samee'ul'al eem
Wamin 'ayaatihil laylu wan-nahaaru wash-shamsu wal qamaru laa tasjudu lish-shamsi wal aa lil qamari wasjudu lil laahil lazee khal aqahunna 'in kuntum 'iyyaahu ta'budoon
Fainistakbaru fal lazeena 'inda rabbika yusabbihoona lahu bil layli wan-nahaari wahum laa yasamoon
Wamin 'ayaatihiaa 'annaka taraal arda khaashi'at faizaa 'anzal naa 'al ayhaal maa'ahtazzat warabat 'innal lazeeaa 'ahyaahaa lamuhyil mawtaa 'innahu 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
'innal lazeena yul hidoona feeaa 'ayaatinaa laa yakhfawna 'al aynaa 'afamany yul qaa fee an-naari khayrun 'am mmany yateeaa 'aamina yawmal qeeaamati'mal u maa shi'tum 'innahu bimaa ta'mal oona baseer
'innal lazeena kafaru biz-zikri lammaa jaa'ahum wainnahu lakitaabun 'azeez
Llaa yateehil baatil u mim bayni yadayhi wal aa min khal fihi tanzeel mmin hakeemin hameed
Mmaa yuqaal u laka 'il laa maa qad qeela lir-rusul i min qablika 'inna rabbaka lazoo maghfirat wazoo 'iqaabin 'al eem

Wal aw ja'al naahu qur'aanana 'a'jamiyya llaqaal u lawlaa fussil at 'ayaatuhuaa 'aa'jameey wa'arabeey qul hooa lil lazeena 'aamanu huda washifaa' wal lazeena laa yu'minoona feeaa 'aazaanihim waqr wahooa 'al ayhim 'amana 'ul aa'ika yunaadawna mim mmakaani ba'eed
Wal aqad 'aataynaa moosaal kitaaba fakhtul ifa feehi wal awlaa kal imat sabaqat mir rrabbika laqudeea baynahum wainnahum lafee shakk mminhu mureeb
Mman 'amil a saal iha fal inafsihi waman 'asaa'a fa'al ayhaa wamaa rabbuka bizal laam llil'abeed

'il ayhi yuraddu 'il mus-saa'ati wamaa takhruju min thamaraat mmin 'akmaamihaa wamaa tahmil u min 'unthaa wal aa tada'u 'il laa bi'il mihi wayawma yunaadeehim 'ayna shurakaa'ee qaal ooaa 'aazannaaka maa minnaa min shaheed
Wadal la 'anhum mmaa kaanu yad'oona min qablu wazannu maa lahum mmim mmahees
Llaa yasamul insaanu min du'aa'il khayri waim mmassahush-sharru fayaoos qanooh

Wal a'in 'azaqnaahu rahmat mminnaa mim ba'di darraa'a massathu layaqoolanna haazaa lee wamaa 'azunnus-saa'ata qaa'imat wal a'ir rruji'tu 'il aa rabbeeaa 'inna lee 'indahu lal husnaa fal anunabbi'annal lazeena kafaru bimaa 'amil u wal anuzeeqannahum mmin 'azaabin ghal eez
Waizaa 'an'amnaa 'al aal insaani 'a'rada wanaa bijaanibihi waizaa massahush-sharru fazoo du'aa'in 'areed
Qul 'ara'aytum 'in kaana min 'indil laahi thumma kafartum bihi man 'adal lu mimman hooa fee shiqaaqi ba'eed
Sanureehim 'ayaatinaa fee al aafaaqi wafeeaa 'anfusihim hattaa yatabayyana lahum 'annahul haqqu 'awal am yakfi birabbika 'annahu 'al aa kul li shay' shaheed
'al aa 'innahum fee miryat mmil lliqaa'i rabbihim 'al aa 'innahu bikul li shay' mmuheeh
Hma
'aasaaqa
Kazaal ika yooheeaa 'il ayka wail aal lazeena min qablikal laahul'azeezul hakeem
Lahu maa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardi wahooal'al eeyul'azeem
Takaadus-samaawaatu yatafattarna min fawqihinna wal mal aa'ikatu yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wayastaghfiroona liman fee al ardi 'al aa 'innal laaha hooal ghafoorur-raheem
Wal lazeenattakhazu min doonihiaa 'awleeaa'al laahu hafeezun 'al ayhim wamaa 'anta 'al ayhim biwakeel
Wakazaal ika 'awhaynaa 'il ayka qur'aanana 'arabiyya llitunzira 'ummal quraa waman hawlahaa watunzira yawmal jam'i laa rayba feehi fareeq fee al jannati wafareeq fee as-sa'eer
Wal aw shaa'al laahu laja'al ahum 'ummat waahidat wal aakiny yudkhil u many yashaa'u fee rahmatihi waz-zaal imoona maa lahum mminw wal eey wal aa naseer
'amittakhazu min doonihiaa 'awleeaa'a fal laahu hooal wal eeyu wahooa yuhyil mawtaa wahooa 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
Wamaakhtal aftum feehi min shay' fahukmuhuaa 'il aal laahi zaal ikumul laahu rabbee 'al ayhi tawakkal tu wail ayhi 'uneeb
Faatirus-samaawaati wal ardi ja'al a lakum mmin 'anfusikum 'azwaaja waminal an'aami 'azwaaja yazra'ukum feehi laysa kamithlihi shay' wahooas-samee'ul baseer
Lahu maqaal eedus-samaawaati wal ardi yabsutur-rizqa limany yashaa'u wayaqdiru 'innahu bikul li shay'in 'al eem

Shara'a lakum mminad-deeni maa wassaa bihi nooha wal lazeeaa 'awhaynaa 'il ayka wamaa wassaynaa bihiaa 'ibraaheema wamoosaa wa'eesaa 'an 'aqeemud-deena wal aa tatafarraqu feehi kabura 'al aal mushrikeena maa tad'oohum 'il ayhil laahu yajtabeeaa 'il ayhi many yashaa'u wayahdeeaa 'il ayhi many yuneeb

Wamaa tafarraqooaa 'il laa mim ba'di maa jaa'ahumul'il mu baghyaa baynahum wal awlaa kal imat sabaqat mir rrabbika 'il aa 'ajal mmusamma llaqudeea baynahum wainnal lazeena 'oorithul kitaaba mim ba'dihim lafee shakk mminhu mureeb

Fal izaal ika fad'u wastaqim kamaa 'umirta wal aa tattabi' 'ahwaa'ahum waqul 'aamantu bimaa 'anzal al laahu min kitaab waumirtu lia'dil a baynakumul laahu rabbunaa warabbukum lanaa 'a'maal unaa wal akum 'a'maal ukum laa hujjata baynanaa wabaynakumul laahu yajma'u baynanaa wail ayhil maseer
Wal lazeena yuhaajjoona fee al laahi mim ba'di maastujeeba lahu hujjatuhum daahidatun 'inda rabbihim wa'al ayhim ghadab wal ahum 'azaab shadeed
Al laahul lazeeaa 'anzal al kitaaba bil haqqi wal meezaana wamaa yudreeka la'al las-saa'ata qareeb
Yasta'jil u bihaal lazeena laa yu'minoona bihaa wal lazeena 'aamanu mushfiqoona minhaa waya'lamoona 'annahaal haqqu 'al aa 'innal lazeena yumaaroona fee as-saa'ati lafee dal aal i ba'eed
Al laahu lateefu bi'ibaadihi yarzuqu many yashaa'u wahooal qaweeyul'azeez
Man kaana yureedu harthal aakhirati nazid lahu fee harthihi waman kaana yureedu harthad-dunyaa nu'tihi minhaa wamaa lahu fee al aakhirati min nnaseeb
'am lahum shurakaa'ua shara'u lahum mminad-deeni maa lam yazam bihil laahu wal awlaa kal imatul fasli laqudeea baynahum wainnaz-zaal imeena lahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Taraaz-zaal imeena mushfiqeena mimmaa kasabu wahooa waaqi'u bihim wal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati fee rawdaatil jannaati lahum mmaa yashaa'oona 'inda rabbihim zaal ika hooal fadlul kabeer

Zaal ikal lazee yubashshirul laahu 'ibaadahul lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati qul-laa 'asal ukum 'al ayhi 'ajrana 'il laal mawaddata fee al qurbaa wamany yaqtarif hasanat nnazid lahu feehaa husnana 'innal laaha ghafoor shakoor
'am yaqooloonaftaraa 'al aal laahi kaziba fainy yashail laahu yakhtim 'al aa qal bika wayamhul laahul baatil a wayuhiqqul haqqa bikal imaatihiaa 'innahu 'al eemu bizaatis-sudoor
Wahooal lazee yaqbal ut-tawbata 'an 'ibaadihi waya'fu 'anis-sayyiaati waya'lamu maa taf'al oon
Wayastajeebul lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati wayazeeduhum mmin fadlihi wal kaafiroona lahum 'azaab shadeed
Wal aw basatal laahur-rizqa li'ibaadihi labaghawa fee al ardi wal aakiny yunazzil u biqadar mmaa yashaa'u 'innahu bi'ibaadihi khabeeru baseer
Wahooal lazee yunazzil ul ghaytha mim ba'di maa qanatu wayanshuru rahmatahu wahooal wal eeyul hameed
Wamin 'ayaatihi khal qus-samaawaati wal ardi wamaa baththa feehimaa min daabbat wahooa 'al aa jam'ihim 'izaa yashaa'u qadeer
Wamaa 'asaabakum mmim mmuseebat fabimaa kasabat 'aydeekum waya'fu 'an katheer
Wamaa 'antum bimu'jizeena fee al ardi wamaa lakum mmin doonil laahi minw wal eey wal aa naseer
Wamin 'ayaatihil jawaari fee al bahri kal a'laam
'iny yasha yuskinir-reeha fayazlal na rawaakida 'al aa zahrihiaa 'inna fee zaal ika layaat llikul li sabbaar shakoor
'aw yoobiqhunna bimaa kasabu waya'fu 'an katheer
Waya'lamal lazeena yujaadil oona feeaa 'ayaatinaa maa lahum mmim mmahees
Famaa 'ooteetum mmin shay' famataa'ul hayawaatid-dunyaa wamaa 'indal laahi khayr waabqaa lil lazeena 'aamanu wa'al aa rabbihim yatawakkal oon
Wal lazeena yajtaniboona kabaa'iral ithmi wal fawaahisha waizaa maa ghadibu hum yaghfiroon
Wal lazeenastajaabu lirabbihim waaqaamus-sal aata waamruhum shooraa baynahum wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
Wal lazeena 'izaa 'asaabahumul baghyu hum yantasiroon
Wajazaa'ua sayyi'at sayyi'at mmithluhaa faman 'afaa waaslaha faajruhu 'al aal laahi 'innahu laa yuhibbuz-zaal imeen
Wal amanintasara ba'da zul mihi faul aa'ika maa 'al ayhim mmin sabeel
'innamaas-sabeelu 'al aal lazeena yazlimoonan-naasa wayabghoona fee al ardi bighayril haqqi 'ul aa'ika lahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Wal aman sabara waghafara 'inna zaal ika lamin 'azmil umoor
Wamany yudlil il laahu famaa lahu minw wal eey mmim ba'dihi wataraaz-zaal imeena lammaa raawual'azaaba yaqooloona hal 'il aa maradd mmin sabeel

Wataraahum yu'radoona 'al ayhaa khaashi'eena minaz-zul li yanzuroona min tarfin khafeey waqaal al lazeena 'aamanooaa 'innal khaasireenal lazeena khasirooaa 'anfusahum waahleehim yawmal qeeaamati 'al aa 'innaz-zaal imeena fee 'azaab mmuqeem
Wamaa kaana lahum mmin 'awleeaa'a yansuroonahum mmin doonil laahi wamany yudlil il laahu famaa lahu min sabeel
Astajeebu lirabbikum mmin qabli 'any yateea yawm llaa maradda lahu minal laahi maa lakum mmim mmal ja yawma'iz wamaa lakum mmin nnakeer

Fain 'a'radu famaa 'arsal naaka 'al ayhim hafeezana 'in 'al ayka 'il laal bal aaghu wainnaa 'izaa 'azaqnaal insaana minnaa rahmat fariha bihaa wain tusibhum sayyi'atu bimaa qaddamat 'aydeehim fainnal insaana kafoor

Wamaa kaana libasharin 'any yukal limahul laahu 'il laa wahyana 'aw minw warayi hijaabin 'aw yursil a rasoola fayooheea biiznihi maa yashaa'u 'innahu 'al eeyun hakeem

Wakazaal ika 'awhaynaa 'il ayka rooha mmin 'amrinaa maa kunta tadree maal kitaabu wal aal eemaanu wal aakin ja'al naahu noora nnahdee bihi man nnashaa'u min 'ibaadinaa wainnaka latahdeeaa 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem

'am 'aataynaahum kitaaba mmin qablihi fahum bihi mustamsikoon
Bal qaal ooaa 'innaa wajadnaa 'aabaa'anaa 'al aa 'ummat wainnaa 'al aa 'aathaarihim mmuhtadoon
Wakazaal ika maa 'arsal naa min qablika fee qaryat mmin nnazeerin 'il laa qaal a mutrafoohaa 'innaa wajadnaa 'aabaa'anaa 'al aa 'ummat wainnaa 'al aa 'aathaarihim mmuqtadoon
Qaal a 'awal aw ji'tukum biahdaa mimmaa wajadttum 'al ayhi 'aabaa'akum qaal ooaa 'innaa bimaa 'ursil tum bihi kaafiroon
Fantaqamnaa minhum fanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul mukazzibeen
Waiz qaal a 'ibraaheemu liabeehi waqawmihiaa 'innanee baraa' mmimmaa ta'budoon
'il laal lazee fataranee fainnahu sayahdeen
Waja'al ahaa kal imata baaqeeat fee 'aqibihi la'al laahum yarji'oon
Bal matta'tu haa'ul aa'i wa'aabaa'ahum hattaa jaa'ahumul haqqu warasool mmubeen
Wal ammaa jaa'ahumul haqqu qaal u haazaa sihr wainnaa bihi kaafiroon
Waqaal u lawlaa nuzzil a haazaal qur'aanu 'al aa rajul mminal qaryatayni 'azeem

'ahum yaqsimoona rahmata rabbika nahnu qasamnaa baynahum mma'eeshatahum fee al hayawaatid-dunyaa warafa'naa ba'dahum fawqa ba'd darajaat lleeattakhiza ba'duhum ba'da sukhriyya warahmatu rabbika khayr mmimmaa yajma'oon
Wal awlaa 'any yakoonan-naasu 'ummat waahidat llaja'al naa limany yakfuru bir-rahmaani libuyootihim suqufa mmin fiddat wama'aarija 'al ayhaa yazharoon
Wal ibuyootihim 'abwaaba wasururana 'al ayhaa yattakioon
Wazukhrufa wain kul lu zaal ika lammaa mataa'ul hayawaatid-dunyaa wal aakhiratu 'inda rabbika lil muttaqeen
Wamany ya'shu 'an zikrir-rahmaani nuqayyid lahu shaytaana fahooa lahu qareen
Wainnahum layasuddoonahum 'anis-sabeeli wayahsaboona 'annahum mmuhtadoon
Hattaa 'izaa jaa'anaa qaal a yaal ayta baynee wabaynaka bu'dal mashriqayni fabi'sal qareen

Faimmaa nazhabanna bika fainnaa minhum mmuntaqimoon
'aw nureeannakal lazee wa'adnaahum fainnaa 'al ayhim mmuqtadiroon
Fastamsik bil lazeeaa 'ooheea 'il ayka 'innaka 'al aa siraat mmustaqeem
Wainnahu lazikr llaka wal iqawmika wasawfa tusal oon

Wal aqad 'arsal naa moosaa biayaatinaa 'il aa fir'awna wamal aeehi faqaal a 'innee rasoolu rabbil'aal ameen
Fal ammaa jaa'ahum biayaatinaa 'izaa hum mminhaa yadhakoon
Wamaa nureehim mmin 'ayatin 'il laa heea 'akbaru min 'ukhtihaa waakhaznaahum bil'azaabi la'al laahum yarji'oon
Waqaal u yayyuhas-saahirud'u lanaa rabbaka bimaa 'ahida 'indaka 'innanaa lamuhtadoon
Fal ammaa kashafnaa 'anhumul'azaaba 'izaa hum yankuthoon
Wanaadaa fir'awnu fee qawmihi qaal a yaaqawmi 'al aysa lee mul ku misra wahaazihil anhaaru tajree min tahteeaa 'afal aa tubsiroon
'am 'anaa khayr mmin haazaal lazee hooa maheen wal aa yakaadu yubeen
Fal awlaa 'ul qeea 'al ayhi 'aswirat mmin zahabin 'aw jaa'a ma'ahul mal aa'ikatu muqtarineen
Fastakhaffa qawmahu faataa'oohu 'innahum kaanu qawma faasiqeen
Fal ammaa 'aasafoonaantaqamnaa minhum faaghraqnaahum 'ajma'een
Faja'al naahum sal afa wamathal a llil aakhireen
Wal ammaa duribabnu maryama mathal ana 'izaa qawmuka minhu yasiddoon
Waqaal ooaa 'aal ihatunaa khayrun 'am hooa maa daraboohu laka 'il laa jadal aa bal hum qawmun khasimoon
'in hooa 'il laa 'abdun 'an'amnaa 'al ayhi waja'al naahu mathal a llibaneeaa 'israa'eel
Wal aw nashaa'u laja'al naa minkum mmal aa'ikat fee al ardi yakhlufoon
Wainnahu la'il m llis-saa'ati fal aa tamtarunna bihaa wattabi'ooni haazaa siraat mmustaqeem
Wal aa yasuddannakumush-shaytaanu 'innahu lakum 'adoow mmubeen
Wal ammaa jaa'a 'eesaa bil bayyinaati qaal a qad ji'tukum bil hikmati wal iubayyina lakum ba'dal lazee takhtal ifoona feehi fattaqul laaha waatee'oon
'innal laaha hooa rabbee warabbukum fa'budoohu haazaa siraat mmustaqeem
Fakhtal afal ahzaabu mim baynihim fawayl llil lazeena zal amu min 'azaabi yawmin 'al eem
Hal yanzuroona 'il laas-saa'ata 'an tateeahum baghtat wahum laa yash'uroon
Al akhil laa'u yawma'izi ba'duhum liba'din 'adoowun 'il laal muttaqeen
Yaa'ibaadi laa khawfun 'al aykumul yawma wal aa 'antum tahzanoon
Al lazeena 'aamanu biayaatinaa wakaanu muslimeen
Adkhul ul jannata 'antum waazwaajukum tuhbaroon
Yutaafu 'al ayhim bisihaaf mmin zahab waakwaab wafeehaa maa tashtaheehil anfusu watal azzul a'yunu waantum feehaa khaal idoon
Watil kal jannatul lateeaa 'oorithtumoohaa bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Lakum feehaa faakihat katheerat mminhaa takul oon
'innal mujrimeena fee 'azaabi jahannama khaal idoon
Laa yufattaru 'anhum wahum feehi mublisoon
Wamaa zal amnaahum wal aakin kaanu humuz-zaal imeen
Wanaadawa yaamaal iku leeaqdi 'al aynaa rabbuka qaal a 'innakum mmaakithoon
Laqad ji'naakum bil haqqi wal aakinna 'aktharakum lil haqqi kaarihoon
'am 'abramooaa 'amra fainnaa mubrimoon

Wahooal lazee fee as-samaa'i 'il aah wafee al ardi 'il aah wahooal hakeemul'al eem
Watabaarakal lazee lahu mul kus-samaawaati wal ardi wamaa baynahumaa wa'indahu 'il mus-saa'ati wail ayhi turja'oon

Wal a'in saal tahum mman khal aqahum layaqoolunnal laahu faannaa yu'fakoon

Wakhtil aafil layli wan-nahaari wamaa 'anzal al laahu minas-samaa'i mir rrizq faahyaa bihil arda ba'da mawtihaa watasreefir-reeaahi 'ayaat lliqawm ya'qil oon
