Tanzeelul kitaabi minal laahil'azeezil hakeem
Maa khal aqnaas-samaawaati wal arda wamaa baynahumaa 'il laa bil haqqi waajal mmusamma wal lazeena kafaru 'ammaa 'unziru mu'ridoon
Qul 'ara'aytum mmaa tad'oona min doonil laahi 'aroonee maazaa khal aqu minal ardi 'am lahum shirk fee as-samaawaati'toonee bikitaab mmin qabli haazaa 'aw 'athaarat mmin 'il min 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Waman 'adal lu mimmany yad'u min doonil laahi mal llaa yastajeebu lahuaa 'il aa yawmil qeeaamati wahum 'an du'aa'ihim ghaafil oon
Waizaa hushiran-naasu kaanu lahum 'a'daa' wakaanu bi'ibaadatihim kaafireen
Waizaa tutlaa 'al ayhim 'ayaatunaa bayyinaat qaal al lazeena kafaru lil haqqi lammaa jaa'ahum haazaa sihr mmubeen
'am yaqooloonaftaraahu qul 'iniftaraytuhu fal aa tamlikoona lee minal laahi shayana hooa 'a'lamu bimaa tufeedoona feehi kafaa bihi shaheedaa baynee wabaynakum wahooal ghafoorur-raheem
Qul maa kuntu bid'a mminar-rusul i wamaa 'adree maa yuf'al u bee wal aa bikum 'in 'attabi'u 'il laa maa yoohaa 'il ayya wamaa 'anaa 'il laa nazeer mmubeen
Qul 'ara'aytum 'in kaana min 'indil laahi wakafartum bihi washahida shaahid mmim baneeaa 'israa'eela 'al aa mithlihi faamana wastakbartum 'innal laaha laa yahdee al qawmaz-zaal imeen
Waqaal al lazeena kafaru lil lazeena 'aamanu law kaana khayra mmaa sabaqoonaa 'il ayhi waiz lam yahtadu bihi fasayaqooloona haazaa 'ifk qadeem
Wamin qablihi kitaabu moosaa 'imaama warahmat wahaazaa kitaab mmusaddiq llisaanana 'arabiyya lleeunziral lazeena zal amu wabushraa lil muhsineen
'innal lazeena qaal u rabbunaal laahu thummastaqaamu fal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
'ul aa'ika 'ashaabul jannati khaal ideena feehaa jazaa'a bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon

Wawassaynaal insaana biwaal idayhi 'ihsaanana hamal athu 'ummuhu kurha wawada'athu kurha wahamluhu wafisaal uhu thal aathoona shahrana hattaa 'izaa bal agha 'ashuddahu wabal agha 'arba'eena sanat qaal a rabbi 'awzi'neeaa 'an 'ashkura ni'matakal lateeaa 'an'amta 'al ayya wa'al aa waal idayya waan 'a'mal a saal iha tardaahu waaslih lee fee zurriyyateeaa 'innee tubtu 'il ayka wainnee minal muslimeen
'ul aa'ikal lazeena nataqabbal u 'anhum 'ahsana maa 'amil u wanatajaawazu 'an sayyiaatihim feeaa 'ashaabil jannati wa'das-sidqil lazee kaanu yoo'adoon

Wal lazee qaal a liwaal idayhi 'uff llakumaa 'ata'idaanineeaa 'an 'ukhraja waqad khal atil quroonu min qablee wahumaa yastagheethaanil laaha waylaka 'aamin 'inna wa'dal laahi haqq fayaqoolu maa haazaa 'il laa 'asaateerul awwal een
'ul aa'ikal lazeena haqqa 'al ayhimul qawlu feeaa 'umam qad khal at min qablihim mminal jinni wal insi 'innahum kaanu khaasireen
Wal ikul l darajaat mmimmaa 'amil u wal eeooaffeeahum 'a'maal ahum wahum laa yuzlamoon

Wayawma yu'radul lazeena kafaru 'al aan-naari 'azhabtum tayyibaatikum fee hayaatikumud-dunyaa wastamta'tum bihaa fal yawma tujzawna 'azaabal hooni bimaa kuntum tastakbiroona fee al ardi bighayril haqqi wabimaa kuntum tafsuqoon
Wazkur 'akhaa 'aadin 'iz 'anzara qawmahu bil ahqaafi waqad khal atin-nuzuru mim bayni yadayhi wamin khal fihiaa 'al laa ta'budooaa 'il laal laaha 'inneeaa 'akhaafu 'al aykum 'azaaba yawmin 'azeem
Qaal ooaa 'aji'tanaa litafikanaa 'an 'aal ihatinaa fatinaa bimaa ta'idunaa 'in kunta minas-saadiqeen
Qaal a 'innamaal'il mu 'indal laahi waubal lighukum mmaa 'ursil tu bihi wal aakinneeaa 'araakum qawma tajhal oon
Fal ammaa raawhu 'aarida mmustaqbil a 'awdeeatihim qaal u haazaa 'aarid mmumtirunaa bal hooa maasta'jal tum bihi reeh feehaa 'azaabun 'al eem
Tudammiru kul la shay'i biamri rabbihaa faasbahu laa yuraa 'il laa masaakinuhum kazaal ika najzee al qawmal mujrimeen

Wal aqad makkannaahum feemaa 'im mmakkannaakum feehi waja'al naa lahum sam'a waabsaara waafidat famaa 'aghnaa 'anhum sam'uhum wal aa 'absaaruhum wal aa 'afidatuhum mmin shay'in 'iz kaanu yajhadoona biayaatil laahi wahaaqa bihim mmaa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Wal aqad 'ahlaknaa maa hawlakum mminal quraa wasarrafnaal ayaati la'al laahum yarji'oon
Fal awlaa nasarahumul lazeenattakhazu min doonil laahi qurbaanana 'aal ihata bal dal lu 'anhum wazaal ika 'ifkuhum wamaa kaanu yaftaroon
Waiz sarafnaa 'il ayka nafara mminal jinni yastami'oonal qur'aana fal ammaa hadaroohu qaal ooaa 'ansitu fal ammaa qudeea wal lawa 'il aa qawmihim mmunzireen
Qaal u yaaqawmanaa 'innaa sami'naa kitaabana 'unzil a mim ba'di moosaa musaddiqa llimaa bayna yadayhi yahdeeaa 'il aal haqqi wail aa tareeq mmustaqeem
Yaaqawmanaa 'ajeebu daa'eeal laahi wa'aaminu bihi yaghfir lakum mmin zunoobikum wayujirkum mmin 'azaabin 'al eem
Wamal llaa yujib daa'eeal laahi fal aysa bimu'jiz fee al ardi wal aysa lahu min doonihiaa 'awleeaa'u 'ul aa'ika fee dal aal mmubeen
'awal am yarawa 'annal laahal lazee khal aqas-samaawaati wal arda wal am ya'ya bikhal qihinna biqaadirin 'al aa 'any yuheeal mawtaa bal aa 'innahu 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
Wayawma yu'radul lazeena kafaru 'al aan-naari 'al aysa haazaa bil haqqi qaal u bal aa warabbinaa qaal a fazooqul'azaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon

Fasbir kamaa sabara 'oolul'azmi minar-rusul i wal aa tasta'jil-laahum kaannahum yawma yarawna maa yoo'adoona lam yal bathooaa 'il laa saa'at mmin nnahaari bal aagh fahal yuhlaku 'il laal qawmul faasiqoon
Al lazeena kafaru wasaddu 'an sabeelil laahi 'adal la 'a'maal ahum
Wal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati wa'aamanu bimaa nuzzil a 'al aa muhammad wahooal haqqu mir rrabbihim kaffara 'anhum sayyiaatihim waaslaha baal ahum
Zaal ika biannal lazeena kafaruttaba'ul baatil a waannal lazeena 'aamanuttaba'ul haqqa mir rrabbihim kazaal ika yadribul laahu lin-naasi 'amthaal ahum

Faizaa laqeetumul lazeena kafaru fadarbar-riqaabi hattaa 'izaa 'athkhantumoohum fashuddul wathaaqa faimmaa mannaa ba'du waimmaa fidaa'an hattaa tada'al harbu 'awzaarahaa zaal ika wal aw yashaa'ul laahu lantasara minhum wal aakil lleeablooaa ba'dakum biba'd wal lazeena qutil u fee sabeelil laahi fal any yudil la 'a'maal ahum
Sayahdeehim wayuslihu baal ahum
Wayudkhil uhumul jannata 'arrafahaa lahum
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'in tansurul laaha yansurkum wayuthabbit 'aqdaamakum
Wal lazeena kafaru fata'sa llaahum waadal la 'a'maal ahum
Zaal ika biannahum karihu maa 'anzal al laahu faahbata 'a'maal ahum
'afal am yaseeru fee al ardi fayanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul lazeena min qablihim dammaral laahu 'al ayhim wal il kaafireena 'amthaal uha
Zaal ika biannal laaha mawlaal lazeena 'aamanu waannal kaafireena laa mawlaa lahum
'innal laaha yudkhil ul lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati jannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru wal lazeena kafaru yatamatta'oona wayakul oona kamaa takul ul an'aamu wan-naaru mathwa llaahum
Wakayyim mmin qaryatin heea 'ashaddu qoowat mmin qaryatikal lateeaa 'akhrajatka 'ahlaknaahum fal aa naasira lahum
'afaman kaana 'al aa bayyinat mmir rrabbihi kaman zuyyina lahu sooaa'u 'amal ihi wattaba'ooaa 'ahwaa'ahum

Mmathal ul jannatil latee wu'idal muttaqoona feehaa 'anhaar mmim mmaa'in ghayri 'aasinw waanhaar mmil llabal llam yataghayyar ta'muhu waanhaar mmin khamr llazzat llish-shaaribeena waanhaar mmin 'asal mmusaffa wal ahum feehaa min kul lith-thamaraati wamaghfirat mmir rrabbihim kaman hooa khaal id fee an-naari wasuqu maa'an hameema faqatta'a 'am'aa'ahum

Waminhum mmany yastami'u 'il ayka hattaa 'izaa kharaju min 'indika qaal u lil lazeena 'ootul'il ma maazaa qaal a 'aanifana 'ul aa'ikal lazeena taba'al laahu 'al aa qul oobihim wattaba'ooaa 'ahwaa'ahum
Wal lazeenahtadawa zaadahum huda wa'aataahum taqwaahum
Fahal yanzuroona 'il laas-saa'ata 'an tateeahum baghtat faqad jaa'a 'ashraatuhaa faannaa lahum 'izaa jaa'athum zikraahum
Fa'lam 'annahu laa 'il aaha 'il laal laahu wastaghfir lizanbika wal il mu'mineena wal mu'minaati wal laahu ya'lamu mutaqal labakum wamathwaakum

Wayaqoolul lazeena 'aamanu lawlaa nuzzil at soorat faizaa 'unzil at soorat mmuhkamat wazukira feehaal qitaal u raytal lazeena fee qul oobihim mmarad yanzuroona 'il ayka nazaral maghsheeyi 'al ayhi minal mawti faawlaa lahum
Taa'at waqawl mma'roof faizaa 'azamal amru fal aw sadaqul laaha lakaana khayra llaahum
Fahal 'asaytum 'in tawal laytum 'an tufsidu fee al ardi watuqatti'ooaa 'arhaamakum
'ul aa'ikal lazeena la'anahumul laahu faasammahum waa'maa 'absaarahum
'afal aa yatadabbaroonal qur'aana 'am 'al aa qul oobin 'aqfaal uha
'innal lazeenartaddu 'al aa 'adbaarihim mmim ba'di maa tabayyana lahumul hudaash-shaytaanu sawwal a lahum waamlaa lahum
Zaal ika biannahum qaal u lil lazeena karihu maa nazzal al laahu sanutee'ukum fee ba'dil amri wal laahu ya'lamu 'israarahum
Fakayfa 'izaa tawaffathumul mal aa'ikatu yadriboona wujoohahum waadbaarahum
Zaal ika biannahumuttaba'u maa 'askhatal laaha wakarihu ridwaanahu faahbata 'a'maal ahum
'am hasibal lazeena fee qul oobihim mmaradun 'al llany yukhrijal laahu 'adghaanahum
Wal aw nashaa'u laaraynaakahum fal a'araftahum biseemaahum wal ata'rifannahum fee lahnil qawli wal laahu ya'lamu 'a'maal akum
Wal anablooannakum hattaa na'lamal mujaahideena minkum was-saabireena wanablooaa 'akhbaarakum
'innal lazeena kafaru wasaddu 'an sabeelil laahi washaaqqur-rasoola mim ba'di maa tabayyana lahumul hudaa lany yadurrul laaha shaya wasayuhbitu 'a'maal ahum
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'atee'ul laaha waatee'ur-rasoola wal aa tubtil ooaa 'a'maal akum
'innal lazeena kafaru wasaddu 'an sabeelil laahi thumma maatu wahum kuffaar fal any yaghfiral laahu lahum
Fal aa tahinu watad'ooaa 'il aas-sal mi waantumul a'lawna wal laahu ma'akum wal any yatirakum 'a'maal akum
'innamaal hayawaatud-dunyaa la'ib wal ahw wain tu'minu watattaqu yu'tikum 'ujoorakum wal aa yasal kum 'amwaal akum
'iny yasal kumoohaa fayuhfikum tabkhal u wayukhrij 'adghaanakum

Haantum haa'ul aa'i tud'awna litunfiqu fee sabeelil laahi faminkum mmany yabkhal u wamany yabkhal fainnamaa yabkhal u 'an nnafsihi wal laahul ghaneeyu waantumul fuqaraa'u wain tatawal lawa yastabdil qawmana ghayrakum thumma laa yakoonooaa 'amthaal akum
'innaa fatahnaa laka fatha mmubeen
Lleeaghfira lakal laahu maa taqaddama min zanbika wamaa taakhkhara wayutimma ni'matahu 'al ayka wayahdeeaka siraata mmustaqeem
Wayansurakal laahu nasrana 'azeezan
Hooal lazeeaa 'anzal as-sakeenata fee qul oobil mu'mineena leeazdaadooaa 'eemaana mma'a 'eemaanihim wal il laahi junoodus-samaawaati wal ardi wakaanal laahu 'al eemana hakeem
Lleeudkhil al mu'mineena wal mu'minaati jannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa wayukaffira 'anhum sayyiaatihim wakaana zaal ika 'indal laahi fawzana 'azeem

Wayu'azzibal munaafiqeena wal munaafiqaati wal mushrikeena wal mushrikaatiz-zaanneena bil laahi zannas-saw'i 'al ayhim daa'iratus-saw'i waghadibal laahu 'al ayhim wal a'anahum waa'adda lahum jahannama wasaa'at maseer
Wal il laahi junoodus-samaawaati wal ardi wakaanal laahu 'azeezana hakeeman
'innaa 'arsal naaka shaahida wamubashshira wanazeer
Llitu'minu bil laahi warasoolihi watu'azziroohu watooaqqiroohu watusabbihoohu bukrat waaseelan

'innal lazeena yubayi'oonaka 'innamaa yubayi'oonal laaha yadul laahi fawqa 'aydeehim faman nnakatha fainnamaa yankuthu 'al aa nafsihi waman 'awfaa bimaa 'aahada 'al ayhul laaha fasayu'teehi 'ajrana 'azeem

Sayaqoolu lakal mukhal lafoona minal a'raabi shaghal atnaa 'amwaal unaa waahloonaa fastaghfir lanaa yaqooloona bial sinatihim mmaa laysa fee qul oobihim qul famany yamliku lakum mminal laahi shayana 'in 'araada bikum darrana 'aw 'araada bikum naf'aa bal kaanal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona khabeera
Bal zanantum 'al llany yanqal ibar-rasoolu wal mu'minoona 'il aa 'ahleehim 'abada wazuyyina zaal ika fee qul oobikum wazanantum zannas-saw'i wakuntum qawmaa boor
Wamal llam yu'mim bil laahi warasoolihi fainnaa 'a'tadnaa lil kaafireena sa'eer
Wal il laahi mul kus-samaawaati wal ardi yaghfiru limany yashaa'u wayu'azzibu many yashaa'u wakaanal laahu ghafoora rraheem

Sayaqoolul mukhal lafoona 'izaantal aqtum 'il aa maghaanima litakhuzoohaa zaroonaa nattabi'kum yureedoona 'any yubaddil u kal aamal laahi qul-lan tattabi'oonaa kazaal ikum qaal al laahu min qablu fasayaqooloona bal tahsudoonanaa bal kaanu laa yafqahoona 'il laa qal eel

Qul-lil mukhal lafeena minal a'raabi satud'awna 'il aa qawmin 'oolee bas shadeed tuqaatil oonahum 'aw yuslimoona fain tutee'u yu'tikumul laahu 'ajrana hasana wain tatawal lawa kamaa tawal laytum mmin qablu yu'azzibkum 'azaabana 'al eem

Llaysa 'al aal a'maa haraj wal aa 'al aal a'raji haraj wal aa 'al aal mareedi haraj wamany yuti'il laaha warasoolahu yudkhil hu jannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru wamany yatawal la yu'azzibhu 'azaabana 'al eem
Llaqad radeeal laahu 'anil mu'mineena 'iz yubayi'oonaka tahtash-shajarati fa'al ima maa fee qul oobihim faanzal as-sakeenata 'al ayhim waathaabahum fatha qareeb
Wamaghaanima katheerat yakhuzoonahaa wakaanal laahu 'azeezana hakeem
Wa'adakumul laahu maghaanima katheerat takhuzoonahaa fa'ajjal a lakum haazihi wakaffa 'aydeean-naasi 'ankum wal itakoona 'ayat llil mu'mineena wayahdeeakum siraata mmustaqeem
Waukhraa lam taqdiru 'al ayhaa qad 'ahaatal laahu bihaa wakaanal laahu 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
Wal aw qaatal akumul lazeena kafaru lawal lawual adbaara thumma laa yajidoona wal iyya wal aa naseer
Sunnatal laahil latee qad khal at min qablu wal an tajida lisunnatil laahi tabdeel
Wahooal lazee kaffa 'aydeeahum 'ankum waydeeakum 'anhum bibatni makkata mim ba'di 'an 'azfarakum 'al ayhim wakaanal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona baseeran

Humul lazeena kafaru wasaddookum 'anil masjidil haraami wal hadya ma'koofana 'any yablugha mahil laahu wal awlaa rijaal mmu'minoona wanisaa' mmu'minaat llam ta'lamoohum 'an tataoohum fatuseebakum mminhum mma'arratu bighayri 'il m lleeudkhil al laahu fee rahmatihi many yashaa'u law tazayyal u la'azzabnaal lazeena kafaru minhum 'azaabana 'al eeman

'iz ja'al al lazeena kafaru fee qul oobihimul hamiyyata hamiyyatal jaahil iyyati faanzal al laahu sakeenatahu 'al aa rasoolihi wa'al aal mu'mineena waal zamahum kal imatat-taqwaa wakaanooaa 'ahaqqa bihaa waahlahaa wakaanal laahu bikul li shay'in 'al eem

Llaqad sadaqal laahu rasoolahur-ru'yaa bil haqqi latadkhul unnal masjidal haraama 'in shaa'al laahu 'aamineena muhal liqeena ru'oosakum wamuqassireena laa takhaafoona fa'al ima maa lam ta'lamu faja'al a min dooni zaal ika fatha qareeban
Hooal lazeeaa 'arsal a rasoolahu bil hudaa wadeenil haqqi leeuzhirahu 'al aad-deeni kul lihi wakafaa bil laahi shaheed

Mmuhammad rrasoolul laahi wal lazeena ma'ahuaa 'ashiddaa'u 'al aal kuffaari ruhamaa'u baynahum taraahum rukka'a sujjada yabtaghoona fadla mminal laahi waridwaana seemaahum fee wujoohihim mmin 'atharis-sujoodi zaal ika mathal uhum fee at-tawraati wamathal uhum fee al injeeli kazar'in 'akhraja shatahu faazarahu fastaghlaza fastawaa 'al aa sooqihi yu'jibuz-zurraa'a leeagheeza bihimul kuffaara wa'adal laahul lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati minhum mmaghfirat waajrana 'azeema
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa tuqaddimu bayna yadayil laahi warasoolihi wattaqul laaha 'innal laaha samee'un 'al eem
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa tarfa'ooaa 'aswaatakum fawqa sawtin-nabeeyi wal aa tajharu lahu bil qawli kajahri ba'dikum liba'din 'an tahbata 'a'maal ukum waantum laa tash'uroon
'innal lazeena yaghuddoona 'aswaatahum 'inda rasoolil laahi 'ul aa'ikal lazeenamtahanal laahu qul oobahum lit-taqwaa lahum mmaghfirat waajrun 'azeem
'innal lazeena yunaadoonaka minw waraa'il hujuraati 'aktharuhum laa ya'qil oon
Wal aw 'annahum sabaru hattaa takhruja 'il ayhim lakaana khayra llaahum wal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'in jaa'akum faasiqu binaba fatabayyanooaa 'an tuseebu qawmaa bijahaal at fatusbihu 'al aa maa fa'al tum naadimeen

Wa'lamooaa 'anna feekum rasoolal laahi law yutee'ukum fee katheer mminal amri la'anittum wal aakinnal laaha habbaba 'il aykumul eemaana wazayyanahu fee qul oobikum wakarraha 'il aykumul kufra wal fusooqa wal'isyaana 'ul aa'ika humur-raashidoon
Fadla mminal laahi wani'mat wal laahu 'al eemun hakeem

Wain taa'ifataani minal mu'mineenaqtatal u faaslihu baynahumaa faim baghat 'ihdaahumaa 'al aal ukhraa faqaatil ul latee tabghee hattaa tafeeaa'a 'il aa 'amril laahi fain faa'at faaslihu baynahumaa bil'adli waaqsitooaa 'innal laaha yuhibbul muqsiteen
'innamaal mu'minoona 'ikhwat faaslihu bayna 'akhawaykum wattaqul laaha la'al lakum turhamoon

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa yaskhar qawm mmin qawmin 'asaa 'any yakoonu khayra mminhum wal aa nisaa' mmin nnisaa'in 'asaa 'any yakunna khayra mminhunna wal aa tal mizooaa 'anfusakum wal aa tanaabazu bil al qaabi bi'sal ismul fusooqu ba'dal eemaani wamal llam yatub faul aa'ika humuz-zaal imoon

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanujtanibu katheera mminaz-zanni 'inna ba'daz-zanni 'ithm wal aa tajassasu wal aa yaghtab bba'dukum ba'dana 'ayuhibbu 'ahadukum 'any yakul a lahma 'akheehi mayta fakarihtumoohu wattaqul laaha 'innal laaha tawwaab rraheem
Yayyuhaan-naasu 'innaa khal aqnaakum mmin zakar waunthaa waja'al naakum shu'ooba waqabaa'il a lita'aarafooaa 'inna 'akramakum 'indal laahi 'atqaakum 'innal laaha 'al eemun khabeer

Qaal atil a'raabu 'aamannaa qul-lam tu'minu wal aakin qoolooaa 'aslamnaa wal ammaa yadkhul il eemaanu fee qul oobikum wain tutee'ul laaha warasoolahu laa yal itkum mmin 'a'maal ikum shayana 'innal laaha ghafoor rraheem
'innamaal mu'minoonal lazeena 'aamanu bil laahi warasoolihi thumma lam yartaabu wajaahadu biamwaal ihim waanfusihim fee sabeelil laahi 'ul aa'ika humus-saadiqoon
Qul 'atu'al limoonal laaha bideenikum wal laahu ya'lamu maa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardi wal laahu bikul li shay'in 'al eem
Yamunnoona 'al ayka 'an 'aslamu qul-laa tamunnu 'al ayya 'islaamakum bal il laahu yamunnu 'al aykum 'an hadaakum lil eemaani 'in kuntum saadiqeen
'innal laaha ya'lamu ghaybas-samaawaati wal ardi wal laahu baseeru bimaa ta'mal oon
Qaa wal qur'aanil majeed
Bal 'ajibooaa 'an jaa'ahum mmunzir mminhum faqaal al kaafiroona haazaa shay'un 'ajeeb
'a'izaa mitnaa wakunnaa turaaba zaal ika raj'u ba'eed
Qad 'al imnaa maa tanqusul ardu minhum wa'indanaa kitaabun hafeez
Bal kazzabu bil haqqi lammaa jaa'ahum fahum feeaa 'amr mmareej
'afal am yanzurooaa 'il aas-samaa'i fawqahum kayfa banaynaahaa wazayyannaahaa wamaa lahaa min furooj
Wal arda madadnaahaa waal qaynaa feehaa rawaaseea waanbatnaa feehaa min kul li zawji baheej
Tabsirat wazikraa likul li 'abd mmuneeb
Wanazzal naa minas-samaa'i maa' mmubaaraka faanbatnaa bihi jannaat wahabbal haseed
Wan-nakhla baasiqaat llaahaa tal' nnadeed
Rrizqa llil'ibaadi waahyaynaa bihi bal dat mmayta kazaal ikal khurooj

Sabbaha lil laahi maa fee as-samaawaati wal ardi wahooal'azeezul hakeem
Lahu mul kus-samaawaati wal ardi yuhyi wayumeetu wahooa 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
Hooal awwal u wal aakhiru waz-zaahiru wal baatinu wahooa bikul li shay'in 'al eem

Hooal lazee khal aqas-samaawaati wal arda fee sittati 'ayyaam thummastawaa 'al aal'arshi ya'lamu maa yal iju fee al ardi wamaa yakhruju minhaa wamaa yanzil u minas-samaa'i wamaa ya'ruju feehaa wahooa ma'akum 'ayna maa kuntum wal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona baseer
Llaahu mul kus-samaawaati wal ardi wail aal laahi turja'ul umoor
Yoolijul layla fee an-nahaari wayoolijun-nahaara fee al layli wahooa 'al eemu bizaatis-sudoor
'aaminu bil laahi warasoolihi waanfiqu mimmaa ja'al akum mmustakhlafeena feehi fal lazeena 'aamanu minkum waanfaqu lahum 'ajr kabeer
Wamaa lakum laa tu'minoona bil laahi war-rasoolu yad'ookum litu'minu birabbikum waqad 'akhaza meethaaqakum 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
Hooal lazee yunazzil u 'al aa 'abdihiaa 'ayaati bayyinaat lleeukhrijakum mminaz-zul umaati 'il aan-noori wainnal laaha bikum lara'oof rraheem

Wamaa lakum 'al laa tunfiqu fee sabeelil laahi wal il laahi meeraathus-samaawaati wal ardi laa yastawee minkum mman 'anfaqa min qablil fathi waqaatal a 'ul aa'ika 'a'zamu darajat mminal lazeena 'anfaqu mim ba'du waqaatal u wakul la wa'adal laahul husnaa wal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer
Mman zaal lazee yuqridul laaha qardana hasana fayudaa'ifahu lahu wal ahuaa 'ajr kareem
Yawma taraal mu'mineena wal mu'minaati yas'aa nooruhum bayna 'aydeehim wabiaymaanihim bushraakumul yawma jannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa zaal ika hooal fawzul'azeem

Yawma yaqoolul munaafiqoona wal munaafiqaatu lil lazeena 'aamanunzuroonaa naqtabis min nnoorikum qeelarji'u waraa'akum fal tamisu noora faduriba baynahum bisoor llaahu baabu baatinuhu feehir-rahmatu wazaahiruhu min qibal ihil'azaab
Yunaadoonahum 'al am nakum mma'akum qaal u bal aa wal aakinnakum fatantum 'anfusakum watarabbastum wartabtum wagharratkumul amaaneeyu hattaa jaa'a 'amrul laahi wagharrakum bil laahil gharoor
Fal yawma laa yu'khazu minkum fidyat wal aa minal lazeena kafaru mawaakumun-naaru heea mawlaakum wabi'sal maseer

'al am yani lil lazeena 'aamanooaa 'an takhsha'a qul oobuhum lizikril laahi wamaa nazal a minal haqqi wal aa yakoonu kal lazeena 'ootul kitaaba min qablu fataal a 'al ayhimul amadu faqasat qul oobuhum wakatheer mminhum faasiqoon
A'lamooaa 'annal laaha yuhyil arda ba'da mawtihaa qad bayyannaa lakumul ayaati la'al lakum ta'qil oon
'innal mussaddiqeena wal mussaddiqaati waaqradul laaha qardana hasana yudaa'afu lahum wal ahum 'ajr kareem
Wal lazeena 'aamanu bil laahi warusul ihiaa 'ul aa'ika humus-siddeeqoona wash-shuhadaa'u 'inda rabbihim lahum 'ajruhum wanooruhum wal lazeena kafaru wakazzabu biayaatinaa 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabul jaheem

A'lamooaa 'annamaal hayawaatud-dunyaa la'ib wal ahw wazeenat watafaakhuru baynakum watakaathur fee al amwaal i wal awlaadi kamathal i ghaythin 'a'jabal kuffaara nabaatuhu thumma yaheeju fataraahu musfarra thumma yakoonu hutaama wafee al aakhirati 'azaab shadeed wamaghfirat mminal laahi waridwaanw wamaal hayawaatud-dunyaa 'il laa mataa'ul ghuroor

Saabiqooaa 'il aa maghfirat mmir rrabbikum wajannatin 'arduhaa ka'ardis-samaa'i wal ardi 'u'iddat lil lazeena 'aamanu bil laahi warusul ihi zaal ika fadlul laahi yu'teehi many yashaa'u wal laahu zoo al fadlil'azeem
Maa 'asaaba mim mmuseebat fee al ardi wal aa feeaa 'anfusikum 'il laa fee kitaab mmin qabli 'an nnabraahaa 'inna zaal ika 'al aal laahi yaseer
Llikaylaa tasawa 'al aa maa faatakum wal aa tafrahu bimaa 'aataakum wal laahu laa yuhibbu kul la mukhtaal fakhoor
Al lazeena yabkhal oona wayamuroonan-naasa bil bukhli wamany yatawal la fainnal laaha hooal ghaneeyul hameed

Laqad 'arsal naa rusul anaa bil bayyinaati waanzal naa ma'ahumul kitaaba wal meezaana leeaqooman-naasu bil qisti waanzal naal hadeeda feehi bas shadeed wamanaafi'u lin-naasi wal eea'lamal laahu many yansuruhu warusul ahu bil ghaybi 'innal laaha qaweeyun 'azeez
Wal aqad 'arsal naa nooha waibraaheema waja'al naa fee zurriyyatihimaan-nuboowata wal kitaaba faminhum mmuhtad wakatheer mminhum faasiqoon

Thumma qaffaynaa 'al aa 'aathaarihim birusul inaa waqaffaynaa bi'eesaabni maryama wa'aataynaahul injeela waja'al naa fee qul oobil lazeenattaba'oohu rafat warahmat warahbaaniyyatan abtada'oohaa maa katabnaahaa 'al ayhim 'il laabtighaa'a ridwaanil laahi famaa ra'awhaa haqqa ri'ayatihaa faataynaal lazeena 'aamanu minhum 'ajrahum wakatheer mminhum faasiqoon
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanuttaqul laaha wa'aaminu birasoolihi yu'tikum kiflayni mir rrahmatihi wayaj'al-lakum noora tamshoona bihi wayaghfir lakum wal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Lli'al laa ya'lama 'ahlul kitaabi 'al laa yaqdiroona 'al aa shay' mmin fadlil laahi waannal fadla beeadil laahi yu'teehi many yashaa'u wal laahu zoo al fadlil'azeem
Qad sami'al laahu qawlal latee tujaadil uka fee zawjihaa watashtakeeaa 'il aal laahi wal laahu yasma'u tahaawurakumaa 'innal laaha samee'u baseer

Al lazeena yuzaahiroona minkum mmin nnisaa'ihim mmaa hunna 'ummahaatihim 'in 'ummahaatuhum 'il laal laaee wal adnahum wainnahum layaqooloona munkara mminal qawli wazoora wainnal laaha la'afoowun ghafoor
Wal lazeena yuzaahiroona min nnisaa'ihim thumma ya'oodoona limaa qaal u fatahreeru raqabat mmin qabli 'any yatamaassaa zaal ikum too'azoona bihi wal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer

Famal llam yajid faseeaamu shahrayni mutataabi'ayni min qabli 'any yatamaassaa famal llam yastati' fait'aamu sitteena miskeena zaal ika litu'minu bil laahi warasoolihi watil ka hudoodul laahi wal il kaafireena 'azaabun 'al eem
'innal lazeena yuhaaddoonal laaha warasoolahu kubitu kamaa kubital lazeena min qablihim waqad 'anzal naa 'ayaati bayyinaat wal il kaafireena 'azaab mmuheen
Yawma yab'athuhumul laahu jamee'a fayunabbi'uhum bimaa 'amil ooaa 'ahsaahul laahu wanasoohu wal laahu 'al aa kul li shay' shaheed

'al am tara 'annal laaha ya'lamu maa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardi maa yakoonu min nnajwaa thal aathatin 'il laa hooa raabi'uhum wal aa khamsatin 'il laa hooa saadisuhum wal aa 'adnaa min zaal ika wal aa 'akthara 'il laa hooa ma'ahum 'ayna maa kaanu thumma yunabbi'uhum bimaa 'amil u yawmal qeeaamati 'innal laaha bikul li shay'in 'al eem

'al am tara 'il aal lazeena nuhu 'anin-najwaa thumma ya'oodoona limaa nuhu 'anhu wayatanaajawna bil ithmi wal'udwaani wama'seeatir-rasooli waizaa jaa'ooka hayyawka bimaa lam yuhayyika bihil laahu wayaqooloona feeaa 'anfusihim lawlaa yu'azzibunaal laahu bimaa naqoolu hasbuhum jahannamu yaslawnahaa fabi'sal maseer
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'izaa tanaajaytum fal aa tatanaajawa bil ithmi wal'udwaani wama'seeatir-rasooli watanaajawa bil birri wat-taqwaa wattaqul laahal lazeeaa 'il ayhi tuhsharoon
'innamaan-najwaa minash-shaytaani leeahzunal lazeena 'aamanu wal aysa bidaarrihim shayana 'il laa biiznil laahi wa'al aal laahi fal yatawakkal il mu'minoon

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'izaa qeela lakum tafassahu fee al majaal isi fafsahu yafsahil laahu lakum waizaa qeelanshuzu fanshuzu yarfa'il laahul lazeena 'aamanu minkum wal lazeena 'ootul'il ma darajaat wal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'izaa naajaytumur-rasoola faqaddimu bayna yaday najwaakum sadaqat zaal ika khayr llakum waatharu fail llam tajidu fainnal laaha ghafoor rraheem
'aashfaqtum 'an tuqaddimu bayna yaday najwaakum sadaqaat faiz lam taf'al u wataabal laahu 'al aykum faaqeemus-sal aata wa'aatuz-zakaata waatee'ul laaha warasoolahu wal laahu khabeeru bimaa ta'mal oon
'al am tara 'il aal lazeena tawal lawa qawmana ghadibal laahu 'al ayhim mmaa hum mminkum wal aa minhum wayahlifoona 'al aal kazibi wahum ya'lamoon
'a'addal laahu lahum 'azaaba shadeedana 'innahum saa'a maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Attakhazooaa 'aymaanahum junnat fasaddu 'an sabeelil laahi fal ahum 'azaab mmuheen
Llan tughneea 'anhum 'amwaal uhum wal aa 'awlaaduhum mminal laahi shayana 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabun-naari hum feehaa khaal idoon
Yawma yab'athuhumul laahu jamee'a fayahlifoona lahu kamaa yahlifoona lakum wayahsaboona 'annahum 'al aa shay'in 'al aa 'innahum humul kaaziboon
Astahwaza 'al ayhimush-shaytaanu faansaahum zikral laahi 'ul aa'ika hizbush-shaytaani 'al aa 'inna hizbash-shaytaani humul khaasiroon
'innal lazeena yuhaaddoonal laaha warasoolahuaa 'ul aa'ika fee al azal leen
Katabal laahu laaghlibanna 'anaa warusul eeaa 'innal laaha qaweeyun 'azeez

Llaa tajidu qawma yu'minoona bil laahi wal yawmil aakhiri yooaaddoona man haaddal laaha warasoolahu wal aw kaanooaa 'aabaa'ahum 'aw 'abnaa'ahum 'aw 'ikhwaanahum 'aw 'asheeratahum 'ul aa'ika kataba fee qul oobihimul eemaana wayyadahum birooh mminhu wayudkhil uhum jannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa radeeal laahu 'anhum waradu 'anhu 'ul aa'ika hizbul laahi 'al aa 'inna hizbal laahi humul muflihoon
Sabbaha lil laahi maa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardi wahooal'azeezul hakeem

Hooal lazeeaa 'akhrajal lazeena kafaru min 'ahlil kitaabi min deeaarihim liawwal il hashri maa zanantum 'any yakhruju wazannooaa 'annahum mmaani'atuhum husoonuhum mminal laahi faataahumul laahu min haythu lam yahtasibu waqazafa fee qul oobihimur-ru'ba yukhriboona buyootahum biaydeehim waydee al mu'mineena fa'tabiru yaaoolee al absaar
Wal awlaa 'an katabal laahu 'al ayhimul jal aa'a la'azzabahum fee ad-dunyaa wal ahum fee al aakhirati 'azaabun-naar
Zaal ika biannahum shaaqqul laaha warasoolahu wamany yushaaqqil laaha fainnal laaha shadeedul'iqaab
Maa qata'tum mmil lleenatin 'aw taraktumoohaa qaa'imatan 'al aa 'usoolihaa fabiiznil laahi wal eeukhzeeal faasiqeen
Wamaa 'afaa'al laahu 'al aa rasoolihi minhum famaa 'awjaftum 'al ayhi min khayl wal aa rikaab wal aakinnal laaha yusal litu rusul ahu 'al aa many yashaa'u wal laahu 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer

Mmaa 'afaa'al laahu 'al aa rasoolihi min 'ahlil quraa fal il laahi wal ir-rasooli wal izee al qurbaa wal yataamaa wal masaakeeni wabnis-sabeeli kay laa yakoona doolata baynal aghneeaa'i minkum wamaa 'aataakumur-rasoolu fakhuzoohu wamaa nahaakum 'anhu fantahu wattaqul laaha 'innal laaha shadeedul'iqaab
Lil fuqaraa'il muhaajireenal lazeena 'ukhriju min deeaarihim waamwaal ihim yabtaghoona fadla mminal laahi waridwaana wayansuroonal laaha warasoolahuaa 'ul aa'ika humus-saadiqoon

Wal lazeena tabawwa'oo ad-daara wal eemaana min qablihim yuhibboona man haajara 'il ayhim wal aa yajidoona fee sudoorihim haajat mmimmaa 'ootu wayu'thiroona 'al aa 'anfusihim wal aw kaana bihim khasaasat wamany yooqa shuhha nafsihi faul aa'ika humul muflihoon

Wal lazeena jaa'oo mim ba'dihim yaqooloona rabbanaaghfir lanaa wal iikhwaaninaal lazeena sabaqoonaa bil eemaani wal aa taj'al fee qul oobinaa ghil la llil lazeena 'aamanu rabbanaa 'innaka ra'oof rraheem

'al am tara 'il aal lazeena naafaqu yaqooloona liikhwaanihimul lazeena kafaru min 'ahlil kitaabi la'in 'ukhrijtum lanakhrujanna ma'akum wal aa nutee'u feekum 'ahadana 'abada wain qootil tum lanansurannakum wal laahu yashhadu 'innahum lakaaziboon
La'in 'ukhriju laa yakhrujoona ma'ahum wal a'in qootil u laa yansuroonahum wal a'in nnasaroohum layooal lunnal adbaara thumma laa yunsaroon
Laantum 'ashaddu rahbat fee sudoorihim mminal laahi zaal ika biannahum qawm llaa yafqahoon
Laa yuqaatil oonakum jamee'ana 'il laa fee qura mmuhassanatin 'aw minw waraa'i juduri basuhum baynahum shadeed tahsabuhum jamee'a waqul oobuhum shattaa zaal ika biannahum qawm llaa ya'qil oon
Kamathal il lazeena min qablihim qareeba zaaqu wabaal a 'amrihim wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Kamathal ish-shaytaani 'iz qaal a lil insaanikfur fal ammaa kafara qaal a 'innee bareeaa' mminka 'inneeaa 'akhaaful laaha rabbal'aal ameen
Fakaana 'aaqibatahumaa 'annahumaa fee an-naari khaal idayni feehaa wazaal ika jazaa'uaz-zaal imeen
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanuttaqul laaha wal tanzur nafs mmaa qaddamat lighad wattaqul laaha 'innal laaha khabeeru bimaa ta'mal oon
Wal aa takoonu kal lazeena nasul laaha faansaahum 'anfusahum 'ul aa'ika humul faasiqoon
Laa yastaweeaa 'ashaabun-naari waashaabul jannati 'ashaabul jannati humul faa'izoon
Law 'anzal naa haazaal qur'aana 'al aa jabal-laraytahu khaashi'a mmutasaddi'a mmin khashyatil laahi watil kal amthaal u nadribuhaa lin-naasi la'al laahum yatafakkaroon
Hooal laahul lazee laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa 'aal imul ghaybi wash-shahaadati hooar-rahmaanur-raheem
Hooal laahul lazee laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooal mal ikul quddoosus-sal aamul mu'minul muhayminul'azeezul jabbaarul mutakabbiru subhaanal laahi 'ammaa yushrikoon
Hooal laahul khaal iqul baari'ul musawwiru lahul asmaa'ul husnaa yusabbihu lahu maa fee as-samaawaati wal ardi wahooal'azeezul hakeem

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa tattakhizu 'adoowee wa'adoowakum 'awleeaa'a tul qoona 'il ayhim bil mawaddati waqad kafaru bimaa jaa'akum mminal haqqi yukhrijoonar-rasoola waiyyaakum 'an tu'minu bil laahi rabbikum 'in kuntum kharajtum jihaada fee sabeelee wabtighaa'a mardaatee tusirroona 'il ayhim bil mawaddati waanaa 'a'lamu bimaa 'akhfaytum wamaa 'a'lantum wamany yaf'al hu minkum faqad dal la sawaa'as-sabeel
'iny yathqafookum yakoonu lakum 'a'daa' wayabsutooaa 'il aykum 'aydeeahum waal sinatahum bis-sooaa'i wawaddu law takfuroon
Lan tanfa'akum 'arhaamukum wal aa 'awlaadukum yawmal qeeaamati yafsil u baynakum wal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona baseer

Qad kaanat lakum 'uswatun hasanat feeaa 'ibraaheema wal lazeena ma'ahuaa 'iz qaal u liqawmihim 'innaa bura'aa'ua minkum wamimmaa ta'budoona min doonil laahi kafarnaa bikum wabadaa baynanaa wabaynakumul'adaawatu wal baghdaa'u 'abadana hattaa tu'minu bil laahi wahdahuaa 'il laa qawla 'ibraaheema liabeehi laastaghfiranna laka wamaa 'amliku laka minal laahi min shay' rrabbanaa 'al ayka tawakkal naa wail ayka 'anabnaa wail aykal maseer
Rabbanaa laa taj'al naa fitnat llil lazeena kafaru waghfir lanaa rabbanaa 'innaka 'antal'azeezul hakeem
Laqad kaana lakum feehim 'uswatun hasanat lliman kaana yarjul laaha wal yawmal aakhira wamany yatawal la fainnal laaha hooal ghaneeyul hameed
'asaal laahu 'any yaj'al a baynakum wabaynal lazeena 'aadaytum mminhum mmawaddat wal laahu qadeer wal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Llaa yanhaakumul laahu 'anil lazeena lam yuqaatil ookum fee ad-deeni wal am yukhrijookum mmin deeaarikum 'an tabarroohum watuqsitooaa 'il ayhim 'innal laaha yuhibbul muqsiteen
'innamaa yanhaakumul laahu 'anil lazeena qaatal ookum fee ad-deeni waakhrajookum mmin deeaarikum wazaaharu 'al aa 'ikhraajikum 'an tawal lawhum wamany yatawal laahum faul aa'ika humuz-zaal imoon

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'izaa jaa'akumul mu'minaatu muhaajiraat famtahinoohunnal laahu 'a'lamu bieemaanihinna fain 'al imtumoohunna mu'minaat fal aa tarji'oohunna 'il aal kuffaari laa hunna hil l llaahum wal aa hum yahil loona lahunna wa'aatoohum mmaa 'anfaqu wal aa junaaha 'al aykum 'an tankihoohunna 'izaa 'aataytumoohunna 'ujoorahunna wal aa tumsiku bi'isamil kawaafiri wasal u maa 'anfaqtum wal yasal u maa 'anfaqu zaal ikum hukmul laahi yahkumu baynakum wal laahu 'al eemun hakeem
Wain faatakum shay' mmin 'azwaajikum 'il aal kuffaari fa'aaqabtum faatul lazeena zahabat 'azwaajuhum mmithla maa 'anfaqu wattaqul laahal lazeeaa 'antum bihi mu'minoon

Yayyuhaan-nabeeyu 'izaa jaa'akal mu'minaatu yubayi'naka 'al aa 'al llaa yushrikna bil laahi shaya wal aa yasriqna wal aa yazneena wal aa yaqtul na 'awlaadahunna wal aa yateena bibuhtaany yaftareenahu bayna 'aydeehinna waarjul ihinna wal aa ya'seenaka fee ma'roof fabayi'hunna wastaghfir lahunnal laaha 'innal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa tatawal lawa qawmana ghadibal laahu 'al ayhim qad ya'isu minal aakhirati kamaa ya'isal kuffaaru min 'ashaabil quboor
Sabbaha lil laahi maa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardi wahooal'azeezul hakeem
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu lima taqooloona maa laa taf'al oon
Kabura maqtana 'indal laahi 'an taqoolu maa laa taf'al oon
'innal laaha yuhibbul lazeena yuqaatil oona fee sabeelihi saffa kaannahum bunyaam mmarsoos
Waiz qaal a moosaa liqawmihi yaaqawmi lima tu'zoonanee waqad tta'lamoona 'annee rasoolul laahi 'il aykum fal ammaa zaaghooaa 'azaaghal laahu qul oobahum wal laahu laa yahdee al qawmal faasiqeen

Waiz qaal a 'eesaabnu maryama yaabaneeaa 'israa'eela 'innee rasoolul laahi 'il aykum mmusaddiqa llimaa bayna yadayya minat-tawraati wamubashshiraa birasool yatee mim ba'dee asmuhuaa 'ahmadu fal ammaa jaa'ahum bil bayyinaati qaal u haazaa sihr mmubeen
Waman 'azlamu mimmaniftaraa 'al aal laahil kaziba wahooa yud'aa 'il aal islaami wal laahu laa yahdee al qawmaz-zaal imeen
Yureedoona leeutfiu nooral laahi biafwaahihim wal laahu mutimmu noorihi wal aw karihal kaafiroon
Hooal lazeeaa 'arsal a rasoolahu bil hudaa wadeenil haqqi leeuzhirahu 'al aad-deeni kul lihi wal aw karihal mushrikoon
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu hal 'adul lukum 'al aa tijaarat tunjeekum mmin 'azaabin 'al eem
Tu'minoona bil laahi warasoolihi watujaahidoona fee sabeelil laahi biamwaal ikum waanfusikum zaal ikum khayr llakum 'in kuntum ta'lamoon
Yaghfir lakum zunoobakum wayudkhil kum jannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru wamasaakina tayyibat fee jannaati 'adn zaal ikal fawzul'azeem
Waukhraa tuhibboonahaa nasr mminal laahi wafath qareeb wabashshiril mu'mineen

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu koonooaa 'ansaaral laahi kamaa qaal a 'eesaabnu maryama lil hawaareeyina man 'ansaareeaa 'il aal laahi qaal al hawaareeyoona nahnu 'ansaarul laahi faamanat ttaa'ifat mmim baneeaa 'israa'eela wakafarat ttaa'ifat fayyadnaal lazeena 'aamanu 'al aa 'adoowihim faasbahu zaahireen
Yusabbihu lil laahi maa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardil mal ikil quddoosil'azeezil hakeem
Hooal lazee ba'atha fee al ummeeyina rasoola mminhum yatlu 'al ayhim 'ayaatihi wayuzakkeehim wayu'al limuhumul kitaaba wal hikmata wain kaanu min qablu lafee dal aal mmubeen
Wa'aakhareena minhum lammaa yal haqu bihim wahooal'azeezul hakeem
Zaal ika fadlul laahi yu'teehi many yashaa'u wal laahu zoo al fadlil'azeem
Mathal ul lazeena hummil ut-tawraata thumma lam yahmil oohaa kamathal il himaari yahmil u 'asfaaraa bi'sa mathal ul qawmil lazeena kazzabu biayaatil laahi wal laahu laa yahdee al qawmaz-zaal imeen
Qul yayyuhaal lazeena haadooaa 'in za'amtum 'annakum 'awleeaa'u lil laahi min doonin-naasi fatamannawual mawta 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Wal aa yatamannawnahuaa 'abadaa bimaa qaddamat 'aydeehim wal laahu 'al eemu biz-zaal imeen
Qul 'innal mawtal lazee tafirroona minhu fainnahu mul aaqeekum thumma turaddoona 'il aa 'aal imil ghaybi wash-shahaadati fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'izaa noodeea lis-sal awaati miny yawmil jumu'ati fas'awa 'il aa zikril laahi wazarul bay'a zaal ikum khayr llakum 'in kuntum ta'lamoon
Faizaa qudeeatis-sal aatu fantashiru fee al ardi wabtaghu min fadlil laahi wazkurul laaha katheera lla'al lakum tuflihoon
Waizaa raawa tijaaratan 'aw lahwananfaddooaa 'il ayhaa watarakooka qaa'ima qul maa 'indal laahi khayr mminal laahwi waminat-tijaarati wal laahu khayrur-raaziqeen
'izaa jaa'akal munaafiqoona qaal u nashhadu 'innaka larasoolul laahi wal laahu ya'lamu 'innaka larasooluhu wal laahu yashhadu 'innal munaafiqeena lakaaziboon
Attakhazooaa 'aymaanahum junnat fasaddu 'an sabeelil laahi 'innahum saa'a maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Zaal ika biannahum 'aamanu thumma kafaru fatubi'a 'al aa qul oobihim fahum laa yafqahoon
Waizaa raytahum tu'jibuka 'ajsaamuhum wainy yaqoolu tasma' liqawlihim kaannahum khushub mmusannadat yahsaboona kul la sayhatin 'al ayhim humul'adoowu fahzarhum qaatal ahumul laahu 'annaa yu'fakoon
Waizaa qeela lahum ta'aal awa yastaghfir lakum rasoolul laahi lawwawa ru'oosahum waraytahum yasuddoona wahum mmustakbiroon
Sawaa'un 'al ayhim 'astaghfarta lahum 'am lam tastaghfir lahum lany yaghfiral laahu lahum 'innal laaha laa yahdee al qawmal faasiqeen
Humul lazeena yaqooloona laa tunfiqu 'al aa man 'inda rasoolil laahi hattaa yanfaddu wal il laahi khazaa'inus-samaawaati wal ardi wal aakinnal munaafiqeena laa yafqahoon
Yaqooloona la'ir rraja'naa 'il aal madeenati layukhrijannal a'azzu minhaal azal la wal il laahil'izzatu wal irasoolihi wal il mu'mineena wal aakinnal munaafiqeena laa ya'lamoon
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu laa tul hikum 'amwaal ukum wal aa 'awlaadukum 'an zikril laahi wamany yaf'al zaal ika faul aa'ika humul khaasiroon
Waanfiqu mim mmaa razaqnaakum mmin qabli 'any yateea 'ahadakumul mawtu fayaqoola rabbi lawlaa 'akhkhartaneeaa 'il aa 'ajal qareeb faassaddaqa waakum mminas-saal iheen
Wal any yu'akhkhiral laahu nafsana 'izaa jaa'a 'ajal uhaa wal laahu khabeeru bimaa ta'mal oon
Yusabbihu lil laahi maa fee as-samaawaati wamaa fee al ardi lahul mul ku wal ahul hamdu wahooa 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
Hooal lazee khal aqakum faminkum kaafir waminkum mmu'minw wal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona baseer
Khal aqas-samaawaati wal arda bil haqqi wasawwarakum faahsana sooarakum wail ayhil maseer
Ya'lamu maa fee as-samaawaati wal ardi waya'lamu maa tusirroona wamaa tu'linoona wal laahu 'al eemu bizaatis-sudoor
'al am yatikum naba'ual lazeena kafaru min qablu fazaaqu wabaal a 'amrihim wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Zaal ika biannahu kaanat ttateehim rusul uhum bil bayyinaati faqaal ooaa 'abashar yahdoonanaa fakafaru watawal la wwastaghnaal laahu wal laahu ghaneeyun hameed
Za'amal lazeena kafarooaa 'al llany yub'athu qul bal aa warabbee latub'athunna thumma latunabba'unna bimaa 'amil tum wazaal ika 'al aal laahi yaseer
Faaminu bil laahi warasoolihi wan-nooril lazeeaa 'anzal naa wal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer

Yawma yajma'ukum leeawmil jam'i zaal ika yawmut-taghaabuni wamany yu'mim bil laahi waya'mal saal iha yukaffir 'anhu sayyiaatihi wayudkhil hu jannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa 'abada zaal ikal fawzul'azeem
Wal lazeena kafaru wakazzabu biayaatinaa 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabun-naari khaal ideena feehaa wabi'sal maseer
Maa 'asaaba mim mmuseebatin 'il laa biiznil laahi wamany yu'mim bil laahi yahdi qal bahu wal laahu bikul li shay'in 'al eem
Waatee'ul laaha waatee'ur-rasoola fain tawal laytum fainnamaa 'al aa rasoolinaal bal aaghul mubeen
Al laahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa wa'al aal laahi fal yatawakkal il mu'minoon
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanooaa 'inna min 'azwaajikum waawlaadikum 'adoowa llakum fahzaroohum wain ta'fu watasfahu wataghfiru fainnal laaha ghafoor rraheem
'innamaa 'amwaal ukum waawlaadukum fitnat wal laahu 'indahuaa 'ajrun 'azeem
Fattaqul laaha maastata'tum wasma'u waatee'u waanfiqu khayra llianfusikum wamany yooqa shuhha nafsihi faul aa'ika humul muflihoon
'in tuqridul laaha qardana hasana yudaa'ifhu lakum wayaghfir lakum wal laahu shakoorun hal eem
'aal imul ghaybi wash-shahaadatil'azeezul hakeem

Yayyuhaan-nabeeyu 'izaa tal laqtumun-nisaa'a fatal liqoohunna li'iddatihinna waahsul'iddata wattaqul laaha rabbakum laa tukhrijoohunna mim buyootihinna wal aa yakhrujna 'il laa 'any yateena bifaahishat mmubayyinat watil ka hudoodul laahi wamany yata'adda hudoodal laahi faqad zal ama nafsahu laa tadree la'al lal laaha yuhdithu ba'da zaal ika 'amr

Faizaa bal aghna 'ajal ahunna faamsikoohunna bima'roofin 'aw faariqoohunna bima'roof waashhidu zaway 'adl mminkum waaqeemush-shahaadata lil laahi zaal ikum yoo'azu bihi man kaana yu'minu bil laahi wal yawmil aakhiri wamany yattaqil laaha yaj'al-laahu makhraj
Wayarzuqhu min haythu laa yahtasibu wamany yatawakkal 'al aal laahi fahooa hasbuhuaa 'innal laaha baal ighu 'amrihi qad ja'al al laahu likul li shay' qadr

Wal laaee ya'isna minal maheedi min nnisaa'ikum 'inirtabtum fa'iddatuhunna thal aathatu 'ashhur wal laaee lam yahidna waoolaatul ahmaal i 'ajal uhunna 'any yada'na hamlahunna wamany yattaqil laaha yaj'al-laahu min 'amrihi yusr
Zaal ika 'amrul laahi 'anzal ahuaa 'il aykum wamany yattaqil laaha yukaffir 'anhu sayyiaatihi wayu'zim lahuaa 'ajran

'askinoohunna min haythu sakantum mminw wujdikum wal aa tudaarroohunna litudayyiqu 'al ayhinna wain kunna 'oolaati haml faanfiqu 'al ayhinna hattaa yada'na hamlahunna fain 'arda'na lakum faatoohunna 'ujoorahunna watamiru baynakum bima'roof wain ta'aasartum fasaturdi'u lahuaa 'ukhra
Leeunfiq zoo sa'at mmin sa'atihi waman qudira 'al ayhi rizquhu fal yunfiq mimmaa 'aataahul laahu laa yukal liful laahu nafsana 'il laa maa 'aataahaa sayaj'al ul laahu ba'da 'usr yusr
Wakayyim mmin qaryatin 'atat 'an 'amri rabbihaa warusul ihi fahaasabnaahaa hisaaba shadeeda wa'azzabnaahaa 'azaaba nnukr
Fazaaqat wabaal a 'amrihaa wakaana 'aaqibatu 'amrihaa khusran
'a'addal laahu lahum 'azaaba shadeeda fattaqul laaha yaaoolee al al baabil lazeena 'aamanu qad 'anzal al laahu 'il aykum zikr

Rrasoola yatlu 'al aykum 'ayaatil laahi mubayyinaat lleeukhrijal lazeena 'aamanu wa'amil us-saal ihaati minaz-zul umaati 'il aan-noori wamany yu'mim bil laahi waya'mal saal iha yudkhil hu jannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa 'abada qad 'ahsanal laahu lahu rizqan
Al laahul lazee khal aqa sab'a samaawaat waminal ardi mithlahunna yatanazzal ul amru baynahunna lita'lamooaa 'annal laaha 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer waannal laaha qad 'ahaata bikul li shay'in 'il ma
Yayyuhaan-nabeeyu lima tuharrimu maa 'ahal lal laahu laka tabtaghee mardaata 'azwaajika wal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Qad faradal laahu lakum tahil lata 'aymaanikum wal laahu mawlaakum wahooal'al eemul hakeem

Waiz 'asarran-nabeeyu 'il aa ba'di 'azwaajihi hadeetha fal ammaa nabbaat bihi waazharahul laahu 'al ayhi 'arrafa ba'dahu waa'rada 'am ba'd fal ammaa nabbaahaa bihi qaal at man 'anbaaka haazaa qaal a nabbaaneeal'al eemul khabeer
'in tatoobaa 'il aal laahi faqad saghat qul oobukumaa wain tazaaharaa 'al ayhi fainnal laaha hooa mawlaahu wajibreelu wasaal ihul mu'mineena wal mal aa'ikatu ba'da zaal ika zaheer
'asaa rabbuhuaa 'in tal laqakunna 'any yubdil ahuaa 'azwaajana khayra mminkunna muslimaat mmu'minaat qaanitaat taa'ibaatin 'aabidaat saa'ihaat thayyibaat waabkaar
Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu qooaa 'anfusakum waahleekum naara waqooduhaan-naasu wal hijaaratu 'al ayhaa mal aa'ikatun ghil aaz shidaad llaa ya'soonal laaha maa 'amarahum wayaf'al oona maa yu'maroon
Yayyuhaal lazeena kafaru laa ta'tazirul yawma 'innamaa tujzawna maa kuntum ta'mal oon

Yayyuhaal lazeena 'aamanu toobooaa 'il aal laahi tawbat nnasoohana 'asaa rabbukum 'any yukaffira 'ankum sayyiaatikum wayudkhil akum jannaat tajree min tahtihaal anhaaru yawma laa yukhzee al laahun-nabiyya wal lazeena 'aamanu ma'ahu nooruhum yas'aa bayna 'aydeehim wabiaymaanihim yaqooloona rabbanaa 'atmim lanaa nooranaa waghfir lanaa 'innaka 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
Yayyuhaan-nabeeyu jaahidil kuffaara wal munaafiqeena waghluz 'al ayhim wamawaahum jahannamu wabi'sal maseer

Darabal laahu mathal a llil lazeena kafarumraata nooh wamraata loot kaanataa tahta 'abdayni min 'ibaadinaa saal ihayni fakhaanataahumaa fal am yughneeaa 'anhumaa minal laahi shaya waqeeladkhul aan-naara ma'ad-daakhil een
Wadarabal laahu mathal a llil lazeena 'aamanumraata fir'awna 'iz qaal at rabbibni lee 'indaka bayta fee al jannati wanajjinee min fir'awna wa'amal ihi wanajjinee minal qawmiz-zaal imeen
Wamaryamabnata 'imraanal lateeaa 'ahsanat farjahaa fanafakhnaa feehi mir rroohinaa wasaddaqat bikal imaati rabbihaa wakutubihi wakaanat minal qaaniteen
Tabaarakal lazee beeadihil mul ku wahooa 'al aa kul li shay' qadeer
Al lazee khal aqal mawta wal hayawaata leeablooakum 'ayyukum 'ahsanu 'amal a wahooal'azeezul ghafoor
Al lazee khal aqa sab'a samaawaat tibaaqa mmaa taraa fee khal qir-rahmaani min tafaawut farji'il basara hal taraa min futoor
Thummarji'il basara karratayni yanqal ib 'il aykal basaru khaasi'a wahooa haseer
Wal aqad zayyannaas-samaa'ad-dunyaa bimasaabeeha waja'al naahaa rujooma llish-shayaateeni waa'tadnaa lahum 'azaabas-sa'eer
Wal il lazeena kafaru birabbihim 'azaabu jahannama wabi'sal maseer
'izaa 'ul qu feehaa sami'u lahaa shaheeqa waheea tafoor
Takaadu tamayyazu minal ghayzi kul lamaa 'ul qeea feehaa fawj saal ahum khazanatuhaa 'al am yatikum nazeer
Qaal u bal aa qad jaa'anaa nazeer fakazzabnaa waqul naa maa nazzal al laahu min shay'in 'in 'antum 'il laa fee dal aal kabeer
Waqaal u law kunnaa nasma'u 'aw na'qil u maa kunnaa feeaa 'ashaabis-sa'eer
Fa'tarafu bizanbihim fasuhqa lliashaabis-sa'eer
'innal lazeena yakhshawna rabbahum bil ghaybi lahum mmaghfirat waajr kabeer
Waasirru qawlakum 'awijharu bihiaa 'innahu 'al eemu bizaatis-sudoor
'al aa ya'lamu man khal aqa wahooal lateeful khabeer
Hooal lazee ja'al a lakumul arda zal oola famshu fee manaakibihaa wakul u mir rrizqihi wail ayhin-nushoor
'aamintum mman fee as-samaa'i 'any yakhsifa bikumul arda faizaa heea tamoor
'am 'amintum mman fee as-samaa'i 'any yursil a 'al aykum haasiba fasata'lamoona kayfa nazeer
Wal aqad kazzabal lazeena min qablihim fakayfa kaana nakeer
'awal am yarawa 'il aat-tayri fawqahum saaffaat wayaqbidna maa yumsikuhunna 'il laar-rahmaanu 'innahu bikul li shay'i baseer
'amman haazaal lazee hooa jund llakum yansurukum mmin doonir-rahmaani 'inil kaafiroona 'il laa fee ghuroor
'amman haazaal lazee yarzuqukum 'in 'amsaka rizqahu bal-lajju fee 'utoow wanufoor
'afamany yamshee mukibbana 'al aa wajhihiaa 'ahdaa 'ammany yamshee sawiyyana 'al aa siraat mmustaqeem
Qul hooal lazeeaa 'anshaakum waja'al a lakumus-sam'a wal absaara wal afidata qal eela mmaa tashkuroon
Qul hooal lazee zaraakum fee al ardi wail ayhi tuhsharoon
Wayaqooloona mataa haazaal wa'du 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul 'innamaal'il mu 'indal laahi wainnamaa 'anaa nazeer mmubeen
Fal ammaa raawhu zul fat seeaat wujoohul lazeena kafaru waqeela haazaal lazee kuntum bihi tadda'oon
Qul 'ara'aytum 'in 'ahlakaneeal laahu wamam mma'eea 'aw rahimanaa famany yujeerul kaafireena min 'azaabin 'al eem
Qul hooar-rahmaanu 'aamannaa bihi wa'al ayhi tawakkal naa fasata'lamoona man hooa fee dal aal mmubeen
Qul 'ara'aytum 'in 'asbaha maa'ukum ghawra famany yateekum bimaa' mma'een
Naa wal qal ami wamaa yasturoon
Maa 'anta bini'mati rabbika bimajnoon
Wainna laka laajrana ghayra mamnoon
Wainnaka la'al aa khul uqin 'azeem
Fasatubsiru wayubsiroon
Biayyyikumul maftoon

Fal aa tuti'il mukazzibeen
Waddu law tudhinu fayudhinoon

'al llaa yadkhul annahaal yawma 'al aykum mmiskeen
Waghadawa 'al aa hard qaadireen
Fal ammaa raawhaa qaal ooaa 'innaa ladaal loon

Qaal a 'awsatuhum 'al am 'aqul-lakum lawlaa tusabbihoon
Qaal u subhaana rabbinaa 'innaa kunnaa zaal imeen
Faaqbal a ba'duhum 'al aa ba'd yatal aawamoon
Qaal u yaawaylanaa 'innaa kunnaa taagheen
'asaa rabbunaa 'any yubdil anaa khayra mminhaa 'innaa 'il aa rabbinaa raaghiboon
Kazaal ikal'azaabu wal a'azaabul aakhirati 'akbaru law kaanu ya'lamoon
'inna lil muttaqeena 'inda rabbihim jannaatin-na'eem
'afanaj'al ul muslimeena kal mujrimeen
Maa lakum kayfa tahkumoon
'am lakum kitaab feehi tadrusoon
'inna lakum feehi lamaa takhayyaroon
'am lakum 'aymaanun 'al aynaa baal ighatun 'il aa yawmil qeeaamati 'inna lakum lamaa tahkumoon
Sal hum 'ayyuhum bizaal ika za'eem
'am lahum shurakaa'u fal yatu bishurakaa'ihim 'in kaanu saadiqeen
Yawma yukshafu 'an saaq wayud'awna 'il aas-sujoodi fal aa yastatee'oon
Khaashi'atan 'absaaruhum tarhaquhum zil lat waqad kaanu yud'awna 'il aas-sujoodi wahum saal imoon
Fazarnee wamany yukazzibu bihaazaal hadeethi sanastadrijuhum mmin haythu laa ya'lamoon
Waumlee lahum 'inna kaydee mateen
'am tasal uhum 'ajra fahum mmim mmaghram mmuthqal oon
'am 'indahumul ghaybu fahum yaktuboon
Fasbir lihukmi rabbika wal aa takun kasaahibil hooti 'iz naadaa wahooa makzoom
Llawlaa 'an tadaarakahu ni'mat mmir rrabbihi lanubiza bil'araa'i wahooa mazmoom
Fajtabaahu rabbuhu faja'al ahu minas-saal iheen
Wainy yakaadul lazeena kafaru layuzliqoonaka biabsaarihim lammaa sami'uz-zikra wayaqooloona 'innahu lamajnoon
Wamaa hooa 'il laa zikr llil'aal ameen

Fahal taraa lahum mmim baaqeeah
Wajaa'a fir'awnu waman qablahu wal mu'tafikaatu bil khaati'ah

'innaa lammaa taghaal maa'u hamal naakum fee al jaareeah
Linaj'al ahaa lakum tazkirat wata'eeahaa 'uzunw waa'eeah
Faizaa nufikha fee as-soori nafkhat waahidah
Wahumil atil ardu wal jibaal u fadukkataa dakkat waahidah
Fayawma'iz waqa'atil waaqi'ah
Wanshaqqatis-samaa'u faheea yawma'iz waaheeah
Wal mal aku 'al aa 'arjaa'ihaa wayahmil u 'arsha rabbika fawqahum yawma'iz thamaaneeah
Yawma'iz tu'radoona laa takhfaa minkum khaafeeah
Faammaa man 'ooteea kitaabahu beeameenihi fayaqoolu haa'umuqra'u kitaabeeah
'innee zanantu 'annee mul aaqin hisaabeeah

Wal am 'adri maa hisaabeeah

Sayaslaa naara zaata lahab
Wamraatuhu hammaal atal hatab
Fee jeedihaa habl mmim mmasad
Qul hooal laahu 'ahad
Al laahus-samad
Lam yal id wal am yoolad
Wal am yakul llaahu kufooana 'ahad
Qul 'a'oozu birabbil fal aq
Min sharri maa khal aq
Wamin sharri ghaasiqin 'izaa waqab
Wamin sharrin-naffaathaati fee al'uqad
Wamin sharri haasidin 'izaa hasad
Qul 'a'oozu birabbin-naas
Mal ikin-naas
'il aahin-naas
Min sharril waswaasil khannaas
Al lazee yooaswisu fee sudoorin-naas
Minal jinnati wan-naas
